examples.x: The old customs are dying.
His secret died with him (= he never told anyone).
The words died on my lips (= I stopped speaking).

senses.definition_vi: ngừng tồn tại; biến mất.

senses.definition: to stop working

examples.x: My phone died and I had no way to contact you.
The engine spluttered and died.
My car just died on me.

senses.definition_vi: ngừng hoạt động.

senses.definition: to want something or want to do something very much

examples.x: I'm dying for a glass of water.
I'm dying to know what happened.

senses.definition_vi: muốn một cái gì đó hoặc muốn làm một cái gì đó rất nhiều.

senses.definition: used to emphasize that you are telling the truth or will do what you promise

examples.x: I saw him do it—cross my heart.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn đang nói sự thật hoặc sẽ thực hiện lời hứa của mình.

senses.definition: to fail completely

examples.x: The play got terrible reviews and quickly died a death.

senses.definition_vi: thất bại hoàn toàn.

senses.definition: to die because you are old or ill
senses.definition_vi: chết hoặc bị bệnh và gục ngã với số lượng rất lớn.

senses.definition: to find something extremely funny

examples.x: I nearly died laughing when she said that.

senses.definition_vi: thấy một cái gì đó cực kỳ hài hước.

senses.definition: to die or become ill and fall down in very large numbers

examples.x: People were dropping like flies in the intense heat.

senses.definition_vi: chết hoặc bị bệnh và gục ngã với số lượng rất lớn.

senses.definition: a situation where you need to act in a very determined way or taking a great risk, because there is no alternative

examples.x: At this stage in the competition it's do or die.

senses.definition_vi: một tình huống mà bạn cần phải hành động một cách quyết đoán hoặc chấp nhận một rủi ro lớn, vì không có lựa chọn nào khác.

senses.definition: do not stop hoping
senses.definition_vi: đừng ngừng hy vọng.

senses.definition: used to say that things change very slowly
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng mọi thứ thay đổi rất chậm.

senses.definition: if you think something is to die for, you really want it, and would do anything to get it

examples.x: She was wearing a dress to die for.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nghĩ một cái gì đó đáng chết, bạn thực sự muốn nó và sẽ làm bất cứ điều gì để có được nó.

senses.definition: the food and drink that you eat and drink regularly

examples.x: to eat a healthy, balanced diet
I loved the Japanese diet of rice, vegetables and fish.
a vegetarian/vegan diet
The traditional Mediterranean diet is fairly high in fat.
to receive advice on diet

senses.definition_vi: thức ăn và đồ uống mà bạn ăn và uống thường xuyên.

senses.definition: a limited variety or amount of food that you eat for medical reasons or because you want to lose weight; a time when you only eat this limited variety or amount

examples.x: He followed a strict low-fat diet.
I decided to go on a diet (= to lose weight) before my holiday.
She is trying to lose weight through diet and exercise.
diet drinks (= with fewer calories than normal)
Lose pounds with our new diet plan!

senses.definition_vi: một lượng hạn chế hoặc giới hạn thực phẩm mà bạn ăn vì lý do y tế hoặc vì bạn muốn giảm cân; một khoảng thời gian bạn chỉ ăn loại thực phẩm hạn chế này.

senses.definition: a large amount of a limited range of activities

examples.x: Children today are brought up on a diet of video games and TV on demand.

senses.definition_vi: một lượng lớn các hoạt động trong một phạm vi hạn chế.

senses.definition: to be different from somebody/something

examples.x: They hold differing views.
French differs from English in this respect.

examples.cf: A and B differ (from each other)
examples.x: French and English differ in this respect.
Ideas on childcare may differ considerably between the parents.

senses.definition_vi: khác với ai đó/cái gì đó.

senses.definition: to disagree with somebody

examples.x: I have to differ with you on that.
Medical opinion differs as to how to treat the disease.

senses.definition_vi: không đồng ý với ai đó.

senses.definition: if two people agree to differ/disagree, they accept that they have different opinions about something, but they decide not to discuss it any longer

examples.x: We must just agree to differ on this.
In the end we agreed to disagree.
I think you're wrong. Let's just agree to differ.

senses.definition_vi: nếu hai người đồng ý bất đồng/không đồng ý, họ chấp nhận rằng họ có ý kiến khác nhau về một điều gì đó, nhưng họ quyết định không thảo luận về nó nữa.

senses.definition: used to say politely that you do not agree with something that has just been said

examples.x: ‘At least she is good at her job.’ ‘Oh, I beg to differ.’

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói một cách lịch sự rằng bạn không đồng ý với điều vừa được nói.

senses.definition: the way in which two people or things are not like each other; the way in which somebody/something has changed

examples.x: Americans and Brits speak the same language, but there are big cultural differences.
There are no significant differences between the education systems of the two countries.
He was studying the similarities and differences between humans and animals.
I can never tell the difference (= distinguish) between the twins.
There's no difference in the results.
There is a fundamental difference in approach to conservation in Japan.
She noticed a marked difference in the children on her second visit.
Her work questions notions of gender difference.
What a difference! You look great with your hair like that.
Differences among beetle species may prove to be a key factor.
Despite their differences, the two are great friends.

senses.definition_vi: cách hai người hoặc hai vật không giống nhau; cách ai đó/điều gì đó đã thay đổi.

senses.definition: the amount that something is greater or smaller than something else

examples.x: We measured the difference in temperature.
The difference between the two numbers gives you the profit.
There's an age difference of six years between the boys (= one is six years older than the other).

examples.cf: difference in something between A and B
examples.x: There is not much difference in price between the two brands.
I'll lend you £500 and you'll have to find the difference (= the rest of the money that you need).

senses.definition_vi: số lượng một thứ gì đó lớn hơn hoặc nhỏ hơn thứ khác.

senses.definition: a disagreement between people

examples.x: We have our differences, but she's still my sister.
Why don't you settle your differences and be friends again?
There was a difference of opinion over who had won.

senses.definition_vi: sự bất đồng giữa mọi người.

senses.definition: to stop not being friendly and become friends again

examples.x: After not speaking to each other for years, the two brothers decided to bury the hatchet.

senses.definition_vi: ngừng không thân thiện và trở lại làm bạn.

senses.definition: a point that somebody wants to suggest is a difference when in fact it is not different at all

examples.x: His government did not brand them terrorists, but rather ‘an entity that supports terrorism’. That may prove to be a distinction without a difference.

senses.definition_vi: một điểm mà ai đó muốn gợi ý là khác biệt trong khi thực tế lại không hề khác biệt.

senses.definition: to have an important effect on somebody/something; to make somebody feel better

examples.x: A few kind words at the right time make all the difference.
Just five minutes' exercise a day could make all the difference.

senses.definition_vi: có ảnh hưởng quan trọng đến ai đó/điều gì đó; làm cho ai đó cảm thấy tốt hơn.

senses.definition: to have an effect/no effect on somebody/something

examples.x: The rain didn't make much difference to the game.
Your age shouldn't make any difference to whether you get the job or not.
Changing schools made a big difference to my life.
What difference will it make if he knows or not?
I don't think it makes a lot of difference what colour it is (= it is not important).
‘Shall we go on Friday or Saturday?’ ‘It makes no difference (to me).’

senses.definition_vi: có ảnh hưởng/không có ảnh hưởng đến ai đó/điều gì đó.

senses.definition: used to say that you think the differences between two things are not important

examples.x: ‘That's not a xylophone, it's a glockenspiel.’ ‘Same difference.’

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn nghĩ sự khác biệt giữa hai thứ không quan trọng.

senses.definition: to agree to forget about your disagreements

examples.x: We need to sink our differences and present a united opposition to the plan.

senses.definition_vi: đồng ý quên đi những bất đồng của bạn.

senses.definition: (when discussing a price, etc.) to agree on an amount that is at an equal distance between the two amounts that have been suggested

examples.x: I offered €200 but he wanted €300. In the end, we split the difference and I paid him €250.
I wanted to leave early and Ian wanted to leave late, so we split the difference and left at noon.

senses.definition_vi: (khi thảo luận về giá cả, v.v.) đồng ý về một số tiền ở khoảng cách bằng nhau giữa hai số tiền đã được đề xuất.

senses.definition: used to show that something is interesting or unusual

examples.x: The traditional backpack with a difference—it's waterproof.
If you want a holiday with a difference, come to Iceland.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để chỉ ra rằng điều gì đó thú vị hoặc bất thường.

senses.definition: used to emphasize how much difference there is between two things

examples.x: There's a world of difference between liking someone and loving them.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh sự khác biệt lớn như thế nào giữa hai thứ.

senses.definition: not the same as somebody/something; not like somebody/something else

examples.x: American English is significantly different from British English.
It's slightly different to what I'm used to.
He's different than the rest.
It's completely different now than it was a year ago.
People often give very different accounts of the same event.
My son's terribly untidy; my daughter's no different.
The room looks different without the furniture.
Now he spoke in a different and kinder voice.
Let's try a different approach.

senses.definition_vi: không giống với ai đó/điều gì đó; không giống với người khác/vật khác.

senses.definition: separate and individual

examples.x: Each chapter deals with a different type of business.
She offered us five different kinds of cake.
We're helping society in many different ways.
The programme was about customs in different parts of the country.
They are sold in many different colours.
I looked it up in three different dictionaries.

senses.definition_vi: riêng biệt và cá nhân.

senses.definition: unusual; not like other people or things

examples.x: ‘Did you enjoy the play?’ ‘Well, it was certainly different!’

senses.definition_vi: bất thường; không giống những người hoặc vật khác.

senses.definition: to be very different

examples.x: I know which area they live in, but whether I can find their house is a different matter.
That's a whole different matter.
I don't mind lizards, but snakes are a different matter.

senses.definition_vi: rất khác biệt.

senses.definition: a completely different situation or person from the one previously mentioned
senses.definition_vi: một tình huống hoặc một người hoàn toàn khác với người hoặc tình huống được đề cập trước đó.

senses.definition: to have information or evidence that the opposite is true

examples.x: He says he doesn't care about what the critics write, but I know different.

senses.definition_vi: có thông tin hoặc bằng chứng cho thấy điều ngược lại là đúng.

senses.definition: to behave in a different way from other people; to have different attitudes or ideas

examples.x: She was a gifted and original artist who marched to a different drummer.

senses.definition_vi: hành động khác với người khác; có thái độ hoặc ý tưởng khác.

senses.definition: to have different aims that cannot be achieved together without causing problems

examples.x: There are different considerations, often pulling in different directions.

senses.definition_vi: có những mục tiêu khác nhau không thể đạt được cùng nhau mà không gây ra vấn đề.

senses.definition: to change the way that a situation appears

examples.x: What you have told us puts a different complexion on the situation.
This puts a whole new complexion on the matter.

senses.definition_vi: thay đổi cách mà một tình huống xuất hiện.

senses.definition: to change your opinion about somebody/something or your attitude towards somebody/something
senses.definition_vi: thay đổi ý kiến của bạn về ai đó/điều gì đó hoặc thái độ của bạn đối với ai đó/điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to give some information that is different from what you expect or have been told

examples.x: These drugs are widely believed to be effective medications. The data, however, tell a different story.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp một số thông tin khác với những gì bạn mong đợi hoặc đã được cho biết.

senses.definition: to recognize or show that two things are not the same

examples.x: It's difficult to differentiate between the two varieties.
I can't differentiate one variety from another.

senses.definition_vi: nhận ra hoặc chỉ ra rằng hai thứ không giống nhau.

senses.definition: to be the particular thing that shows that things or people are not the same

examples.x: The male's yellow beak differentiates it from the female.
features which clearly differentiate this product from other similar ones

senses.definition_vi: là điều cụ thể cho thấy các vật hoặc người không giống nhau.

senses.definition: to treat people or things in a different way, especially in an unfair way

examples.x: Rules that differentiate between employees on the basis of gender need to be revised.

senses.definition_vi: đối xử với mọi người hoặc mọi vật theo cách khác nhau, đặc biệt là một cách không công bằng.

senses.definition: to become more specialized during growth and development; to make a cell or tissue more specialized during growth and development

examples.x: The fertilized egg differentiates into several different cell types.
The receptors are developed and differentiated into sense organs.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên chuyên biệt hơn trong quá trình phát triển; làm cho một tế bào hoặc mô chuyên biệt hơn trong quá trình phát triển.

senses.definition: in a different way from somebody/something

examples.x: Boys and girls may behave differently.
He didn't like being treated differently.
What will you do differently next time?
Eddie comes from an older generation that thought differently than we do.
The male bird has a differently shaped head.

senses.definition_vi: theo một cách khác với ai đó/điều gì đó.

senses.definition: not easy; needing effort or skill to do or to understand

examples.x: The competition judges were given a very difficult task.
a difficult decision/question
Asking for help is extremely difficult for some people.

examples.cf: it is difficult to do something
examples.x: It's really difficult to read your writing.
Your writing is really difficult to read.
It is difficult to imagine how this could have happened.
She finds it very difficult to get up early.

examples.cf: it is difficult for somebody to do something
examples.x: It's difficult for them to get here much before seven.
It has become increasingly difficult for young people to buy a house.

senses.definition_vi: không dễ dàng; đòi hỏi nỗ lực hoặc kỹ năng để thực hiện hoặc hiểu.

senses.definition: full of problems; causing a lot of trouble

examples.x: I found myself in a difficult situation.
difficult conditions/circumstances
I'd had a difficult time and needed a break.
a difficult year/month
My boss is making life very difficult for me.
13 is a difficult age.

senses.definition_vi: đầy rẫy vấn đề; gây ra nhiều rắc rối.

senses.definition: not easy to please; not helpful

examples.x: a difficult child/customer/boss
Don't pay any attention to her—she's just being difficult.
The singer has a difficult reputation.

senses.definition_vi: khó làm hài lòng; không hữu ích.

senses.definition: to have difficulty doing something

examples.x: You'll have a job convincing them that you're right.
He had a hard job to make himself heard.

senses.definition_vi: gặp khó khăn khi làm điều gì đó.

senses.definition: a problem; a thing or situation that causes problems

examples.x: the difficulties of English syntax
a patient with breathing difficulties
They encountered numerous difficulties while making the film.
She had been experiencing technical difficulties.
I think we've managed to overcome most of the practical difficulties.
I know the kinds of difficulties faced by parents and teachers.
We've run into difficulties with the new project.
I'm having difficulty with the engine.
He was often in financial difficulties.
He got into difficulty while swimming and had to be rescued.
It was a time fraught with difficulties and frustration.

senses.definition_vi: một vấn đề; một thứ hoặc tình huống gây ra vấn đề.

senses.definition: the state or quality of being hard to do or to understand; the effort that something involves

examples.x: I had considerable difficulty (in) persuading her to leave.
I had no difficulty (in) making myself understood.
He spoke slowly and with great difficulty.
The changes were made with surprisingly little difficulty.
We found the house without difficulty.
They discussed the difficulty of studying abroad.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái hoặc phẩm chất của việc khó thực hiện hoặc khó hiểu; nỗ lực mà một điều gì đó liên quan đến.

senses.definition: how hard something is

examples.x: Both roles had a high degree of difficulty.
The games have varying levels of difficulty.
questions of increasing difficulty
The walks in the book vary in difficulty.

senses.definition_vi: một điều gì đó khó như thế nào.

senses.definition: to make a hole in the ground or to move soil from one place to another using your hands, a tool or a machine

examples.x: I think I'll do some digging in the garden.
They dug deeper and deeper but still found nothing.
We could only dig down a few feet.
to dig for gold/treasure
to dig a hole/trench/grave
I've been digging the garden.
They had obviously dug special tunnels beneath the city.
The present entrance was dug through the soft limestone.

senses.definition_vi: đào một lỗ trên mặt đất hoặc di chuyển đất từ nơi này sang nơi khác bằng tay, bằng công cụ hoặc bằng máy.

senses.definition: to remove something from the ground with a tool

examples.x: I'll dig some potatoes for lunch.

senses.definition_vi: loại bỏ thứ gì đó khỏi mặt đất bằng công cụ.

senses.definition: to search in something in order to find an object in something

examples.x: I dug around in my bag for a pen.

senses.definition_vi: tìm kiếm trong một thứ gì đó để tìm một vật thể trong đó.

senses.definition: to approve of or like something very much
senses.definition_vi: tán thành hoặc rất thích một cái gì đó.

senses.definition: to search for information in a careful and detailed way

examples.x: You'll need to dig deep into the records to find the figures you want.

senses.definition_vi: tìm kiếm thông tin một cách cẩn thận và chi tiết

senses.definition: to try hard to provide the money, equipment, etc. that is needed

examples.x: We're asking you to dig deep for the earthquake victims.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng hết sức để cung cấp tiền, thiết bị, v.v. cần thiết

senses.definition: to discover and reveal information about somebody that could damage them

examples.x: They hired private investigators to dig up dirt on their political opponents.
She has come to dig the dirt on her old rival.

senses.definition_vi: khám phá và tiết lộ thông tin về ai đó có thể gây tổn hại cho họ

senses.definition: to refuse to do something or to change your mind about something

examples.x: They dug in their heels and would not lower the price.

senses.definition_vi: từ chối làm điều gì đó hoặc thay đổi ý định về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to spend a lot of your own money on something
senses.definition_vi: chi tiêu nhiều tiền của bản thân vào việc gì đó

senses.definition: to push your finger or your elbow into somebody’s side, especially to attract their attention
senses.definition_vi: dùng ngón tay hoặc khuỷu tay đẩy vào sườn ai đó, đặc biệt là để thu hút sự chú ý của họ

senses.definition: to do something that will have very harmful results for you
senses.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó sẽ có kết quả rất có hại cho bản thân

senses.definition: to get yourself into a bad situation that will be very difficult to get out of
senses.definition_vi: tự đưa mình vào một tình huống xấu mà sẽ rất khó thoát ra

senses.definition: using a system of receiving and sending information as a series of the numbers one and zero, showing that an electronic signal is there or is not there

examples.x: a digital camera
digital media/content/platforms
These figures include digital downloads in addition to retail sales.
He quickly realized that all film and video production would go digital.
The system is fully digital, with no analogue components.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng một hệ thống nhận và gửi thông tin dưới dạng một chuỗi các số một và không, cho thấy tín hiệu điện tử có hoặc không có

senses.definition: connected with the use of computer technology, especially the internet

examples.x: communication in the digital age
Digital technology continues to evolve rapidly.
Advertisers are putting more and more money into digital marketing.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến việc sử dụng công nghệ máy tính, đặc biệt là internet

senses.definition: showing information by using figures, rather than with hands that point to numbers

examples.x: a digital clock/watch
The instrument panel has an easy-to-read digital display.

senses.definition_vi: hiển thị thông tin bằng cách sử dụng các con số, thay vì bằng kim chỉ số

senses.definition: a calm and serious manner that deserves respect

examples.x: She accepted the criticism with quiet dignity.
He brings a quiet dignity to the role.
His aristocratic voice gives him an air of dignity and power.

senses.definition_vi: một thái độ bình tĩnh và nghiêm túc đáng được tôn trọng

senses.definition: the fact of being given honour and respect by people

examples.x: the dignity of work
The terminally ill should be allowed to die with dignity.

senses.definition_vi: việc được mọi người trao cho sự vinh dự và tôn trọng

senses.definition: a sense of your own importance and value

examples.x: It's difficult to preserve your dignity when you have no job and no home.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác về tầm quan trọng và giá trị của bản thân

senses.definition: below what you see as your own importance or worth

examples.x: He clearly regarded manual work as beneath his dignity.

senses.definition_vi: thấp hơn những gì bạn coi là tầm quan trọng hoặc giá trị của bản thân

senses.definition: to demand to be treated with the respect that you think that you deserve

examples.x: Our teacher never stands on her dignity with us, but treats us all as friends and colleagues.
She was never one to stand on her dignity.

senses.definition_vi: yêu cầu được đối xử với sự tôn trọng mà bạn nghĩ rằng bạn xứng đáng

senses.definition: a situation that makes problems, often one in which you have to make a very difficult choice between things of equal importance

examples.x: I could see no way of resolving this moral dilemma.
The digital era brings new ethical dilemmas for journalists.
They were caught in a real dilemma.
She faced a dilemma about whether to accept the offer or not.
the perennial dilemma between work and family commitments

senses.definition_vi: một tình huống tạo ra vấn đề, thường là một tình huống mà bạn phải đưa ra lựa chọn rất khó khăn giữa những thứ có tầm quan trọng ngang nhau

senses.definition: in a situation in which you have to make a choice between things that are equally unpleasant

examples.x: The medical profession’s eagerness for scientific advance had impaled it on the horns of a dilemma, forcing an unnatural choice between science and morality.
The dire economic situation had placed the prime minister on the horns of a dilemma.

senses.definition_vi: trong một tình huống mà bạn phải lựa chọn giữa những điều khó chịu như nhau

senses.definition: a measurement in space, for example how high, wide or long something is

senses.definition: if two people agree to differ/disagree, they accept that they have different opinions about something, but they decide not to discuss it any longer

examples.x: We must just agree to differ on this.
In the end we agreed to disagree.
I think you're wrong. Let's just agree to differ.

senses.definition_vi: nếu hai người đồng ý khác biệt/không đồng ý, họ chấp nhận rằng họ có ý kiến khác nhau về điều gì đó, nhưng họ quyết định không thảo luận thêm nữa

senses.definition: a situation where people have different opinions about something and often argue

examples.x: Disagreement arose about exactly how to plan the show.
disagreement on the method to be used
There's no room for disagreement on this point.
There is considerable disagreement over the safety of the treatment.
We are in total disagreement as to how to proceed.
It was a source of disagreement between the two states.
There is disagreement among archaeologists as to the age of the sculpture.
They have had several disagreements with their neighbours.
He shook his head in disagreement.

senses.definition_vi: tình huống mọi người có ý kiến khác nhau về điều gì đó và thường tranh cãi

senses.definition: a difference between two things that should be the same

examples.x: The comparison shows considerable disagreement between theory and practice.

senses.definition_vi: sự khác biệt giữa hai thứ lẽ ra phải giống nhau

senses.definition: to become impossible to see

examples.x: With that, Matt promptly disappeared.
The mirror made the ceiling seem to disappear.
The plane disappeared behind a cloud.
Lisa watched until the train disappeared from view.
Lucy watched his tall figure disappear into the cafe.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên không thể nhìn thấy

senses.definition: to stop existing

examples.x: Her nervousness quickly disappeared once she was on stage.
The problem won't just disappear.
Our countryside is disappearing at an alarming rate.
Wildlife is fast disappearing from our countryside.
These fish have virtually disappeared from their traditional waters.

senses.definition_vi: ngừng tồn tại

senses.definition: to be lost or impossible to find

examples.x: I can never find a pen in this house. They disappear as soon as I buy them.
Then one day he simply disappeared.
The plane mysteriously disappeared over the Indian Ocean.
The child disappeared from his home some time after four.

senses.definition_vi: bị mất hoặc không thể tìm thấy

senses.definition: if a person is disappeared, they are arrested or captured and kept in prison without trial or killed, usually for political reasons

examples.x: 10 000 people have been disappeared and over 160 000 displaced.
One month later, he was disappeared by the regime.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một người bị mất tích, họ bị bắt hoặc bị giam giữ và giam giữ mà không bị xét xử hoặc bị giết, thường vì lý do chính trị

senses.definition: to remove something secretly or illegally so that it cannot be found

examples.x: In the last five years, nearly 5 000 companies have been disappeared from the registry.
Soon after the blog post went up, someone disappeared it.

senses.definition_vi: xóa bỏ thứ gì đó một cách bí mật hoặc bất hợp pháp để không thể tìm thấy

senses.definition: to disappear completely

examples.x: Keep looking—they can't just have vanished off the face of the earth.

senses.definition_vi: biến mất hoàn toàn

senses.definition: to disappear suddenly in a mysterious way

examples.x: She can’t just have vanished into thin air.
At a stroke she could make things vanish into thin air.

senses.definition_vi: biến mất đột ngột một cách bí ẩn

senses.definition: to go away or be impossible to find when people need or want you

examples.x: The cat had done a disappearing act.

senses.definition_vi: đi đi hoặc không thể tìm thấy khi mọi người cần hoặc muốn bạn

senses.definition: to make somebody feel sad because something that they hope for or expect to happen does not happen or is not as good as they hoped

examples.x: Her decision to cancel the concert is bound to disappoint her fans.
I hate to disappoint you, but I'm just not interested.
The movie had disappointed her (= it wasn't as good as she had expected).
I hate to disappoint the children when they've been looking forward to it so much.
His latest novel does not disappoint.
It disappointed me that nobody bothered to say thank you.

senses.definition_vi: làm ai đó buồn vì điều gì đó mà họ hy vọng hoặc mong đợi xảy ra không xảy ra hoặc không tốt như họ hy vọng

senses.definition: to prevent something that somebody hopes for from becoming a reality

examples.x: The new government had soon disappointed the hopes of many of its supporters.
If he agrees to the deal he will disappoint the expectations of many colleagues.

senses.definition_vi: ngăn chặn điều gì đó mà ai đó hy vọng trở thành hiện thực

senses.definition: upset because something you hoped for has not happened or been as good, successful, etc. as you expected

examples.x: The singer has promised to refund any disappointed fans.
to be extremely/very/a bit/a little disappointed
They were bitterly disappointed at the result of the game.
Fans of the original film will be sorely disappointed at this remake.
I was disappointed by the quality of the food.
Andrea was disappointed about the decision.
I'm disappointed about John not coming.
I'm disappointed in you—I really thought I could trust you!
Nick seemed disappointed in her lack of response.
I was very disappointed with myself.
It is hard not to feel disappointed with the end result.
He was disappointed to see she wasn't at the party.
I’m disappointed (that) it was sold out.
She was disappointed not to be chosen.

senses.definition_vi: buồn vì điều gì đó bạn hy vọng đã không xảy ra hoặc không tốt, thành công, v.v. như bạn mong đợi

senses.definition: not as good, successful, etc. as you had hoped; making you feel disappointed

examples.x: a disappointing result/performance/defeat
The team has had a disappointing start to the season.
The outcome of the court case was disappointing for the family involved.
The choices made on election day will always be disappointing to a significant number of voters.
We did a good job but it's still disappointing to only finish second.

senses.definition_vi: không tốt, thành công, v.v. như bạn đã hy vọng; khiến bạn cảm thấy thất vọng

senses.definition: the feeling of being sad because something has not happened or been as good, successful, etc. as you expected or hoped

examples.x: Book early for the show to avoid disappointment.
To our great disappointment, it rained every day of the trip.
He found it difficult to hide his disappointment when she didn't arrive.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác buồn vì điều gì đó đã không xảy ra hoặc không tốt, thành công, v.v. như bạn mong đợi hoặc hy vọng

senses.definition: a person or thing that is disappointing

examples.x: a bitter/major disappointment
That new restaurant was a big disappointment.
He's suffered a whole string of disappointments this week.
I always felt I was a disappointment to my father.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật gây thất vọng

senses.definition: an unexpected event, such as a very bad accident, a flood or a fire, that kills a lot of people or causes a lot of damage

examples.x: the world's worst humanitarian disaster
an environmental/ecological disaster
a rail/mining/tsunami disaster
Thousands died in the disaster.
They provided more than $2.3 billion in disaster relief.
It was taking years for disaster victims to settle and rebuild.
Given the threat of earthquake, we recognized the need for disaster recovery centres.

senses.definition_vi: một sự kiện bất ngờ, chẳng hạn như một vụ tai nạn rất tồi tệ, một trận lụt hoặc một đám cháy, giết chết nhiều người hoặc gây ra nhiều thiệt hại

senses.definition: a very bad situation that causes problems

examples.x: Losing your job doesn't have to be such a disaster.
Disaster struck when the wheel came off.
Archie has to act quickly to avert disaster.
They could think of no way to avoid the impending disaster.
Many business partnerships end in disaster.
The discovery of the disease among sheep spells financial disaster for farmers.
Letting her organize the party is a recipe for disaster (= something that is likely to go badly wrong).

senses.definition_vi: một tình huống rất tồi tệ gây ra vấn đề

senses.definition: a complete failure

examples.x: As a teacher, he's a disaster.
The play's first night was a total disaster.
a complete/total/absolute/unmitigated disaster

senses.definition_vi: một sự thất bại hoàn toàn

senses.definition: a thing or person that is very likely to cause danger or a problem in the future because of the condition it is in or the way they behave

examples.x: Any one of these nuclear plants may be a disaster waiting to happen.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ hoặc một người rất có khả năng gây nguy hiểm hoặc rắc rối trong tương lai vì tình trạng của nó hoặc cách cư xử của họ

senses.definition: very bad, harmful or unsuccessful

examples.x: a disastrous harvest/fire/result
Lowering interest rates could have disastrous consequences for the economy.
It was a disastrous start to the season for the team.

senses.definition_vi: rất tệ, có hại hoặc không thành công

senses.definition: a thin flat round object

examples.x: He wears an identity disc around his neck.
In a total eclipse, the moon completely covers the disc of the sun.

senses.definition_vi: một vật mỏng, phẳng, tròn

senses.definition: a CD or DVD

examples.x: This disc contains lots of extra features, including an interview with the director.
This recording is available online or on disc.
The series comes as a two-disc box set with three episodes on each disc.
There are lots of extras on this disc.

senses.definition_vi: một đĩa CD hoặc DVD

senses.definition: a disk for a computer

examples.x: He inserted the disc into the machine.

senses.definition_vi: một đĩa cho máy tính

senses.definition: a record (= a thin round piece of plastic on which music, etc. is recorded)

examples.x: I have an old vinyl disc of her singing.

senses.definition_vi: một đĩa nhạc (= một miếng nhựa tròn mỏng ghi nhạc, v.v.)

senses.definition: a structure made of cartilage between the bones of the back
senses.definition_vi: một cấu trúc sụn giữa các xương ở lưng

senses.definition: to get rid of something that you no longer want or need

examples.x: The room was littered with discarded newspapers.
He had discarded his jacket because of the heat.
She could now discard all thought of promotion.
10 per cent of the data was discarded as unreliable.

senses.definition_vi: vứt bỏ thứ gì đó mà bạn không còn muốn hoặc cần nữa

senses.definition: to get rid of a card that you do not want
senses.definition_vi: vứt bỏ một lá bài mà bạn không muốn

senses.definition: to give somebody official permission to leave the police or the armed forces; to make somebody leave the police or the armed forces

examples.x: He was discharged from the army following his injury.
She was discharged from the police force for bad conduct.
He was found guilty and dishonourably discharged from the army.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó rời khỏi cảnh sát hoặc quân đội; buộc ai đó rời khỏi cảnh sát hoặc quân đội

senses.definition: to allow somebody to leave hospital because they are well enough to leave

examples.x: Patients were being discharged from the hospital too early.
All the people involved in the accident have now been discharged from hospital.
She had discharged herself against medical advice.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó rời bệnh viện vì họ đã đủ khỏe để rời đi

senses.definition: to allow somebody to leave prison or court

examples.x: He was conditionally discharged after admitting the theft.
She was formally discharged by the court.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó rời khỏi nhà tù hoặc tòa án

senses.definition: to allow a member of a jury to stop serving in a court case

examples.x: If the jury cannot agree, it should be discharged.
The judge took the unusual step of discharging the entire jury halfway through the trial.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép một thành viên bồi thẩm đoàn ngừng phục vụ trong một vụ án tại tòa

senses.definition: when a gas or a liquid discharges or is discharged, or somebody discharges it, it flows somewhere

examples.x: The river is diverted through the power station before discharging into the sea.
The factory was fined for discharging chemicals into the river.
Raw sewage was discharged from the treatment plant directly into the river.

senses.definition_vi: khi một chất khí hoặc chất lỏng xả ra hoặc được xả ra, hoặc ai đó xả nó, nó chảy đến một nơi nào đó

senses.definition: if part of the body discharges something, a liquid such as pus comes out of it

examples.x: The wound started discharging pus.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một bộ phận cơ thể chảy ra thứ gì đó, một chất lỏng như mủ sẽ chảy ra từ đó

senses.definition: to release force or power

examples.x: Lightning is caused by clouds discharging electricity.

senses.definition_vi: giải phóng lực hoặc năng lượng

senses.definition: to do everything that is necessary to perform and complete a particular duty

examples.x: to discharge your duties/responsibilities/obligations
to discharge a debt (= to pay it)

senses.definition_vi: làm mọi thứ cần thiết để thực hiện và hoàn thành một nhiệm vụ cụ thể

senses.definition: to fire a gun, etc.; (of a gun, etc.) to be fired

examples.x: The police officer accidentally discharged a firearm while unloading it.
They gave a cheer and charged, discharging a volley of arrows as they came.
He knocked her hand down and the gun discharged into the floor.

senses.definition_vi: bắn một khẩu súng, v.v.; (của một khẩu súng, v.v.) được bắn

senses.definition: the practice of training people to obey rules and orders and punishing them if they do not; the controlled behaviour or situation that is the result of this training

examples.x: The school has a reputation for high standards of discipline.
Strict discipline is imposed on army recruits.
harsh/rigorous/rigid/iron discipline
She keeps good discipline in class.
to instill/enforce/impose/maintain discipline
Lack of discipline at home meant that many pupils found it difficult to settle into the ordered environment of the school.
a serious breach of discipline

senses.definition_vi: việc rèn luyện mọi người tuân theo các quy tắc và mệnh lệnh và phạt họ nếu họ không làm vậy; hành vi hoặc tình huống có kiểm soát là kết quả của sự rèn luyện này

senses.definition: a method of training your mind or body or of controlling your behaviour; an area of activity where this is necessary

examples.x: Yoga is a good discipline for learning to relax.

senses.definition_vi: một phương pháp rèn luyện tâm trí hoặc cơ thể của bạn hoặc kiểm soát hành vi của bạn; một lĩnh vực hoạt động mà điều này là cần thiết

senses.definition: the ability to control your behaviour or the way you live, work, etc.

examples.x: He'll never get anywhere working for himself—he's got no discipline.
Her determination and discipline were admirable.

senses.definition_vi: khả năng kiểm soát hành vi của bạn hoặc cách bạn sống, làm việc, v.v.

senses.definition: an area of knowledge; a subject that people study or are taught, especially in a university

examples.x: The new recruits were drawn from a range of academic disciplines.

senses.definition_vi: một lĩnh vực kiến thức; một môn học mà mọi người nghiên cứu hoặc được giảng dạy, đặc biệt là ở trường đại học

senses.definition: to give somebody information about something, especially something that was previously secret

examples.x: The spokesman refused to disclose details of the takeover to the press.
The report discloses that human error was to blame for the accident.
It was disclosed that two women were being interviewed by the police.
I cannot disclose what we discussed.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp cho ai đó thông tin về điều gì đó, đặc biệt là điều gì đó trước đây đã được giữ bí mật

senses.definition: to allow something that was hidden to be seen

examples.x: The door swung open, disclosing a long dark passage.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép thứ gì đó bị ẩn được nhìn thấy

senses.definition: the act of making something known or public that was previously secret or private

examples.x: the newspaper’s disclosure of defence secrets
The bank will need full disclosure of your financial situation and assets.
The court ruled to prevent public disclosure of the contents of the documents.

senses.definition_vi: hành động làm cho điều gì đó được biết hoặc công khai mà trước đây đã được giữ bí mật hoặc riêng tư

senses.definition: information or a fact that is made known or public that was previously secret or private

examples.x: startling disclosures about his private life

senses.definition_vi: thông tin hoặc một sự thật được công khai hoặc biết đến mà trước đây đã được giữ bí mật hoặc riêng tư

senses.definition: an amount of money that is taken off the usual cost of something

examples.x: to get/offer a discount
a 10, 20, 50, etc. per cent discount
Spend over £50 and receive a 15 per cent discount.
Do you qualify for a student discount?
Do you give any discount for students?
If you pay cash you may be able to negotiate a discount.
They're offering a 10% discount on all sofas this month.
You can get a substantial discount off your car insurance.
They were selling everything at a discount (= at reduced prices).
a chance to buy new shares at a discount to the current trading price
We offer special discount rates for families.
a discount voucher/coupon/card
a discount store/retailer (= one that regularly sells goods at reduced prices)
a discount airline/carrier (= an airline that sells cheap tickets)

senses.definition_vi: trừ một khoản tiền khỏi chi phí thông thường của một cái gì đó; bán một cái gì đó với giá chiết khấu

senses.definition: to try to prevent something or to prevent somebody from doing something, especially by making it difficult to do or by showing that you do not approve of it

examples.x: a campaign to discourage investing in fossil fuel development
I leave a light on when I'm out to discourage burglars.
His parents tried to discourage him from being an actor.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng ngăn chặn một điều gì đó hoặc ngăn ai đó làm điều gì đó, đặc biệt là bằng cách làm cho nó khó thực hiện hoặc bằng cách thể hiện rằng bạn không chấp thuận nó

senses.definition: to make somebody feel less confident or enthusiastic about doing something

examples.x: Don't be discouraged by the first failure—try again!
The weather discouraged people from attending.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy kém tự tin hoặc kém nhiệt tình khi làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: a long and serious treatment or discussion of a subject in speech or writing

examples.x: a discourse on issues of gender and sexuality
He was hoping for some lively political discourse at the meeting.

senses.definition_vi: một bài trình bày hoặc thảo luận dài và nghiêm túc về một chủ đề bằng lời nói hoặc chữ viết

senses.definition: the use of language in speech and writing in order to produce meaning; language that is studied, usually in order to see how the different parts of a text are connected

examples.x: spoken/written discourse
discourse analysis

senses.definition_vi: việc sử dụng ngôn ngữ trong lời nói và chữ viết để tạo ra ý nghĩa; ngôn ngữ được nghiên cứu, thường là để xem các phần khác nhau của một văn bản được kết nối như thế nào

senses.definition: to be the first person to become aware that a particular place or thing exists

examples.x: Cook is credited with discovering Hawaii.
Scientists around the world are working to discover a cure for the disease.
a newly discovered snake species
They first discovered this protein about five years ago.
She recently discovered two fungi that were new to science.

senses.definition_vi: là người đầu tiên nhận thức được sự tồn tại của một địa điểm hoặc vật thể cụ thể

senses.definition: to find somebody/something that was hidden or that you did not expect to find

examples.x: Police discovered a large stash of drugs while searching the house.
We discovered this beach while we were sailing around the island.
His body was discovered in the lake near his house.
He was discovered hiding in a shed.
She was discovered dead at her home in Leeds.

senses.definition_vi: tìm thấy ai đó/cái gì đó bị ẩn hoặc bạn không mong đợi tìm thấy

senses.definition: to find out about something; to find some information about something

examples.x: She was determined to discover the truth about her neighbours.
to discover a secret
I've just discovered hang-gliding!
Discover the joys of yoga!
It was a shock to discover (that) he couldn’t read.
We never did discover why she gave up her job.
It was later discovered that the diaries were a fraud.
He was later discovered to be seriously ill.

senses.definition_vi: tìm hiểu về điều gì đó; tìm một số thông tin về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to be the first person to realize that somebody is very good at singing, acting, etc. and help them to become successful and famous

examples.x: The singer was discovered while still at school.
There's great talent out there just waiting to be discovered.

senses.definition_vi: là người đầu tiên nhận ra ai đó rất giỏi hát, diễn xuất, v.v. và giúp họ trở nên thành công và nổi tiếng

senses.definition: an act or the process of finding somebody/something, or learning about something that was not known about before

examples.x: Researchers in this field have made some important new discoveries.
New scientific discoveries are being made all the time.
the discovery of antibiotics in the twentieth century
The discovery of a child's body in the river has shocked the community.
the discovery of new talent in the art world
He saw life as a voyage of discovery.
The film takes us on a journey of discovery to different parts of the globe.
She was shocked by the discovery that he had been unfaithful.
In 1974 Hawking made the discovery (= he discovered) that black holes give off radiation.

senses.definition_vi: một hành động hoặc quá trình tìm thấy ai đó/cái gì đó, hoặc tìm hiểu về điều gì đó chưa từng được biết đến trước đây

senses.definition: a thing, fact or person that is found or learned about for the first time

examples.x: The drug is not a new discovery—it's been known about for years.
one of the most important scientific discoveries of all time
potentially the biggest archaeological discovery in Norway for fifty years
recent discoveries about sleep

senses.definition_vi: một thứ, sự thật hoặc người được tìm thấy hoặc tìm hiểu lần đầu tiên

senses.definition: the freedom or power to decide what should be done in a particular situation

examples.x: I'll leave it up to you to use your discretion.
How much to tell terminally ill patients is left to the discretion of the doctor.

senses.definition_vi: quyền tự do hoặc quyền quyết định những gì nên được thực hiện trong một tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: care in what you say or do, in order to keep something secret or to avoid causing difficulty for somebody or making them feel embarrassed; the quality of being discreet

examples.x: This is confidential, but I know that I can rely on your discretion.
Jane is the soul of discretion (= you can trust her).
Use the utmost discretion when you talk to her.

senses.definition_vi: sự cẩn thận trong lời nói hoặc hành động, để giữ bí mật hoặc tránh gây khó khăn hoặc bối rối cho người khác; phẩm chất của sự kín đáo

senses.definition: according to what somebody decides or wishes to do

examples.x: Bail is granted at the discretion of the court.
There is no service charge and tipping is at your discretion.

senses.definition_vi: theo quyết định hoặc mong muốn của ai đó

senses.definition: you should avoid danger and not take unnecessary risks
senses.definition_vi: bạn nên tránh nguy hiểm và không có những rủi ro không cần thiết

senses.definition: the practice of treating somebody or a particular group in society less fairly than others

examples.x: age/racial/gender/sex discrimination (= because of somebody’s age, race, gender or sex)
discrimination against the elderly
discrimination in favour of the young
They alleged discrimination by the authorities.

examples.cf: discrimination on the basis of something
examples.x: to prohibit/outlaw/ban discrimination on the basis of race, gender or sexual orientation

examples.cf: discrimination on the grounds of something
examples.x: legislation to ban discrimination on the grounds of age

senses.definition_vi: thực hành đối xử với ai đó hoặc một nhóm người cụ thể trong xã hội kém công bằng hơn những người khác

senses.definition: the ability to judge what is good, true, etc.

examples.x: He showed great discrimination in his choice of friends.

senses.definition_vi: khả năng phán đoán cái gì là tốt, đúng, v.v.

senses.definition: the ability to recognize a difference between one thing and another; a difference that is recognized

examples.x: to learn discrimination between right and wrong

examples.x: We came within touching distance of winning the cup.
We live within spitting distance of the bus station.

senses.definition_vi: rất gần

senses.definition: far away in space or time

examples.x: the distant sound of music
distant stars/planets
The time we spent together is now a distant memory.
The airport was about 20 kilometres distant.
a star 30 000 light years distant from the Earth
Peace was just a distant hope (= not very likely).

senses.definition_vi: xa trong không gian hoặc thời gian

senses.definition: not like something else

examples.x: Their life seemed utterly distant from his own.
The medieval mind can seem impossibly distant.

senses.definition_vi: không giống với cái gì khác

senses.definition: related to you but not closely

examples.x: a distant cousin/aunt/relative

senses.definition_vi: có quan hệ với bạn nhưng không gần gũi

senses.definition: not friendly; not wanting a close relationship with somebody

examples.x: Pat sounded very cold and distant on the phone.
He became emotionally distant from his friends and family after the illness.

senses.definition_vi: không thân thiện; không muốn có mối quan hệ gần gũi với ai đó

senses.definition: not paying attention to something but thinking about something completely different

examples.x: There was a distant look in her eyes; her mind was obviously on something else.
He seemed distant and distracted.

senses.definition_vi: không chú ý đến điều gì đó nhưng đang suy nghĩ về một điều hoàn toàn khác

senses.definition: a long time ago

examples.x: stories from the dim and distant past
In the distant past this land was covered in forests.

senses.definition_vi: cách đây rất lâu

senses.definition: not a long time in the future but fairly soon

examples.x: I hope we’ll see each other again in the not too distant future.

senses.definition_vi: không còn xa trong tương lai nhưng khá sớm

senses.definition: easily or clearly heard, seen, felt, etc.

examples.x: There was a distinct smell of gas.
His voice was quiet but every word was distinct.

senses.definition_vi: dễ dàng hoặc rõ ràng nghe thấy, nhìn thấy, cảm nhận, v.v.

senses.definition: clearly different or of a different kind

examples.x: The results of the survey fell into two distinct groups.
Jamaican reggae music is quite distinct from North American jazz or blues.
We are talking about rural areas, as distinct from major cities.

senses.definition_vi: khác biệt rõ ràng hoặc thuộc một loại khác

senses.definition: used to emphasize that you think an idea or situation definitely exists and is important

examples.x: Being tall gave Tony a distinct advantage.
I had the distinct impression I was being watched.
A strike is now a distinct possibility.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn nghĩ một ý tưởng hoặc tình huống chắc chắn tồn tại và quan trọng

senses.definition: a clear difference or contrast especially between people or things that are similar or related

examples.x: distinctions between traditional and modern societies
Philosophers did not use to make a distinction between arts and science.
We need to draw a distinction between the two events.

senses.definition_vi: sự khác biệt hoặc tương phản rõ ràng, đặc biệt là giữa những người hoặc những thứ tương tự hoặc có liên quan

senses.definition: the act of separating people or things into different groups

examples.x: The new law makes no distinction between adults and children (= treats them equally).
All groups are entitled to this money without distinction.

senses.definition_vi: hành động tách biệt mọi người hoặc mọi thứ thành các nhóm khác nhau

senses.definition: the quality of being something that is special

examples.x: She had the distinction of being the first woman to fly the Atlantic.

senses.definition_vi: phẩm chất của một cái gì đó đặc biệt

senses.definition: the quality of being excellent or important

examples.x: a writer of distinction

senses.definition_vi: phẩm chất của sự xuất sắc hoặc quan trọng

senses.definition: a special mark or award that is given to somebody, especially a student, for excellent work

examples.x: Naomi got a distinction in maths.
He graduated with distinction.

senses.definition_vi: một dấu hiệu hoặc giải thưởng đặc biệt được trao cho ai đó, đặc biệt là sinh viên, vì thành tích xuất sắc

senses.definition: a point that somebody wants to suggest is a difference when in fact it is not different at all

examples.x: His government did not brand them terrorists, but rather ‘an entity that supports terrorism’. That may prove to be a distinction without a difference.

senses.short_meaning_vi: sự phân biệt không có thật
senses.definition_vi: một điểm mà ai đó muốn gợi ý là một sự khác biệt nhưng thực tế lại không khác biệt chút nào

senses.definition: having a quality or characteristic that makes something different and easily noticed

examples.x: clothes with a distinctive style
The male bird has distinctive white markings on its head.

senses.definition_vi: có một phẩm chất hoặc đặc điểm làm cho một cái gì đó khác biệt và dễ nhận thấy

senses.definition: to recognize the difference between two people or things

examples.x: At what age are children able to distinguish between right and wrong?
English law clearly distinguishes between murder and manslaughter.
It was hard to distinguish one twin from the other.
Sometimes reality and fantasy are hard to distinguish.
We can distinguish five meanings of the word ‘mad’.

senses.definition_vi: nhận ra sự khác biệt giữa hai người hoặc hai vật

senses.definition: to be a characteristic that makes two people, animals or things different

examples.x: What was it that distinguished her from her classmates?
The male bird is distinguished from the female by its red beak.
The adult bird can be readily distinguished by its orange bill.
Does your cat have any distinguishing marks?
The power of speech distinguishes human beings from animals.

senses.definition_vi: là một đặc điểm làm cho hai người, động vật hoặc vật thể khác nhau

senses.definition: to be able to see or hear something

examples.x: I could not distinguish her words, but she sounded agitated.
She could not distinguish the make and colour of the car in the fading light.

senses.definition_vi: có thể nhìn thấy hoặc nghe thấy điều gì đó

senses.definition: to do something so well that people notice and admire you

examples.x: She has already distinguished herself as an athlete.

senses.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó tốt đến mức mọi người chú ý và ngưỡng mộ bạn

senses.definition: to change the shape, appearance or sound of something so that it is strange or not clear

examples.x: a fairground mirror that distorts your shape
The loudspeaker seemed to distort his voice.

senses.definition_vi: thay đổi hình dạng, ngoại hình hoặc âm thanh của một cái gì đó để nó trở nên kỳ lạ hoặc không rõ ràng

senses.definition: to change facts, ideas, etc. so that they are no longer correct or true

examples.x: Newspapers are often guilty of distorting the truth.

senses.definition_vi: thay đổi sự kiện, ý tưởng, v.v. để chúng không còn chính xác hoặc đúng sự thật nữa

senses.definition: to take somebody’s attention away from what they are trying to do

examples.x: You're distracting me from my work.
Don't talk to her—she's very easily distracted.
It was another attempt to distract attention from the truth.
He’s easily distracted from his work
an attempt to distract attention away from the real problems in the country

senses.definition_vi: lấy đi sự chú ý của ai đó khỏi những gì họ đang cố gắng làm

senses.definition: a feeling of great worry or unhappiness; great mental pain

examples.x: The newspaper article caused the actor considerable distress.
She sensed his deep emotional distress.
She was obviously in distress after the attack.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy rất lo lắng hoặc không hạnh phúc

senses.definition: severe problems caused by not having enough money, food, etc.

examples.x: economic/financial distress
The charity aims to relieve poverty and distress caused by natural disasters.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy rất lo lắng hoặc không hạnh phúc

senses.definition: a situation in which a ship, plane, etc. is in danger or difficulty and needs help

examples.x: a distress signal (= a message asking for help)
It is a rule of the sea to help another boat in distress.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy rất lo lắng hoặc không hạnh phúc

senses.definition: a state of physical pain and effort, especially difficulty in breathing

examples.x: The patient was suffering serious respiratory distress.
The baby was clearly in distress.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy rất lo lắng hoặc không hạnh phúc

senses.definition: a young woman who needs help
senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy rất lo lắng hoặc không hạnh phúc

senses.definition: to give things to a large number of people; to share something between a number of people or groups

examples.x: The leaflets have been widely distributed.
The newspaper is distributed free.
to distribute fliers/pamphlets/questionnaires
Viruses are often distributed via email.
The organization distributed food to the earthquake victims.
The money was distributed among schools in the area.
The proceeds will be distributed between local charities.

senses.definition_vi: trao vật cho một số lượng lớn người; chia sẻ một cái gì đó giữa một số người hoặc nhóm

senses.definition: to send goods to shops and businesses so that they can be sold

examples.x: Who distributes our products in the UK?
Their trademark jeans enjoyed immediate success and were soon distributed worldwide.

senses.definition_vi: gửi hàng hóa đến các cửa hàng và doanh nghiệp để chúng có thể được bán

senses.definition: to spread something, or different parts of something, over an area

examples.x: Make sure your weight is evenly distributed.
Cases of the disease are widely distributed through Europe.

senses.definition_vi: lan truyền một cái gì đó, hoặc các bộ phận khác nhau của một cái gì đó, trên một khu vực

senses.definition: the way that something is spread or exists over a particular area or among a particular group of people

examples.x: They studied the geographical distribution of the disease.
a more equitable distribution of wealth
an unequal/uneven income distribution
the age distribution of the general population
The map shows the distribution of this species across the world.

senses.definition_vi: cách một cái gì đó được lan truyền hoặc tồn tại trên một khu vực cụ thể hoặc trong một nhóm người cụ thể

senses.definition: the act of giving or sharing something out among a number of people

examples.x: the distribution of food and medicines
the distribution of profit among the partners
When are distributions likely to be made to creditors?
The food was packed up for distribution to outlying communities.

senses.definition_vi: hành động trao hoặc chia sẻ một cái gì đó cho một số người

senses.definition: the system of transporting and delivering a product

examples.x: They have systems in place for marketing, sales and distribution.
We focused on finding new distribution channels for our products.
The company's distribution network includes more than 1  200 retail outlets.
production and distribution systems
a distribution centre/depot/warehouse

senses.definition_vi: hệ thống vận chuyển và giao sản phẩm

senses.definition: an area of a country or town, especially one that has particular features

examples.x: the City of London’s financial district
Every city has its central business district.
The house is in a historic district.
Milan's most fashionable shopping district
a poor district of the city
rural/urban districts

senses.definition_vi: một khu vực của một quốc gia hoặc thị trấn, đặc biệt là một khu vực có các đặc điểm nhất định

senses.definition: one of the areas that a country, town or state is divided into for purposes of organization, with official boundaries (= borders)

examples.x: a tax district
a village in the Darjeeling district
a district judge
the district health authority

senses.definition_vi: một trong những khu vực mà một quốc gia, thị trấn hoặc tiểu bang được chia thành cho mục đích tổ chức, với ranh giới chính thức (= biên giới)

senses.definition: to interrupt somebody when they are trying to work, sleep, etc.

examples.x: I'm sorry to disturb you, but can I talk to you for a moment?
If you get up early, try not to disturb everyone else.
Do not disturb (= a sign placed on the outside of the door of a hotel room, office, etc.)
She awoke early after a disturbed night.
Only the cry of seabirds disturbed the silence.

senses.definition_vi: làm gián đoạn ai đó khi họ đang cố gắng làm việc, ngủ, v.v.

senses.definition: to make somebody worry

examples.x: The letter shocked and disturbed me.

examples.cf: it disturbs somebody to do something
examples.x: It disturbed her to realize that she was alone.
It disturbed her to realize that she was missing him already.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó lo lắng

senses.definition: to move something or change its position

examples.x: Don't disturb the papers on my desk.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển một cái gì đó hoặc thay đổi vị trí của nó

senses.definition: to make something function differently from normal

examples.x: During a magnetic storm, the earth's magnetic field is disturbed.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho một cái gì đó hoạt động khác với bình thường

senses.definition: making you feel anxious and upset or shocked

examples.x: a disturbing piece of news
a profoundly disturbing experience

senses.definition_vi: làm cho bạn cảm thấy lo lắng, buồn bã hoặc sốc

senses.definition: a jump into deep water with your head first and your arms in front of you

examples.x: a spectacular high dive (= from high above the water)

senses.definition_vi: nhảy xuống nước với đầu và tay bạn chạm nước trước

senses.definition: an act of going underwater and swimming there with special equipment

examples.x: a dive to a depth of 18 metres
We did a deep dive to see if we could find the wreckage.

senses.definition_vi: nhảy xuống nước với đầu và tay bạn chạm nước trước

senses.definition: an act of suddenly flying downwards

examples.x: The pilot seemed to be having difficulty in pulling out of the dive.
The plane went into a steep dive.

senses.definition_vi: nhảy xuống nước với đầu và tay bạn chạm nước trước

senses.definition: a bar, music club, etc. that is cheap, and perhaps dark or dirty

examples.x: The band played in every smoky dive in town.

senses.definition_vi: nhảy xuống nước với đầu và tay bạn chạm nước trước

senses.definition: a deliberate fall that a player makes when somebody tackles them

examples.x: Kane's dive won England a penalty.

senses.definition_vi: nhảy xuống nước với đầu và tay bạn chạm nước trước

senses.definition: to suddenly move or jump forward to do something or reach somebody/something

examples.x: The goalkeeper made a dive for the ball.
Paul made a dive for the fridge to get a drink.

senses.definition_vi: nhảy xuống nước với đầu và tay bạn chạm nước trước

senses.definition: to suddenly get worse

examples.x: Profits really took a dive last year.
The market is volatile and profits could take a dive.

senses.definition_vi: nhảy xuống nước với đầu và tay bạn chạm nước trước

senses.definition: very different from each other and of various kinds

examples.x: People from diverse cultures were invited to the event.
My interests are very diverse.

senses.definition_vi: rất khác nhau và thuộc nhiều loại khác nhau

senses.definition: a range of many people or things that are very different from each other

examples.x: the biological diversity of the rainforests
a great/wide/rich diversity of opinion

senses.definition_vi: một loạt nhiều người hoặc vật rất khác nhau

senses.definition: the quality or fact of including a range of many people or things

examples.x: There is a need for greater diversity and choice in education.

senses.definition_vi: chất lượng hoặc sự thật bao gồm một loạt nhiều người hoặc vật

senses.definition: the practice or quality of including or involving people from a range of different social and ethnic backgrounds and of different genders, religions, etc.

examples.x: People are being encouraged to celebrate the diversity of their communities.
The company is working to improve its profile in terms of diversity and inclusion.

senses.definition_vi: thực hành hoặc chất lượng bao gồm hoặc liên quan đến những người thuộc nhiều nguồn gốc xã hội và dân tộc khác nhau và có giới tính, tôn giáo, v.v. khác nhau

senses.definition: to make somebody/something change direction

examples.x: The course of the stream has now been diverted.
Northbound traffic will have to be diverted onto minor roads.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó thay đổi hướng

senses.definition: to use money, materials, etc. for a different purpose from their original purpose

examples.x: More of the budget was diverted into promotions.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng tiền, vật liệu, v.v. cho một mục đích khác với mục đích ban đầu của chúng

senses.definition: to take somebody’s thoughts or attention away from something

examples.x: The war diverted people's attention away from the economic situation.
She managed to divert the baby onto a different activity.

senses.definition_vi: lấy suy nghĩ hoặc sự chú ý của ai đó ra khỏi điều gì đó

senses.definition: to entertain people

examples.x: Children are easily diverted.

senses.definition_vi: giải trí cho mọi người

senses.definition: a difference between two groups of people or two things that separates them from each other

examples.x: He offered advice on bridging cultural divides.
to straddle/cross a divide
The referendum revealed a deep urban–rural divide.
Will this deepen the divide between the country's rich and poor?

senses.definition_vi: tách thành các bộ phận; làm cho một cái gì đó tách thành các bộ phận

senses.definition: a line of high land that separates two systems of rivers
senses.definition_vi: tách thành các bộ phận; làm cho một cái gì đó tách thành các bộ phận

senses.definition: to reduce or get rid of the differences that exist between two things or groups of people

examples.x: The new degree course aims to bridge the gulf between education and industry.

senses.definition_vi: tách thành các bộ phận; làm cho một cái gì đó tách thành các bộ phận

senses.definition: coming from or connected with God or a god

examples.x: divine law/love/will
divine intervention (= help from God to change a situation)

senses.definition_vi: đến từ hoặc liên quan đến Chúa hoặc một vị thần

senses.definition: wonderful; beautiful

examples.x: That mango tasted divine!

senses.definition_vi: tuyệt vời; đẹp đẽ

senses.definition: the process or result of dividing into separate parts; the process or result of dividing something or sharing it out

examples.x: The organism begins as a single cell and grows by cell division.
We need to ensure a fair division of time and resources.

examples.cf: division (of something) between A and B
examples.x: the division of responsibilities between different members of the team
The living room is divided from a large terrace by glass walls so division between inside and outside is blurred.
His will detailed his assets and gave instructions for their division among his children.
The fund is available for discretionary division among members.
This division of the population into age groups is obviously convenient for marketing purposes.
This is a distinction which cuts right across the familiar division into arts and sciences.

senses.definition_vi: quá trình hoặc kết quả của việc chia thành các phần riêng biệt; quá trình hoặc kết quả của việc chia một thứ gì đó hoặc chia sẻ nó

senses.definition: the process of dividing one number by another

examples.x: the division sign (÷)
division by three

senses.definition_vi: quá trình chia một số cho một số khác

senses.definition: a disagreement or difference in opinion, way of life, etc., especially between members of a society or an organization

examples.x: We choose peace over hatred and division.
There are deep divisions in the party over the war.
the work of healing the divisions within society
divisions between rich and poor
The party was weakened by division between various factions.
Her comments appeared to have deepened divisions between the two countries.
He has tried to sow division among the people.

senses.definition_vi: sự bất đồng hoặc khác biệt về ý kiến, cách sống, v.v., đặc biệt là giữa các thành viên của một xã hội hoặc một tổ chức

senses.definition: a large and important unit or section of an organization

examples.x: the organized crime division of the Austrian police force
The company's sales division is going to be restructured.
the head of the crime division in West Yorkshire police
She works in the marketing division.
The company recently launched its publishing division.
the administrative divisions of the Roman Empire
The company sold its financial services division for £762m.
The whole division works/work in the office on Tuesdays.

senses.definition_vi: một đơn vị hoặc bộ phận lớn và quan trọng của một tổ chức

senses.definition: part of a city, county, or country that is regarded as a separate area for administration purposes

examples.x: Oldham is one of the police divisions of Greater Manchester.
Nagpur is the most eastern division in the state.

senses.definition_vi: một phần của thành phố, quận hoặc quốc gia được coi là một khu vực riêng biệt cho mục đích hành chính

senses.definition: a group of teams or competitors in a sports competition who compete against each other. Divisions may be organized by ability, geography or weight, depending on the sport.

examples.x: the premier division
The club will finish second in Division One.
a first-division team
one of the most competitive weight divisions in judo

senses.definition_vi: một nhóm các đội hoặc đối thủ cạnh tranh trong một cuộc thi thể thao, những người thi đấu với nhau. Các hạng đấu có thể được tổ chức theo khả năng, địa lý hoặc cân nặng, tùy thuộc vào môn thể thao.

senses.definition: a unit of an army, consisting of several brigades or regiments

examples.x: the Guards Armoured Division
The commander of the fourth infantry division defied orders.

senses.definition_vi: một đơn vị của quân đội, bao gồm nhiều lữ đoàn hoặc trung đoàn

senses.definition: a line that divides something

examples.x: A hedge forms the division between their land and ours.
Sometimes there is no simple division between good and evil.

senses.definition_vi: một đường chia một thứ gì đó

senses.definition: the act of separating members of the British parliament into groups to vote for or against something

examples.x: The Bill was read without a division.

senses.definition_vi: hành động tách các thành viên của quốc hội Anh thành các nhóm để bỏ phiếu cho hoặc chống lại một điều gì đó

senses.definition: the legal ending of a marriage

examples.x: The marriage ended in divorce in 1996.
an increase in the divorce rate (= the number of divorces in a year)
They have agreed to get a divorce.
Divorce proceedings (= the legal process of divorce) started today.
Bella wants a divorce.
He remarried after a divorce from his first wife, Kate.
She told him she was filing for divorce.

senses.definition_vi: chấm dứt hợp pháp cuộc hôn nhân của bạn với ai đó

senses.definition: an act of separating two things; the ending of a relationship between two things

examples.x: the divorce between religion and science

senses.definition_vi: chấm dứt hợp pháp cuộc hôn nhân của bạn với ai đó

senses.definition: no longer married because your marriage has been legally ended

examples.x: My parents are divorced.
Many divorced men remarry and have second families.
a divorced father/mother/couple

senses.definition_vi: không còn kết hôn vì cuộc hôn nhân của bạn đã được chấm dứt hợp pháp

senses.definition: appearing not to be affected by something; separate from something

examples.x: He seems completely divorced from reality.

senses.definition_vi: có vẻ như không bị ảnh hưởng bởi một điều gì đó; tách biệt khỏi một điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to refer to actions that you do not mention by name or do not know about

examples.x: What are you doing this evening?
We will do what we can to help.
Are you doing anything tomorrow evening?
The company ought to do something about the poor service.
What have you done to your hair?
There's nothing to do (= no means of passing the time in an enjoyable way) in this place.
There's nothing we can do about it (= we can't change the situation).
What can I do for you (= how can I help)?

senses.definition_vi: nếu một âm thanh vọng lại, nó được phản xạ khỏi tường, sườn núi, v.v. để bạn có thể nghe lại

developed economies

possible economies in phone costs

an economy fare/ticket/seat/passenger

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu tách rời hoặc thất bại

senses.definition_vi: rất phấn khích và tập trung hoàn toàn vào điều gì đó

senses.definition_vi: có một số phần nhỏ, ví dụ trong một màn trình diễn hoặc trong tính cách của bạn, vẫn chưa tốt như đáng lẽ phải có

senses.definition_vi: làm cho cái gì đó bớt mạnh, bớt tệ, v.v.

senses.definition: to be very close to a very unpleasant or dangerous situation

senses.definition_vi: khi ai đó biên tập một bộ phim, chương trình truyền hình, v.v. họ lấy những gì đã được quay hoặc ghi lại và quyết định những phần nào sẽ đưa vào và theo thứ tự nào

the print/online edition

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến nhiệm vụ chuẩn bị một cái gì đó như một tờ báo, một cuốn sách hoặc một chương trình truyền hình hoặc radio để xuất bản hoặc phát sóng

post-secondary education

the British education system

senses.definition_vi: các tổ chức hoặc con người tham gia vào việc giảng dạy và đào tạo

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến giáo dục

an educational visit
educational games/toys (= that teach you something as well as amusing you)

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp giáo dục

senses.definition_vi: một người có công việc là dạy hoặc giáo dục mọi người
