senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó/điều gì đó cảm thấy khó chịu hoặc lo lắng

senses.definition: to remain determined to succeed even when a situation is difficult
senses.definition_vi: vẫn quyết tâm thành công ngay cả khi tình huống khó khăn

senses.definition: to take a left/right turn
senses.definition_vi: rẽ trái/phải

senses.definition: to remain calm; to not worry

examples.x: It's OK—hang loose and stay cool.

senses.definition_vi: giữ bình tĩnh; không lo lắng

senses.definition: to hold somebody/something very tightly or keep something in a very determined way because you are afraid

examples.x: You get a job, then you get a mortgage and then you hang on like grim death to your job to pay off the mortgage.

senses.definition_vi: giữ chặt ai đó/điều gì đó hoặc giữ điều gì đó một cách rất kiên quyết vì bạn sợ hãi

senses.definition: to listen with great attention to somebody you admire

examples.x: The journalists hung on his every word as he spoke of his ordeal.

senses.definition_vi: lắng nghe với sự chú ý cao độ một người mà bạn ngưỡng mộ

senses.definition: to put somebody in a difficult situation

examples.x: She is being hung out to dry for one silly mistake.

senses.definition_vi: đặt ai đó vào một tình huống khó khăn

senses.definition: to be determined and refuse to change your attitude or ideas
senses.definition_vi: quyết tâm và từ chối thay đổi thái độ hoặc ý tưởng của bạn

senses.definition: if the future of something/somebody, or the result of something is/hangs in the balance, it is not certain

examples.x: The long-term future of the space programme hangs in the balance.
Tom’s life hung in the balance for two weeks as he lay in a coma.

senses.definition_vi: tương lai của một cái gì đó/ai đó, hoặc kết quả của một cái gì đó đang bị treo lơ lửng, nó không chắc chắn

senses.definition: to express your feelings freely
senses.definition_vi: bày tỏ cảm xúc của bạn một cách tự do

senses.definition: if you are going to be punished for doing something wrong, whether it is a big or small thing, you may as well do the big thing
senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn sẽ bị phạt vì làm điều gì đó sai trái, dù đó là việc lớn hay nhỏ, bạn cũng có thể làm việc lớn

senses.definition: something that gives you an excuse or opportunity to discuss or explain something

examples.x: The character provides a peg to hang the writer’s political ideas on.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó mang lại cho bạn một cái cớ hoặc cơ hội để thảo luận hoặc giải thích điều gì đó

senses.definition: to take place, especially without being planned

examples.x: You'll never guess what's happened!
Accidents like this happen all the time.
The most recent incident happened only a week ago.
The government has denied that the events ever happened.
Change doesn't happen overnight.
You have to make things happen.
Let's see what happens next week.
I'll be there whatever happens.
No matter what happens, he's going to pay for what he's done.
Is this really happening or is it a dream?
This would never happen in real life.
I don't know how this happened.
I try to keep up with what is happening in the world.

senses.definition_vi: diễn ra, đặc biệt là không có kế hoạch

senses.definition: to take place as the result of something

examples.x: She pressed the button but nothing happened.
What happens if nobody comes to the party?
Just plug it in and see what happens.

senses.definition_vi: diễn ra như là kết quả của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to do or be something by chance

examples.x: She happened to be out when we called.
You don't happen to know his name, do you?
This happens to be my favourite restaurant.
The door happened to be unlocked.
It happened that she was out when we called.

senses.definition_vi: làm hoặc là một cái gì đó một cách tình cờ

senses.definition: used to tell somebody something, especially when you are disagreeing with them or annoyed by what they have said

examples.x: That happens to be my mother you're talking about!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói với ai đó một điều gì đó, đặc biệt là khi bạn không đồng ý với họ hoặc khó chịu về những gì họ đã nói

senses.definition: a thing or person that is very likely to cause danger or a problem in the future because of the condition it is in or the way they behave

examples.x: Any one of these nuclear plants may be a disaster waiting to happen.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ hoặc một người rất có khả năng gây nguy hiểm hoặc vấn đề trong tương lai vì tình trạng của nó hoặc cách nó cư xử

senses.definition: people say accidents will happen to tell somebody who has had an accident, for example breaking something, that it does not matter and they should not worry
senses.definition_vi: người ta nói tai nạn sẽ xảy ra để nói với ai đó đã gặp tai nạn, ví dụ như làm vỡ đồ, rằng điều đó không quan trọng và họ không nên lo lắng

senses.definition: used to say that it is not possible to know what the result of something will be
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng không thể biết kết quả của một điều gì đó sẽ như thế nào

senses.definition: used when you say something that is surprising, or something connected with what somebody else has just said

examples.x: I agree with you, as it happens.
As it happens, I have a spare set of keys in my office.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn nói điều gì đó đáng ngạc nhiên, hoặc điều gì đó liên quan đến những gì người khác vừa nói

senses.definition: if something happens

examples.x: In the event of an accident, call this number.
Sheila will inherit everything in the event of his death.
In the unlikely event of a crash, please remain calm.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một điều gì đó xảy ra

senses.definition: by chance

examples.x: It just so happened they'd been invited too.

senses.definition_vi: một cách tình cờ

senses.definition: used to express the idea that we must accept that bad things often happen without reason
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng chúng ta phải chấp nhận rằng những điều tồi tệ thường xảy ra mà không có lý do

senses.definition: used to tell somebody not to worry about something they have done

examples.x: ‘Sorry—I've broken a glass.’ ‘Never mind. These things happen.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói với ai đó đừng lo lắng về những gì họ đã làm

senses.definition: in a cheerful way; with feelings of pleasure

examples.x: children playing happily on the beach
to be happily married
I think we can manage quite happily on our own.
And they all lived happily ever after (= used as the end of a fairy tale).

senses.definition_vi: một cách vui vẻ; với cảm giác thích thú

senses.definition: by good luck

examples.x: Happily, the damage was only slight.

senses.definition_vi: bởi may mắn

senses.definition: willingly

examples.x: I'll happily help, if I can.
A majority of those interviewed said they would happily accept a tax increase if the money went to health and education.

senses.definition_vi: sẵn lòng

senses.definition: in a way that is suitable or appropriate

examples.x: This suggestion did not fit very happily with our existing plans.

senses.definition_vi: một cách phù hợp hoặc thích hợp

senses.definition: the state of feeling or showing pleasure

examples.x: to find true happiness
Fame did not bring her happiness.
the pursuit of happiness
Her eyes shone with happiness.
Their grandchildren are a constant source of happiness.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái cảm thấy hoặc thể hiện niềm vui; hài lòng

senses.definition: the state of being satisfied that something is good or right

examples.x: The meeting expressed happiness about the progress made.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái hài lòng rằng một cái gì đó là tốt hoặc đúng

senses.definition: feeling or showing pleasure; pleased

examples.x: a happy family
a happy smile/face
You don't look very happy today.
He always seemed happy enough.
I've never felt so happy.
Money won't make you happy.
We are happy to announce the engagement of our daughter.
I'm very happy for you.
I’m happy (that) you could come.

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy hoặc thể hiện niềm vui; hài lòng

senses.definition: giving or causing pleasure

examples.x: She had a very happy life.
a happy marriage/childhood/occasion
I have many happy memories from that time.
The story has a happy ending.
Those were the happiest days of my life.
It had been a gloriously happy time.

senses.definition_vi: mang lại hoặc gây ra niềm vui

senses.definition: if you wish somebody a Happy Birthday, Happy New Year, etc. you mean that you hope they have a pleasant celebration
senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn chúc ai đó Sinh nhật vui vẻ, Năm mới vui vẻ, v.v., bạn có nghĩa là bạn hy vọng họ có một lễ kỷ niệm dễ chịu

senses.definition: satisfied that something is good or right; not anxious

examples.x: I don't know what you've done, but the boss isn't happy.
I said I'd go just to keep him happy.
Are you happy with that arrangement?
I'm not happy with his work this term.
She was happy enough with her performance.
If there's anything you're not happy about, come and ask.
I'm not too happy about her living alone.

senses.definition_vi: hài lòng rằng một cái gì đó là tốt hoặc đúng; không lo lắng

senses.definition: willing or pleased to do something

examples.x: I'm perfectly happy to leave it till tomorrow.
People seemed quite happy to help.
He will be more than happy to come with us.
We'd be only too happy to accept your invitation.

senses.definition_vi: sẵn lòng hoặc vui lòng làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: lucky; successful

examples.x: By a happy coincidence, we arrived at exactly the same time.
He is in the happy position of never having to worry about money.

senses.definition_vi: may mắn; thành công

senses.definition: suitable and appropriate for a particular situation

examples.x: That wasn't the happiest choice of words.

senses.definition_vi: thích hợp và phù hợp cho một tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: (not) pleased about a situation

examples.x: She wasn't a happy bunny at all.

senses.definition_vi: hài lòng về một tình huống

senses.definition: the birth of a baby
senses.definition_vi: sự ra đời của một em bé

senses.definition: a course of action that is not extreme
senses.definition_vi: một hướng hành động không cực đoan

senses.definition: something that is in the middle between two choices or two ways of doing something

examples.x: She tried to strike a happy medium between making the questions too hard and making them too easy.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó ở giữa hai lựa chọn hoặc hai cách làm việc

senses.definition: used to wish somebody a happy and pleasant birthday
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chúc ai đó sinh nhật vui vẻ và dễ chịu

senses.definition: the act of annoying or worrying somebody by putting pressure on them or saying or doing unpleasant things to them

examples.x: sexual/racial harassment
workplace/street harassment (= that happens at work/in the street)

senses.definition_vi: hành động làm phiền hoặc lo lắng ai đó bằng cách gây áp lực lên họ hoặc nói hoặc làm những điều khó chịu với họ

senses.definition: the act of making repeated attacks on an enemy

examples.x: guerrilla harassment of the enemy

senses.definition_vi: hành động tấn công lặp đi lặp lại vào kẻ thù

senses.definition: an area of water on the coast, protected from the open sea by strong walls, where ships can shelter

examples.x: Several boats lay at anchor in the harbour.
to enter/leave harbour
the harbour front/mouth/wall
She felt as though she'd reached a safe harbour after sailing in a vast, unfriendly sea.

senses.definition_vi: một khu vực nước trên bờ biển, được che chắn khỏi biển cả bởi các bức tường vững chắc, nơi tàu thuyền có thể trú ẩn

senses.definition: difficult to do, understand or answer

examples.x: a hard choice/decision/question
It is hard to believe that she's only nine.
It's hard to see how they can lose.
It's hard to imagine a more cynical political strategy.
‘When will the job be finished?’ ‘It's hard to say (= it is difficult to be certain)’ .
It's getting harder and harder to earn enough to pay the rent.
I find his attitude very hard to take (= difficult to accept).
We're finding reliable staff hard to come by (= difficult to get).
Houses like this are extremely hard to find.
You are hard to please, aren’t you?
I found it hard to believe what they told me.
It must be hard for her, bringing up four children on her own.

examples.cf: hard for somebody to do something
examples.x: It's hard for old people to change their ways.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: full of difficulty and problems, especially because of a lack of money

examples.x: Times were hard at the end of the war.
She's had a hard life.
Life got very hard.
Conditions were extremely hard in the camps.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: needing or using a lot of physical strength or mental effort

examples.x: It's hard work shovelling snow.
This is the hardest part of my job.
It was one of the hardest things I ever did.
I've had a long hard day.
This season has been a hard slog.
They had put in hours of hard graft.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: putting a lot of effort or energy into an activity

examples.x: She's a very hard worker.
He's hard at work on a new novel.
When I left they were all still hard at it (= working hard).

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: done with a lot of strength or force

examples.x: He gave the door a good hard kick.
a hard punch

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: solid or stiff and difficult to bend or break

examples.x: Wait for the concrete to go hard.
a hard mattress
Diamonds are the hardest known mineral.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: showing no kind feelings or sympathy

examples.x: My father was a hard man.
She gave me a hard stare.
His voice was hard.
He said some very hard things to me.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: showing no signs of fear or weakness; ready to fight or compete

examples.x: Come and get me if you think you're hard enough.
You think you're really hard, don't you?
He's as hard and uncompromising as any professional sportsman.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: definitely true and based on information that can be proved

examples.x: Is there any hard evidence either way?
The newspaper story is based on hard facts.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: very cold and severe

examples.x: It had been a hard winter.
There was a hard frost that night.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: strongly alcoholic

examples.x: hard liquor
a drop of the hard stuff (= a strong alcoholic drink)

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: containing calcium and other mineral salts that make mixing with soap difficult

examples.x: a hard water area
Our water is very hard.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: used to describe a letter c or g when pronounced as in ‘cat’ or ‘go’, rather than as in ‘city’ or ‘giant’
senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: to treat or criticize somebody in a very severe or strict way

examples.x: Don't be too hard on him—he's very young.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: to be difficult for or unfair to somebody/something

examples.x: It's hard on people who don't have a car.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: to be likely to hurt or damage something

examples.x: Looking at a computer screen all day can be very hard on the eyes.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: in a situation where you have to choose between two things, both of which are unpleasant
senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: to argue in an aggressive way and force somebody to agree on the best possible price or arrangement
senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: to deliberately make a situation difficult and unpleasant for somebody

examples.x: They really gave me a hard time at the interview.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: that cannot be changed in any circumstances

examples.x: There are no hard and fast rules about this.
This situation isn’t hard and fast.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: showing no fear, sympathy or kind behaviour
senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: used as a way of saying that you are sorry about something, usually ironically (= you really mean the opposite)
senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: difficult to understand or needing a lot of effort

examples.x: I'm finding his latest novel very hard going.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: used to tell somebody that you feel sorry for them

examples.x: ‘Failed again, I'm afraid.’ ‘Oh, hard luck.’

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: a difficult problem or situation to deal with
senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: a person or event that is so good or successful at something that it will be difficult for anyone/anything else coming after them to be as good or successful

examples.x: She has been an excellent principal and will be a hard act to follow.
Their contribution will prove a tough act to follow.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: by having an unpleasant experience or by making mistakes

examples.x: She won't listen to my advice so she'll just have to learn the hard way.
He learned about the dangers of drugs the hard way.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: to have difficulty doing something

examples.x: You'll have a job convincing them that you're right.
He had a hard job to make himself heard.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: to use more time or energy on a task than is necessary
senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: used after you have been arguing with somebody or have beaten them in a contest but you would still like to be friendly with them

examples.x: It looks like I'm the winner again. No hard feelings, Dave, eh?
Someone has to lose. No hard feelings, eh?

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: to make yourself seem more attractive or interesting by not immediately accepting an invitation to do something
senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: to consider a problem or possibility very carefully and without hurrying

examples.x: We need to take a long, hard look at all the options.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: needing too much effort

examples.x: I can't be bothered making a hot meal—it's too much like hard work.

senses.definition_vi: với nhiều nỗ lực; một cách khó khăn

senses.definition: almost no; almost not; almost none

examples.x: There's hardly any tea left.
Hardly anyone has bothered to reply.
She hardly ever calls me (= almost never).
We hardly know each other.
I had hardly seen my father since that day.
It hardly seems fair to put all the blame on him.
Hardly a day goes by without my thinking of her (= I think of her almost every day).
At the time, I hardly spoke any French.
There was hardly a cloud in the sky.

senses.definition_vi: hầu như không có; hầu như không; hầu như không có cái nào

senses.definition: used especially after ‘can’ or ‘could’ and before the main verb, to emphasize that it is difficult to do something

examples.x: I can hardly keep my eyes open (= I'm almost falling asleep).
I could hardly believe it when I read the letter.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng đặc biệt sau 'can' hoặc 'could' và trước động từ chính, để nhấn mạnh rằng việc làm gì đó là khó khăn

senses.definition: used to suggest that something is unlikely or unreasonable or that somebody is silly for saying or doing something

examples.x: He is hardly likely to admit he was wrong.
It's hardly surprising she was fired; she never did any work.
It's hardly the time to discuss it now.
You can hardly expect her to do it for free.
‘Couldn't you have just said no?’ ‘Well, hardly (= of course not), she's my wife's sister.’
He’s 24—hardly a baby.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để gợi ý rằng điều gì đó không có khả năng xảy ra hoặc vô lý hoặc ai đó ngớ ngẩn khi nói hoặc làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to say that something has just begun, happened, etc.

examples.x: We can't stop for coffee now, we've hardly started.
We had hardly sat down to supper when my phone rang.
Hardly had she spoken before she regretted it bitterly.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng điều gì đó vừa mới bắt đầu, xảy ra, v.v.

senses.definition: the machines and electronic parts in a computer or other electronic system

examples.x: We supply computer hardware to businesses.

senses.definition_vi: các máy móc và bộ phận điện tử trong máy tính hoặc hệ thống điện tử khác

senses.definition: tools and equipment that are used in the house and garden

examples.x: a hardware shop/store

senses.definition_vi: công cụ và thiết bị được sử dụng trong nhà và vườn

senses.definition: the equipment, machines and vehicles used to do something

examples.x: tanks and other military hardware

senses.definition_vi: thiết bị, máy móc và phương tiện được sử dụng để làm một việc gì đó

senses.definition: damage or injury that is caused by a person or an event

examples.x: He would never frighten anyone or cause them any harm.
The accused clearly intended to inflict harm on him.
He may look fierce, but he means no harm.
No definite harm to human health has been determined.
The court case will do serious harm to my business.
The accident could have been much worse; luckily no harm was done.
Don't worry, we'll see that the children come to no harm.
I can't say I like Mark very much, but I don't wish him any harm.
Hard work never did anyone any harm.
Look, we're just going out for a few drinks, where's the harm in that?
The treatment they gave him did him more harm than good.

senses.definition_vi: làm tổn hại hoặc gây thương tích cho ai đó hoặc làm hỏng một cái gì đó

senses.definition: used to suggest that it would be a good idea for somebody to do something

examples.x: It wouldn't do you any harm to smarten yourself up.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái khỏe mạnh về thể chất và tinh thần

the Department of Health
health professionals/workers

senses.definition_vi: mức độ thành công của một cái gì đó

senses.definition_vi: nói trước khi uống rượu để bày tỏ lời chúc tốt đẹp cho sức khỏe và hạnh phúc của ai đó

senses.definition: looking or feeling very healthy

senses.definition_vi: yêu cầu mọi người chúc ai đó sức khỏe, hạnh phúc và thành công bằng cách nâng ly và uống

senses.definition: the service of providing medical care

community healthcare
healthcare workers/professionals

senses.definition_vi: dịch vụ cung cấp chăm sóc y tế

senses.definition: having good health and not likely to become ill

a healthy animal/tree

The newborn was perfectly healthy.
People are living longer and living healthier lives.

senses.definition_vi: có sức khỏe tốt và không có khả năng bị bệnh

senses.definition: good for your health

healthy eating/food/living

senses.definition_vi: tốt cho sức khỏe của bạn

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện rằng bạn có sức khỏe tốt

senses.definition_vi: bình thường và hợp lý

senses.definition_vi: thành công và hoạt động tốt

a healthy profit

Did you hear him go out?

Didn't you hear what I said?

senses.definition_vi: nhận thức được âm thanh bằng tai của bạn

I’ve heard it said (that) they met in Italy.

We are waiting to hear what the lawyers have to say.

senses.definition_vi: được cho biết về điều gì đó

Today the jury began to hear the evidence.

senses.definition_vi: lắng nghe và phán xử một vụ án tại tòa

senses.definition: used to ask somebody if they have heard a particular joke before

senses.definition: used to show that you agree with or approve of what somebody has just said, especially during a speech

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói với ai đó rằng bạn đã lắng nghe ý kiến của họ, đặc biệt là khi bạn sắp đưa ra một ý kiến khác

senses.definition: used to say that you do not really believe somebody’s promises or excuses because they are the same ones you have heard before
senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn không thực sự tin vào lời hứa hoặc lời bào chữa của ai đó vì chúng giống với những gì bạn đã nghe trước đây

senses.definition: used to give the most recent news you have about somebody/something

senses.definition_vi: dùng để đưa ra tin tức mới nhất bạn có về ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng ai đó/điều gì đó xứng đáng được khen ngợi

senses.definition_vi: cực kỳ yên tĩnh

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói với ai đó một cách tức giận rằng hãy chú ý và nghe lời bạn

hearing loss

senses.definition_vi: đủ gần với ai đó để họ có thể nghe thấy những gì được nói

heart disease/problems
to have a heart condition
heart patients/surgery

His sad story touched her heart.

senses.definition_vi: nơi trong một người mà cảm xúc và tình cảm được cho là tồn tại, đặc biệt là những cảm xúc liên quan đến tình yêu

senses.definition_vi: rất thân thiết với ai đó

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng ai đó đột nhiên cảm thấy buồn hoặc chán nản về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to fall in love with somebody/something

senses.definition: a man/woman who likes the same things or has the same opinions as you

examples.x: She's learnt the whole speech off by heart.
I've seen the show so often I know all the songs by heart.

senses.definition_vi: chỉ sử dụng trí nhớ

senses.definition_vi: vì những tình cảm tốt đẹp, không suy nghĩ về lợi ích cá nhân

senses.definition_vi: kể cho ai đó nghe tất cả các vấn đề, cảm xúc, v.v. của bạn

senses.definition: performed by skaters on an ice rink

examples.x: Cinderella on ice

senses.definition_vi: được biểu diễn bởi các vận động viên trượt băng trên sân băng

senses.definition: a type of sweet frozen food made from milk fat, tasting of fruit, chocolate, etc. and often eaten as a dessert; a small amount of this food intended for one person, often served in a container made of biscuit that is like a cone in shape

examples.x: Desserts are served with cream or ice cream.
Who wants an ice cream?
apple pie with ice cream

senses.definition_vi: một loại thực phẩm đông lạnh ngọt làm từ chất béo sữa, có hương vị trái cây, sô cô la, v.v. và thường ăn như món tráng miệng; một lượng nhỏ thực phẩm này dành cho một người, thường được phục vụ trong một chiếc ốc quế làm bằng bánh quy

senses.definition: a small symbol on a computer or smartphone screen that represents a program or a file

examples.x: Click on the printer icon with the mouse.
Tap the app icon on your phone to open it.

senses.definition_vi: một biểu tượng nhỏ trên màn hình máy tính hoặc điện thoại thông minh đại diện cho một chương trình hoặc một tệp

senses.definition: a famous person or thing that people admire and see as a symbol of a particular idea, way of life, etc.

examples.x: Madonna and other pop icons of the 1980s
a feminist/gay icon (= somebody that feminists/gay people admire)
Sandra has become a style icon, for the fashion world particularly.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật nổi tiếng mà mọi người ngưỡng mộ và coi như một biểu tượng của một ý tưởng, lối sống cụ thể, v.v.

senses.definition: a painting or statue of a holy person that is also thought of as a holy object
senses.definition_vi: một bức tranh hoặc bức tượng về một người thánh cũng được coi là một vật thánh

senses.definition: an official way of showing who you are, for example a document with your name, date of birth and often a photograph on it (the abbreviation for ‘identity’ or ‘identification’)

examples.x: You must carry ID at all times.
The police checked IDs at the gate.
You will need some form of photo ID.

senses.definition_vi: một cách chính thức để chứng minh bạn là ai, ví dụ: một tài liệu có tên, ngày sinh và thường có ảnh của bạn (viết tắt của ‘identity’ hoặc ‘identification’)

senses.definition: identification (= the fact of showing, proving or recognizing who or what somebody/something is)

examples.x: The police need a witness to make a positive ID.

senses.definition_vi: sự nhận dạng (= việc cho thấy, chứng minh hoặc nhận ra ai hoặc cái gì là ai/cái gì)

senses.definition: a plan, thought or suggestion, especially about what to do in a particular situation

examples.x: It would be a good idea to call before we leave.
That's a great idea!
I’ve had a brilliant idea!
I knew this was a bad idea.
The party's latest big idea is to create a Centre for Teaching Excellence.
The surprise party was Jane's idea.
He already had an idea for his next novel.
We’re having a meeting to try to come up with ideas for fundraising.
The idea of a new museum was first discussed two years ago.
I like the idea of living on a boat.
We've been toying with the idea of (= thinking about) getting a dog.
Her family expected her to go to college, but she had other ideas.
I don't know what to do, but I'm open to ideas.
It might be an idea (= it would be sensible) to try again later.
It seemed like a good idea at the time, and then it all went horribly wrong.
Ben is the ideas man and the others do the day-to-day work.
Ben is the idea man.

senses.definition_vi: một kế hoạch, suy nghĩ hoặc đề xuất, đặc biệt là về những gì cần làm trong một tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: a picture or an impression in your mind of what somebody/something is like

examples.x: The brochure should give you a good idea of the hotel.
I had some idea of what the job would be like.
This film changed the very idea of what an outer space movie could be.
An evening at home watching TV is not my idea of a good time.
If this is your idea of a joke, then I don’t find it very funny.
I don't want anyone getting the wrong idea (= getting the wrong impression about something).

senses.definition_vi: một hình ảnh hoặc ấn tượng trong tâm trí bạn về người/vật nào đó trông như thế nào

senses.definition: an opinion or a belief about something

examples.x: the experiences that shaped her ideas
He has some very strange ideas about education.
Her ideas on the family are pretty old-fashioned.
These photographs challenge conventional ideas of beauty.
She rejects the idea that product quality has suffered.

senses.definition_vi: một ý kiến hoặc niềm tin về điều gì đó

senses.definition: a feeling that something is possible or is true

examples.x: Where on earth did you get that idea?
What gave you the idea that he'd be here?
I have a pretty good idea where I left it—I hope I'm right.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác rằng điều gì đó là có thể hoặc là sự thật

senses.definition: the aim or purpose of something

examples.x: You'll soon get the idea (= understand).
What's the idea of the game?
The whole idea of going was so that we could meet her new boyfriend.

examples.cf: with the idea of doing something
examples.x: They buy other people's tickets with the idea of reselling them.

senses.definition_vi: mục tiêu hoặc mục đích của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to start behaving in a more acceptable way, so that work gets done better, etc.
senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu cư xử theo cách chấp nhận được hơn, để công việc được thực hiện tốt hơn, v.v.

senses.definition: to give somebody hopes about something that may not be possible or likely; to make somebody act or think in an unreasonable way

examples.x: Who's been putting ideas into his head?

senses.definition_vi: mang lại cho ai đó hy vọng về điều gì đó có thể không có thật hoặc khó xảy ra; khiến ai đó hành động hoặc suy nghĩ theo một cách không hợp lý

senses.definition: used to emphasize that you do not know something

examples.x: ‘What's she talking about?’ ‘I've no idea.’
He hasn't the faintest idea how to manage people.
I had no idea she’d had such a difficult life.
I don’t have any idea where he is.
She doesn't seem to have any idea of what I'm talking about.
I haven't got the faintest idea what she meant.
He hadn't had the slightest idea about what had been going on.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn không biết điều gì đó

senses.definition: to have found a very good or successful way of living, doing something, etc.

examples.x: He's certainly got the right idea—retiring at 55.
The party had the right idea, but failed to win over the voters.

senses.definition_vi: đã tìm ra một cách sống, làm việc, v.v. rất tốt hoặc thành công

senses.definition: used to reply in a positive way to a suggestion that somebody has made

examples.x: Hey, that's an idea! And we could get a band, as well.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để trả lời một cách tích cực cho một đề xuất mà ai đó đã đưa ra

senses.definition: used to encourage people and to tell them that they are doing something right

examples.x: That's the idea! You're doing fine.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để khuyến khích mọi người và cho họ biết rằng họ đang làm điều gì đó đúng đắn

senses.definition: used to show that something is hard for somebody else to imagine

examples.x: You've no idea how much traffic there was tonight.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để chỉ ra rằng điều gì đó rất khó để người khác tưởng tượng

senses.definition: perfect; most suitable

examples.x: an ideal location/place
This beach is ideal for children.
She's the ideal candidate for the job.
The trip to Paris will be an ideal opportunity to practise my French.
The prime minister admitted the current situation was ‘not ideal’ (= was bad).
It was not the ideal solution to the problem.
Harvesting is being done in less than ideal conditions.

senses.definition_vi: một ý tưởng hoặc tiêu chuẩn có vẻ hoàn hảo và đáng để cố gắng đạt được hoặc có được

senses.definition: existing only in your imagination or as an idea; not likely to be real

examples.x: the search for ideal love

senses.definition_vi: một ý tưởng hoặc tiêu chuẩn có vẻ hoàn hảo và đáng để cố gắng đạt được hoặc có được

senses.definition: used to say that something is what you would like to happen or what should happen, but you know it cannot

examples.x: In an ideal world we would be recycling and reusing everything.

senses.definition_vi: một ý tưởng hoặc tiêu chuẩn có vẻ hoàn hảo và đáng để cố gắng đạt được hoặc có được

senses.definition: similar in every detail

examples.x: a row of identical houses
The two pictures are similar, although not identical.
Her dress is almost identical to mine.
The name on the ticket should be identical with the one in the passport.

senses.definition_vi: tương tự về mọi chi tiết

senses.definition: the same

examples.x: This is the identical room we stayed in last year.

senses.definition_vi: giống nhau

senses.definition: the process of showing, proving or recognizing who or what somebody/something is

examples.x: The identification of the crash victims was a long and difficult task.
Accurate identification of these birds is difficult.
Each product has a number for easy identification.
The vehicle's identification number is stamped on the engine.
Biometric identification methods include fingerprints and facial recognition scanners.
Only one witness could make a positive identification.
The hospital had mixed up the patients' identification tags.

senses.definition_vi: quá trình cho thấy, chứng minh hoặc nhận ra ai hoặc cái gì là ai/cái gì

senses.definition: the process of recognizing that something exists, or is important

examples.x: The early identification of children with special educational needs is very important.

senses.definition_vi: quá trình nhận ra rằng một cái gì đó tồn tại, hoặc là quan trọng

senses.definition: official papers or a document that can prove who you are

examples.x: Can I see some identification, please?
To vote, Florida law requires a photo identification with a signature.

senses.definition_vi: giấy tờ hoặc tài liệu chính thức có thể chứng minh bạn là ai

senses.definition: a strong feeling of sympathy, understanding or support for somebody/something

examples.x: her emotional identification with the play’s heroine
their increasing identification with the struggle for independence

senses.definition_vi: một cảm giác mạnh mẽ về sự đồng cảm, thấu hiểu hoặc ủng hộ đối với ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: the process of making a close connection between one person or thing and another

examples.x: the voters’ identification of the Democrats with high taxes

senses.definition_vi: quá trình tạo ra một mối liên hệ chặt chẽ giữa một người hoặc vật này với một người hoặc vật khác

senses.definition: to recognize somebody/something and be able to say who or what they are

examples.x: She was able to identify her attacker.
Passengers were asked to identify their own suitcases before they were put on the plane.
Many of those arrested refused to identify themselves (= would not say who they were).
The bodies were identified as those of two suspected terrorists.
two species of waterbirds that can be identified by their distinctive beaks

senses.definition_vi: nhận ra ai đó/cái gì đó và có thể nói họ là ai hoặc cái gì

senses.definition: to find or discover somebody/something

examples.x: First of all we must identify the problem areas.
Scientists have identified the gene responsible for the disease.
As yet they have not identified a buyer for the company.
to identify a need/factor/source/cause
They are trying to identify what is wrong with the present system.

senses.definition_vi: tìm hoặc khám phá ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: to make it possible to recognize who or what somebody/something is

examples.x: In many cases, the clothes people wear identify them as belonging to a particular social class.
a serial number that uniquely identifies the disk

senses.definition_vi: làm cho có thể nhận ra ai hoặc cái gì là ai hoặc cái gì

senses.definition: who or what somebody/something is

examples.x: The police are trying to discover the identity of the killer.
to establish/reveal/confirm the identity of somebody/something
Their names have been changed for the purposes of this article to protect their identities.
Their identities were kept secret.
Do you have any proof of identity?
The thief used a false identity.
He falls in love with her but can't reveal his true identity.
Each object in the collection has a unique identity number.
She went through an identity crisis in her teens (= was not sure of who she was or of her place in society).

senses.definition_vi: ai hoặc cái gì là ai hoặc cái gì

senses.definition: the characteristics, feelings or beliefs that make people different from others

examples.x: national/cultural/personal identity
ethnic/racial identity
The region's sense of identity remained strong.
a plan to strengthen the corporate identity of the company
Scotland has never lost its identity as a separate nation.
She was searching for a clearer conception of her identity as a writer.

senses.definition_vi: những đặc điểm, cảm xúc hoặc niềm tin làm cho mọi người khác biệt với người khác

senses.definition: the state or feeling of being very similar to and able to understand somebody/something

examples.x: The two companies started working together as a result of a clear identity of interests.
He feels a strong sense of identity with his fellow soldiers.
There's a close identity between fans and their team.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái hoặc cảm giác rất giống và có thể hiểu ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: based on or connected with an ideology

examples.x: ideological differences
This was rejected for ideological reasons.
His agenda has been purely ideological.

senses.definition_vi: dựa trên hoặc liên quan đến một hệ tư tưởng

senses.definition: a set of ideas that an economic or political system is based on

examples.x: Marxist/capitalist ideology

senses.definition_vi: một tập hợp các ý tưởng mà một hệ thống kinh tế hoặc chính trị dựa trên đó

senses.definition: a set of beliefs, especially one held by a particular group, that influences the way people behave

examples.x: the ideology of gender roles
alternative ideologies

senses.definition_vi: một tập hợp các niềm tin, đặc biệt là niềm tin được nắm giữ bởi một nhóm người cụ thể, ảnh hưởng đến cách mọi người hành xử

senses.definition: a rude way to refer to somebody who you think is very stupid

examples.x: When I lost my passport, I felt such an idiot.
What idiot pressed the switch?

senses.definition_vi: một cách nói thô lỗ để chỉ ai đó mà bạn cho là rất ngu ngốc

senses.definition: a word for a person with very low intelligence that is now considered offensive
senses.definition_vi: một từ dùng để chỉ người có trí thông minh rất thấp, hiện nay được coi là xúc phạm

senses.definition: used to say that one thing can, will or might happen or be true, depending on another thing happening or being true

examples.x: If you see him, give him this note.
I'll only stay if you offer me more money.
If necessary I can come at once.
You can stay for the weekend if you like.
If anyone calls, tell them I'm not at home.
If he improved his IT skills, he'd (= he would) easily get a job.
You would know what was going on if you'd (= you had) listened.
They would have been here by now if they'd caught the early train.
If I was in charge, I'd do things differently.
If I were in charge…

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng một điều có thể, sẽ hoặc có thể xảy ra hoặc đúng, tùy thuộc vào một điều khác xảy ra hoặc đúng

senses.definition: when; whenever; every time

examples.x: If metal gets hot it expands.
She glares at me if I go near her desk.

senses.definition_vi: khi; bất cứ khi nào; mỗi lần

senses.definition: used after ask, know, find out, wonder, etc. to introduce one of two or more possibilities

examples.x: Do you know if he's married?
I wonder if I should wear a coat or not.
He couldn't tell if she was laughing or crying.
Listen to the tune and see if you can remember the words.

senses.definition_vi: dùng sau ask, know, find out, wonder, v.v. để giới thiệu một trong hai hoặc nhiều khả năng

senses.definition: used after verbs or adjectives expressing feelings

examples.x: I am sorry if I disturbed you.
I'd be grateful if you would keep it a secret.
Do you mind if I turn the TV off?

senses.definition_vi: dùng sau các động từ hoặc tính từ diễn tả cảm xúc

senses.definition: used to admit that something is possible, but to say that it is not very important

examples.x: If she has any weakness, it is her Italian.
So what if he was late. Who cares?

senses.definition_vi: dùng để thừa nhận rằng điều gì đó có thể xảy ra, nhưng để nói rằng điều đó không quan trọng lắm

senses.definition: used to ask somebody to listen to your opinion

examples.x: If you ask me, she's too scared to do it.
If you think about it, those children must be at school by now.
If you remember, Mary was always fond of animals.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để yêu cầu ai đó lắng nghe ý kiến của bạn

senses.definition: used before an adjective or adverb to introduce a contrast

examples.x: He's a good driver, if a little over-confident.
We'll only do it once—if at all.

senses.definition_vi: dùng trước một tính từ hoặc trạng từ để giới thiệu một sự tương phản

senses.definition: used with will or would to ask somebody politely to do something

examples.x: If you will sit down for a few moments, I'll tell the manager you're here.
If you would care to leave your name, we'll contact you as soon as possible.

senses.definition_vi: dùng với will hoặc would để lịch sự yêu cầu ai đó làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: used before could, may or might to suggest something or to interrupt somebody politely

examples.x: If I may make a suggestion, perhaps we could begin a little earlier next week.

senses.definition_vi: dùng trước could, may hoặc might để gợi ý điều gì đó hoặc để ngắt lời ai đó một cách lịch sự

senses.definition: despite the possibility that; no matter whether

examples.x: I'll get there, even if I have to walk.

senses.definition_vi: bất chấp khả năng rằng; bất kể

senses.definition: despite the fact that; even though

examples.x: He is a great leader, even if he has many enemies.

senses.definition_vi: bất chấp thực tế rằng; ngay cả khi

senses.definition: used to say something about an event that may or may not happen

examples.x: If and when we ever meet again I hope he remembers what I did for him.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói điều gì đó về một sự kiện có thể xảy ra hoặc không

senses.definition: used to express an opinion about something, or after a negative statement to suggest that the opposite is true

examples.x: I'd say he was more like his father, if anything.
She's not thin—if anything she's on the plump side.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để đưa ra ý kiến về điều gì đó, hoặc sau một câu phủ định để gợi ý điều ngược lại là đúng

senses.definition: used to give somebody advice

examples.x: If I were you I'd start looking for another job.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để đưa ra lời khuyên cho ai đó

senses.definition: used to introduce a different suggestion, after a sentence with if

examples.x: I'll go if you're going. If not (= if you are not), I'd rather stay at home.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để giới thiệu một gợi ý khác, sau một câu có 'if'

senses.definition: used after a yes/no question to say what will or should happen if the answer is ‘no’

examples.x: Are you ready? If not, I'm going without you.
Do you want that cake? If not, I'll have it.

senses.definition_vi: dùng sau câu hỏi có/không để nói điều gì sẽ xảy ra hoặc nên xảy ra nếu câu trả lời là 'không'

senses.definition: used to suggest that something may be even larger, more important, etc. than was first stated

examples.x: They cost thousands if not millions of pounds to build.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để gợi ý rằng điều gì đó có thể còn lớn hơn, quan trọng hơn, v.v. so với những gì ban đầu được nêu

senses.definition: used to say that you wish something was true or that something had happened

examples.x: If only I were rich.
If only I knew her name.
If only he'd remembered to send that letter.
If only I had gone by taxi.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn ước điều gì đó là đúng hoặc điều gì đó đã xảy ra

senses.definition: if that is the case

examples.x: Do you do research in your studies? If so, what research methods do you use?

senses.definition_vi: nếu đó là trường hợp

senses.definition: used to say that something that is happening is surprising

examples.x: I'm surprised they've invited me to their wedding—it's not as if I know them well.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều đang xảy ra là đáng ngạc nhiên

senses.definition: used to state the only situation in which something can happen

examples.x: Only if a teacher has given permission is a student allowed to leave the room.
Only if the red light comes on is there any danger to employees.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nêu tình huống duy nhất mà điều gì đó có thể xảy ra

senses.definition: a lack of knowledge or information about something

examples.x: They fought a long battle against prejudice and ignorance.
I hate to admit my ignorance, but how does it work?
He showed a remarkable ignorance of the facts.
widespread ignorance about the disease
They were kept in ignorance of their government's activities.
Children often behave badly out of ignorance.
Many lives are lost through ignorance.

senses.definition_vi: sự thiếu kiến thức hoặc thông tin về điều gì đó

senses.definition: the state of not knowing about something and so being unable to worry about it

examples.x: We preferred to remain in blissful ignorance of what was going on.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái không biết về điều gì đó và do đó không thể lo lắng về nó

senses.definition: if you do not know about something, you cannot worry about it

examples.x: Some doctors believe ignorance is bliss and don't give their patients all the facts.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn không biết về điều gì đó, bạn không thể lo lắng về nó

senses.definition: to pay no attention to something

examples.x: He ignored the 30 mph speed limit sign and accelerated down the road.
I made a suggestion but they chose to ignore it.
We cannot afford to ignore their advice.
to ignore a warning/a problem/an issue
She deliberately ignored my question and changed the subject.
We can't ignore the fact that there is a huge problem here.
His work was largely ignored and forgotten for 30 years.
Much of social science research simply ignores these sectors.
The government has completely ignored the wishes of the public.

senses.definition_vi: không chú ý đến điều gì đó

senses.definition: to pretend that you have not seen somebody or that somebody is not there

examples.x: She ignored him and carried on with her work.
If he tries to start an argument, just ignore him.

senses.definition_vi: giả vờ như bạn đã không nhìn thấy ai đó hoặc như ai đó không có ở đó

senses.definition: suffering from an illness or disease; not feeling well

examples.x: Her father is seriously ill in St Luke's hospital.
critically/gravely/severely ill
Uncle Harry is terminally ill with cancer (= he will die from his illness).
chronically ill patients (= who are ill for a long time )
She was taken ill suddenly.
We both started to feel ill shortly after the meal.
veterans who became ill after fighting in the Gulf War
Shortly after drinking the water I was violently ill.
He fell ill and died soon after.
I can't eat bananas as they make me ill.
She'd been ill with cancer for months.

senses.definition_vi: bị bệnh hoặc mắc bệnh; không khỏe

senses.definition: bad or harmful

examples.x: She suffered no ill effects from the experience.
a house of ill repute (= with a bad reputation, especially because behaviour that is not considered moral happens there)
