It's important to remember that our figures are averages only.
It is important that he attend every day.
It is important that he should attend every day.

examples.cf: it is important to somebody that…
examples.x: It's very important to me that you be there.
It's very important to me that you should be there.

examples.cf: it is important for somebody/something to do something
examples.x: It is important for him to attend every day.

senses.definition_vi: có ảnh hưởng lớn đến con người hoặc sự vật; có giá trị lớn

senses.definition: having great influence or authority

examples.x: an important member of the team
He likes to feel important.

senses.definition_vi: có ảnh hưởng hoặc quyền lực lớn

senses.definition: to introduce a new law, rule, tax, etc.; to order that a rule, punishment, etc. be used

examples.x: The UN Security Council imposed sanctions in 1992.
to impose a penalty/fine/sentence/ban
A new tax was imposed on fuel.

senses.definition_vi: ban hành một luật, quy tắc, thuế mới, v.v.; ra lệnh sử dụng một quy tắc, hình phạt, v.v.

senses.definition: to force somebody/something to have to deal with something that is difficult or unpleasant

examples.x: He described the limitations imposed by his disease.
This system imposes additional financial burdens on many people.
to impose restrictions/constraints/obligations on somebody/something
The time limits are imposed on us by factors outside our control.

senses.definition_vi: buộc ai đó/cái gì đó phải đối mặt với một điều gì đó khó khăn hoặc khó chịu

senses.definition: to make somebody accept the same opinions, wishes, etc. as your own

examples.x: She didn't want to impose her values on her family.
It was noticeable how a few people managed to impose their will on the others.

senses.definition_vi: buộc ai đó chấp nhận cùng ý kiến, mong muốn, v.v. như của bạn

senses.definition: to expect somebody to do something for you or to spend time with you, when it may not be convenient for them

examples.x: ‘You must stay for lunch.’ ‘Well, thanks, but I don’t want to impose…’
Everyone imposes on Dave's good nature.

senses.definition_vi: mong đợi ai đó làm điều gì đó cho bạn hoặc dành thời gian cho bạn, khi điều đó có thể không thuận tiện cho họ

senses.definition: to make somebody/something accept or be aware of your presence or ideas

examples.x: European civilization was the first to impose itself across the whole world.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó chấp nhận hoặc nhận thức được sự hiện diện hoặc ý tưởng của bạn

senses.definition: that cannot exist or be done; not possible

examples.x: almost/virtually/nearly impossible
Only a year ago this would have seemed impossible.
Getting any kind of decent job was proving impossible.
an impossible dream/goal
Going downstairs would be impossible for him with his sprained ankle.
The outcome is impossible to predict.
It's impossible to prove.
Cheap rental accommodation was impossible to find.

examples.cf: it is impossible to do something
examples.x: It's impossible to say which is the best.
It is impossible to tell whether it will actually work.
I find it impossible to lie to her.

examples.cf: it is impossible for somebody to do something
examples.x: It's impossible for me to be there before eight.

senses.definition_vi: không thể tồn tại hoặc được thực hiện; không thể

senses.definition: very difficult to deal with

examples.x: I've been placed in an impossible position.
Honestly, you're impossible at times!

senses.definition_vi: rất khó để xử lý

senses.definition: a thing that is or seems impossible

examples.x: to attempt the impossible

senses.definition_vi: một điều gì đó là hoặc có vẻ không thể

senses.definition: a difficult or impossible task

examples.x: Many regard this task as mission impossible.

senses.definition_vi: một nhiệm vụ khó khăn hoặc bất khả thi

senses.definition: if a person or thing impresses you, you admire them or it

examples.x: We interviewed a number of candidates but none of them impressed us.
The Grand Canyon never fails to impress people.
The Grand Canyon never fails to impress.
His sincerity impressed her.
He impressed her with his sincerity.
It impressed me that she remembered my name.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một người hoặc vật gây ấn tượng với bạn, bạn ngưỡng mộ họ hoặc nó

senses.definition: to make somebody understand how important, serious, etc. something is by emphasizing it

examples.x: He impressed on us the need for immediate action.
Their responsibilities are impressed on them during training.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó hiểu tầm quan trọng, sự nghiêm túc, v.v. của một điều gì đó bằng cách nhấn mạnh nó

senses.definition: to have a great effect on something, especially somebody’s mind, imagination, etc.

examples.x: Her words impressed themselves on my memory.

senses.definition_vi: có tác động lớn đến một điều gì đó, đặc biệt là tâm trí, trí tưởng tượng, v.v. của ai đó

senses.definition: admiring somebody/something because you think they are particularly good, interesting, etc.

examples.x: I must admit I am impressed.
We were all impressed by her enthusiasm.
He was particularly impressed by her essay.
She was suitably impressed (= as impressed as somebody had hoped) with the painting.
He was impressed at the way the team had played.

examples.cf: impressed to see, hear, find, etc.
examples.x: We were impressed to see how well they'd done already.
I was impressed that she remembered my name.

senses.definition_vi: ngưỡng mộ ai đó/điều gì đó vì bạn nghĩ họ hoặc nó đặc biệt tốt, thú vị, v.v.

senses.definition: an idea, a feeling or an opinion that you get about somebody/something, or that somebody/something gives you

examples.x: My first impression of him was favourable.
She gives the impression of being very busy.
I did not get the impression that they were unhappy about the situation.
I had the impression that it was all done in a hurry.
My impression is that there are still a lot of problems.
Try and smile. You don't want to give people the wrong impression (= that you are not friendly).
He does not want to give a false impression of progress.
If you want to create the right impression, I suggest you wear a suit.

senses.definition_vi: một ý tưởng, một cảm giác hoặc một ý kiến mà bạn có về ai đó/điều gì đó, hoặc mà ai đó/điều gì đó mang lại cho bạn

senses.definition: the effect that an experience or a person has on somebody/something

examples.x: You'll have to play better than that if you really want to make an impression (= to make people admire you).
His trip to India made a strong impression on him.
My words made no impression on her.
The whole business left a lasting impression on Margaret.
The new player failed to make an immediate impression on the team.
I don't think this argument made any impression upon the brothers.
The events left an indelible impression on all those who witnessed them.
The stillness and silence leave a deep impression on visitors.

senses.definition_vi: hiệu quả mà một trải nghiệm hoặc một người có đối với ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: a drawing showing what a person looks like or what a place or a building will look like in the future

examples.x: This is an artist's impression of the new stadium.

senses.definition_vi: một bản vẽ cho thấy một người trông như thế nào hoặc một địa điểm hoặc một tòa nhà sẽ trông như thế nào trong tương lai

senses.definition: a clever or funny copy of the way a person acts or speaks

examples.x: He did an impression of the prime minister.
She did her Marilyn Monroe impression.

senses.definition_vi: một bản sao thông minh hoặc hài hước về cách một người hành động hoặc nói chuyện

senses.definition: an appearance that may be false

examples.x: Clever lighting creates an impression of space in a room.

senses.definition_vi: một vẻ ngoài có thể là giả tạo

senses.definition: a mark that is left when an object is pressed hard into a surface

examples.x: The dentist made an impression of his teeth.
The sealing wax bore the impression of a sailing ship.

senses.definition_vi: một vết lõm được tạo ra khi một vật bị ấn mạnh vào một bề mặt

senses.definition: all the copies of a book that are printed at one time, with few or no changes to the contents since the last time the book was printed
senses.definition_vi: tất cả các bản sao của một cuốn sách được in cùng một lúc, với ít hoặc không có thay đổi về nội dung kể từ lần cuối cùng cuốn sách được in

senses.definition: believing, usually wrongly, that something is true or is happening

examples.x: I was under the impression that the work had already been completed.
The soldiers scattered, under the impression that it was an enemy attack.
I was under the impression that you weren't coming until tomorrow.

senses.definition_vi: tin rằng, thường là sai lầm, rằng một điều gì đó là đúng hoặc đang xảy ra

senses.definition: making you admire them, because they are very large, good, skilful, etc.

examples.x: an impressive performance
an impressive array/list/collection
an impressive display of skill
He has an impressive record of 63 wins from 71 fights.
an impressive building with a huge tower
one of the most impressive novels of recent years
Several of the younger players also looked impressive.
She was very impressive in the interview.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho bạn ngưỡng mộ họ, vì họ rất lớn, tốt, khéo léo, v.v.

senses.definition: to put somebody in a prison or another place from which they cannot escape

examples.x: They were imprisoned for a crime they didn't commit.
I feel imprisoned in my own home.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ai đó vào tù hoặc một nơi khác mà họ không thể thoát ra

senses.definition: the act of putting somebody in a prison or another place from which they cannot escape; the state of being there

examples.x: to be sentenced to life imprisonment for murder

senses.definition_vi: hành động đưa ai đó vào tù hoặc một nơi khác mà họ không thể thoát ra; trạng thái ở đó

senses.definition: to become better than before; to make something/somebody better than before

examples.x: Overall the situation has improved dramatically.
Things are improving every day.
You should see your score improve significantly.
Working conditions have greatly improved.
His quality of life has improved dramatically since the operation.
The doctor says she should continue to improve (= after an illness).
I hope my French will improve when I go to France.
This vital service helps to improve the quality of life for people with cancer.
measures to improve public health
This was a much improved performance by the team.
The goal was to improve the efficiency of the department.
Engineers are working to improve this technology.
He's a guy who wants to improve himself, to be the best.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên tốt hơn trước; làm cho ai đó/điều gì đó tốt hơn trước

senses.definition: the act of making something better; the process of something becoming better

examples.x: The economy has shown significant improvement over the past 9 months.
We expect to see further improvement over the coming year.
Sales figures continue to show signs of improvement.
There were areas that needed improvement.
There is a need for continuous improvement in performance.
I think there is room for improvement in any organization.

senses.definition_vi: hành động làm cho một điều gì đó tốt hơn; quá trình một điều gì đó trở nên tốt hơn

senses.definition: a change in something that makes it better; something that is better than it was before

examples.x: a significant/dramatic improvement
a slight/steady improvement
There has been a marked improvement in the quality of teaching.
The work should lead to an improvement in water quality.
The decade saw vast improvements in cardiology techniques.
We have made some mechanical improvements to the car.
This is a great improvement on your previous work.
The results are certainly an improvement over last year.

senses.definition_vi: một sự thay đổi trong một cái gì đó làm cho nó tốt hơn; một cái gì đó tốt hơn so với trước đây

senses.definition: into an object, an area or a substance

examples.x: She opened the door and went in.
The kids were playing by the river and one of them fell in.

senses.definition_vi: tại một điểm trong một khu vực hoặc không gian

senses.definition: contained within an object, an area or a substance

examples.x: We were locked in.
I can't drink coffee with milk in.

senses.definition_vi: tại một điểm trong một khu vực hoặc không gian

senses.definition: at home or at a place of work

examples.x: Nobody was in when we called.
I didn't hear you come in.

senses.definition_vi: tại một điểm trong một khu vực hoặc không gian

senses.definition: at the place where people can get on or off, for example the station

examples.x: The bus is due in (= it should arrive) at six.

senses.definition_vi: tại một điểm trong một khu vực hoặc không gian

senses.definition: received

examples.x: Applications must be in by April 30.

senses.definition_vi: tại một điểm trong một khu vực hoặc không gian

senses.definition: at or towards its highest point on land

examples.x: Is the tide coming in or going out?

senses.definition_vi: tại một điểm trong một khu vực hoặc không gian

senses.definition: elected

examples.x: Several new councillors got in at the last election.

senses.definition_vi: tại một điểm trong một khu vực hoặc không gian

senses.definition: if a team or team member is in, they are batting
senses.definition_vi: tại một điểm trong một khu vực hoặc không gian

senses.definition: if the ball is in, it has landed inside the line

examples.x: Her serve was just in.
The ball landed in.

senses.definition_vi: tại một điểm trong một khu vực hoặc không gian

senses.definition: to be present when something happens

examples.x: They were in at the start.

senses.definition_vi: tại một điểm trong một khu vực hoặc không gian

senses.definition: to be going to experience something soon, especially something unpleasant

examples.x: He's in for a shock!
I'm afraid we're in for a storm.

senses.definition_vi: tại một điểm trong một khu vực hoặc không gian

senses.definition: to be/become involved in something; to share or know about something

examples.x: I'd like to be in on the plan.
Is she in on the secret?

senses.definition_vi: tại một điểm trong một khu vực hoặc không gian

senses.definition: to be (very) friendly with somebody, and likely to get an advantage from the friendship
senses.definition_vi: tại một điểm trong một khu vực hoặc không gian

senses.definition: going regularly to a place

examples.x: He was in and out of jail for most of his life.

senses.definition_vi: tại một điểm trong một khu vực hoặc không gian

senses.definition: the fact of not being able to do something

examples.x: the government’s inability to provide basic services
Some families go without medical treatment because of their inability to pay.

senses.definition_vi: việc không thể làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: not enough; not good enough

examples.x: inadequate supplies
The system is inadequate for the tasks it has to perform.
The food supplies are inadequate to meet the needs of the hungry.

senses.definition_vi: không đủ; không đủ tốt

senses.definition: not able, or not confident enough, to deal with a situation

examples.x: I felt totally inadequate as a parent.

senses.definition_vi: không đủ khả năng, hoặc không đủ tự tin để đối phó với một tình huống

senses.definition: not suitable or appropriate in a particular situation

examples.x: inappropriate behaviour/language

examples.cf: it is inappropriate (for somebody/something) (to do something)
examples.x: It would be inappropriate for me to comment.
clothes inappropriate to the occasion

senses.definition_vi: không thích hợp hoặc không phù hợp trong một tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: something that encourages you to do something

examples.x: There is no incentive for people to save fuel.
There is an added incentive for you to buy from our new range—a free gift with every purchase.

senses.definition_vi: thứ gì đó khuyến khích bạn làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: a payment or concession (= a reduction in the amount of money that has to be paid) that encourages somebody to do something

examples.x: tax incentives to encourage savings

senses.definition_vi: một khoản thanh toán hoặc nhượng bộ (= một khoản giảm số tiền phải trả) khuyến khích ai đó làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: a unit for measuring length or height, equal to 2.54 centimetres. There are 12 inches in a foot.

examples.x: She's a few inches taller than me.
a laptop with a 15-inch screen
Each image measures 46 x 28 inches.
a fat envelope about half an inch thick
The snow is about one and a half inches deep.
1.14 inches of rain fell last night.
Every square inch of available land has been built on.
a metal tube about three inches in diameter
They feed on leaves and may grow to two inches in length.
Since I started jogging I've lost three and a half inches from my waistline.
Babies focus best on objects ten inches from their eyes.

senses.definition_vi: một đơn vị đo chiều dài hoặc chiều cao, bằng 2,54 centimet. Có 12 inch trong một foot.

senses.definition: a small amount or distance

examples.x: He escaped death by an inch.
The car missed us by inches.
She was within an inch of being killed.
They beat him (to) within an inch of his life (= very severely).
Her face was only inches from mine.
He was just inches away from scoring.

senses.definition_vi: một lượng nhỏ hoặc khoảng cách nhỏ

senses.definition: the whole of something

examples.x: The doctor examined every inch of his body.
If they try to fire me I'll fight them every inch of the way.

senses.definition_vi: toàn bộ một thứ gì đó

senses.definition: completely

examples.x: In his first game the young player already looked every inch a winner.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn

senses.definition: used to say that if you allow some people a small amount of freedom or power they will see you as weak and try to take a lot more
senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng nếu bạn cho phép một số người một chút tự do hoặc quyền lực, họ sẽ coi bạn là yếu đuối và cố gắng đòi hỏi nhiều hơn

senses.definition: very slowly and with great care or difficulty

examples.x: She crawled forward inch by inch.

senses.definition_vi: rất chậm và cẩn thận hoặc khó khăn

senses.definition: to refuse to change your position, decision, etc. even a little

examples.x: We tried to negotiate a lower price but they wouldn't budge an inch.

senses.definition_vi: từ chối thay đổi vị trí, quyết định, v.v. dù chỉ một chút

senses.definition: to not trust somebody at all

examples.x: He says he just wants to help you but I wouldn’t trust him an inch if I were you.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn không tin tưởng ai đó

senses.definition: the extent to which something happens or has an effect

examples.x: an area with a high incidence of crime

senses.definition_vi: mức độ xảy ra hoặc có ảnh hưởng của một điều gì đó

senses.definition: the way in which light meets a surface

examples.x: the angle of incidence

senses.definition_vi: cách ánh sáng gặp một bề mặt

senses.definition: something that happens, especially something unusual or unpleasant

examples.x: His bad behaviour was just an isolated incident.
The most recent incident occurred last January.
She couldn't have been more than five years old when the incident happened.
One particular incident sticks in my mind.
The hot-headed tennis star became involved in an incident with the umpire.

senses.definition_vi: điều gì đó xảy ra, đặc biệt là điều gì đó bất thường hoặc khó chịu

senses.definition: a serious or violent event, such as a crime, an accident or an attack

examples.x: a violent/serious incident
There was a shooting incident near here last night.
She reported the incident to the police.
He said that the authorities would investigate the incident.
A 36-year-old man and a 25-year-old woman were stabbed in separate incidents.
The demonstration passed off without incident.
It was an alleged incident with a cleaner in this hotel that led to his dismissal.
There had been a number of incidents of violence against staff.

senses.definition_vi: một sự kiện nghiêm trọng hoặc bạo lực, chẳng hạn như tội phạm, tai nạn hoặc tấn công

senses.definition: a disagreement between two countries, often involving military forces

examples.x: a border/diplomatic incident

senses.definition_vi: sự bất đồng giữa hai quốc gia, thường liên quan đến lực lượng quân sự

senses.definition: wanting to do something

examples.x: She was inclined to trust him.
He writes only when he feels inclined to.
There'll be time for a swim if you feel so inclined.

senses.definition_vi: muốn làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: tending to do something; likely to do something

examples.x: He's inclined to be lazy.
They'll be more inclined to listen if you don't shout.

senses.definition_vi: có xu hướng làm điều gì đó; có khả năng làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: used when you are expressing an opinion but do not want to express it very strongly

examples.x: I'm inclined to agree with you.
I'm half inclined to believe him.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng khi bạn đang bày tỏ ý kiến nhưng không muốn bày tỏ quá mạnh mẽ

senses.definition: having a natural ability for something; preferring to do something

examples.x: musically/academically inclined children
The club was a notorious hang-out for the criminally inclined.

senses.definition_vi: có khả năng thiên bẩm về điều gì đó; thích làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: sloping; at an angle
senses.definition_vi: dốc; ở một góc

senses.definition: if one thing includes another, it has the second thing as one of its parts

examples.x: The tour included a visit to the Science Museum.
Does the price include tax?
The report includes a number of recommendations.
Your duties will include greeting visitors and directing them to the appropriate department.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một thứ bao gồm một thứ khác, thì nó có thứ thứ hai như một phần của nó

senses.definition: to make somebody/something part of something

examples.x: You should include some examples in your essay.
We need to include children in our study.
Representatives from the country were included as observers at the conference.
Quite a few members are worried and I include myself among them.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó trở thành một phần của cái gì đó

senses.definition: contained as part of something

examples.x: all of Europe (Britain included)
Is breakfast included?
We all went, me included.
Also included on the disc are English subtitles.

senses.definition_vi: chứa đựng như một phần của cái gì đó

senses.definition: having something as part of a group or set

examples.x: I've got three days' holiday including New Year's Day.
Six people were killed in the riot, including a policeman.
It's £7.50, not including tax.

senses.definition_vi: có cái gì đó như một phần của một nhóm hoặc tập hợp

senses.definition: the fact of including somebody/something; the fact of being included

examples.x: His inclusion in the team is in doubt.

senses.definition_vi: việc bao gồm ai đó/cái gì đó; việc được bao gồm

senses.definition: a person or thing that is included

examples.x: There were some surprising inclusions in the list.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật được bao gồm

senses.definition: the fact or policy of providing equal opportunities and resources for people who might otherwise not get them, for example people who are disabled or belong to minority groups

examples.x: The company is actively promoting diversity and inclusion.
The internet promotes the social inclusion of groups such as people with disabilities.

senses.definition_vi: việc hoặc chính sách cung cấp cơ hội và nguồn lực bình đẳng cho những người mà nếu không thì có thể không nhận được, ví dụ như người khuyết tật hoặc thuộc các nhóm thiểu số

senses.definition: the money that a person, a region, a country, etc. earns from work, from investing money, from business, etc.

examples.x: Average household income fell slightly.
a weekly disposable income (= the money that you have left to spend after tax, etc.) of £400
His parents have a combined annual income of less than $85 000.
Net income for the year was $43m.
a rise in national income
Trying to earn an income as an artist can be hard.
Some low-paid workers supplement their income with second jobs.
Tourism generates income for the local economy.
These tax changes should help people on low incomes.
New figures show a drop in income for the newly retired.
They lived on the rental income from the property.
They receive a proportion of their income from the sale of goods and services.
Tourism is a major source of income for the area.
Both higher- and lower-income groups will be paying more tax from next year.

senses.definition_vi: số tiền mà một người, một khu vực, một quốc gia, v.v. kiếm được từ công việc, đầu tư tiền, kinh doanh, v.v.

senses.definition: to include something so that it forms a part of something

examples.x: The new car design incorporates all the latest safety features.
We have incorporated all the latest safety features into the design.
Many of your suggestions have been incorporated in the plan.

senses.definition_vi: bao gồm cái gì đó để nó tạo thành một phần của cái gì đó

senses.definition: to create a legally recognized company

examples.x: The company was incorporated in 2008.

senses.definition_vi: tạo ra một công ty được công nhận về mặt pháp lý

senses.definition: not accurate or true

examples.x: incorrect information/spelling
His version of what happened is incorrect.

senses.definition_vi: không chính xác hoặc không đúng sự thật

senses.definition: speaking or behaving in a way that does not follow the accepted standards or rules
senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc hành xử theo cách không tuân theo các tiêu chuẩn hoặc quy tắc được chấp nhận

senses.definition: a rise in the amount, number or value of something

examples.x: price/tax/wage increases
Profits show a steady increase.
Last year the business saw a 3% increase in turnover.
a substantial increase in the number of products on the market
There has been a significant increase in oil prices.
The tax has resulted in a dramatic increase in rents.
an increase of 2p in the pound on income tax
The figure is a tenfold increase on the earlier amount.
This is an increase of 12% on the previous year.
This represents a 14% increase over last year.
They report a massive increase from last year.
Homelessness is on the increase (= increasing).
The rate of increase is accelerating.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên lớn hơn về số lượng, số lượng, giá trị, v.v.; làm cho cái gì đó lớn hơn về số lượng, số lượng, giá trị, v.v.

senses.definition: more and more all the time

examples.x: Tourism is playing an increasingly important role in the region's economy
increasingly difficult/popular
It is becoming increasingly clear that this problem will not be easily solved.
It is looking increasingly likely that no agreement will be reached.
Doctors are growing increasingly concerned about his condition.
Increasingly, training is taking place in the office rather than outside it.

senses.definition_vi: ngày càng nhiều hơn theo thời gian

senses.definition: impossible or very difficult to believe

examples.x: an incredible story
It seemed incredible that she had been there a week already.

examples.cf: it is incredible to somebody that…
examples.x: It's just incredible to me that only one person was hurt.
It really is incredible how she managed to get away with it.

examples.cf: it is incredible to do something
examples.x: It's incredible to think that the affair had been going on for years.

senses.definition_vi: không thể hoặc rất khó tin

senses.definition: extremely good

examples.x: The hotel was incredible.
You're pretty incredible, Barbara.
Standing waiting for the marathon to start was the most incredible feeling.
This is an incredible opportunity for us as a company.
The trip to Costa Rica was an incredible experience.

examples.cf: it is incredible to do something
examples.x: It's just incredible to have him home again.
The Yorkshire forests were incredible to drive in.

senses.definition_vi: cực kỳ tốt

senses.definition: extremely large

examples.x: an incredible amount of work
The UFO zoomed off at an incredible speed.
The prices they charge are absolutely incredible.

senses.definition_vi: cực kỳ lớn

senses.definition: extremely

examples.x: It was all incredibly difficult.
organizations doing incredibly important work
incredibly stupid/boring
incredibly powerful/strong
incredibly lucky/talented/beautiful

senses.definition_vi: cực kỳ

senses.definition: in a way that is very difficult to believe

examples.x: Incredibly, she had no idea what was going on.

senses.definition_vi: theo một cách rất khó tin

senses.definition: if you incur something unpleasant, you are in a situation in which you have to deal with it

examples.x: She had incurred the wrath of her father by marrying without his consent.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn gánh chịu điều gì đó khó chịu, bạn đang ở trong tình huống phải đối phó với nó

senses.definition: if you incur costs, you have to pay them

examples.x: You risk incurring bank charges if you exceed your overdraft limit.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn gánh chịu chi phí, bạn phải trả chúng

senses.definition: used after very and an adjective or adverb to emphasize a statement, description, etc.

examples.x: Thank you very much indeed!
I was very sad indeed to hear of your father's death.
The last three months have been very good indeed for the company.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng sau 'very' và một tính từ hoặc trạng từ để nhấn mạnh một tuyên bố, mô tả, v.v.

senses.definition: used to emphasize a positive statement or answer

examples.x: ‘Was he very angry?’ ‘Indeed he was.’
‘Do you agree?’ ‘Indeed I do/Yes, indeed.’
‘You said you'd help?’ ‘I did indeed—yes.’
It is indeed a remarkable achievement.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh một tuyên bố hoặc câu trả lời tích cực

senses.definition: used to add information to a statement

examples.x: I don't mind at all. Indeed, I would be delighted to help.
Today's youth live in a more affluent society than their grandparents, indeed even their parents.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để bổ sung thông tin cho một tuyên bố

senses.definition: used to show that you are surprised at something or that you find something silly

examples.x: A ghost indeed! I've never heard anything so silly.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để thể hiện sự ngạc nhiên về điều gì đó hoặc thấy điều gì đó ngớ ngẩn

senses.definition: used when you are repeating a question that somebody has just asked and showing that you do not know the answer

examples.x: ‘Why did he do it?’ ‘Why indeed?’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn lặp lại một câu hỏi mà ai đó vừa hỏi và thể hiện rằng bạn không biết câu trả lời

senses.definition: a friend who gives you help when you need it (is a true friend)
senses.definition_vi: một người bạn giúp đỡ bạn khi bạn cần (là một người bạn thực sự)

senses.definition: freedom from political control by other countries

examples.x: Argentina gained independence from Spain in 1816.

senses.definition_vi: tự do khỏi sự kiểm soát chính trị của các quốc gia khác

senses.definition: the time when a country gains freedom from political control by another country

examples.x: independence celebrations
the first elections since independence

senses.definition_vi: thời điểm một quốc gia giành được tự do khỏi sự kiểm soát chính trị của một quốc gia khác

senses.definition: the freedom to organize your own life, make your own decisions, etc. without needing help from other people

examples.x: He values his independence.
Financial independence was imprortant to her.

senses.definition_vi: sự tự do để tổ chức cuộc sống của riêng mình, đưa ra quyết định của riêng mình, v.v. mà không cần sự giúp đỡ của người khác

senses.definition: having its own government

examples.x: an independent state/nation/country
the newly independent republics of Central Asia in the 1990s
Mozambique became independent in 1975.
In 1961 the country was declared independent.
The country became fully independent from France in 1960.
Adams urged Congress to declare the American colonies independent of Britain.

senses.definition_vi: có chính phủ riêng

senses.definition: confident and free to do things without needing help from other people

examples.x: Going away to college has made me much more independent.
She's a very independent-minded young woman.
Pat has always been fiercely independent.
Students should aim to become more independent of their teachers.

senses.definition_vi: tự tin và tự do làm những việc mà không cần sự giúp đỡ của người khác

senses.definition: having or earning enough money so that you do not have to rely on somebody else for help

examples.x: It was important to me to be financially independent of my parents.
a man of independent means (= with an income that he does not earn by working)

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc kiếm đủ tiền để không phải phụ thuộc vào sự giúp đỡ của người khác

senses.definition: done or given by somebody who is not involved in a situation and so is able to judge it fairly

examples.x: an independent inquiry/review/investigation
an independent commission/body/panel
an independent adviser/consultant/expert
She went to a lawyer for some independent advice.
The auditing of a company's accounts is done by independent accountants.

senses.definition_vi: được thực hiện hoặc đưa ra bởi một người không liên quan đến một tình huống và do đó có thể đánh giá nó một cách công bằng

senses.definition: not connected with or influenced by something; not connected with each other

examples.x: The police force should be independent of direct government control.
Two independent research bodies reached the same conclusions.
The results were obtained from four independent experiments.

senses.definition_vi: không liên quan hoặc bị ảnh hưởng bởi một cái gì đó; không liên quan đến nhau

senses.definition: supported by private money rather than government money

examples.x: independent television
the independent sector

senses.definition_vi: được hỗ trợ bởi tiền tư nhân thay vì tiền chính phủ

senses.definition: not employed or controlled by a company; not created by a big company

examples.x: She was hired to do the work as an independent contractor.
Farmers operate as independent producers in the sense of working for themselves and running their own business.
a low-budget independent film

senses.definition_vi: không được tuyển dụng hoặc kiểm soát bởi một công ty; không được tạo ra bởi một công ty lớn

senses.definition: not representing or belonging to a particular political party

examples.x: an independent candidate

senses.definition_vi: không đại diện hoặc thuộc về một đảng phái chính trị cụ thể

senses.definition: a list of names or topics that are referred to in a book, etc., usually arranged at the end of a book in alphabetical order or listed in a separate file or book

examples.x: Look it up in the index.
Author and subject indexes are available on a library database.

senses.definition_vi: một danh sách tên hoặc chủ đề được tham chiếu trong một cuốn sách, v.v., thường được sắp xếp ở cuối sách theo thứ tự bảng chữ cái hoặc được liệt kê trong một tệp hoặc sách riêng biệt

senses.definition: a box of cards with information on them, arranged in alphabetical order
senses.definition_vi: một hộp thẻ có thông tin trên đó, được sắp xếp theo thứ tự bảng chữ cái

senses.definition: a system that shows the level of prices and wages, etc. so that they can be compared with those of a previous date

examples.x: the cost-of-living index
The Dow Jones index fell 15 points this morning.
stock market indices
house price indexes

senses.definition_vi: một hệ thống cho thấy mức giá cả, tiền lương, v.v. để có thể so sánh với những ngày trước đó

senses.definition: a number giving a measurement of something compared with a particular standard

examples.x: White bread has a high glycaemic index.
pain management index scores

senses.definition_vi: một con số đo lường một cái gì đó so với một tiêu chuẩn cụ thể

senses.definition: a sign or measure that something else can be judged by

examples.x: The number of new houses being built is a good index of a country's prosperity.

senses.definition_vi: một dấu hiệu hoặc thước đo để đánh giá một cái gì đó khác

senses.definition: a list of the records in a computer file with information about where each is located

examples.x: Search the index to find the address of the data file.
The index of a search engine is like a library.

senses.definition_vi: một danh sách các bản ghi trong một tệp máy tính với thông tin về vị trí của mỗi bản ghi

senses.definition: the small number written above a larger number to show how many times that number must be multiplied by itself. In the equation 42 = 16, the number 2 is an index.
senses.definition_vi: số nhỏ viết phía trên một số lớn hơn để chỉ số lần số đó phải nhân với chính nó. Trong phương trình 42 = 16, số 2 là số mũ.

senses.definition: to show that something is true or exists

examples.x: Initial tests indicate the presence of oxygen.
The survey data indicate a general satisfaction with the process.
Although the president promised to foster unity, his actions have indicated otherwise.
Research indicates that eating habits are changing fast.
These findings clearly indicate that the scheme has improved pedestrian safety.
The study/evidence/report indicates that…
Kingston-upon-Thames, as the name indicates, is situated on the banks of the Thames.
Our results indicate how misleading it could be to rely on this method.

senses.definition_vi: cho thấy điều gì đó là đúng hoặc tồn tại

senses.definition: to be a sign of something; to show that something is possible or likely

examples.x: A red sky at night often indicates fine weather the next day.
Early results indicate that the government will be returned to power.
These figures indicate to me that the company is in serious trouble.

senses.definition_vi: là một dấu hiệu của điều gì đó; cho thấy điều gì đó có thể hoặc có khả năng xảy ra

senses.definition: to mention something, especially in an indirect way

examples.x: In his letter he indicated to us (that) he was willing to cooperate.
He indicated his willingness to cooperate.
Has she indicated yet whether she would like to be involved?

senses.definition_vi: đề cập đến một điều gì đó, đặc biệt là một cách gián tiếp

senses.definition: to make somebody notice somebody/something, especially by pointing or moving your head

examples.x: ‘What are they doing here?’ he asked, indicating her bags in the hallway.
She took out a map and indicated the quickest route to us.
He indicated where the furniture was to go.
She indicated that I was to sit down.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó chú ý đến ai/cái gì, đặc biệt bằng cách chỉ tay hoặc nghiêng đầu

senses.definition: to represent information without using words

examples.x: Arrows indicate the direction of flow.
The results are indicated in Table 2.

senses.definition_vi: biểu thị thông tin mà không cần dùng lời nói

senses.definition: to give information in writing

examples.x: You are allowed 20  kg of baggage unless indicated otherwise on your ticket.
As indicated above, this chapter deals with the practical implications of the research.
Please indicate clearly which colour you require.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp thông tin bằng văn bản

senses.definition: to show a particular measurement

examples.x: When the temperature gauge indicates 30°C or more, turn off the engine.

senses.definition_vi: chỉ một phép đo cụ thể

senses.definition: to show that your vehicle is going to change direction, by using lights or your arm

examples.x: Always indicate before moving into another lane.
He indicated left and then turned right.
She indicated that she was turning right.

senses.definition_vi: cho biết phương tiện của bạn sắp chuyển hướng, bằng cách sử dụng đèn hoặc cánh tay của bạn

senses.definition: to be necessary or recommended

examples.x: A course of chemotherapy was indicated.

senses.definition_vi: là cần thiết hoặc được khuyến nghị

senses.definition: a remark or sign that shows that something is happening or what somebody is thinking or feeling

examples.x: They gave no indication of how the work should be done.
He shows every indication (= clear signs) of wanting to accept the post.
There are clear indications that the economy is improving.
All the indications are that the deal will go ahead as planned.

senses.definition_vi: một nhận xét hoặc dấu hiệu cho thấy điều gì đó đang xảy ra hoặc những gì ai đó đang nghĩ hoặc cảm nhận

senses.definition: a symptom that suggests that particular medical treatment is necessary

examples.x: There was no clinical indication for such a test.

senses.definition_vi: một triệu chứng cho thấy phương pháp điều trị y tế cụ thể là cần thiết

senses.definition: a sign that shows you what something is like or how a situation is changing

examples.x: The economic indicators are better than expected.
These atmospheric waves are a reliable indicator of weather changes.

senses.definition_vi: một dấu hiệu cho bạn biết điều gì đó như thế nào hoặc một tình huống đang thay đổi như thế nào

senses.definition: a device on a machine that shows speed, pressure, etc.

examples.x: a depth indicator

senses.definition_vi: một thiết bị trên máy hiển thị tốc độ, áp suất, v.v.

senses.definition: a light on a vehicle that flashes to show that the vehicle is going to turn left or right

examples.x: Her right-hand indicator was flashing.
He flicked on his indicator light and passed the lorry.

senses.definition_vi: một đèn trên xe nhấp nháy để cho biết xe sắp rẽ trái hoặc rẽ phải

senses.definition: a sign that a system, society, etc. is very bad or very wrong

examples.x: The poverty in our cities is a damning indictment of modern society.
This research is a terrible indictment on the medical profession.

senses.definition_vi: một dấu hiệu cho thấy một hệ thống, xã hội, v.v. rất tệ hoặc rất sai lầm

senses.definition: an official statement accusing somebody of a crime

examples.x: She was convicted on an indictment for conspiracy.
The federal district court dismissed the indictment.
The government announced a federal indictment against him.
They issued an indictment against them.
Two men were named in the indictment.
War crimes indictments were handed down by a UN-backed court.
an indictment charging theft
There is sufficient evidence against him to support an indictment for murder.

senses.definition_vi: một tuyên bố chính thức buộc tội ai đó phạm tội

senses.definition: the act of officially accusing somebody of a crime

examples.x: This led to his indictment on allegations of conspiracy.
He faces indictment for perjury.

senses.definition_vi: hành động chính thức buộc tội ai đó phạm tội

senses.definition: coming from a particular place and having lived there for a long time before other people came there; relating to, belonging to or developed by these people

examples.x: the indigenous peoples/languages of an area
Indigenous Australians/Canadians
indigenous land/territory
She campaigns for indigenous rights.

senses.definition_vi: đến từ một nơi cụ thể và đã sống ở đó từ lâu trước khi những người khác đến; liên quan đến, thuộc về hoặc được phát triển bởi những người này

senses.definition: having originally developed in a particular place, rather than having been brought there from somewhere else

examples.x: The kangaroo is indigenous to Australia.
The reserve supports a wide range of indigenous species.

senses.definition_vi: có nguồn gốc phát triển ở một nơi cụ thể, thay vì được mang đến đó từ nơi khác

senses.definition: happening not as the main aim, cause or result of a particular action, but in addition to it

examples.x: the indirect effects of the war
to find something out by indirect methods
The building collapsed as an indirect result of the heavy rain.
There would be some benefit, however indirect, to the state.

senses.definition_vi: không phải là mục đích, nguyên nhân hoặc kết quả chính của một hành động cụ thể, mà là bổ sung thêm vào nó

senses.definition: not done directly; done through somebody/something else

examples.x: territories under the indirect control of the British

senses.definition_vi: không được thực hiện trực tiếp; được thực hiện thông qua ai đó/cái gì đó khác

senses.definition: avoiding saying something in a clear and obvious way

examples.x: The comment was an indirect attack on the prime minister.
The president made an indirect reference to the subject in his speech.

senses.definition_vi: tránh nói điều gì đó một cách rõ ràng và hiển nhiên

senses.definition: not going in a straight line

examples.x: an indirect route
The plant prefers indirect sunlight.

senses.definition_vi: không đi theo đường thẳng

senses.definition: considered separately rather than as part of a group

examples.x: We interviewed each individual member of the community.
The minister refused to comment on individual cases.
Farmers each have their own individual concerns about the changes.
The individual members of the team must all be motivated to contribute.

senses.definition_vi: một người được xem xét riêng biệt thay vì là một phần của nhóm

senses.definition: connected with one person; designed for one person

examples.x: respect for individual freedom
The bill addresses an issue of individual liberty.
A democracy must protect individual rights.
an individual pizza

senses.definition_vi: một người được xem xét riêng biệt thay vì là một phần của nhóm

senses.definition: typical of one particular person or thing in a way that is different from others

examples.x: a highly individual style of dress

senses.definition_vi: một người được xem xét riêng biệt thay vì là một phần của nhóm

senses.definition: located, done or used inside a building

examples.x: an indoor swimming pool
indoor games
Poor indoor air quality can result in increased risk of asthma and allergies.

senses.definition_vi: nằm, được thực hiện hoặc được sử dụng bên trong một tòa nhà

senses.definition: relating to sports played indoors

examples.x: the world indoor 200 metres champion

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến các môn thể thao chơi trong nhà

senses.definition: inside or into a building

examples.x: I prefer to stay indoors in this really hot weather.
Let's go indoors.
I was indoors watching TV when I heard shouting in the street.
Many herbs can be grown indoors.
She added that in Hong Kong most cats were kept indoors.

senses.definition_vi: bên trong hoặc vào bên trong một tòa nhà

senses.definition: to persuade or influence somebody to do something

examples.x: Nothing would induce me to take the job.

senses.definition_vi: thuyết phục hoặc ảnh hưởng ai đó làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to cause something

examples.x: drugs that induce sleep
a drug-induced coma
Hearing loss is often induced by exposure to loud noise.

senses.definition_vi: gây ra điều gì đó

senses.definition: to make a woman start giving birth to her baby by giving her special drugs; to make a baby start being born by giving the mother special drugs

examples.x: an induced labour
We'll have to induce her.
I was admitted and the baby was induced at 35 weeks.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho một phụ nữ bắt đầu sinh con bằng cách cho dùng thuốc đặc biệt; làm cho em bé bắt đầu chào đời bằng cách cho người mẹ dùng thuốc đặc biệt

senses.definition: to allow yourself to have or do something that you like, especially something that is considered bad for you

examples.x: They went into town to indulge in some serious shopping.
She has never been one to indulge in gossip.
He was free to indulge in a little romantic daydreaming.
I indulged myself with a long hot bath.
For a special treat, indulge yourself with one of these luxury desserts.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép bản thân có hoặc làm điều gì đó mà bạn thích, đặc biệt là điều gì đó được cho là có hại cho bạn

senses.definition: to satisfy a particular desire, interest, etc.

examples.x: The inheritance enabled him to indulge his passion for art.
In the closing lines, the poet indulges his sense of irony.

senses.definition_vi: làm thỏa mãn một ham muốn, sở thích, v.v. cụ thể

senses.definition: to be too generous in allowing somebody to have or do whatever they like

examples.x: She did not believe in indulging the children with presents.
His questions were annoying but it was easier to indulge him than try and protest.
Her father had always indulged her every whim.

senses.definition_vi: quá rộng rãi trong việc cho phép ai đó có hoặc làm bất cứ điều gì họ muốn

senses.definition: to take part in an activity, especially one that is illegal
