senses.definition_vi: hệ thống pháp luật được sử dụng để trừng phạt những người đã phạm tội

senses.definition: a judge in a court (also used before the name of a judge)
senses.definition_vi: một thẩm phán trong tòa án (cũng được sử dụng trước tên của thẩm phán)

senses.definition: used before the name of a judge in a court of appeal

examples.x: Mr Justice Davies

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trước tên của thẩm phán tại tòa phúc thẩm

senses.definition: to arrest somebody for a crime and put them on trial in court
senses.definition_vi: bắt giữ ai đó vì một tội ác và đưa họ ra xét xử tại tòa

senses.definition: to treat or represent somebody/something fairly, especially in a way that shows how good, attractive, etc. they are

examples.x: That photo doesn't do you justice.
He didn’t play as well as he can, but to do him justice, it was his first game since his injury.
The review did not do justice to her talents.

senses.definition_vi: đối xử hoặc đại diện cho ai đó/điều gì đó một cách công bằng, đặc biệt là theo cách thể hiện sự tốt đẹp, hấp dẫn, v.v. của họ

senses.definition: to deal with somebody/something correctly and completely

examples.x: You cannot do justice to such a complex situation in just a few pages.
I didn’t feel well and wasn’t able to do justice to the meal she had cooked (= I could not eat all the food).

senses.definition_vi: xử lý ai đó/điều gì đó một cách chính xác và hoàn chỉnh

senses.definition: to do something as well as you can in order to show other people how good you are

examples.x: She didn't do herself justice in the exam.

senses.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó tốt nhất có thể để thể hiện cho người khác thấy bạn giỏi như thế nào

senses.definition: to tell a lie or to do something in order to prevent the police, etc. from finding out the truth about a crime
senses.definition_vi: nói dối hoặc làm điều gì đó để ngăn cảnh sát, v.v. khám phá ra sự thật về một tội ác

senses.definition: a good reason why something exists or is done

examples.x: I can see no possible justification for increasing taxes any further.
I could find no real justification for the proposed reorganization.
He was getting angry—and with some justification.
She was arrested entirely without justification.

senses.definition_vi: một lý do chính đáng để giải thích tại sao điều gì đó tồn tại hoặc được thực hiện

senses.definition: as an explanation of why something exists or why somebody has done something

examples.x: All I can say in justification of her actions is that she was under a lot of pressure at work.
the argument which he put forward in justification

senses.definition_vi: như một lời giải thích tại sao điều gì đó tồn tại hoặc tại sao ai đó đã làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to show that somebody/something is right or reasonable

examples.x: How can they justify paying such huge salaries?
The results of the inquiry did not justify them departing from their existing policy.
Her success had justified the faith her teachers had put in her.

senses.definition_vi: chứng tỏ rằng ai đó/điều gì đó là đúng hoặc hợp lý

senses.definition: to give an explanation or excuse for something or for doing something

examples.x: The senator made an attempt to justify his actions.
The Prime Minister has been asked to justify the decision to Parliament.
You don't need to justify yourself to me.
He sought to justify taking these measures by citing the threat of a terrorist attack.
The press release was intended to justify them sacking her.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ra một lời giải thích hoặc bào chữa cho điều gì đó hoặc cho việc làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to arrange lines of printed text so that one or both edges are straight
senses.definition_vi: sắp xếp các dòng văn bản in sao cho một hoặc cả hai lề thẳng hàng

senses.definition: bad or unfair methods of doing something are acceptable if the result of that action is good or positive

examples.x: He defended a morality in which the end justifies the means.
That's only OK if you believe that the end justifies the means.

senses.definition_vi: các phương pháp làm việc xấu hoặc không công bằng được chấp nhận nếu kết quả của hành động đó tốt hoặc tích cực

senses.definition: involving many people or things, especially over a wide area

examples.x: Large areas of the forest will be cleared for ranching as part of a large-scale development plan.
the large-scale manufacturing of the vaccine

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến nhiều người hoặc nhiều thứ, đặc biệt là trên một khu vực rộng lớn

senses.definition: drawn or made to a scale that shows a small area of land or a building in great detail
senses.definition_vi: được vẽ hoặc làm theo một tỷ lệ cho thấy một khu vực đất đai nhỏ hoặc một tòa nhà một cách chi tiết

senses.definition: the same; in a similar way

examples.x: He voted for the change and he expected his colleagues to do likewise.

senses.definition_vi: như vậy; theo cách tương tự.

senses.definition: also

examples.x: Her second marriage was likewise unhappy.

senses.definition_vi: cũng.

senses.definition: used to show that you feel the same towards somebody or about something

examples.x: ‘Let me know if you ever need any help.’ ‘Likewise.’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để cho thấy bạn cảm thấy điều tương tự đối với ai đó hoặc về điều gì đó.

senses.definition: the people who are going to take part in a particular event

examples.x: an impressive line-up of speakers
Jones has not been included in the quarter-final line-up.
the starting line-up (= the players who will begin the game)
The team returns this season with a new car and a new line-up of drivers.

senses.definition_vi: những người sẽ tham gia vào một sự kiện cụ thể

senses.definition: a set of items, events etc. arranged to follow one another

examples.x: A horror movie completes this evening's TV line-up.

senses.definition_vi: một loạt các mục, sự kiện, v.v. được sắp xếp để diễn ra nối tiếp nhau

senses.definition: a row of people, including one person who is suspected of a crime, who are shown to a witness to see if they can recognize the suspect

examples.x: He was identified in an April 21 police line-up.

senses.definition_vi: một hàng người, bao gồm một người bị nghi ngờ phạm tội, được cho nhân chứng xem để xem họ có thể nhận dạng nghi phạm hay không

senses.definition: that has existed or lasted for a long time

examples.x: a long-standing relationship
Long-standing grievances were aired at the meeting.
The country’s long-standing relationship with the US was finally under strain.

senses.definition_vi: đã tồn tại hoặc kéo dài trong một thời gian dài

senses.definition: lasting or having an effect over a long period of time

examples.x: Our long-term goal is to lower operating costs by 10 per cent.
discussions about the long-term future of agriculture
the long-term effects/consequences/impact of something
They questioned his long-term commitment to the project.
She has never been in a long-term relationship.
The long-term trend is for prices to rise.
a long-term strategy/plan
long-term investment
the long-term unemployed
solutions for long-term unemployment

senses.definition_vi: trong một thời gian dài

senses.definition: having been the particular thing mentioned for a long time

examples.x: his long-time colleague

senses.definition_vi: đã là thứ được đề cập trong một thời gian dài

senses.definition: coloured substances used on the skin to make yourself look more attractive or to change your appearance

examples.x: eye make-up
to put on your make-up
She never wears make-up.
a make-up artist (= a person whose job is to put make-up on other people)
The actor has to spend three hours in make-up (= having make-up put on) each morning before filming can start.
publicity photos of the actor in make-up (= wearing make-up) for the role

senses.definition_vi: các chất màu dùng trên da để làm cho bản thân trông hấp dẫn hơn hoặc thay đổi ngoại hình

senses.definition: the different qualities that combine to form somebody’s character or being

examples.x: Jealousy is not part of his make-up.
The final act exposes the fatal flaws in his make-up.
a person’s genetic make-up
The report studies the psychological make-up of a serial killer.

senses.definition_vi: những phẩm chất khác nhau kết hợp để tạo nên tính cách hoặc bản chất của một người

senses.definition: the different things, people, etc. that combine to form something; the way in which they combine

examples.x: the make-up of a TV audience
Ireland did show up a number of flaws in the England team's make-up.
the page make-up of a text (= the way in which the words and pictures are arranged on a page)

senses.definition_vi: những thứ, con người, v.v. khác nhau kết hợp để tạo thành một cái gì đó; cách chúng kết hợp

senses.definition: a special exam taken by students who missed or failed an earlier one
senses.definition_vi: một kỳ thi đặc biệt dành cho sinh viên đã bỏ lỡ hoặc trượt một kỳ thi trước đó

senses.definition: used with plural nouns and verbs, especially in negative sentences or in more formal English, to mean ‘a large number of’. Also used in questions to ask about the size of a number, and with ‘as’, ‘so’ and ‘too’.

examples.x: We don't have very many copies left.
You can't have one each. We haven't got many.
Many people feel that the law should be changed.
Many of those present disagreed.
How many children do you have?
There are too many mistakes in this essay.
He made ten mistakes in as many (= in ten) lines.
New drivers have twice as many accidents as experienced drivers.
Don't take so many.
I've known her for a great many (= very many) years.
Even if one person is hurt that is one too many.
It was one of my many mistakes.
a many-headed monster

senses.definition_vi: dùng với danh từ và động từ số nhiều, đặc biệt trong câu phủ định hoặc trong tiếng Anh trang trọng hơn, có nghĩa là ‘một số lượng lớn’. Cũng được sử dụng trong câu hỏi để hỏi về kích thước của một số, và với ‘as’, ‘so’ và ‘too’.

senses.definition: used with a plural verb to mean ‘most people’

examples.x: a government which improves conditions for the many

senses.definition_vi: dùng với động từ số nhiều có nghĩa là ‘hầu hết mọi người’

senses.definition: used with a singular noun and verb to mean ‘a large number of’

examples.x: He had not been back there for many a year.

senses.definition_vi: dùng với danh từ và động từ số ít có nghĩa là ‘một số lượng lớn’

senses.definition: used to show surprise that the number of people or things involved is so large

examples.x: There were as many as 200 people at the lecture.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để thể hiện sự ngạc nhiên rằng số lượng người hoặc vật liên quan lớn như vậy

senses.definition: to be slightly drunk
senses.definition_vi: hơi say

senses.definition: used to show that something happens often

examples.x: Many's the time I heard her use those words.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để chỉ ra rằng điều gì đó xảy ra thường xuyên

senses.definition: used when you are not certain that something will happen or that something is true or is a correct number

examples.x: Maybe he'll come, maybe he won't.
‘Are you going to sell your house?’ ‘Maybe.’
Is she right? Maybe, maybe not.
Maybe it will do me some good to go for a run.
It will cost two, maybe three hundred pounds.
We go there maybe once or twice a month.
There are two sides to every story, maybe even more in this case.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn không chắc chắn rằng điều gì đó sẽ xảy ra hoặc điều gì đó là đúng hoặc là một con số chính xác

senses.definition: used when making a suggestion

examples.x: I thought maybe we could go together.
Maybe you should tell her.
Maybe we can meet for lunch next week sometime.
Maybe readers should be warned.
I've just got a new laptop, so maybe you can use my old one.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi đưa ra một gợi ý

senses.definition: used when replying to a question or an idea, especially when you are not sure whether to agree or disagree

examples.x: ‘I think he should resign.’ ‘Maybe.’
‘Am I nervous? Well, maybe just a little.’
‘You should stop work when you have the baby.’ ‘Maybe, but I can't afford to.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi trả lời một câu hỏi hoặc một ý tưởng, đặc biệt là khi bạn không chắc chắn có đồng ý hay không

senses.definition: the form of I that is used when the speaker or writer is the object of a verb or preposition, or after the verb be

examples.x: Don't hit me.
Excuse me!
Give it to me.
You're taller than me.
Hello, it's me.
‘Who's there?’ ‘Only me.’

senses.definition_vi: hình thức của 'I' được sử dụng khi người nói hoặc người viết là đối tượng của một động từ hoặc giới từ, hoặc sau động từ 'be'

senses.definition: used when showing that something is or was possible

examples.x: He might get there in time, but I can't be sure.
It might not be too late to save the building.
I know Vicky doesn't like the job, but I mightn't find it too bad.
The pills might have helped him, if only he'd taken them regularly.
He might say that now (= it is true that he does), but he can soon change his mind.
He might, if he chose, retire and live in luxury for the rest of his days.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi cho thấy điều gì đó có thể hoặc đã có thể xảy ra

senses.definition: used as the past tense of may when reporting what somebody has said

examples.x: He said he might come tomorrow.
Zheng said she might not stay in the city for long.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng làm thì quá khứ của 'may' khi báo cáo lại lời nói của ai đó

senses.definition: used to make a polite suggestion

examples.x: You might try calling the help desk.
I thought we might go to the zoo on Saturday.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đưa ra một gợi ý lịch sự

senses.definition: used to ask permission politely

examples.x: Might I use your phone?
If I might just say something…

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để xin phép một cách lịch sự

senses.definition: used to ask for information

examples.x: How might the plans be improved upon?
And who might she be?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để hỏi thông tin

senses.definition: used to show that you are annoyed about something that somebody could do or could have done

examples.x: I think you might at least offer to help!
Honestly, you might have told me!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy bạn khó chịu về điều gì đó mà ai đó có thể làm hoặc có thể đã làm

senses.definition: used to say that you are not surprised by something

examples.x: I might have guessed it was you!
Her film was full of magical effects, as you might expect.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn không ngạc nhiên về điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to emphasize that an important point has been made

examples.x: ‘And where is the money coming from?’ ‘You might well ask!’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng một điểm quan trọng đã được đưa ra

senses.definition: used to say that something seems the best thing to do in the situation that you are in, although you may not really want to do it

examples.x: If no one else wants it, we might as well give it to him.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng điều gì đó có vẻ là việc tốt nhất nên làm trong tình huống bạn đang gặp phải, mặc dù bạn có thể không thực sự muốn làm điều đó

senses.definition: used to say that there is no real difference between two things that you might do

examples.x: If you are going to have sugar, you may as well have a bar of chocolate.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng không có sự khác biệt thực sự giữa hai điều bạn có thể làm

senses.definition: used to form the comparative of most adjectives and adverbs with two or more syllables

examples.x: She was far more intelligent than her sister.
He read the letter more carefully the second time.

senses.definition_vi: một số lượng hoặc số lượng lớn hơn

senses.definition: to a greater degree than something else; to a greater degree than usual

examples.x: I like the film more than the book.
a course for more advanced students
It had more the appearance of a deliberate crime than of an accident.
I had no complaints and no more (= neither) did Tom.
Signing the forms is little more than (= only) a formality.
I'm more than happy (= extremely happy) to take you there in my car.
She was more than a little shaken (= extremely shaken) by the experience.
I will torment you no more (= no longer).

senses.definition_vi: một số lượng hoặc số lượng lớn hơn

senses.definition: again

examples.x: Could you repeat that once more (= one more time)?

senses.definition_vi: một số lượng hoặc số lượng lớn hơn

senses.definition: at a rate that keeps increasing

examples.x: I was becoming more and more irritated by his behaviour.

senses.definition_vi: một số lượng hoặc số lượng lớn hơn

senses.definition: used to show that two things change to the same degree

examples.x: The more she thought about it, the more depressed she became.
The less said about the whole thing, the happier I'll be.

senses.definition_vi: một số lượng hoặc số lượng lớn hơn

senses.definition: almost

examples.x: I've more or less finished the book.

senses.definition_vi: một số lượng hoặc số lượng lớn hơn

senses.definition: approximately

examples.x: She could earn $200 a night, more or less.

senses.definition_vi: một số lượng hoặc số lượng lớn hơn

senses.definition: used to add a point that is even more important

examples.x: You're wrong, and what's more you know it!

senses.definition_vi: một số lượng hoặc số lượng lớn hơn

senses.definition: used to introduce some new information that adds to or supports what you have said previously

examples.x: A talented artist, he was, moreover, a writer of some note.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để giới thiệu một thông tin mới bổ sung hoặc hỗ trợ những gì bạn đã nói trước đó

senses.definition: used to form the superlative of most adjectives and adverbs of two or more syllables

examples.x: the most boring/beautiful part
It was the people with the least money who gave most generously.

senses.definition_vi: lớn nhất về số lượng hoặc số lượng

senses.definition: to the greatest degree

examples.x: What did you enjoy (the) most?
It was what she wanted most of all.

senses.definition_vi: lớn nhất về số lượng hoặc số lượng

senses.definition: very; extremely; completely

examples.x: It was most kind of you to meet me.
We shall most probably never meet again.
This technique looks easy, but it most certainly is not.

senses.definition_vi: lớn nhất về số lượng hoặc số lượng

senses.definition: almost

examples.x: I go to the store most every day.

senses.definition_vi: lớn nhất về số lượng hoặc số lượng

senses.definition: to a great degree

examples.x: Thank you very much for the flowers.
I would very much like to see you again.
He isn't in the office much (= often).
You worry too much.
My new job is much the same as the old one.
Much to her surprise he came back the next day.
She's much better today.
The other one was much too expensive.
Nikolai's English was much the worst.
We are very much aware of the lack of food supplies.
I'm not much good at tennis.
He was much loved by all who knew him.
an appeal to raise much-needed cash

senses.definition_vi: dùng với danh từ không đếm được, đặc biệt trong câu phủ định để có nghĩa là ‘một lượng lớn cái gì đó’, hoặc sau ‘how’ để hỏi về số lượng cái gì đó. Nó cũng được sử dụng với ‘as’, ‘so’ và ‘too’.

senses.definition: although

examples.x: Much as I would like to stay, I really must go home.

senses.definition_vi: dùng với danh từ không đếm được, đặc biệt trong câu phủ định để có nghĩa là ‘một lượng lớn cái gì đó’, hoặc sau ‘how’ để hỏi về số lượng cái gì đó. Nó cũng được sử dụng với ‘as’, ‘so’ và ‘too’.

senses.definition: and certainly not

examples.x: No explanation was offered, still less an apology.
He’s too shy to ask a stranger the time, much less speak to a room full of people.

senses.definition_vi: dùng với danh từ không đếm được, đặc biệt trong câu phủ định để có nghĩa là ‘một lượng lớn cái gì đó’, hoặc sau ‘how’ để hỏi về số lượng cái gì đó. Nó cũng được sử dụng với ‘as’, ‘so’ và ‘too’.

senses.definition: used to say that something is even better/worse

examples.x: We don't actually need it on Tuesday, but if it arrives by then, so much the better.
If hurricanes become more powerful, as current research suggests, so much the worse.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó khó thực hiện

senses.definition: used to say that something is necessary or very important (sometimes involving a rule or a law)

examples.x: All visitors must report to reception.
Cars must not be parked in front of the entrance (= it is not allowed).
I must ask you not to do that again.
You mustn't say things like that.
I must go and get the kids from school.
I must admit (= I feel that I should admit) I was surprised it cost so little.
Must you always question everything I say? (= it is annoying)
‘Do we have to finish this today?’ ‘Yes, you must.’

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó là cần thiết hoặc rất quan trọng (đôi khi liên quan đến một quy tắc hoặc luật lệ)

senses.definition: used to say that something is likely or logical

examples.x: You must be hungry after all that walking.
He must have known (= surely he knew) what she wanted.
I'm sorry, she's not here. She must have left already (= that must be the explanation).

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó có khả năng xảy ra hoặc hợp lý

senses.definition: used to recommend that somebody does something because you think it is a good idea

examples.x: You simply must read this book.
We must get together soon for lunch.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để khuyên ai đó nên làm gì đó vì bạn nghĩ đó là một ý tưởng hay

senses.definition: used to say that somebody may do something but you do not really want them to

examples.x: ‘Can I smoke?’ ‘If you must.’
It's from my boyfriend, if you must know.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng ai đó có thể làm điều gì đó nhưng bạn không thực sự muốn họ làm vậy

senses.definition: used to tell people that something is so good or interesting that they should see, read, get it, etc.

examples.x: Sydney is one of the world's must-see cities.
The magazine is a must-read in the show business world.
This is on my must-do list.
a must-have for any fan

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói với mọi người rằng điều gì đó tốt hoặc thú vị đến mức họ nên xem, đọc, hoặc có được nó, v.v.

senses.definition: in certain situations it is necessary for you to do something that you do not like or enjoy
senses.definition_vi: trong một số tình huống nhất định, bạn cần phải làm điều gì đó mà bạn không thích hoặc không vui

senses.definition: of or belonging to the speaker or writer

examples.x: Where's my passport?
My feet are cold.

senses.definition_vi: thuộc về người nói hoặc người viết

senses.definition: used in exclamations to express surprise, etc.

examples.x: My goodness! Look at the time.
Oh my! What are we going to do?
My my Megan, I do believe you 're jealous!

senses.definition_vi: được dùng trong các câu cảm thán để bày tỏ sự ngạc nhiên, v.v.

senses.definition: used when speaking to somebody, to show love

examples.x: my dear/darling/love

senses.definition_vi: được dùng khi nói chuyện với ai đó để thể hiện tình yêu

senses.definition: used when speaking to somebody that you consider to have a lower status than you

examples.x: My dear girl, you're wrong.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng khi nói chuyện với ai đó mà bạn coi là có địa vị thấp hơn bạn

senses.definition: used when the speaker or writer is also the person affected by an action

examples.x: I cut myself on a knife.
I wrote a message to myself.
I found myself unable to speak.
I haven't been feeling myself recently (= I have not felt well).
I needed space to be myself (= not influenced by other people).

senses.definition_vi: được dùng khi người nói hoặc người viết cũng là người bị ảnh hưởng bởi một hành động

senses.definition: used to emphasize the fact that the speaker is doing something

examples.x: I'll speak to her myself.
I myself do not agree.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh sự thật rằng người nói đang làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: alone; without anyone else

examples.x: I live by myself.

senses.definition_vi: một mình; không có ai khác

senses.definition: without help

examples.x: I painted the room all by myself.

senses.definition_vi: không cần giúp đỡ

senses.definition: for the speaker or writer alone to have or use; not shared

examples.x: I had a whole pizza to myself.

senses.definition_vi: chỉ để người nói hoặc người viết có hoặc sử dụng; không chia sẻ

senses.definition: used to introduce more exact and detailed information about something that you have just mentioned

examples.x: We need to concentrate on our target audience, namely women aged between 20 and 30.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để giới thiệu thông tin chính xác và chi tiết hơn về một điều gì đó bạn vừa đề cập

senses.definition: used to say that something cannot be avoided

examples.x: The number of places available is necessarily limited.
Servants necessarily had close contact with their employers.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó không thể tránh khỏi

senses.definition: used to say that something is possibly true but not definitely or always true

examples.x: Biggest doesn't necessarily mean best.
It isn't necessarily true that sugar is bad for you.
The more expensive articles are not necessarily better.
‘We're going to lose.’ ‘Not necessarily.’
The views in this article do not necessarily reflect those of the college.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó có thể đúng nhưng không chắc chắn hoặc không phải luôn luôn đúng

senses.definition: used to show that a negative statement is also true of somebody/something else

examples.x: He didn't remember and neither did I.
I hadn't been to New York before and neither had Jane.
‘I can't understand a word of it.’ ‘Neither can I.’
‘I don't know.’ ‘Me neither.’

senses.definition_vi: không cái này cũng không cái kia trong hai thứ hoặc hai người

senses.definition: used to show that a negative statement is true of two things

examples.x: I neither knew nor cared what had happened to him.
Their house is neither big nor small.
Neither the TV nor the Wifi actually work/works.

senses.definition_vi: không cái này cũng không cái kia trong hai thứ hoặc hai người

senses.definition: despite something that you have just mentioned

examples.x: There is little chance that we will succeed in changing the law. Nevertheless, it is important that we try.
Our defeat was expected but it is disappointing nevertheless.
The old system had its flaws, but nevertheless it was preferable to the new one.

senses.definition_vi: bất chấp điều gì đó bạn vừa đề cập

senses.definition: in or into a position right by somebody/something

examples.x: We sat next to each other.

senses.definition_vi: ở hoặc vào một vị trí ngay bên cạnh ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: following in order or importance after somebody/something

examples.x: Next to skiing my favourite sport is skating.

senses.definition_vi: tiếp theo về thứ tự hoặc tầm quan trọng sau ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: almost

examples.x: Charles knew next to nothing about farming.
The horse came next to last (= the one before the last one) in the race.

senses.definition_vi: hầu như

senses.definition: in comparison with somebody/something

examples.x: Next to her I felt like a fraud.

senses.definition_vi: so với ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: not one; not any; not a

examples.x: No student is to leave the room.
I have no meetings this morning.
There's no bread left.
No two days are the same.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đưa ra một câu trả lời hoặc tuyên bố phủ định

senses.definition: used, for example on notices, to say that something is not allowed

examples.x: No smoking!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đưa ra một câu trả lời hoặc tuyên bố phủ định

senses.definition: used to express the opposite of what is mentioned

examples.x: She's no fool (= she's intelligent).
It was no easy matter (= it was difficult).

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đưa ra một câu trả lời hoặc tuyên bố phủ định

senses.definition: used to say that it is impossible to do something

examples.x: There's no telling what will happen next.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đưa ra một câu trả lời hoặc tuyên bố phủ định

senses.definition: not anyone; no person

examples.x: No one was at home.
There was no one else around.
We were told to speak to no one.

senses.definition_vi: không một ai; không một người nào

senses.definition: not anyone; no person

examples.x: Nobody knew what to say.

senses.definition_vi: không một ai; không có người nào

senses.definition: not one of a group of people or things; not any

examples.x: None of these pens works/work.
We have three sons but none of them lives/live nearby.
We saw several houses but none we really liked.
Tickets for Friday? Sorry we've got none left.
He told me all the news but none of it was very exciting.
‘Is there any more milk?’ ‘No, none at all.’
Everybody liked him but none (= nobody) more than I.

senses.definition_vi: không một ai trong nhóm người hoặc vật; không có gì

senses.definition: to refuse to accept something

examples.x: I offered to pay but he was having none of it.
They pretended to be enthusiastic about my work but then suddenly decided they wanted none of it.

senses.definition_vi: từ chối chấp nhận một cái gì đó

senses.definition: only

examples.x: None but he knew the truth.

senses.definition_vi: chỉ

senses.definition: despite this fact
senses.definition_vi: mặc dù vậy

senses.definition: used to emphasize who or what somebody/something is, when this is surprising

examples.x: Her first customer was none other than Mrs Obama.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh ai hoặc cái gì là ai/cái gì, khi điều này gây ngạc nhiên

senses.definition: despite this fact

examples.x: The book is too long but, nonetheless, informative and entertaining.
The problems are not serious. Nonetheless, we shall need to tackle them soon.

senses.definition_vi: mặc dù vậy

senses.definition: and not

examples.x: She seemed neither surprised nor worried.
He wasn't there on Monday. Nor on Tuesday, for that matter.
Not a building nor a tree was left standing.

senses.definition_vi: và không

senses.definition: used before a positive verb to agree with something negative that has just been said

examples.x: She doesn't like them and nor does Jeff.
‘I'm not going.’ ‘Nor am I.’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng trước một động từ khẳng định để đồng ý với một điều phủ định vừa được nói

senses.definition: used with be, do or have to form the negative of verbs; used to form the negative of modal verbs like can or must

examples.x: She did not/didn’t see him.
It’s not/It isn’t raining.
It's cold, isn't it?
Don't you eat meat?
I can't see from here.
He must not go.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với 'be', 'do' hoặc 'have' để tạo dạng phủ định của động từ; được sử dụng để tạo dạng phủ định của các động từ khuyết thiếu như 'can' hoặc 'must'

senses.definition: used to give the following word or phrase a negative meaning, or to reply in the negative

examples.x: He warned me not to be late.
I was sorry not to have seen them.
Not everybody agrees.
They had still not decided.
‘Who's next?’ ‘Not me.’
‘What did you do at school?’ ‘Not a lot.’
It's not easy being a parent (= it's difficult).
It's not every day you get to meet a famous actor.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để mang lại ý nghĩa phủ định cho từ hoặc cụm từ theo sau, hoặc để trả lời phủ định

senses.definition: used after hope, expect, believe, etc. to give a negative reply

examples.x: ‘Will she be there?’ ‘I hope not.’
‘Is it ready?’ ‘I'm afraid not.’
‘Does he know?’ ‘I believe not.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng sau 'hope', 'expect', 'believe', v.v. để đưa ra câu trả lời phủ định

senses.definition: used to show a negative possibility

examples.x: I don't know if he's telling the truth or not.
Whether you succeed or not depends on the how skilled you are.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ một khả năng phủ định

senses.definition: used to say that you do not want something or will not allow something

examples.x: ‘Some more?’ ‘Not for me, thanks.’
‘Can I throw this out?’ ‘Certainly not.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn không muốn hoặc sẽ không cho phép điều gì đó

senses.definition: even less than

examples.x: She was standing not three feet in front of me.

senses.definition_vi: thậm chí còn ít hơn

senses.definition: used to suggest that the opposite of the following word or phrase is true

examples.x: This could all happen in the not too distant future (= soon).
His view on the matter was not a million miles away from (= close to) mine.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để gợi ý rằng điều ngược lại với từ hoặc cụm từ theo sau là đúng

senses.definition: used to emphasize the opposite of a statement

examples.x: Well, that sounds like a fun evening—not!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh điều ngược lại của một tuyên bố

senses.definition: used for emphasis to mean ‘no thing or person’

examples.x: He didn't speak to me—not one word.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng không có thứ gì hoặc người nào

senses.definition: used to politely accept thanks or to agree to something

examples.x: ‘Thanks a lot.’ ‘Not at all.’
‘Do you mind if I open a window?’ ‘Not at all.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để lịch sự chấp nhận lời cảm ơn hoặc đồng ý với điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to emphasize that something else is also true

examples.x: She not only wrote the text but also selected the illustrations.
He not only read the book, but also remembered what he had read.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng một điều gì đó khác cũng đúng

senses.definition: used to state that you are not suggesting something

examples.x: She hasn't written—not that she said she would.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nêu rằng bạn không đề xuất điều gì đó

senses.definition: not anything; no single thing

examples.x: There was nothing in her bag.
There's nothing you can do to help.
The doctor said there was nothing wrong with me.
Nothing else matters to him apart from his job.
It cost us nothing to go in.
He's five foot nothing (= exactly five feet tall).

senses.definition_vi: không có gì; không một thứ gì

senses.definition: very little; something that is not at all important or interesting

examples.x: We did nothing at the weekend.
‘What's that in your pocket?’ ‘Oh, nothing.’
I know next to nothing (= almost nothing) about art.

senses.definition_vi: rất ít; điều gì đó không hề quan trọng hoặc thú vị

senses.definition: to be a person that somebody has no feelings for

examples.x: I used to love her but she's nothing to me any more.

senses.definition_vi: là một người mà ai đó không có tình cảm

senses.definition: to have no connection with somebody/something

examples.x: Get out! It's nothing to do with you (= you have no right to know about it).
That has nothing to do with what we're discussing.

senses.definition_vi: không có mối liên hệ với ai/điều gì

senses.definition: without payment

examples.x: She's always trying to get something for nothing.

senses.definition_vi: không phải trả tiền

senses.definition: with no reward or result

examples.x: All that preparation was for nothing because the visit was cancelled.

senses.definition_vi: không có phần thưởng hoặc kết quả

senses.definition: to have much less of a particular quality than somebody/something

examples.x: I'm quite a fast worker, but I've got nothing on her!

senses.definition_vi: có ít hơn nhiều một phẩm chất cụ thể so với ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: to have no information that could show somebody to be guilty of something
senses.definition_vi: không có thông tin nào có thể cho thấy ai đó có tội về điều gì đó

senses.definition: used as a polite way of replying when somebody thanks you for doing something, to show that you were happy to do it

examples.x: ‘Thanks for all your help.’ ‘It was nothing—I enjoyed it.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng như một cách lịch sự để trả lời khi ai đó cảm ơn bạn vì đã làm điều gì đó, để cho thấy rằng bạn vui lòng làm điều đó

senses.definition: for a very good reason

examples.x: Not for nothing was he called the king of rock and roll.

senses.definition_vi: vì một lý do rất tốt

senses.definition: only; no more/less than

examples.x: Nothing but a miracle can save her now.
I want nothing but the best for my children.

senses.definition_vi: chỉ; không hơn/kém hơn

senses.definition: extremely; very

examples.x: The trip was nothing if not varied.

senses.definition_vi: cực kỳ; rất

senses.definition: used to emphasize how great or extreme something is

examples.x: It was nothing less than a disaster.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh mức độ lớn hoặc cực đoan của điều gì đó

senses.definition: not at all like

examples.x: It looks nothing like a horse.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn không giống

senses.definition: not nearly; not at all

examples.x: I had nothing like enough time to answer all the questions.

senses.definition_vi: không gần như; không hề

senses.definition: not a great amount of something; nothing of great value or importance

examples.x: There's nothing much in the fridge.
I got up late and did nothing much all day.

senses.definition_vi: không có nhiều thứ; không có gì có giá trị hoặc tầm quan trọng lớn

senses.definition: (it’s) very easy

examples.x: You'll soon learn. There's nothing to it really.

senses.definition_vi: rất dễ dàng

senses.definition: to be willing to do anything to get what you want, even if it is dishonest or wrong

examples.x: She’ll stop at nothing to make money.

senses.definition_vi: sẵn sàng làm bất cứ điều gì để đạt được điều mình muốn, ngay cả khi điều đó không trung thực hoặc sai trái

senses.definition: romantic words

examples.x: to whisper sweet nothings in somebody’s ear

senses.definition_vi: lời lẽ lãng mạn

senses.definition: there is no other action to take except the one mentioned

examples.x: There was nothing else for it but to resign.

senses.short_meaning_vi: không còn lựa chọn nào khác
senses.definition_vi: không có hành động nào khác để thực hiện ngoại trừ hành động được đề cập

senses.definition: something is/was not true

examples.x: There was a rumour she was going to resign, but there was nothing in it.

senses.definition_vi: điều gì đó là/đã không đúng sự thật

senses.definition: used to say that you enjoy something very much

examples.x: There's nothing like a brisk walk on a cold day!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn rất thích điều gì đó

senses.definition: used with the numbers 1 to 12 when telling the time, to mean an exact hour

examples.x: He left between five and six o'clock.
at/after/before eleven o’clock

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với các số từ 1 đến 12 khi nói giờ, để chỉ một giờ chính xác

senses.definition: the quality or fact of being very fat, in a way that is not healthy

examples.x: Obesity can increase the risk of heart disease.

senses.definition_vi: tình trạng hoặc sự thật của việc quá béo, theo cách không lành mạnh

senses.definition: to do what you are told or expected to do

examples.x: to obey a command/an order/rules/the law
He was arrested when he failed to obey a police instruction to stop.
He has turned into an efficient soldier, blindly obeying orders (= without questioning them).
He had always obeyed his parents without question.
I tried to run but my legs just wouldn't obey me.
‘Sit down!’ Meekly, she obeyed.

senses.definition_vi: làm những gì bạn được yêu cầu hoặc mong đợi

senses.definition: a thing that can be seen and touched, but is not alive

examples.x: everyday objects such as cups and saucers
inanimate objects (= things that are not alive)
a physical/material object (= that you can see and touch)
The scanner detected a metal object.
We now know that solid objects are largely made up of empty space.
art objects from the ancient world

senses.definition_vi: nói rằng bạn không đồng ý hoặc phản đối điều gì đó

senses.definition: a person or thing that somebody desires, studies, pays attention to, etc.

examples.x: He felt he was nothing more to her than an object of desire.
Her objects of study are all paintings.
an object of affection/ridicule/worship

senses.definition_vi: nói rằng bạn không đồng ý hoặc phản đối điều gì đó

senses.definition: an aim or a purpose

examples.x: Her sole object in life is to become a travel writer.
The object is to educate people about road safety.
The object of the game is to score points by combining cards.
If you're late, you'll defeat the whole object of the exercise.

examples.cf: with the object of doing something
examples.x: He put together an army with the object of taking back the lost territory.

senses.definition_vi: nói rằng bạn không đồng ý hoặc phản đối điều gì đó

senses.definition: a noun, noun phrase or pronoun that refers to a person or thing that is affected by the action of the verb (called the direct object), or that the action is done to or for (called the indirect object)
senses.definition_vi: nói rằng bạn không đồng ý hoặc phản đối điều gì đó

senses.definition: money is not something that needs to be considered, because there is plenty of it available

examples.x: She travels around the world as if money is no object.

senses.definition_vi: nói rằng bạn không đồng ý hoặc phản đối điều gì đó

senses.definition: a reason why you do not like or are opposed to something; a statement about this

examples.x: I'd like to come too, if you have no objection.
They raised no objections at the time.
He did not know how to voice his objections.
The main objection to the plan was that it would cost too much.
There was widespread objection to the proposals.
I have no objection to him coming to stay.
I have no objection to staying here.
The proposal will go ahead despite strong objections from the public.
He dismissed the objection that the plan was too expensive.

senses.definition_vi: một lý do khiến bạn không thích hoặc phản đối điều gì đó; một tuyên bố về điều này

senses.definition: not influenced by personal feelings or opinions; considering only facts

examples.x: an objective assessment of the situation
objective truth/facts/reality
objective criteria/measures/measurements
He doesn't even pretend to be impartial and objective.
It's hard to remain completely objective.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó mà bạn đang cố gắng đạt được

senses.definition: existing outside the mind; based on facts that can be proved

examples.x: objective reality

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó mà bạn đang cố gắng đạt được

senses.definition: the objective case is the one which is used for the object of a sentence
senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó mà bạn đang cố gắng đạt được

senses.definition: the state of being forced to do something because it is your duty, or because of a law, etc.

examples.x: You are under no obligation to buy anything.
She did not feel under any obligation to tell him the truth.
I don't want people coming to see me out of a sense of obligation.
We will send you an estimate for the work without obligation (= you do not have to accept it).

senses.definition_vi: tình trạng bị buộc phải làm điều gì đó vì đó là nhiệm vụ của bạn, hoặc vì luật pháp, v.v.

senses.definition: something which you must do because you have promised, because of a law, etc.

examples.x: legal/professional/financial obligations
They reminded him of his contractual obligations.
The country has promised to comply with its international obligations.
We have a moral obligation to protect the environment.
I have an obligation under law to protect their confidentiality.
I felt that there was a moral obligation on me to tell the story.
We want to fulfil our obligation to farmers and see they get a fair price.
The company did not have enough money to meet its obligations.
We have an obligation to our consumers.

senses.definition_vi: một điều bạn phải làm vì bạn đã hứa, vì luật pháp, v.v.

senses.definition: to force somebody to do something, by law, because it is a duty, etc.

examples.x: Parents are obliged by law to send their children to school.
I felt obliged to ask them to dinner.
He suffered a serious injury that obliged him to give up work.
Libel plaintiffs are virtually obliged to go into the witness box.

senses.definition_vi: buộc ai đó phải làm điều gì đó, theo luật, vì đó là nhiệm vụ, v.v.

senses.definition: to help somebody by doing what they ask or what you know they want

examples.x: Call me if you need any help—I'd be happy to oblige.
Would you oblige me with some information?
Oblige me by keeping your suspicions to yourself.
The fans were looking for another goal and Kane duly obliged.

senses.definition_vi: giúp ai đó bằng cách làm những gì họ yêu cầu hoặc những gì bạn biết họ muốn

senses.definition: the act of watching somebody/something carefully for a period of time, especially to learn something

examples.x: Most information was collected by direct observation of the animals' behaviour.
results based on scientific observations
We managed to escape observation (= we were not seen).
The suspect is being kept under observation (= watched closely by the police).
She has outstanding powers of observation (= the ability to notice things around her).
an observation post/tower (= a place from where somebody, especially an enemy, can be watched)
an observation deck (= a room or platform at the top of a tall building which provides views of the surrounding area)
his close observations of animal life in its natural setting

senses.definition_vi: hành động theo dõi ai đó/điều gì đó cẩn thận trong một khoảng thời gian, đặc biệt là để học hỏi điều gì đó

senses.definition: a comment, especially based on something you have seen, heard or read

examples.x: May I make a personal observation?
He began by making a few general observations about the report.
She has some interesting observations on possible future developments.
her witty observations on life

senses.definition_vi: một bình luận, đặc biệt dựa trên điều gì đó bạn đã thấy, nghe hoặc đọc

senses.definition: to see or notice somebody/something

examples.x: Have you observed any changes lately?
All the characters in the novel are closely observed (= seem like people in real life).
I want you to observe all the details.
The patterns observed in our study may represent a general rule.
The police observed a man enter the bank.
They observed him entering the bank.
She observed that all the chairs were already occupied.
He was observed to follow her closely.

senses.definition_vi: nhìn thấy hoặc nhận thấy ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to watch somebody/something carefully, especially to learn more about them

examples.x: He observes keenly, but says little.
I felt he was observing everything I did.
The patients were observed over a period of several months.
an observed decrease in rainfall in the area
The program provided an opportunity to observe the effects of treatment.
The cells were observed under a microscope.
The patient should be observed for signs of an allergic reaction.
They observed how the parts of the machine fitted together.

senses.definition_vi: theo dõi ai đó/điều gì đó cẩn thận, đặc biệt là để tìm hiểu thêm về họ

senses.definition: to make a remark

examples.x: She observed that it was getting late.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ra một nhận xét

senses.definition: to obey rules, laws, etc.

examples.x: Will the rebels observe the ceasefire?
The crowd observed a minute's silence (= were silent for one minute) in memory of those who had died.

senses.definition_vi: tuân theo các quy tắc, luật pháp, v.v.

senses.definition: to celebrate festivals, birthdays, etc.

examples.x: Religious festivals were always observed.

senses.definition_vi: tổ chức các lễ hội, sinh nhật, v.v.

senses.definition: a person who watches somebody/something

examples.x: According to observers, the plane exploded shortly after take-off.
To the casual observer (= somebody who does not pay much attention), the system appears confusing.
Most art forms require a contribution from the observer.

senses.definition_vi: một người xem ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: a person who attends a meeting, lesson, etc. to listen and watch but not to take part

examples.x: A team of British officials were sent as observers to the conference.

senses.definition_vi: một người tham dự một cuộc họp, bài học, v.v. để lắng nghe và quan sát nhưng không tham gia

senses.definition: a person who watches and studies particular events, situations, etc. and is therefore considered to be an expert on them

examples.x: a royal observer

senses.definition_vi: một người theo dõi và nghiên cứu các sự kiện, tình huống, v.v. cụ thể và do đó được coi là chuyên gia về chúng

senses.definition: to completely fill your mind so that you cannot think of anything else, in a way that is not reasonable or normal

examples.x: He's obsessed by computers.
She's completely obsessed with him.
The need to produce the most exciting newspaper story obsesses most journalists.

senses.definition_vi: làm đầy tâm trí bạn hoàn toàn đến mức bạn không thể nghĩ về bất cứ điều gì khác, theo cách không hợp lý hoặc bình thường

senses.definition: to be always talking or worrying about a particular thing, especially when this annoys other people

examples.x: I think you should try to stop obsessing about food.

senses.definition_vi: luôn nói hoặc lo lắng về một điều gì đó cụ thể, đặc biệt là khi điều này làm phiền người khác

senses.definition: the state in which a person’s mind is completely filled with thoughts of one particular thing or person in a way that is not reasonable or normal

examples.x: Her fear of flying is bordering on obsession.
There's a national obsession with celebrity in England.
The media's obsession with the young prince continues.

senses.definition_vi: tình trạng mà tâm trí một người hoàn toàn bị lấp đầy bởi suy nghĩ về một điều hoặc một người cụ thể theo cách không hợp lý hoặc bình thường

senses.definition: a person or thing that somebody thinks about too much

examples.x: Fitness has become an obsession with him.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật mà ai đó nghĩ về quá nhiều

senses.definition: a situation, an event, etc. that makes it difficult for you to do or achieve something

examples.x: So far, we have managed to overcome all the obstacles that have been placed in our path.
A lack of qualifications can be a major obstacle to finding a job.
The MP claims that there is now no obstacle to him standing at the next general election.
The huge distances involved have proved an obstacle to communication between villages.

senses.definition_vi: một tình huống, một sự kiện, v.v. khiến bạn khó thực hiện hoặc đạt được điều gì đó

senses.definition: an object that is in your way and that makes it difficult for you to move forward

examples.x: The area was full of streams and bogs and other natural obstacles.
He managed with difficulty to negotiate the obstacles strewn across the floor.

senses.definition_vi: một vật cản đường bạn và khiến bạn khó di chuyển về phía trước

senses.definition: a fence, etc. for a horse to jump over

examples.x: This huge open ditch forms the biggest obstacle on the course.

senses.definition_vi: một hàng rào, v.v. để ngựa nhảy qua

senses.definition: to get something, especially by making an effort

examples.x: to obtain information/data/results
I've been trying to obtain permission to publish this material.
I finally managed to obtain a copy of the report.
Further details can be obtained by writing to the above address.
To obtain the overall score, add up the totals in each column.

senses.definition_vi: có được một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là bằng nỗ lực

senses.definition: to exist

examples.x: These conditions no longer obtain.

senses.definition_vi: tồn tại

senses.definition: easy to see or understand

examples.x: I know you don't like her but try not to make it so obvious.
He agreed with obvious pleasure.
It soon became obvious that the machine did not work.
It's painfully obvious that the budget was low for this movie.
It's obvious a change is needed.
It was obvious to everyone that the child had been badly treated.
The lessons seem fairly obvious to anyone who doesn't work in the Administration.
It's obvious from what she said that something is wrong.
For obvious reasons, I'd prefer not to give my name.
The reasons for this decision were not immediately obvious.
It is blindingly obvious that there is not enough money to finance this public spending programme.
It was far from obvious how they were going to get off the island.

senses.definition_vi: dễ dàng nhìn thấy hoặc hiểu

senses.definition: that most people would think of or agree to

examples.x: She was the obvious choice for the job.
There's no obvious solution to the problem.
This seemed the most obvious thing to do.
an obvious example/answer/question

senses.definition_vi: mà hầu hết mọi người sẽ nghĩ đến hoặc đồng ý

senses.definition: not interesting, new or showing imagination; unnecessary because it is clear to everyone

examples.x: The ending was pretty obvious.
I may be stating the obvious but without more money the project cannot survive.

senses.definition_vi: không thú vị, mới lạ hoặc thể hiện sự sáng tạo; không cần thiết vì điều đó đã rõ ràng với mọi người

senses.definition: used when giving information that you expect other people to know already or agree with

examples.x: Obviously, we don't want to spend too much money.
Diet and exercise are obviously important.
I wanted to do well, obviously, but I wasn't nervous because I don't see exams as the be all and end all.
She responded 'Oh well, obviously I disagree with him'.
This massive storm obviously had a huge impact on air travellers.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi cung cấp thông tin mà bạn mong đợi người khác đã biết hoặc đồng ý

senses.definition: used to say that a particular situation or fact is easy to see or understand

examples.x: He was obviously upset.
They're obviously not coming.
‘I didn't realise it was a formal occasion.’ ‘Obviously!’ (= I can see by the way you are dressed)
This story is so obviously false that Matthew doesn't bother to refute it.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng một tình huống hoặc sự thật cụ thể dễ dàng nhận thấy hoặc hiểu được

senses.definition: a particular time when something happens

examples.x: on this/that occasion
I've met him on several occasions.
They have been seen together on two separate occasions.
On one occasion, she called me in the middle of the night.
Only on rare occasions do I go out socially.
I can remember very few occasions when he had to cancel because of ill health.
He used the occasion to announce further tax cuts.
I have stated on numerous occasions what options are open.
Harry has mentioned this on many previous occasions.

senses.definition_vi: một thời điểm cụ thể khi một điều gì đó xảy ra

senses.definition: a special event, ceremony or celebration

examples.x: a great/memorable/happy/momentous occasion
Turn every meal into a special occasion.
They marked the occasion (= celebrated it) with an open-air concert.
Their wedding turned out to be quite an occasion.
We expect you to dress for the occasion.
He was presented with the watch on the occasion of his retirement.
Every good wish to them on the occasion of their 40th anniversary.

senses.definition_vi: một sự kiện, nghi lễ hoặc lễ kỷ niệm đặc biệt

senses.definition: a suitable time for something

examples.x: It should have been an occasion for rejoicing, but she could not feel any real joy.
These workshops provide an occasion for talking about art.
This is not a time for specifics, but an occasion for vision.
Festivals were occasions for great celebration.
I’ll speak to him about it if the occasion arises (= if I get a chance).

senses.definition_vi: một thời điểm thích hợp cho một điều gì đó

senses.definition: a reason or cause

examples.x: I've had no occasion to visit him recently.
She doesn’t have much occasion to speak French in her new job.
Her death was the occasion of mass riots.
Art here is an occasion for education and entertainment.
I'm willing to go to court over this if the occasion arises (= if it becomes necessary).

senses.definition_vi: một lý do hoặc nguyên nhân

senses.definition: sometimes but not often

examples.x: He has been known on occasion to lose his temper.

senses.definition_vi: đôi khi nhưng không thường xuyên

senses.definition: a feeling or understanding that an event is important or special

examples.x: Candles on the table gave the evening a sense of occasion.

senses.definition_vi: một cảm giác hoặc sự hiểu biết rằng một sự kiện là quan trọng hoặc đặc biệt

senses.definition: happening or done sometimes but not often

examples.x: He works for us on an occasional basis.
The occasional sweet treat won't do you any harm.
He spent five years in Paris, with occasional visits to Italy.
an occasional drinker (= a person who drinks alcohol, but not often)

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc được thực hiện đôi khi nhưng không thường xuyên

senses.definition: sometimes but not often

examples.x: We occasionally meet for a drink after work.
This type of allergy can very occasionally be fatal.
Only occasionally was there any doubt that they would succeed.
Johnston is an intelligent, occasionally brilliant writer.
Cook on a medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

senses.definition_vi: đôi khi nhưng không thường xuyên

senses.definition: a job or profession

examples.x: Please state your name, age and occupation below.

senses.definition_vi: một công việc hoặc nghề nghiệp

senses.definition: the way in which you spend your time, especially when you are not working

examples.x: Her main occupation seems to be shopping.

senses.definition_vi: cách bạn dành thời gian của mình, đặc biệt là khi bạn không làm việc

senses.definition: the act of moving into a country, town, etc. and taking control of it using military force; the period of time during which a country, town, etc. is controlled in this way

examples.x: the Roman occupation of Britain
The zones under occupation contained major industrial areas.
occupation forces

senses.definition_vi: hành động di chuyển vào một quốc gia, thị trấn, v.v. và kiểm soát nó bằng vũ lực; khoảng thời gian mà một quốc gia, thị trấn, v.v. bị kiểm soát theo cách này

senses.definition: the act of living in or using a building, room, piece of land, etc.

examples.x: The offices will be ready for occupation in June.
The following applies only to tenants in occupation after January 1 this year.
The level of owner occupation (= people owning their homes) has increased rapidly in the last 30 years.

senses.definition_vi: hành động sống hoặc sử dụng một tòa nhà, phòng, mảnh đất, v.v.

senses.definition: to fill or use a space, an area or an amount of time

examples.x: The bed seemed to occupy most of the room.
As the company grew, it continued to occupy more space.
Administrative work occupies half of my time.
How do you occupy your time?
Their time is fully occupied with their rigorous training regime.

senses.definition_vi: lấp đầy hoặc sử dụng một không gian, một khu vực hoặc một khoảng thời gian

senses.definition: to live or work in a room, house or building

examples.x: He occupies an office on the 12th floor.

senses.definition_vi: sống hoặc làm việc trong một căn phòng, nhà hoặc tòa nhà

senses.definition: to enter a place in a large group and take control of it, especially by military force

examples.x: The capital has been occupied by the rebel army.
Protesting students occupied the TV station.

senses.definition_vi: tiến vào một địa điểm với một nhóm lớn và kiểm soát nó, đặc biệt là bằng vũ lực quân sự

senses.definition: to fill your time or keep you busy doing something

examples.x: a game that will occupy the kids for hours
Problems at work continued to occupy his mind for some time.
She occupied herself with routine office tasks.
She occupied herself doing routine office tasks.

senses.definition_vi: lấp đầy thời gian của bạn hoặc giữ cho bạn bận rộn làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to have an official job or position

examples.x: The president occupies the position for four years.
jobs that have traditionally been occupied by men

senses.definition_vi: có một công việc hoặc vị trí chính thức

senses.definition: to happen

examples.x: When exactly did the incident occur?
Something unexpected occurred.
Three major events occurred in my life that year.
These chemical changes occur naturally.
In most years more deaths occur in winter.

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra

senses.definition: to exist or be found somewhere

examples.x: Sugar occurs naturally in fruit.
naturally occurring chemicals in the brain
Lemurs occur in the wild only in Madagascar.
Infected plants frequently occur in patches.
Calluses typically occur on the bottom of the feet and heel.

senses.definition_vi: tồn tại hoặc được tìm thấy ở đâu đó

senses.definition: something that happens or exists

examples.x: a common/everyday/frequent/regular occurrence
Vandalism used to be a rare occurrence here.
The program counts the number of occurrences of any word within the text.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó xảy ra hoặc tồn tại

senses.definition: the fact of something happening or existing

examples.x: the recent occurrence of skin cancer in younger patients

senses.definition_vi: việc một điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc tồn tại

senses.definition: the mass of salt water that covers most of the earth’s surface

examples.x: The ship was dredged from the depths of the ocean.
People were swimming in the ocean despite the hurricane warning.
The plane hit the ocean several miles offshore.
Our beach house is just a couple of miles from the ocean.
ships large enough to sail the open ocean
an ocean liner
a species of fish that lives on the ocean floor
El Nino is a warm ocean current that appears off the coast of Peru during the winter.
Ocean levels are rising.

senses.definition_vi: khối nước mặn bao phủ phần lớn bề mặt trái đất

senses.definition: one of the five large areas that the ocean is divided into

examples.x: the Antarctic/Arctic/Atlantic/Indian/Pacific Ocean
They travelled across oceans in search of a new life.

senses.definition_vi: một trong năm khu vực lớn mà đại dương được chia thành

senses.definition: an amount of something that is too small or unimportant to make any real difference to a situation

examples.x: The amount of money raised was a drop in the ocean compared to what we needed.

senses.definition_vi: một lượng thứ gì đó quá nhỏ hoặc không quan trọng để tạo ra sự khác biệt thực sự cho một tình huống

senses.definition: a large amount of something
senses.definition_vi: một lượng lớn thứ gì đó

senses.definition: the 10th month of the year, between September and November

examples.x: She was born in October.
The meeting is on the fifth of October/October the fifth.
The meeting is on October fifth.
We went to Japan last October.
I arrived at the end of October.
last October's election
the October issue of the magazine

senses.definition_vi: tháng thứ 10 trong năm, giữa tháng 9 và tháng 11

senses.definition: strange or unusual

examples.x: They're very odd people.
There's something odd about that man.
That painting looks very odd.
a teenage girl with rather odd hair
After a while she noticed something quite odd.
When we got inside something struck me as odd.
It's an odd little movie.
It seems odd that nobody noticed anything wrong.
It's most odd that (= very odd that) she hasn't written.
The odd thing was that he didn't recognize me.

examples.cf: it is odd to do something
examples.x: It's odd to think I will never see her again.

senses.definition_vi: kỳ lạ hoặc khác thường

senses.definition: strange or unusual in the way mentioned

examples.x: an odd-looking house
an odd-sounding name

senses.definition_vi: kỳ lạ hoặc khác thường theo cách được đề cập

senses.definition: that cannot be divided exactly by the number two

examples.x: 1, 3, 5 and 7 are odd numbers.
Each section may have an odd or even number of players.

senses.definition_vi: không thể chia hết cho số hai

senses.definition: happening or appearing occasionally; not happening often

examples.x: He makes the odd mistake—nothing too serious.

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc xuất hiện không thường xuyên; không xảy ra thường xuyên

senses.definition: of no particular type or size; various

examples.x: decorations made of odd scraps of paper

senses.definition_vi: không thuộc loại hoặc kích thước cụ thể; các loại khác nhau

senses.definition: not with the pair or set that it belongs to; not matching

examples.x: You're wearing odd socks!

senses.definition_vi: không đi cùng với cặp hoặc bộ mà nó thuộc về; không khớp

senses.definition: available; that somebody can use

examples.x: Could I see you when you've got an odd moment?

senses.definition_vi: sẵn có; mà ai đó có thể sử dụng

senses.definition: approximately or a little more than the number mentioned

examples.x: How old is she—seventy odd?
He's worked there for twenty-odd years.

senses.definition_vi: xấp xỉ hoặc hơn một chút so với số lượng được đề cập

senses.definition: a person or thing that is different from others or does not fit easily into a group or set

examples.x: At school he was always the odd man out.
Dog, cat, horse, shoe—which is the odd one out?

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật khác với những người khác hoặc không phù hợp dễ dàng vào một nhóm hoặc bộ

senses.definition: a person who is slightly strange or crazy
senses.definition_vi: một người hơi kỳ lạ hoặc điên rồ

senses.definition: the degree to which something is likely to happen

examples.x: The odds are very much in our favour (= we are likely to succeed).
The odds are heavily against him (= he is not likely to succeed).
The odds are that (= it is likely that) she'll win.
What are the odds (= how likely is it) he won't turn up?

senses.definition_vi: mức độ mà một điều gì đó có khả năng xảy ra

senses.definition: something that makes it seem impossible to do or achieve something

examples.x: They secured a victory in the face of overwhelming odds.
She defied the odds to beat the clear favourite.
to beat/overcome the odds
The film is a heart-warming tale of triumph against the odds.
Against all (the) odds, he made a full recovery.
The odds against making a profit in this business are huge.

senses.definition_vi: điều gì đó khiến việc làm hoặc đạt được điều gì đó có vẻ không thể

senses.definition: the connection between two numbers that shows how much money somebody will receive if they win a bet

examples.x: odds of ten to one (= ten times the amount of money that has been bet by somebody will be paid to them if they win)
They are offering long/short odds (= the prize money will be high/low because there is a high/low risk of losing) on the defending champion.
I'll lay odds on him getting the job (= I'm sure he will get it).

senses.definition_vi: mối liên hệ giữa hai con số cho biết số tiền mà ai đó sẽ nhận được nếu họ thắng một lần đặt cược

senses.definition: to disagree with somebody about something

examples.x: He's always at odds with his father over politics.

senses.definition_vi: không đồng ý với ai đó về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to be different from something, when the two things should be the same

examples.x: These findings are at odds with what is going on in the rest of the country.

senses.definition_vi: khác với điều gì đó, khi hai điều lẽ ra phải giống nhau

senses.definition: you are unlikely to succeed because the conditions are not good for you
senses.definition_vi: bạn khó có thể thành công vì các điều kiện không thuận lợi cho bạn

senses.definition: you are likely to succeed because the conditions are good and you have an advantage
senses.definition_vi: bạn có khả năng thành công vì các điều kiện thuận lợi và bạn có lợi thế

senses.definition: used to say that something is not important

examples.x: It makes no odds to me whether you go or stay.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó không quan trọng

senses.definition: more money than you would normally expect

examples.x: Many collectors are willing to pay over the odds for early examples of his work.

senses.definition_vi: nhiều tiền hơn bạn mong đợi bình thường

senses.definition: belonging to somebody; relating to somebody

examples.x: a friend of mine
the love of a mother for her child
the role of the teacher
Can't you throw out that old bike of Tommy's?
the paintings of Monet

senses.definition_vi: thuộc về ai đó; liên quan đến ai đó

senses.definition: belonging to something; being part of something; relating to something

examples.x: the lid of the box
the director of the company
a member of the team
the result of the debate

senses.definition_vi: thuộc về một cái gì đó; là một phần của một cái gì đó; liên quan đến một cái gì đó

senses.definition: coming from a particular background or living in a place

examples.x: a woman of Italian descent
the people of Wales

senses.definition_vi: đến từ một nền tảng cụ thể hoặc sống ở một nơi nào đó

senses.definition: relating to or showing somebody/something

examples.x: a story of passion
a photo of my dog
a map of India

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến hoặc cho thấy ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to say what somebody/something is, consists of or contains

senses.definition_vi: người già

a beautiful old farmhouse

senses.definition_vi: đã tồn tại hoặc đã được sử dụng trong một thời gian dài

senses.definition: a person who is very similar to their mother or father in the way that they look or behave

senses.definition: to dismiss somebody from their job; to end a relationship with somebody
senses.definition_vi: sa thải ai đó khỏi công việc của họ; chấm dứt mối quan hệ với ai đó

senses.definition_vi: một tuổi rất cao

senses.definition: to enjoy yourself very much

senses.definition_vi: trong hoặc kể từ thời xưa

senses.definition: old enough to behave in a more sensible way than you actually did

senses.definition_vi: điều thường xảy ra

senses.definition: an old-fashioned person who likes to do things as they were done in the past

senses.definition_vi: ở trong hoặc trên một vị trí bao phủ, chạm vào hoặc tạo thành một phần của bề mặt

senses.definition: used when you are accepting a bet
senses.definition_vi: ở trong hoặc trên một vị trí bao phủ, chạm vào hoặc tạo thành một phần của bề mặt

senses.definition_vi: ngay khi; khi

senses.definition_vi: ngay khi; khi

senses.definition_vi: ngay khi; khi

senses.definition_vi: ngay khi; khi

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để tránh lặp lại một danh từ, khi bạn đang đề cập đến ai đó/điều gì đó đã được đề cập trước đó, hoặc mà người bạn đang nói chuyện biết về

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để tránh lặp lại một danh từ, khi bạn đang đề cập đến ai đó/điều gì đó đã được đề cập trước đó, hoặc mà người bạn đang nói chuyện biết về
