examples.x: The report studies the organization of labour within the company.
They experimented with new forms of social organization.

senses.definition_vi: cách mà các bộ phận khác nhau của một cái gì đó được sắp xếp

senses.definition: the quality of being arranged in a neat, careful and logical way

examples.x: She is highly intelligent but her work lacks organization.
The website would be more effective with better organization.

senses.definition_vi: chất lượng của việc được sắp xếp một cách gọn gàng, cẩn thận và logic

senses.definition: connected with the way in which the different parts of something are arranged; connected with an organization

examples.x: organizational changes within the party

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến cách sắp xếp các bộ phận của một cái gì đó; liên quan đến một tổ chức

senses.definition: having or showing the ability to arrange or organize things well

examples.x: Candidates will require good organizational skills.
The occasion was an organizational triumph.

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc thể hiện khả năng sắp xếp hoặc tổ chức mọi thứ tốt

senses.definition: to make all the arrangements for something to happen or be provided

examples.x: He helped to organize various events.
to organize a conference/meeting
to organize a protest/demonstration/rally
to organize a workshop/seminar
I'll invite people if you can organize food and drinks.
She's on the organizing committee for the tournament.

senses.definition_vi: để thực hiện tất cả các sắp xếp cho một sự kiện hoặc dịch vụ nào đó diễn ra hoặc được cung cấp

senses.definition: to arrange something or the parts of something into a particular order or structure

examples.x: Modern computers can organize large amounts of data very quickly.
You should try and organize your time better.
We do not fully understand how the brain is organized.
The complex is organized around a central courtyard.
We need to organize the work according to the availability and skills of each volunteer.
The overall organizing principle of the book is chronological order.

senses.definition_vi: sắp xếp một cái gì đó hoặc các bộ phận của một cái gì đó theo một thứ tự hoặc cấu trúc cụ thể

senses.definition: to plan your/somebody’s work and activities in an efficient way

examples.x: I'm sure you don't need me to organize you.

senses.definition_vi: lập kế hoạch công việc/hoạt động của bạn/ai đó một cách hiệu quả

senses.definition: to form a group of people with a shared aim, especially a union or political party

examples.x: the right of workers to organize themselves into unions
Campaigns brought women together to organize.

senses.definition_vi: hình thành một nhóm người có chung mục đích, đặc biệt là một công đoàn hoặc đảng phái chính trị

senses.definition: involving large numbers of people who work together to do something in a way that has been carefully planned

examples.x: an organized body of workers
an organized system of childcare
He was part of an organized criminal gang.
39% of male respondents stated that they regularly participated in organized sport compared with 17% of female respondents.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến số lượng lớn người làm việc cùng nhau để làm điều gì đó theo cách đã được lên kế hoạch cẩn thận

senses.definition: arranged or planned well or in the way mentioned

examples.x: a carefully organized campaign
a well-organized office
a badly organized event
a loosely organized political alliance

senses.definition_vi: được sắp xếp hoặc lên kế hoạch tốt hoặc theo cách đã đề cập

senses.definition: able to plan your work, life, etc. well and in an efficient way

examples.x: a very organized person
Isn't it time you started to get organized?

senses.definition_vi: có khả năng lên kế hoạch tốt cho công việc, cuộc sống, v.v. một cách hiệu quả

senses.definition: a person who makes the arrangements for something

examples.x: the organizers of the festival
an event organizer
The race organizers hope to raise money for charity.

senses.definition_vi: một người thực hiện các sắp xếp cho một sự kiện nào đó

senses.definition: a person’s basic beliefs or feelings about a particular subject

examples.x: religious/political orientation
a person’s sexual orientation (= whether they are attracted to men, women or both)

senses.definition_vi: niềm tin hoặc cảm xúc cơ bản của một người về một chủ đề cụ thể

senses.definition: the type of aims or interests that a person or an organization has; the act of directing your aims towards a particular thing

examples.x: The course is essentially theoretical in orientation.
Companies have been forced into a greater orientation to the market.
People over 55 tended to have a strong leisure orientation.

senses.definition_vi: loại mục tiêu hoặc lợi ích mà một người hoặc một tổ chức có; hành động hướng mục tiêu của bạn về một điều cụ thể

senses.definition: training or information that you are given before starting a new job, course, etc.

examples.x: an orientation session/program/course

senses.definition_vi: sự đào tạo hoặc thông tin bạn nhận được trước khi bắt đầu một công việc, khóa học mới, v.v.

senses.definition: the direction in which an object faces

examples.x: The orientation of the planet's orbit is changing continuously.

senses.definition_vi: hướng mà một vật thể đối mặt

senses.definition: the point from which something starts; the cause of something

examples.x: the origins of life on earth
The origin of the word remains obscure.
Most coughs are viral in origin (= caused by a virus).
The word burlesque is Italian in origin.
a letter of doubtful origin
This particular custom has its origins in Wales.
an origin movie/tale (= one that describes an earlier stage in a story that is already known)

senses.definition_vi: điểm khởi đầu của một cái gì đó; nguyên nhân của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a person’s social and family background

examples.x: She has risen from humble origins to immense wealth.
people of German origin
children of various ethnic origins
a person’s country of origin (= where they were born)
He is a Londoner by origin.
Their family can trace its origins back to the Norman Conquest.
Regardless of national origin, they share a sense of belonging to an adopted land.

senses.definition_vi: lý lịch xã hội và gia đình của một người

senses.definition: existing at the beginning of a particular period, process or activity

examples.x: The room still has many of its original features.
I think you should go back to your original plan.
At the end of the lease, the land will be returned to the original owner.
the original stage version of ‘A Streetcar Named Desire’
The original intention was to publish a double album, but they opted instead for two separate releases.

senses.definition_vi: một tài liệu, tác phẩm nghệ thuật, v.v. được tạo ra lần đầu tiên, từ đó các bản sao được tạo ra sau này

senses.definition: new and interesting in a way that is different from anything that has existed before; able to produce new and interesting ideas

examples.x: an original idea
That's not a very original suggestion.
an original thinker
the product of a highly original mind
It's a taut, fast-moving detective story with strikingly original characters.
I don't think this is a truly original idea.
He believes that he is creating something wholly original.

senses.definition_vi: một tài liệu, tác phẩm nghệ thuật, v.v. được tạo ra lần đầu tiên, từ đó các bản sao được tạo ra sau này

senses.definition: painted, written, etc. by the artist rather than copied

examples.x: an original painting by local artist Graham Tovey
The original manuscript has been lost.
Only original documents (= not photocopies) will be accepted as proof of status.

senses.definition_vi: một tài liệu, tác phẩm nghệ thuật, v.v. được tạo ra lần đầu tiên, từ đó các bản sao được tạo ra sau này

senses.definition: used to describe the situation that existed at the beginning of a particular period or activity, especially before something was changed

examples.x: The school was originally very small.
Originally, we had intended to go to Italy, but then we won the trip to Greece.
Laib originally planned to be a doctor.
She comes originally from York.
The dam project was originally conceived in 1977.
They originally thought she had a muscular injury.
Chloe hails originally from Texas.
The book was originally published in 1935.
The work was originally scheduled to begin in July.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để mô tả tình huống tồn tại vào đầu một khoảng thời gian hoặc hoạt động cụ thể, đặc biệt là trước khi có sự thay đổi

senses.definition: to happen or appear for the first time in a particular place or situation

examples.x: The disease is thought to have originated in the tropics.
The word originated as a marketing term.

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc xuất hiện lần đầu tiên ở một địa điểm hoặc tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: to create something new

examples.x: Locke originated this theory in the 17th century.

senses.definition_vi: tạo ra một cái gì đó mới

senses.definition: to start in a particular place

examples.x: His flight originated in Japan.
Flights originating out of Toronto should reach Edmonton without much problem.
28 trains now originate and terminate at Tambaram.
The call had originated from Jamaica/a cell phone.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu ở một địa điểm cụ thể

senses.definition: used to refer to people or things that are additional or different to people or things that have been mentioned or are known about

examples.x: Mr Harris and Mrs Bate and three other teachers were there.
Are there any other questions?
There seem to be no other survivors.
I can't see you now—some other time, maybe.
Two buildings were destroyed and many others damaged in the blast.
This option is preferable to any other.
Some designs are better than others.
He was the only other person in the apartment.
There was a university party and various other things going on.
Dublin is very expensive compared to other major cities in Europe.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ những người hoặc những thứ bổ sung hoặc khác với những người hoặc những thứ đã được đề cập hoặc đã biết

senses.definition: used to refer to the second of two people or things

examples.x: My other sister is a doctor.
One son went to live in Australia and the other one was killed in a car crash.
He raised one arm and then the other.
You must ask one or other of your parents.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ người thứ hai trong hai người hoặc hai thứ

senses.definition: used to refer to the people or things that remain in a group

examples.x: I'll wear my other shoes—these are dirty.
‘I like this one.’ ‘What about the other ones?’
I went swimming while the others played tennis.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ những người hoặc những thứ còn lại trong một nhóm

senses.definition: used to refer to a place, direction, etc. that is the opposite to where you are, are going, etc.

examples.x: I work on the other side of town.
He crashed into a car coming the other way.
He found me, not the other way round/around.
He listened carefully to the voice on the other end of the line.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ một địa điểm, hướng, v.v. đối diện với nơi bạn đang ở, đang đi, v.v.

senses.definition: recently

examples.x: I saw Jack the other day.
I was in your area the other week.
I woke up the other morning and just could not get myself out of bed.
I was watching TV the other evening, when…

senses.definition_vi: gần đây

senses.definition: except

examples.x: I don't know any French people other than you.
We're going away in June but other than that I'll be here all summer.

senses.definition_vi: ngoại trừ

senses.definition: different or in a different way from; not

examples.x: I have never known him to behave other than selfishly.

senses.definition_vi: khác biệt hoặc theo một cách khác với; không

senses.definition: used to state what the result would be if something did not happen or if the situation were different

examples.x: My parents lent me the money. Otherwise, I couldn't have afforded the trip.
Shut the window, otherwise it'll get too cold in here.
We're committed to the project. We wouldn't be here otherwise.
The project had given children opportunities they would never otherwise have had.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nêu kết quả sẽ xảy ra nếu điều gì đó không xảy ra hoặc nếu tình huống khác đi

senses.definition: apart from that

examples.x: There was some music playing upstairs. Otherwise the house was silent.
He was slightly bruised but otherwise unhurt.

senses.definition_vi: ngoài điều đó ra

senses.definition: in a different way to the way mentioned; differently

examples.x: Bismarck, otherwise known as ‘the Iron Chancellor’
It is not permitted to sell or otherwise distribute copies of past examination papers.
You know what this is about. Why pretend otherwise (= that you do not)?
He maintains that he is innocent, but the police are looking for evidence and witnesses to prove otherwise.
Even when common sense would suggest otherwise, optimism reigns.
I wanted to see him but he was otherwise engaged (= doing something else).
Unless otherwise stated, all translations in the text are my own.

senses.definition_vi: theo một cách khác với cách đã đề cập; khác đi

senses.definition: to have information or evidence that the opposite is true

examples.x: You'd think this was a high-budget film if you didn't know otherwise.

senses.definition_vi: có thông tin hoặc bằng chứng cho thấy điều ngược lại là đúng

senses.definition: used to refer to something that is different from or the opposite of what has just been mentioned

examples.x: It was necessary to discover the truth or otherwise of these statements.
We insure against all damage, accidental or otherwise.

senses.definition_vi: để chỉ điều gì đó khác với hoặc đối lập với những gì vừa được đề cập

senses.definition: used to say what is the right thing to do

examples.x: They ought to apologize.
They ought to have apologized (= but they didn't).
Such things ought not to be allowed.
He oughtn't to have been driving so fast.
‘Ought I to write to say thank you?’ ‘Yes, I think you ought (to).’

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói điều gì là đúng đắn nên làm

senses.definition: used to say what you expect or would like to happen

examples.x: Children ought to be able to read by the age of 7.
Nurses ought to earn more.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói điều gì bạn mong đợi hoặc muốn xảy ra

senses.definition: used to say what you advise or recommend

examples.x: We ought to be leaving now.
This is delicious. You ought to try some.
You ought to have come to the meeting. It was interesting.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói điều gì bạn khuyên hoặc đề xuất

senses.definition: used to say what has probably happened or is probably true

examples.x: If he started out at nine, he ought to be here by now.
That ought to be enough food for the four of us.
Oughtn't the water to have boiled by now?

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói điều gì có lẽ đã xảy ra hoặc có lẽ đúng

senses.definition: belonging to us; connected with us

examples.x: our daughter/dog/house
We showed them some of our photos.
Our main export is rice.
And now, over to our Rome correspondent…

senses.definition_vi: thuộc về chúng tôi; liên quan đến chúng tôi

senses.definition: used to refer to or address God or a holy person

examples.x: Our Father (= God)
Our Lady (= the Virgin Mary)

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để chỉ hoặc xưng hô với Chúa hoặc một người thánh thiện

senses.definition: the one or ones that belong to us

examples.x: Their house is very similar to ours, but ours is bigger.
No, those are Ellie's kids. Ours are upstairs.
He's a friend of ours.

senses.definition_vi: cái hoặc những cái thuộc về chúng tôi

senses.definition: our home

examples.x: Do you fancy coming to ours for Sunday dinner?

senses.definition_vi: nhà của chúng tôi

senses.definition: the reflexive form of we; used when you and another person or other people together cause and are affected by an action

examples.x: We shouldn't blame ourselves for what happened.
Let's just relax and enjoy ourselves.
We'd like to see it for ourselves.

senses.definition_vi: hình thức phản thân của 'chúng tôi'; được dùng khi bạn và một người khác hoặc nhiều người khác cùng gây ra và bị ảnh hưởng bởi một hành động

senses.definition: used to emphasize we or us; sometimes used instead of these words

examples.x: We've often thought of going there ourselves.
The only people there were ourselves.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh 'chúng tôi' hoặc 'chúng ta'; đôi khi được dùng thay thế cho những từ này

senses.definition: alone; without anyone else
senses.definition_vi: một mình; không có ai khác

senses.definition: without help
senses.definition_vi: không cần giúp đỡ

senses.definition: for us alone to have or use; not shared with others

examples.x: We had the pool all to ourselves.

senses.definition_vi: chỉ dành cho chúng tôi một mình có hoặc sử dụng; không chia sẻ với người khác

senses.definition: away from the inside of a place or thing

examples.x: She ran out into the corridor.
She shook the bag and some coins fell out.
I got out of bed.
He opened the box and out jumped a frog.
Out you go! (= used to order somebody to leave a room)
He ran out the door.

senses.definition_vi: xa khỏi bên trong của một nơi hoặc vật

senses.definition: away from or not at home or their place of work

examples.x: I called Liz but she was out.
Let's go out this evening (= for example to a restaurant or club).
We haven't had a night out for weeks.
Mr Green is out of town this week.
I got an out of office reply to my email.

senses.definition_vi: vắng nhà hoặc không có mặt ở nơi làm việc

senses.definition: outside; not in a building

examples.x: It's cold out.
There were children playing out in the street.

senses.definition_vi: ở bên ngoài; không ở trong nhà

senses.definition: used to show that something/somebody is removed from a place, job, etc.

examples.x: This detergent is good for getting stains out.
We want this government out.
He got thrown out of the restaurant.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ra rằng ai đó/cái gì đó bị loại bỏ khỏi một nơi, công việc, v.v.

senses.definition: away from the edge of a place

examples.x: The boy dashed out into the road.
Don't lean out of the window.

senses.definition_vi: xa khỏi mép của một địa điểm

senses.definition: used to show where something comes from

examples.x: He drank his beer out of the bottle.
a romance straight out of a fairy tale
I paid for the damage out of my savings.
We'll get the truth out of her.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ nơi nào đó đến

senses.definition: used to show what something is made from

examples.x: a statue made out of bronze

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ vật liệu làm ra cái gì đó

senses.definition: used to show that somebody/something does not have any of something

examples.x: We're out of milk.
He's been out of work for six months.
You're out of luck—she left ten minutes ago.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ra rằng ai đó/cái gì đó không còn hoặc hết sạch cái gì đó

senses.definition: used to show that somebody/something is not or no longer in a particular state or condition

examples.x: Try and stay out of trouble.
I watched the car until it was out of sight.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ra rằng ai đó/cái gì đó không còn hoặc không còn ở trong một trạng thái hoặc điều kiện cụ thể nữa

senses.definition: used to show that somebody is no longer involved in something

examples.x: It was an awful job and I'm glad to be out of it.
He gets out of the army in a few weeks.
They'll be out (= of prison) on bail in no time.
Brown goes on to the semi-finals but Lee is out.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ra rằng ai đó không còn tham gia vào điều gì đó

senses.definition: from a particular number or set

examples.x: You scored six out of ten.
Two out of three people think the President should resign.

senses.definition_vi: từ một số hoặc một tập hợp cụ thể

senses.definition: clearly and loudly so that people can hear

examples.x: to call/cry/shout out
Read it out loud.
Nobody spoke out in his defence.

senses.definition_vi: rõ ràng và lớn tiếng để mọi người có thể nghe thấy

senses.definition: a long or a particular distance away from a place or from land

examples.x: She's working out in Australia.
He lives right out in the country.
The boats are all out at sea.
The ship sank ten miles out of Stockholm.

senses.definition_vi: ở một khoảng cách xa hoặc một khoảng cách cụ thể so với một địa điểm hoặc đất liền

senses.definition: available to everyone; known to everyone

examples.x: When does her new book come out?
Word always gets out (= people find out about things) no matter how careful you are.
Out with it! (= say what you know)

senses.definition_vi: có sẵn cho mọi người; được mọi người biết đến

senses.definition: used to show the reason why something is done

examples.x: I asked out of curiosity.
She did it out of spite.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ lý do tại sao một điều gì đó được thực hiện

senses.definition: not in the library; borrowed by somebody else

examples.x: The book you wanted is out on loan.

senses.definition_vi: không có trong thư viện; đã được ai đó mượn

senses.definition: at or towards its lowest point on land

examples.x: I like walking on the wet sand when the tide is out.

senses.definition_vi: ở điểm thấp nhất trên đất liền

senses.definition: if the sun, moon or stars are or come out, they can be seen from the earth and are not hidden by clouds
senses.definition_vi: nếu mặt trời, mặt trăng hoặc các vì sao hiện ra, chúng có thể được nhìn thấy từ trái đất và không bị mây che khuất

senses.definition: fully open

examples.x: There should be some snowdrops out by now.

senses.definition_vi: mở hoàn toàn

senses.definition: if a team or team member is out, it is no longer their turn with the bat

examples.x: The West Indies were all out for 364 (= after scoring 364 runs in cricket).

senses.definition_vi: nếu một đội hoặc thành viên đội bị out, thì không còn lượt đánh của họ nữa

senses.definition: if a player is out, they can no longer take part in the game

examples.x: If you have no more cards, you are out. The winner is the one with the most cards.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một người chơi bị out, họ không thể tham gia trò chơi nữa

senses.definition: if the ball is out, it landed outside the line

examples.x: The umpire said the ball was out.
The ball landed out.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bóng out, nó đã rơi ra ngoài vạch giới hạn

senses.definition: not correct or exact; wrong

examples.x: I was slightly out in my calculations.
Your guess was a long way out (= completely wrong).
The estimate was out by more than $100.

senses.definition_vi: không chính xác hoặc đúng; sai

senses.definition: not possible or not allowed

examples.x: Swimming is out until the weather gets warmer.

senses.definition_vi: không thể hoặc không được phép

senses.definition: not fashionable

examples.x: Black is out this year.

senses.definition_vi: không còn hợp thời trang

senses.definition: not or no longer burning or lit

examples.x: Suddenly all the lights went out.
The fire had burnt itself out.

senses.definition_vi: không còn cháy hoặc không còn được thắp sáng

senses.definition_vi: chính thức quyết định rằng một quyết định pháp lý, v.v. là không chính xác, và làm cho nó không còn được công nhận về mặt pháp lý

senses.definition_vi: rất lớn hoặc rất mạnh; quá mạnh đến mức bạn không thể chống cự hoặc quyết định cách phản ứng

senses.definition: to have to pay somebody for something that you have already received or return money that you have borrowed

examples.x: She still owes her father £3 000.

senses.definition_vi: phải trả tiền cho ai đó vì bạn đã nhận được hoặc trả lại tiền bạn đã vay

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy rằng bạn có nghĩa vụ phải làm điều gì đó cho ai đó hoặc cho họ một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là vì họ đã làm điều gì đó cho bạn

senses.definition_vi: tồn tại hoặc thành công nhờ sự giúp đỡ hoặc ảnh hưởng của ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition_vi: phải tuân theo và ủng hộ người có quyền lực hoặc vị thế cao hơn

I have my very own room at last.

I was almost completely in my own little world.
Most people want to live in their own homes as they age.

senses.definition_vi: có thứ gì đó thuộc về bạn, đặc biệt là vì bạn đã mua nó

senses.definition_vi: có thứ gì đó thuộc về bạn, đặc biệt là vì bạn đã mua nó

senses.definition_vi: có thứ gì đó thuộc về bạn, đặc biệt là vì bạn đã mua nó

senses.definition_vi: không thường xuyên lắm

senses.definition: a small animal with a long tail, that looks like a large mouse, usually considered a pest (= an animal which is disliked because it destroys food or spreads disease)

examples.x: rat poison
The police are all over town. He’s caught, like a rat in a trap.

senses.definition_vi: một loài động vật nhỏ có đuôi dài, trông giống như một con chuột lớn, thường được coi là loài gây hại (= một loài động vật bị ghét vì nó phá hoại thức ăn hoặc lây lan bệnh tật)

senses.definition: an unpleasant person, especially somebody who treats their partner or friends badly, for example by leaving them or cheating them

examples.x: You mean he just walked out on her after fifteen years? What a rat!

senses.definition_vi: một người khó chịu, đặc biệt là người đối xử tệ với bạn đời hoặc bạn bè của họ, ví dụ bằng cách bỏ rơi hoặc lừa dối họ

senses.definition: used to talk about people who leave an organization, a company, etc. that is having difficulties, without caring about the people who are left
senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói về những người rời bỏ một tổ chức, một công ty, v.v. đang gặp khó khăn, mà không quan tâm đến những người còn lại

senses.definition: to suspect that something is wrong about a situation
senses.definition_vi: nghi ngờ rằng có điều gì đó không ổn về một tình huống

senses.definition: a measurement of the speed at which something happens

examples.x: Figures published today show another fall in the rate of inflation.
Most people walk at an average rate of five kilometres an hour.
The number of reported crimes is increasing at an alarming rate.
At the rate you work, you'll never finish!

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc cho rằng ai đó/cái gì đó có mức độ chất lượng, giá trị, v.v. cụ thể

senses.definition: a measurement of the number of times something happens or something does something during a particular period

examples.x: We have seen a reduction in the crime rate over the last 12 months.
a high success/failure rate
the youth unemployment rate
His pulse rate dropped suddenly.
a high/low/rising rate of unemployment
Local businesses are closing at the rate of three a year.

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc cho rằng ai đó/cái gì đó có mức độ chất lượng, giá trị, v.v. cụ thể

senses.definition: a fixed amount of money that is charged or paid for something

examples.x: advertising/insurance/postal rates
A rise in interest rates tends to reduce inflation.
The euro exchange rate is strengthening.
He argued for a reduction in the top tax rate.
We offer special reduced rates for students.
to cut/reduce/increase/raise interest rates
a low/high hourly rate of pay
the basic rate of tax (= the lowest amount that is paid by everyone)
We had to borrow money at a high rate of interest.
a premium-rate phone number (= one that costs more than the usual rate to call)

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc cho rằng ai đó/cái gì đó có mức độ chất lượng, giá trị, v.v. cụ thể

senses.definition: a tax paid by businesses to a local authority for land and buildings that they use
senses.definition_vi: có hoặc cho rằng ai đó/cái gì đó có mức độ chất lượng, giá trị, v.v. cụ thể

senses.definition: used to say that a particular fact is true despite what has happened in the past or what may happen in the future

examples.x: Well, that's one good piece of news at any rate.
I may be away on business next week but at any rate I'll be back by Friday.

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc cho rằng ai đó/cái gì đó có mức độ chất lượng, giá trị, v.v. cụ thể

senses.definition: used to show that you are being more accurate about something that you have just said

examples.x: He said he'll be coming tomorrow. At any rate, I think that's what he said.

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc cho rằng ai đó/cái gì đó có mức độ chất lượng, giá trị, v.v. cụ thể

senses.definition: used to show that what you have just said is not as important as what you are going to say

examples.x: There were maybe 60 or 70 people there. At any rate, the room was packed.

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc cho rằng ai đó/cái gì đó có mức độ chất lượng, giá trị, v.v. cụ thể

senses.definition: very quickly

examples.x: She's getting through her winnings at a rate of knots.

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc cho rằng ai đó/cái gì đó có mức độ chất lượng, giá trị, v.v. cụ thể

senses.definition: used to say what will happen if a particular situation continues to develop in the same way

examples.x: At this rate, we'll soon be bankrupt.

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc cho rằng ai đó/cái gì đó có mức độ chất lượng, giá trị, v.v. cụ thể

senses.definition: the usual amount of money paid for goods or services at a particular time

examples.x: They pay slightly more than the going rate.

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc cho rằng ai đó/cái gì đó có mức độ chất lượng, giá trị, v.v. cụ thể

senses.definition: used to mean ‘fairly’ or ‘to some degree’, often when you are disappointed, surprised or expressing slight criticism

examples.x: rather odd/strange/unusual
a rather large sum of money
A rather small number of people turned up.
They took a rather different approach.
I thought it was a rather good idea.
The instructions were rather complicated.
She fell and hurt her leg rather badly.
I didn't fail the exam; in fact I did rather well!
It was a rather difficult question.
It was rather a difficult question.
He looks rather like his father.
The patient has responded to the treatment rather better than expected.
He was conscious that he was talking rather too much.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để có nghĩa là 'khá' hoặc 'ở một mức độ nào đó', thường khi bạn thất vọng, ngạc nhiên hoặc bày tỏ sự chỉ trích nhẹ

senses.definition: used with a verb to make a statement sound less strong

examples.x: I've always rather liked Charlie.
I rather suspect we're making a mistake.
We were rather hoping you'd be able to do it by Friday.

senses.definition_vi: dùng với động từ để làm cho một tuyên bố nghe bớt mạnh mẽ hơn

senses.definition: used to correct something you have said, or to give more accurate information

examples.x: She worked as a secretary, or rather, a personal assistant.
In the end he had to walk—or rather run—to the office.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để sửa chữa điều bạn vừa nói, hoặc để cung cấp thông tin chính xác hơn

senses.definition: used to introduce an idea that is different or opposite to the idea that you have stated previously

examples.x: The walls were not white, but rather a sort of dirty grey.
The problem is not in the whole system, but rather in one small part.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để giới thiệu một ý tưởng khác hoặc đối lập với ý tưởng bạn đã nêu trước đó

senses.definition: instead of somebody/something

examples.x: I think I'll have a cold drink rather than coffee.
Why didn't you ask for help, rather than trying to do it on your own?

senses.definition_vi: thay vì ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: used for saying that you would not like to do something that another person is going to do

examples.x: ‘I'm going climbing tomorrow.’ ‘Rather you than me!’

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn sẽ không muốn làm điều mà người khác sắp làm

senses.definition: would prefer to

examples.x: She'd rather die than give a speech.
‘Do you want to come with us?’ ‘No, I'd rather not.’
Would you rather walk or take the bus?
‘Do you mind if I open a window?’ ‘Well, I'd rather you didn't.’
Personally, I'd rather see the money and resources going into education.
I'd rather have a simple product that actually works than something fancy that's just not reliable.

senses.definition_vi: sẽ thích hơn

senses.definition: a measurement of how good, popular, important, etc. somebody/something is, especially in relation to other people or things

examples.x: Education has been given a high-priority rating by the new administration.
‘The Big Bang Theory’ was the network show with the highest rating.

senses.definition_vi: một phép đo về mức độ tốt, phổ biến, quan trọng, v.v. của ai đó/cái gì đó, đặc biệt là so với những người hoặc vật khác

senses.definition: a set of figures that show how many people watch or listen to a particular television or radio programme, used to show how popular a programme is

examples.x: The show has gone up in the ratings.
The BBC is currently ahead in the ratings war.
Bringing her on the show was a cynical attempt to boost the ratings.
His new sitcom was a ratings success.
It has been ousted from top spot in the TV ratings.
The network's prime-time ratings are up 150 per cent.
The programme's ratings have dipped sharply.
The ratings went shooting up overnight.
The show continues to garner high ratings.

senses.definition_vi: một bộ số liệu cho biết có bao nhiêu người xem hoặc nghe một chương trình truyền hình hoặc radio cụ thể, được sử dụng để cho biết mức độ phổ biến của một chương trình

senses.definition: a number or letter that shows which groups of people a particular film is suitable for

examples.x: The film was given a 15 rating by British censors.
The movie carries an R rating.

senses.definition_vi: một số hoặc chữ cái cho biết các nhóm người mà một bộ phim cụ thể phù hợp

senses.definition: a sailor in the navy who is not an officer
senses.definition_vi: một thủy thủ trong hải quân không phải là sĩ quan

senses.definition: the relationship between two groups of people or things that is represented by two numbers showing how much larger one group is than the other

examples.x: The school has a very high teacher-student ratio.
What is the ratio of men to women in the department?
The ratio of applications to available places currently stands at 100:1.

senses.definition_vi: mối quan hệ giữa hai nhóm người hoặc vật được biểu thị bằng hai số cho biết nhóm này lớn hơn nhóm kia bao nhiêu

senses.definition: based on reason rather than emotions

examples.x: a rational argument/choice/decision
rational analysis/thought
There is no rational explanation for his actions.

senses.definition_vi: dựa trên lý trí thay vì cảm xúc

senses.definition: able to think clearly and make decisions based on reason rather than emotions

examples.x: No rational person would ever behave like that.
Try to be rational about it.
Humans are essentially rational beings.
She said that she had not been fully rational when she signed the form.

senses.definition_vi: có khả năng suy nghĩ rõ ràng và đưa ra quyết định dựa trên lý trí thay vì cảm xúc

senses.definition: not cooked

examples.x: raw meat
raw eggs/vegetables
These fish are often eaten raw.
The tigers were fed raw chicken bones.

senses.definition_vi: chưa nấu chín

senses.definition: in its natural state; not yet changed, used or made into something else

examples.x: raw sewage
raw sugar/milk/cotton
Iron ore is the main raw ingredient in steel.

senses.definition_vi: ở trạng thái tự nhiên; chưa được thay đổi, sử dụng hoặc chế biến thành thứ gì khác

senses.definition: not yet organized into a form in which it can be easily used or understood

examples.x: This information is only raw data and will need further analysis.

senses.definition_vi: chưa được tổ chức thành một hình thức có thể dễ dàng sử dụng hoặc hiểu được

senses.definition: powerful and natural; not trained or showing control

examples.x: songs full of raw emotion
the raw power of imagination
He started with nothing but raw talent and determination.

senses.definition_vi: mạnh mẽ và tự nhiên; chưa được đào tạo hoặc thể hiện sự kiểm soát

senses.definition: red and painful because the skin has been damaged

examples.x: There were raw patches on her feet where the shoes had rubbed.
His throat was raw and painful.
The skin on her feet had been rubbed raw.

senses.definition_vi: đỏ và đau vì da bị tổn thương

senses.definition: new to a job or an activity and therefore without experience or skill

examples.x: a raw beginner
raw recruits (= for example, in the army)

senses.definition_vi: mới trong một công việc hoặc hoạt động và do đó thiếu kinh nghiệm hoặc kỹ năng

senses.definition: very cold

examples.x: a raw north wind
It had been a wet, raw winter.

senses.definition_vi: rất lạnh

senses.definition: honest, direct and sometimes shocking

examples.x: a raw portrayal of working-class life
raw language (= containing many sexual details)

senses.definition_vi: trung thực, thẳng thắn và đôi khi gây sốc

senses.definition: the fact of somebody being treated unfairly

examples.x: Older workers often get a raw deal.

senses.definition_vi: việc ai đó bị đối xử không công bằng

senses.definition: a narrow line of light, heat or other energy

examples.x: The last of the sun's rays shone on the grass.
Ultraviolet rays damage the skin.
The windows were shining in the reflected rays of the setting sun.

senses.definition_vi: một đường ánh sáng, nhiệt hoặc năng lượng khác hẹp

senses.definition: a small amount of something good or of something that you are hoping for

examples.x: There was just one small ray of hope.
The one ray of light in this whole affair is that justice has been done.

senses.definition_vi: một lượng nhỏ của một cái gì đó tốt hoặc của một cái gì đó mà bạn đang hy vọng

senses.definition: a sea fish with a large broad flat body and a long tail, that is used for food
senses.definition_vi: một loài cá biển có thân hình lớn, rộng, phẳng và đuôi dài, được dùng làm thức ăn

senses.definition: the second note of a major scale
senses.definition_vi: nốt thứ hai của một âm giai trưởng

senses.definition: to sit or lie in the sun, especially in order to get a suntan
senses.definition_vi: ngồi hoặc nằm dưới ánh nắng mặt trời, đặc biệt là để có được làn da rám nắng

senses.definition: a person or thing that makes life brighter or more cheerful

examples.x: My nephew is a little ray of sunshine.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật làm cho cuộc sống tươi sáng hơn hoặc vui vẻ hơn

senses.definition: the distance over which you can stretch your arms to touch something; the distance over which a particular object can be used to touch something else

examples.x: The shot was well beyond the reach of the goalkeeper.
Keep all medicines out of reach of children.
He lashed out angrily, hitting anyone within his reach.
It's a book I like to keep within arm's reach.
Use shears with a long reach for cutting high hedges.
As a boxer, his long reach gives him a significant advantage.

senses.definition_vi: đến nơi bạn đã đi du lịch đến

senses.definition: the limit to which somebody/something has the power or influence to do something

examples.x: The brand now has global reach.
The business aims to extend its reach into the North American market.
The company has now overtaken its main rival in terms of size and reach.
Such matters are beyond the reach of the law.
Victory is now out of her reach.
The basic model is priced well within the reach of most people.

senses.definition_vi: đến nơi bạn đã đi du lịch đến

senses.definition: a straight section of water between two bends on a river

examples.x: the upper/lower reaches of the Nile (= the part that is furthest from/nearest to the sea)

senses.definition_vi: đến nơi bạn đã đi du lịch đến

senses.definition: the parts of an area or a place that are a long way from the centre

examples.x: the outer reaches of space
the eastern reaches of the continent
an exploration of the deepest reaches of the human mind

senses.definition_vi: đến nơi bạn đã đi du lịch đến

senses.definition: the higher, etc. sections of an organization, a system, etc.

examples.x: the upper reaches of the civil service
Many clubs in the lower reaches of the league are in financial difficulty.
the upper reaches of the music charts

senses.definition_vi: đến nơi bạn đã đi du lịch đến

senses.definition: close to something

examples.x: The house is within easy reach of schools and sports facilities.
Verona and Padua are both within easy reach for day trips.
a holiday town within reach of Marseilles

senses.definition_vi: đến nơi bạn đã đi du lịch đến

senses.definition: to change or behave in a particular way as a result of or in response to something

examples.x: I nudged her but she didn't react.
You never know how he is going to react.
He would have reacted in the same way.
Local residents have reacted angrily to the news.
The market reacted by falling a further two points.

examples.cf: react to something by doing something
examples.x: The army has reacted to the situation by increasing investment in recruitment.
Her family reacted with horror when she told them.
Residents have reacted with fury to the news.

senses.definition_vi: thay đổi hoặc hành xử theo một cách nhất định do kết quả hoặc để đáp lại điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to become ill after eating, breathing, etc. a particular substance

examples.x: Some patients may react adversely.
People can react badly to certain food additives.
People react differently to these drugs.

senses.definition_vi: bị ốm sau khi ăn, hít phải, v.v. một chất cụ thể.

senses.definition: to experience a chemical change when coming into contact with another substance

examples.x: Silicon reacts chemically like carbon.
Iron reacts with water and air to produce rust.
When an acid and an alkali react together the result is a salt and water.

senses.definition_vi: trải qua một sự thay đổi hóa học khi tiếp xúc với một chất khác.

senses.definition: what you do, say or think as a result of something that has happened

examples.x: to provoke/cause/get a reaction
a positive/negative/adverse reaction
What was his reaction to the news?
Often our actions are based upon an emotional reaction to what someone has done or said to us.
A spokesman said the changes were not in reaction to the company's recent losses.
The initial reaction of the White House was favourable.
It's just another knee-jerk reaction from sections of the media.
My immediate reaction was one of shock.
There has been a mixed reaction to her appointment as director.
The decision provoked an angry reaction from local residents.
I tried shaking him but there was no reaction.

senses.definition_vi: những gì bạn làm, nói hoặc suy nghĩ như là kết quả của một điều gì đó đã xảy ra.

senses.definition: a change in people’s attitudes or behaviour caused by disapproval of the attitudes, etc. of the past

examples.x: Some analysts explain the rise of nationalism as a reaction against globalization.
Her rebellious attitude is just a reaction against her strict upbringing.

senses.definition_vi: sự thay đổi trong thái độ hoặc hành vi của mọi người do sự phản đối thái độ, v.v. của quá khứ.

senses.definition: a response by the body, usually a bad one, to a drug, chemical substance, etc.

examples.x: If you have a bad reaction, discontinue use immediately.
to have an allergic reaction to a drug
Adverse reactions to certain foods can take a few days to manifest.

senses.definition_vi: sự phản ứng của cơ thể, thường là một phản ứng xấu, đối với một loại thuốc, chất hóa học, v.v.

senses.definition: the ability to move quickly in response to something, especially if in danger

examples.x: a skilled driver with quick reactions

senses.definition_vi: khả năng di chuyển nhanh để đáp lại điều gì đó, đặc biệt là khi gặp nguy hiểm.

senses.definition: a chemical change produced by two or more substances acting on each other

examples.x: a chemical reaction
a nuclear reaction
To perform the test, add five drops of the solution to the compound and then observe the reaction.
the reaction of oxygen with other atoms
the reaction of chlorine atoms and ozone

senses.definition_vi: sự thay đổi hóa học được tạo ra bởi hai hoặc nhiều chất tác động lẫn nhau.

senses.definition: a force shown by something in response to another force, which is of equal strength and acts in the opposite direction

examples.x: Action and reaction are equal and opposite.

senses.definition_vi: một lực được thể hiện bởi một vật để đáp lại một lực khác, có cường độ bằng và tác động theo hướng ngược lại.

senses.definition: opposition to social or political progress or change

examples.x: The forces of reaction made change difficult.

senses.definition_vi: sự chống đối lại sự tiến bộ hoặc thay đổi về mặt xã hội hoặc chính trị.

senses.definition: to look at and understand the meaning of written or printed words or symbols

examples.x: She's still learning to read.
Some children can read and write before they go to school.
I can't read your writing.
Can you read music?
I'm trying to read the map.

senses.definition_vi: nhìn và hiểu ý nghĩa của các từ hoặc ký hiệu viết hoặc in.

senses.definition: to go through written or printed words, etc. in silence or speaking them to other people

examples.x: I'm going to go to bed and read.
The book is very easy to read.
He liked reading to his grandchildren.
to read a book/magazine/newspaper
to read an article/a report/a letter/a blog/a review
Have you read any Steinbeck (= novels by him)?
one of the most widely read books in the world
I have read every single post in this entire thread.
I didn't have time to read the novel.
I just finished reading your recent article.
He read the poem aloud.
Go on—read it to us.
Statements from police officers were read to the court.
She read us a story.

senses.definition_vi: đọc các từ viết hoặc in, v.v. một cách thầm lặng hoặc đọc to cho người khác nghe.

senses.definition: to discover or find out about somebody/something by reading

examples.x: I read about the accident in the local paper.
I read that he had resigned.
I read somewhere that women are starting companies at record rates.
I can't remember where I read it.
That's the most ridiculous thing I have ever read!
Don't believe everything you read in the papers.
I read it on the internet.

senses.definition_vi: khám phá hoặc tìm hiểu về ai đó/điều gì đó bằng cách đọc.

senses.definition: to guess what somebody else is thinking

examples.x: Tell me what you want—I can't read your mind!

senses.definition_vi: đoán xem người khác đang nghĩ gì.

senses.definition: to look at the movements of somebody’s lips to learn what they are saying
senses.definition_vi: nhìn vào chuyển động của môi ai đó để biết họ đang nói gì.

senses.definition: to understand something in a particular way

examples.x: How do you read the present situation?
Silence must not always be read as consent.

senses.definition_vi: hiểu điều gì đó theo một cách nhất định.

senses.definition: to have something written on it; to be written in a particular way

examples.x: The sign read ‘No admittance’.
I’ve changed the last paragraph. It now reads as follows…

senses.definition_vi: có một cái gì đó được viết trên đó; được viết theo một cách nhất định.

senses.definition: to give a particular impression when read

examples.x: Generally, the article reads very well.
The poem reads like (= sounds as if it is) a translation.

senses.definition_vi: cho một ấn tượng nhất định khi đọc.

senses.definition: to show a particular weight, pressure, etc.

examples.x: What does the thermometer read?

senses.definition_vi: chỉ một trọng lượng, áp suất, v.v. nhất định.

senses.definition: to get information from a measuring instrument

examples.x: A man came to read the gas meter.

senses.definition_vi: lấy thông tin từ một thiết bị đo lường.

senses.definition: to hear and understand somebody speaking on a radio set

examples.x: ‘Do you read me?’ ‘I'm reading you loud and clear.’

senses.definition_vi: nghe và hiểu ai đó nói trên bộ radio.

senses.definition: to replace one word, etc. with another when correcting a text

examples.x: For ‘madam’ in line 3 read ‘madame’.

senses.definition_vi: thay thế một từ, v.v. bằng một từ khác khi sửa một văn bản.

senses.definition: to study a subject, especially at a university

examples.x: I read English at Oxford.
She's reading for a law degree.

senses.definition_vi: nghiên cứu một môn học, đặc biệt là ở trường đại học.

senses.definition: to take information from a disk

examples.x: The computer could not read the disk at all.
to read a file into a computer

senses.definition_vi: lấy thông tin từ một đĩa.

senses.definition: to look for or discover a meaning in something that is not openly stated

examples.x: Reading between the lines, I think Clare needs money.

senses.definition_vi: tìm kiếm hoặc khám phá ý nghĩa trong một điều gì đó không được nói rõ ràng.

senses.definition: to understand easily what somebody is thinking or feeling
senses.definition_vi: dễ dàng hiểu những gì ai đó đang nghĩ hoặc cảm thấy.

senses.definition: used to tell somebody to listen carefully to what you are saying

examples.x: Read my lips: no new taxes (= I promise there will be no new taxes).

senses.definition_vi: dùng để yêu cầu ai đó lắng nghe cẩn thận những gì bạn đang nói.

senses.definition: to tell somebody with force that they must not do something
senses.definition_vi: nói với ai đó một cách mạnh mẽ rằng họ không được làm điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to accept something without discussing it

examples.x: Can we take it as read that you want the job?

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận một điều gì đó mà không thảo luận.

senses.definition: a person who reads, especially one who reads a lot or in a particular way

examples.x: an avid reader of science fiction
a fast/slow reader
And so, dear reader, our tale comes to its end.
The reader is left to draw his or her own conclusions.
There are many examples to help the reader understand the usefulness of this approach.
Johnson also reminds his readers that ‘the New York School’ was much more than a geographical label.
Readers interested in this period of British history will find much of value in this book.
The book invites young readers to examine the issues.

senses.definition_vi: một người đọc sách, đặc biệt là người đọc nhiều hoặc đọc theo một cách nhất định.

senses.definition: a person who reads a particular newspaper, magazine, etc.

examples.x: readers’ letters
Are you a ‘Times’ reader?
regular readers of this magazine
Readers of this blog will know my views on the matter.
Alert readers may have noticed the misprint in last week's column.
The magazine asked readers to nominate their favourite celebrities.

senses.definition_vi: một người đọc một tờ báo, tạp chí, v.v. cụ thể.

senses.definition: an easy book that is intended to help people learn to read their own or a foreign language

examples.x: a series of graded English readers

senses.definition_vi: một cuốn sách dễ đọc nhằm mục đích giúp mọi người học đọc ngôn ngữ mẹ đẻ hoặc ngoại ngữ của họ.

senses.definition: a senior teacher at a British university just below the rank of a professor

examples.x: She is Reader in Music at Edinburgh.

senses.definition_vi: một giáo viên cấp cao tại một trường đại học của Anh, ngay dưới chức danh giáo sư.

senses.definition: an electronic device that reads data stored in one form and changes it into another form so that a computer can perform operations on it
senses.definition_vi: một thiết bị điện tử đọc dữ liệu được lưu trữ ở một dạng và thay đổi nó thành một dạng khác để máy tính có thể thực hiện các thao tác trên đó.

senses.definition: a machine that produces on a screen a large image of a text stored on a microfiche or microfilm
senses.definition_vi: một máy tạo ra trên màn hình một hình ảnh lớn của văn bản được lưu trữ trên microfiche hoặc microfilm.

senses.definition: quickly and without difficulty

examples.x: All ingredients are readily available from your local store.

senses.definition_vi: nhanh chóng và không gặp khó khăn.

senses.definition: in a way that shows you do not object to something

examples.x: Most people readily accept the need for laws.

senses.definition_vi: theo một cách cho thấy bạn không phản đối điều gì đó.

senses.definition: the activity of somebody who reads

examples.x: My hobbies include reading and painting.
He needs more help with his reading.
Are you any good at map reading?
He enjoys reading and going to the cinema.
reading glasses (= worn when reading)
a reading lamp/light (= one that can be moved to shine light onto something that you are reading)
She has a reading knowledge of German (= she can understand written German).
After extensive reading on the subject she set to work on an article.
He's done a lot of reading about the history of the town.

senses.definition_vi: hoạt động của một người đọc sách.

senses.definition: an act of reading something

examples.x: A closer (= more detailed) reading of the text reveals just how desperate he was feeling.
We are all expected to attend the reading of her will.

senses.definition_vi: một hành động đọc một cái gì đó

senses.definition: books, articles, etc. that are intended to be read

examples.x: reading material
reading matter
a series of reading books for children
further reading (= at the end of a book, a list of other books that give more information about the same subject)
The report makes for interesting reading (= it is interesting to read)
The article is not exactly light reading (= it is serious and requires effort and concentration to understand).
His article should be compulsory reading for law students.
Her assigned reading for English class was ‘Great Expectations’.
a list of suggested reading on this topic

senses.definition_vi: sách, bài báo, v.v. được dự định để đọc

senses.definition: the particular way in which you understand a book, situation, etc.

examples.x: Those conclusions are based on a literal reading of the text.
My own reading of events is less optimistic.

senses.definition_vi: cách bạn hiểu một cuốn sách, tình huống, v.v.

senses.definition: the amount or number shown on an instrument used for measuring something

examples.x: Meter readings are taken every three months.

senses.definition_vi: số lượng hoặc con số hiển thị trên một thiết bị dùng để đo lường cái gì đó

senses.definition: an event at which something is read to an audience for entertainment; a piece of literature that is read at such an event

examples.x: He was invited to give a poetry reading as part of the literary festival.
The evening ended with a reading from her latest novel.

senses.definition_vi: một sự kiện mà ở đó một cái gì đó được đọc cho khán giả để giải trí; một tác phẩm văn học được đọc tại một sự kiện như vậy

senses.definition: a short section from a holy text that is read to people as part of a religious service

examples.x: The reading today is from the Book of Daniel.
readings from the Koran

senses.definition_vi: một đoạn ngắn từ một văn bản thánh được đọc cho mọi người như một phần của buổi lễ tôn giáo

senses.definition: one of the stages during which a bill (= a proposal for a new law) must be discussed and accepted by a parliament before it can become law

examples.x: The bill looks like it will be given a second reading.

senses.definition_vi: một trong những giai đoạn mà một dự luật (= một đề xuất luật mới) phải được thảo luận và chấp nhận bởi một quốc hội trước khi nó có thể trở thành luật

senses.definition: fully prepared for what you are going to do and able to start it immediately

examples.x: Just a minute—I'm almost ready.
Are you nearly ready?
‘Shall we go?’ ‘I'm ready when you are!’
I'm just getting the kids ready for school.
Right, we're ready to go.
We were getting ready to go out.
Volunteers were ready and waiting to pack the food in boxes.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn chuẩn bị cho những gì bạn sắp làm và có thể bắt đầu ngay lập tức

senses.definition: having the experience, attitude, etc. that you need in order to be able to deal with something

examples.x: Her husband wants to start a family, but she isn't ready.
I’m not sure if Karen is ready for marriage yet.
I was twenty years old and ready for anything.
He is clearly not ready to take on such an important role.

senses.definition_vi: có kinh nghiệm, thái độ, v.v. mà bạn cần để có thể đối phó với điều gì đó

senses.definition: completed and available to be used

examples.x: Come on, dinner's ready!
The new building should be ready by 2030.
Can you help me get everything ready for the party?
The contract will be ready to sign in two weeks.

senses.definition_vi: đã hoàn thành và có sẵn để sử dụng

senses.definition: available to be used easily and immediately

examples.x: All the relevant records are ready to hand.
a ready supply of wood
a ready source of income

senses.definition_vi: có sẵn để sử dụng dễ dàng và ngay lập tức

senses.definition: willing and quick to do or give something

examples.x: I was very angry and ready for a fight.
She's always ready with advice.
He's always ready and willing to help.
Don't be so ready to believe the worst about people.

senses.definition_vi: sẵn lòng và nhanh chóng làm hoặc cho đi một cái gì đó

senses.definition: likely to do something very soon

examples.x: She looked ready to collapse at any minute.

senses.definition_vi: có khả năng làm điều gì đó rất sớm

senses.definition: needing something as soon as possible

examples.x: Right, I'm ready for bed.
After the long walk, we were all ready for a rest.

senses.definition_vi: cần một cái gì đó càng sớm càng tốt

senses.definition: quick and clever

examples.x: She has great charm and a ready wit.

senses.definition_vi: nhanh và thông minh

senses.definition: to prepare for something; to prepare something for something

examples.x: to make ready for the President’s visit

senses.definition_vi: chuẩn bị cho một cái gì đó; chuẩn bị một cái gì đó cho một cái gì đó

senses.definition: what you say to tell people to start a race
senses.definition_vi: những gì bạn nói để yêu cầu mọi người bắt đầu một cuộc đua

senses.definition: ready to start

examples.x: The show is just about ready to roll.

senses.definition_vi: sẵn sàng để bắt đầu

senses.definition: actually existing or happening and not imagined or pretended

examples.x: a real danger/risk/threat/concern
All the characters are based on real people.
It wasn't a ghost; it was a real person.
pictures of animals, both real and mythological
In the movies guns kill people instantly, but it's not like that in real life.
Politicians seem to be out of touch with the real world.
The growth of violent crime is a very real problem.
There's no real possibility of them changing their minds.
We have a real chance of success.
By the end of it I had a real sense of achievement.

senses.definition_vi: thực sự tồn tại hoặc xảy ra và không phải là tưởng tượng hay giả vờ

senses.definition: not false or artificial

examples.x: Are those real flowers?
real leather
Pinocchio wanted to be a real live boy.

senses.definition_vi: không giả mạo hoặc nhân tạo

senses.definition: actual or true, rather than what appears to be true

examples.x: Tell me the real reason.
The real story is even more amazing.
Judy Garland's real name was Frances Ethel Gumm.
The real problem is a lack of investment in infrastructure.
The real issue was whether the accused knew the goods were stolen.
The real question here is how he is going to accomplish this.
See the real Africa on one of our walking safaris.
I couldn't resist the opportunity to meet a real live celebrity.
I do my best to hide my real feelings from others.
The only real complaint I have about the film is that it's a little too slow.

senses.definition_vi: thực tế hoặc đúng, thay vì những gì có vẻ đúng

senses.definition: having all the important qualities that it should have to deserve to be called what it is called

examples.x: She never had any real friends at school.
his first real kiss
I had no real interest in politics.
He was making a real effort to be nice to her.
These measures have made a real difference to people's lives.
She has not shown any real regret for what she did.

senses.definition_vi: có tất cả các phẩm chất quan trọng mà nó nên có để xứng đáng được gọi là những gì nó được gọi

senses.definition: used to emphasize a state or quality

examples.x: He looks a real idiot.
This accident could have produced a real tragedy.
Her next play was a real contrast.
This is a real privilege.
It's been a real challenge, but we're determined to succeed.
He made a real cock-up of it.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh một trạng thái hoặc phẩm chất

senses.definition: when the effect of such things as price rises on the power of money to buy things is included in the sums

examples.x: Real wage costs have risen by 10 per cent in the past year.
The real value of the country's exports has grown little since the 1970s.
This represents a reduction of 5 per cent in real terms.

senses.definition_vi: khi ảnh hưởng của những thứ như tăng giá đối với sức mua của tiền được bao gồm trong các phép tính

senses.definition: what somebody claims it is or serious

examples.x: This is not a fire drill—it's for real.
He managed to convince voters that he was for real.
I don’t think her tears were for real.

senses.definition_vi: những gì ai đó tuyên bố nó là hoặc nghiêm túc

senses.definition: used to tell somebody that they are behaving in a stupid or unreasonable way
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói với ai đó rằng họ đang hành xử một cách ngu ngốc hoặc vô lý

senses.definition: to act in an honest and natural way
senses.definition_vi: hành động một cách trung thực và tự nhiên

senses.definition: the person who really controls an organization, a country, etc. in contrast to the person who is legally in charge

examples.x: His assistant was thought to be the real power behind the throne.

senses.definition_vi: người thực sự kiểm soát một tổ chức, một quốc gia, v.v. trái ngược với người có thẩm quyền hợp pháp

senses.definition: something that is what somebody claims it is and that has value, not a copy

examples.x: It's an American flying jacket, the real McCoy.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó thực sự là những gì ai đó tuyên bố nó là và có giá trị, không phải là bản sao

senses.definition: actually what somebody claims that something is

examples.x: Are you sure it's the real thing (= love), not just infatuation?

senses.definition_vi: thực sự là những gì ai đó tuyên bố về một cái gì đó

senses.definition: accepting in a sensible way what it is actually possible to do or achieve in a particular situation

examples.x: a realistic assessment/approach/view
We have to be realistic about our chances of winning.

examples.cf: it is realistic (for somebody) to do something
examples.x: It is not realistic to expect people to spend so much money.
It would not be realistic for the Government to demand a pay freeze in the sector at this point.

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận một cách hợp lý những gì thực sự có thể làm hoặc đạt được trong một tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: sensible and appropriate; possible to achieve

examples.x: a realistic prospect/chance/possibility
a realistic alternative/option
The important thing is to have realistic expectations about what you can and can't accomplish.
We must set realistic goals.
a realistic target
If you want to retain good employees, you have to pay a realistic salary.

senses.definition_vi: hợp lý và phù hợp; có thể đạt được

senses.definition: representing things as they are in real life

examples.x: a realistic portrayal/depiction/picture
She made a very realistic drawing of a horse.
We try to make these training courses as realistic as possible.
The realistic graphics really bring the game to life.

senses.definition_vi: miêu tả mọi thứ như chúng vốn có trong cuộc sống thực

senses.definition: the true situation and the problems that actually exist in life, in contrast to how you would like life to be

examples.x: She refuses to face reality.
You're out of touch with reality.
The reality is that there is not enough money to pay for this project.
They seemed to have the perfect marriage but the reality was very different.
I'm having a hard time adjusting to the reality of this situation.
He needs to accept the reality that his time in this job is over.

senses.definition_vi: tình hình thực sự và những vấn đề thực sự tồn tại trong cuộc sống, trái ngược với cách bạn mong muốn cuộc sống diễn ra

senses.definition: a thing that is actually experienced or seen, in contrast to what people might imagine

examples.x: Will time travel ever become a reality?
The paperless office is still far from being a reality.
As children they experienced the harsh realities of life.
This decision reflects the realities of the political situation.
Politicians should not ignore economic realities for short-term political gain.
It took five years to make her idea a reality.
Money is the key to turning dreams into a reality.

senses.definition_vi: một điều thực sự được trải nghiệm hoặc nhìn thấy, trái ngược với những gì mọi người có thể tưởng tượng

senses.definition: television/shows, etc. that use real people (not actors) in real situations, presented as entertainment

examples.x: the reality show ‘Survivor’

senses.definition_vi: truyền hình/chương trình, v.v. sử dụng người thật (không phải diễn viên) trong các tình huống thực tế, được trình bày như một hình thức giải trí

senses.definition: used to say that a situation is different from what has just been said or from what people believe

examples.x: Outwardly she seemed confident but in reality she felt extremely nervous.
In reality, human beings and dinosaurs never lived on earth at the same time.
The media portray her as happy and successful, but in reality she has a difficult life.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng một tình huống khác với những gì vừa được nói hoặc với những gì mọi người tin

senses.definition: the process of becoming aware of something

examples.x: As realization dawned, he went pale.
the sudden realization of what she had done
There is a growing realization that changes must be made.

senses.definition_vi: quá trình nhận thức được một cái gì đó

senses.definition: the process of achieving a particular aim, etc.

examples.x: It was the realization of his greatest ambition.
the realization of political goals

senses.definition_vi: quá trình đạt được một mục tiêu cụ thể, v.v.

senses.definition: the act of selling something that you own, such as property, in order to get the money that you need for something
senses.definition_vi: hành động bán một thứ gì đó mà bạn sở hữu, chẳng hạn như bất động sản, để có được số tiền bạn cần cho một cái gì đó

senses.definition: the act of producing a sound, play, design, etc.; or the thing that is produced
senses.definition_vi: hành động tạo ra một âm thanh, vở kịch, thiết kế, v.v.; hoặc thứ được tạo ra

senses.definition: to understand or become aware of a particular fact or situation

examples.x: I didn’t realize (that) you were so unhappy.
The moment I saw her, I realized something was wrong.
I finally came to realize that he would never change.
It is important to realize that there are still potential problems.
I don't think you realize how important this is to her.
They hadn't realized just how much time it would take.
Many families fail to realize the importance of a well-balanced diet
Only later did she realize her mistake.
I hope you realize the seriousness of this crime.
The situation was more complicated than they had at first realized.
They managed to leave without any of us realizing.
There was a cheer when it was realized that everyone was safely back.

senses.definition_vi: hiểu hoặc nhận thức được một sự thật hoặc tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: to achieve something important that you very much want to do

examples.x: to realize your dream
We try to help all students realize their full potential (= be as successful as they are able to be).
She never realized her ambition of becoming a professional singer.
He has fully realized the promise which he showed.
I've finally realized a lifelong ambition.

senses.definition_vi: đạt được điều gì đó quan trọng mà bạn rất muốn làm

senses.definition: if somebody’s fears are realized, the things that they are afraid will happen, do happen

examples.x: His worst fears were realized when he saw that the door had been forced open.

senses.definition_vi: nếu nỗi sợ hãi của ai đó trở thành sự thật, những điều họ sợ sẽ xảy ra

senses.definition: to sell things that you own, for example property, in order to get the money that you need for something
senses.definition_vi: bán những thứ bạn sở hữu, ví dụ như bất động sản, để có được số tiền bạn cần cho việc gì đó

senses.definition: to be sold for a particular amount of money

examples.x: The paintings realized $2 million at auction.

senses.definition_vi: được bán với một số tiền nhất định

senses.definition: to produce something that can be seen or heard, based on written information or instructions

examples.x: The stage designs have been beautifully realized.

senses.definition_vi: tạo ra thứ gì đó có thể nhìn hoặc nghe thấy, dựa trên thông tin hoặc hướng dẫn bằng văn bản

senses.definition: used to emphasize an adjective or adverb

examples.x: That's a really good idea.
It's really hard to find a decent job these days.
It all went really well.
This is a really nice place.
Things are looking really bad for him.
It's really important that I speak with her right away.
a really hot fire
I'm really sorry.
She was driving really fast.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh một tính từ hoặc trạng từ

senses.definition: used to emphasize something you are saying or an opinion you are giving

examples.x: I really want to go home now.
I want to help—I really do.
You really need to forget all about her.
Now I really must go.
I really don't mind.
He really likes you.
I really enjoyed the film.
I really, really hope you're right.
I really and truly am in love this time.
I really love it here.
I am really looking forward to seeing the film.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh điều bạn đang nói hoặc ý kiến bạn đang đưa ra

senses.definition: used to express interest in or surprise at what somebody is saying

examples.x: ‘We're going to Japan next month.’ ‘Oh, really?’
‘She's resigned.’ ‘Really? Are you sure?’

senses.definition_vi: dùng để bày tỏ sự quan tâm hoặc ngạc nhiên về điều ai đó đang nói

senses.definition: used to say what is actually the fact or the truth about something

examples.x: What do you really think about it?
Tell me what really happened.
They are not really my aunt and uncle.
I can't believe I am really going to meet the princess.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói điều gì thực sự là sự thật hoặc sự thật về điều gì đó

senses.definition: used, often in negative sentences, to reduce the force of something you are saying

examples.x: I don't really agree with that.
It doesn't really matter.
I don't really know what to expect.
‘Did you enjoy the book?’ ‘Not really’ (= ‘no’ or ‘not very much’).
We’ve done well, really.
I don't really have a choice.
He never really recovered from the scandal.

senses.definition_vi: thường dùng trong câu phủ định, để giảm nhẹ sức mạnh của điều bạn đang nói

senses.definition: used in questions and negative sentences when you want somebody to say ‘no’

examples.x: Do you really expect me to believe that?
I don't really need to go, do I?
He doesn't really have a clue about what's going on, does he?
Is that how you're really going to do it?

senses.definition_vi: dùng trong câu hỏi và câu phủ định khi bạn muốn ai đó nói 'không'

senses.definition: used to show that you think something that somebody has done is bad

examples.x: Really, you could have told us before.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để thể hiện rằng bạn nghĩ điều gì đó mà ai đó đã làm là xấu

senses.definition: an area of activity, interest or knowledge

examples.x: in the realm of literature

senses.definition_vi: một lĩnh vực hoạt động, sở thích hoặc kiến thức

senses.definition: a country ruled by a king or queen

examples.x: The Crown maintains armed forces for the defence of the realm.

senses.definition_vi: một quốc gia được cai trị bởi vua hoặc nữ hoàng

senses.definition: possible/not possible

examples.x: A successful outcome is not beyond the realms of possibility.
It is not beyond the bounds of possibility that we'll all meet again one day.

senses.definition_vi: có thể/không thể

senses.definition: at or near the back of something

examples.x: front and rear windows
the rear entrance of the building

senses.definition_vi: phần sau của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a cause or an explanation for something that has happened or that somebody has done

examples.x: He said no but he didn't give a reason.

Job satisfaction is the main reason people remain in jobs or careers.
The only reason your parents are doing this is because they care so much for you.
Give me one good reason why I should help you.
I'd like to know the reason why you're so late.

For this reason, it's important to have friends who will support you.
These rules are there for a very good reason.
The man attacked me for no apparent reason.
Sometimes I cry for no reason at all.
She resigned for personal reasons.
For obvious reasons the data is not complete.
He wants to keep them all in his office for reasons best known to himself.
people who, for whatever reason, are unable to support themselves
For reasons of security the door is always kept locked.
‘Why do you want to know?’ ‘No reason’ (= I do not want to say why).
‘Why did she do that?’ ‘She must have her reasons’ (= secret reasons which she does not want to tell).
He was excused by reason of (= because of) his age.

senses.definition_vi: một nguyên nhân hoặc lời giải thích cho điều gì đó đã xảy ra hoặc ai đó đã làm

senses.definition: a fact that makes it right or fair to do something

examples.x: They have reason to believe she is lying.

She has good reason to be concerned.
There is no reason at all to doubt it.
There is no reason why we should agree to this.
This result gives us all the more reason for optimism.
He has every reason for feeling excited.
She complained, with reason (= rightly), that she had been underpaid.

senses.definition_vi: một sự thật làm cho việc làm điều gì đó trở nên đúng đắn hoặc công bằng

senses.definition: the power of the mind to think in a logical way, to understand and have opinions, etc.

examples.x: Only human beings are capable of reason (= of thinking in a logical way, etc.).
to lose your reason (= become mentally ill)
the conflict between faith and reason

senses.definition_vi: khả năng của tâm trí để suy nghĩ một cách logic, để hiểu và có ý kiến, v.v.

senses.definition: what is possible, practical or right

examples.x: I can't get her to listen to reason.
Why can't they see reason?
Look, you're supposed to be the voice of reason here.
Keith appears to be open to reason (= to be willing to accept sensible advice).
He's looking for a job and he's willing to do anything within reason.

senses.definition_vi: những gì có thể, thực tế hoặc đúng đắn

senses.definition: it must be clear to any sensible person who thinks about it

examples.x: It stands to reason that they'll leave if you don't pay them enough.
It stands to reason that she wouldn't want them to find out about her personal problems.

senses.definition_vi: phải rõ ràng đối với bất kỳ người nào có lý trí khi suy nghĩ về nó

senses.definition: if there is no rhyme or reason to something or it happens without rhyme or reason, it happens in a way that cannot be easily explained or understood

examples.x: Suddenly, without rhyme or reason, his mood changed.

senses.definition_vi: nếu không có vần điệu hoặc lý do cho điều gì đó hoặc nó xảy ra mà không có vần điệu hoặc lý do, nó xảy ra theo cách không thể giải thích hoặc hiểu được dễ dàng

senses.definition: fair, practical, and sensible

examples.cf: it is reasonable to do something
examples.x: It is reasonable to assume that he knew beforehand that this would happen.
As life expectancy increases, it is reasonable to expect that the retirement age will increase too.
It seems reasonable to conclude that their claims are unfounded.

examples.cf: it is reasonable for somebody to do something
examples.x: Is it not reasonable for the government to look for savings and efficiencies?
Be reasonable! We can't work late every night.

We have reasonable grounds for believing that you are responsible.
Any reasonable person would have done exactly as you did.
You must take all reasonable steps to ensure that the information that you provide is correct.
It seems a perfectly reasonable request to make.
If companies expect work during personal time, it's only reasonable to allow personal time at work.
I considered the evidence in order to decide what is fair and reasonable in the circumstances.

senses.definition_vi: công bằng, thực tế và hợp lý

senses.definition: acceptable and appropriate in a particular situation

examples.x: The police apparently thought this explanation perfectly reasonable.
The judge said they had a reasonable expectation of privacy relating to the information concerned.
He made us a reasonable offer for the car.
You must submit your claim within a reasonable time.
It can even be done as a class project in a reasonable amount of time.
The adviser must take reasonable care to ensure that the information is correct

senses.definition_vi: có thể chấp nhận được và phù hợp trong một tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: not too expensive

examples.x: We sell good-quality food at reasonable prices.
He believes NASA can reach Mars at a reasonable cost.
If the price is reasonable, we'll buy it.

senses.definition_vi: không quá đắt

senses.definition: fairly good, but not very good

examples.x: Most people here have a reasonable standard of living.
The hotel was reasonable, I suppose (= but not excellent).
There's a reasonable chance that he'll come.
The furniture is in reasonable condition.

senses.definition_vi: khá tốt, nhưng không rất tốt

senses.definition: to a degree that is fairly good but not very good

examples.x: The instructions are reasonably straightforward.
She seems reasonably happy in her new job.

senses.definition_vi: ở một mức độ khá tốt nhưng không rất tốt

senses.definition: in a logical and sensible way

examples.x: We tried to discuss the matter calmly and reasonably.

senses.definition_vi: một cách logic và hợp lý

senses.definition: in a fair way

examples.x: He couldn't reasonably be expected to pay back the loan all at once.
The apartments are reasonably priced (= not too expensive).

senses.definition_vi: một cách công bằng

senses.definition: the process of thinking about things in a logical way; opinions and ideas that are based on logical thinking

examples.x: What is the reasoning behind this decision?
This line of reasoning is faulty.

senses.definition_vi: quá trình suy nghĩ về mọi thứ một cách logic; ý kiến và ý tưởng dựa trên tư duy logic

senses.definition: to say or do something that makes somebody less frightened or worried

examples.x: They tried to reassure her, but she still felt anxious.
The doctor reassured him that there was nothing seriously wrong.
She needed to be reassured of his love for her.

senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc làm điều gì đó khiến ai đó bớt sợ hãi hoặc lo lắng

senses.definition: a person who fights against the government of their country

senses.definition_vi: một người chiến đấu chống lại chính phủ của đất nước họ

senses.definition: a person who opposes somebody in authority over them within an organization, a political party, etc.

examples.x: A number of Tory rebels are planning to vote against the government.
