We sat in the sun.
The harvested crop is dried in the hot Indian sun.
They've booked a holiday in the sun (= in a place where it is warm and the sun shines a lot).
We did our best to keep out of the sun.
Her face had obviously caught the sun (= become red or brown) on holiday.
Too much sun ages the skin.
I was driving westwards and I had the sun in my eyes (= the sun was shining in my eyes).
Patients are advised to avoid sun exposure for six weeks.

senses.definition_vi: ánh sáng và nhiệt từ mặt trời

senses.definition: any star around which planets move
senses.definition_vi: bất kỳ ngôi sao nào mà các hành tinh quay quanh

senses.definition: to make good use of opportunities, good conditions, etc. while they last
senses.definition_vi: tận dụng tốt các cơ hội, điều kiện tốt, v.v. khi chúng còn tồn tại

senses.definition: a position in which you are comfortable or have an advantage over other people
senses.definition_vi: một vị trí mà bạn cảm thấy thoải mái hoặc có lợi thế hơn những người khác

senses.definition: used to emphasize that you are talking about a very large number of things

examples.x: We talked about everything under the sun.
I’ve been called all the names under the sun!
There is nothing new under the sun (= in the world).

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn đang nói về một số lượng rất lớn các thứ

senses.definition: when the sun rises or sets

examples.x: I get up with the sun.

senses.definition_vi: khi mặt trời mọc hoặc lặn

senses.definition: the day of the week after Saturday and before Monday, thought of as either the first or the last day of the week

examples.x: It's Sunday today, isn't it?
She went to a cooking class last Sunday.
Are you busy next Sunday?
Sunday morning/afternoon/evening
We'll see each other at Sunday's party.
I work Sunday to Thursday.
I work Sundays to Thursdays.
We'll meet on Sunday (= next Sunday).
We met on Sunday (= last Monday).
We'll meet Sunday.
The office is closed on Sundays (= every Sunday).
The office is closed Sundays.
He was born on a Sunday.
I always do yoga on a Sunday (= every Sunday).
I went to Lisbon on Wednesday, and came back the following Sunday.
‘When did the accident happen?’ ‘It was the Sunday (= the Sunday of the week we are talking about).’
Come back Sunday week (= a week after next Sunday).

senses.definition_vi: ngày trong tuần sau thứ Bảy và trước thứ Hai, được coi là ngày đầu tiên hoặc ngày cuối cùng của tuần

senses.definition: a newspaper published on a Sunday
senses.definition_vi: một tờ báo xuất bản vào Chủ Nhật

senses.definition: used to emphasize that something will never happen or will take a very long time

examples.x: You won't find it, not in a month of Sundays.
It is possible to learn to skydive in Britain, but with our weather it might take a month of Sundays to do it.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng điều gì đó sẽ không bao giờ xảy ra hoặc sẽ mất rất nhiều thời gian

senses.definition: your best clothes

examples.x: I put on my Sunday best for the occasion.

senses.definition_vi: quần áo đẹp nhất của bạn

senses.definition: extremely good

examples.x: a super meal
We had a super time in Italy.
‘The pilot did a super job,’ a passenger said afterwards.
She was super (= very kind) when I was having problems.

senses.definition_vi: cực kỳ tốt

senses.definition: excellent; of very good quality

examples.x: a superb player
The car's in superb condition.
His performance was absolutely superb.
You look superb.

senses.definition_vi: xuất sắc; có chất lượng rất tốt

senses.definition: better in quality than somebody/something else; greater than somebody/something else

examples.x: vastly superior
superior intelligence
Liverpool were clearly the superior team.
This model is technically superior to its competitors.
She felt socially superior to most of her neighbours.
The enemy won because of their superior numbers (= there were more of them).

senses.definition_vi: tốt hơn về chất lượng so với người/vật khác; lớn hơn người/vật khác

senses.definition: higher in rank, importance or position

examples.x: my superior officer
superior status
a superior court of law

senses.definition_vi: cao hơn về cấp bậc, tầm quan trọng hoặc vị trí

senses.definition: showing by your behaviour that you think you are better than others

examples.x: a superior manner
He always looks so superior.

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện qua hành vi của bạn rằng bạn nghĩ mình giỏi hơn người khác

senses.definition: of very good quality; better than other similar things

examples.x: superior apartments
The hotel offers superior accommodation and leisure facilities.

senses.definition_vi: có chất lượng rất tốt; tốt hơn các thứ tương tự khác

senses.definition: a large shop that sells food, drinks and goods used in the home. People choose what they want from the shelves and pay for it as they leave.

examples.x: I only shop at this supermarket.
It is the fifth largest supermarket chain in the UK.
An increasing amount of organic produce is to be found on supermarket shelves.
a supermarket checkout/aisle
a supermarket trolley

senses.definition_vi: một cửa hàng lớn bán thực phẩm, đồ uống và hàng hóa dùng trong gia đình. Mọi người tự chọn những gì họ muốn từ các kệ hàng và thanh toán khi rời đi.

senses.definition: to be in charge of somebody/something and make sure that everything is done correctly, safely, etc.

examples.x: to supervise building work
Who is supervising?
She supervised the children playing near the pool.

senses.definition_vi: chịu trách nhiệm về ai đó/thứ gì đó và đảm bảo rằng mọi thứ được thực hiện một cách chính xác, an toàn, v.v.

senses.definition: the work or activity involved in being in charge of somebody/something and making sure that everything is done correctly, safely, etc.

examples.x: Very young children should not be left to play without supervision.
The drug should only be used under medical supervision.

senses.definition_vi: công việc hoặc hoạt động liên quan đến việc chịu trách nhiệm về ai đó/thứ gì đó và đảm bảo rằng mọi thứ được thực hiện một cách chính xác, an toàn, v.v.

senses.definition: a meeting between a student and their tutor or supervisor that involves teaching and discussion of the student's work

examples.x: I have weekly supervisions.

senses.definition_vi: một buổi gặp mặt giữa sinh viên và người hướng dẫn hoặc giám sát viên, bao gồm việc giảng dạy và thảo luận về công việc của sinh viên

senses.definition: a person who supervises somebody/something

examples.x: I have a meeting with my supervisor about my research topic.
All work is done under the guidance of a supervisor.

senses.definition_vi: một người giám sát ai đó/thứ gì đó

senses.definition: a thing that is added to something else to improve or complete it

examples.x: vitamin/dietary supplements (= vitamins and other foods eaten in addition to what you usually eat)
Industrial sponsorship is a supplement to government funding.

senses.definition_vi: thêm một cái gì đó vào một cái gì đó để cải thiện hoặc làm cho nó hoàn chỉnh hơn

senses.definition: an extra separate section, often in the form of a magazine, that is sold with a newspaper

examples.x: the Sunday colour supplements
Our special supplement is packed with ideas for healthy hair.

senses.definition_vi: thêm một cái gì đó vào một cái gì đó để cải thiện hoặc làm cho nó hoàn chỉnh hơn

senses.definition: a book or a section at the end of a book that gives extra information or deals with a special subject

examples.x: the supplement to the Oxford English Dictionary
a supplement to the main report
You can use these books as supplements to the basic English course.

senses.definition_vi: thêm một cái gì đó vào một cái gì đó để cải thiện hoặc làm cho nó hoàn chỉnh hơn

senses.definition: an amount of money that you pay for an extra service or item, especially in addition to the basic cost of a holiday

examples.x: There is a £10 supplement for a single room.
There is a supplement on rooms with a sea view.
Safety deposit boxes are available at a supplement.

senses.definition_vi: thêm một cái gì đó vào một cái gì đó để cải thiện hoặc làm cho nó hoàn chỉnh hơn

senses.definition: an amount of something that is provided or available to be used

examples.x: Advances in agriculture increased the food supply.
Demand for skilled labour outstrips supply.
We ordered a month's supply of oil.
We cannot guarantee adequate supplies of raw materials.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp cho ai đó/thứ gì đó những gì họ cần hoặc muốn, đặc biệt là với số lượng lớn

senses.definition: the things such as food, medicines, fuel, etc. that are needed by a group of people, for example an army or expedition

examples.x: Our supplies were running out.
food and medical supplies for refugees

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp cho ai đó/thứ gì đó những gì họ cần hoặc muốn, đặc biệt là với số lượng lớn

senses.definition: the act of supplying something; the fact of receiving something that is being supplied

examples.x: the electricity/energy/gas supply
The storm disrupted the town's power supply.
A stroke is caused by disruption to the blood supply to the brain.
the supply of goods and services
a contract for the supply of timber

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp cho ai đó/thứ gì đó những gì họ cần hoặc muốn, đặc biệt là với số lượng lớn

senses.definition: not existing in large enough quantities to satisfy demand

examples.x: Basic foodstuffs were in short supply.
Sunshine will be in short supply for the west coast.
Safe drinking water is in desperately short supply.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp cho ai đó/thứ gì đó những gì họ cần hoặc muốn, đặc biệt là với số lượng lớn

senses.definition: approval that you give to somebody/something because you want them to be successful

examples.x: There is strong public support for the policy.
There is a continued lack of support for the war.
His ideas are gaining popular support (= the support of many people).
to provide/offer support
I intend to lend my full support to the campaign.
to win/gain somebody's support
Can I rely on your support (= will you vote for me) in the election?
The policy has broad support from industry.
Only a few people spoke in support of the proposal.
organizations that provide advice and support to small businesses

senses.definition_vi: giúp đỡ hoặc khuyến khích ai đó/thứ gì đó bằng cách nói hoặc thể hiện rằng bạn đồng ý với họ/nó

senses.definition: money or goods that you give to somebody/something in order to help them

examples.x: They received no financial support from the government.
She has no visible means of support (= no work, income etc.).

senses.definition_vi: giúp đỡ hoặc khuyến khích ai đó/thứ gì đó bằng cách nói hoặc thể hiện rằng bạn đồng ý với họ/nó

senses.definition: sympathy and help that you give to somebody who is in a difficult or unhappy situation

examples.x: Her family and friends have given her lots of support.
Thank you for all your messages of support at this difficult time.
He turned to his closest friends for support.
support staff/services
a support network/system

senses.definition_vi: giúp đỡ hoặc khuyến khích ai đó/thứ gì đó bằng cách nói hoặc thể hiện rằng bạn đồng ý với họ/nó

senses.definition: evidence that helps to show that something is true or correct

examples.x: This suggestion lacks convincing experimental support.
The statistics offer further support for our theory.
There is little evidence in support of this hypothesis.

senses.definition_vi: giúp đỡ hoặc khuyến khích ai đó/thứ gì đó bằng cách nói hoặc thể hiện rằng bạn đồng ý với họ/nó

senses.definition: a thing that holds something and prevents it from falling

examples.x: The supports under the bridge were starting to bend.
When my father died, Jim was a real support.

senses.definition_vi: giúp đỡ hoặc khuyến khích ai đó/thứ gì đó bằng cách nói hoặc thể hiện rằng bạn đồng ý với họ/nó

senses.definition: the act of holding something in position or preventing it from falling

examples.x: She held on to his arm for support.
After the operation he couldn't walk without support.
A firmer mattress gives your back an improved level of support.

senses.definition_vi: giúp đỡ hoặc khuyến khích ai đó/thứ gì đó bằng cách nói hoặc thể hiện rằng bạn đồng ý với họ/nó

senses.definition: something you wear to hold an injured or weak part of your body in position

examples.x: a knee/back support

senses.definition_vi: giúp đỡ hoặc khuyến khích ai đó/thứ gì đó bằng cách nói hoặc thể hiện rằng bạn đồng ý với họ/nó

senses.definition: a band or singer who performs in a pop or rock concert before the main performer

examples.x: The support (act) has yet to be confirmed.

senses.definition_vi: giúp đỡ hoặc khuyến khích ai đó/thứ gì đó bằng cách nói hoặc thể hiện rằng bạn đồng ý với họ/nó

senses.definition: technical help that a company gives to customers using their computers or other products

examples.x: There is a lack of decent home user support.

senses.definition_vi: giúp đỡ hoặc khuyến khích ai đó/thứ gì đó bằng cách nói hoặc thể hiện rằng bạn đồng ý với họ/nó

senses.definition: a person who supports a political party, an idea, etc.

examples.x: a strong/loyal/staunch/ardent supporter
Labour supporters
The magazine is free to members and supporters.
About a hundred of his supporters rallied to demand justice.

senses.definition_vi: một người ủng hộ một đảng chính trị, một ý tưởng, v.v.

senses.definition: a person who supports a particular sports team

examples.x: I'm an Arsenal supporter.

senses.definition_vi: một người ủng hộ một đội thể thao cụ thể

senses.definition: encouraging somebody or giving them help or sympathy

examples.x: a supportive family
She was very supportive during my father's illness.
a mutually supportive relationship
He was strongly supportive of my career.

senses.definition_vi: khuyến khích ai đó hoặc giúp đỡ hoặc đồng cảm với họ

senses.definition: to think or believe that something is true or possible (based on the knowledge that you have)

examples.x: Getting a visa isn't as simple as you might suppose.
Prices will go up, I suppose.
I don't suppose for a minute that he'll agree (= I'm sure that he won't).
It's reasonable to suppose that he left the note after he tried to call her.
Why do you suppose he resigned?
I suppose all the tickets have been sold now, have they?
There is no reason to suppose she's lying.
I suppose you think it's funny, do you (= showing anger)?
She had supposed him (to be) very rich.
I had supposed him a younger man.

senses.definition_vi: nghĩ hoặc tin rằng điều gì đó là đúng hoặc có thể (dựa trên kiến thức bạn có)

senses.definition: used to make a statement, request or suggestion less direct or less strong

examples.x: I could take you in the car, I suppose (= but I don't really want to).
‘Can I borrow the car?’ ‘I suppose so (= Yes, but I'm not happy about it).’
What I’m saying, I suppose, is that she’s not really suitable for the job.
I don’t suppose (that) I could have a look at your newspaper, could I?
Suppose we take a later train?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để làm cho một tuyên bố, yêu cầu hoặc đề xuất ít trực tiếp hơn hoặc yếu hơn

senses.definition: to pretend that something is true; to imagine what would happen if something were true

examples.x: Suppose flights are fully booked on that day—which other day could we go?
Let us suppose, for example, that you are married with two children.
Let's suppose for a moment that these four points are correct.
The theory supposes the existence of life on other planets.
Suppose him (to be) dead—what then?

senses.definition_vi: giả vờ rằng điều gì đó là đúng; tưởng tượng điều gì sẽ xảy ra nếu điều gì đó là đúng

senses.definition: to be expected or required to do/be something according to a rule, a custom, an arrangement, etc.

examples.x: What am I supposed to do?
You're supposed to buy a ticket, but not many people do.
I thought we were supposed to be paid today.
The engine doesn't sound like it's supposed to.
You were supposed to be here an hour ago!
Oops—that wasn't supposed to happen.
How was I supposed to know you were waiting for me?
‘Yes and no.’ ‘What is that supposed to mean?’ (= showing that you are annoyed)

senses.definition_vi: được mong đợi hoặc yêu cầu để làm/là một cái gì đó theo quy tắc, phong tục, thỏa thuận, v.v.

senses.definition: to be generally believed or expected to be/do something

examples.x: I haven't seen it myself, but it's supposed to be a great movie.
This combination of qualities is generally supposed to be extremely rare.
She's supposed to have had hundreds of lovers.

senses.definition_vi: được tin hoặc mong đợi nói chung là/làm một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to not be allowed to do something

examples.x: You're not supposed to walk on the grass.

senses.definition_vi: không được phép làm một cái gì đó

senses.definition: according to what is generally thought or believed but not known for certain

examples.x: The novel is supposedly based on a true story.
a poem supposedly written by Shakespeare
Police have found the supposedly stolen car.

senses.definition_vi: theo những gì thường được nghĩ hoặc tin nhưng không chắc chắn

senses.definition: to put an end, often by force, to a group or an activity that is believed to threaten authority

examples.x: The rebellion was brutally suppressed.

senses.definition_vi: chấm dứt, thường bằng vũ lực, một nhóm hoặc một hoạt động được cho là đe dọa quyền lực

senses.definition: to prevent something from being published or made known

examples.x: The police were accused of suppressing vital evidence.
This information had been deliberately suppressed.

senses.definition_vi: ngăn chặn một cái gì đó được xuất bản hoặc công khai

senses.definition: to prevent yourself from having or expressing a feeling or an emotion

examples.x: to suppress a smile
She was unable to suppress her anger.
He had suppressed the painful memories of his childhood.
He could hardly suppress his surprise.
Her face was charged with barely suppressed anger.
She was unable to suppress a giggle.
The disloyal thought was instantly suppressed.
He couldn't suppress the excitement in his voice.

senses.definition_vi: ngăn bản thân có hoặc thể hiện một cảm giác hoặc cảm xúc

senses.definition: to prevent something from growing, developing or continuing

examples.x: drugs that suppress the appetite

senses.definition_vi: ngăn chặn một cái gì đó phát triển, phát triển hoặc tiếp tục

senses.definition: highest in rank or position

examples.x: the Supreme Commander of the armed forces
the supreme champion
It is an event in which she reigns supreme.

senses.definition_vi: cao nhất về thứ hạng hoặc vị trí

senses.definition: very great or the greatest in degree

examples.x: to make the supreme sacrifice (= die for what you believe in)
a supreme effort
She smiled with supreme confidence.

senses.definition_vi: rất lớn hoặc lớn nhất về mức độ

senses.definition: confident that you know something or that you are right

examples.x: ‘Is that John over there?’ ‘I'm not sure.’
You don't sound very sure.
I'm pretty sure (that) he'll agree.
Are you sure you don't mind?
I’m sure he’s still alive.
I hope you are sure of your facts.
Are you sure about that?
Ask me if you're not sure how to do it.
I'm not sure whether I should tell you this.
not exactly/entirely/absolutely/really sure
I still wasn't even sure who I was talking to.
I like this bit, but I'm not so sure about that one.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói 'có' với ai đó

senses.definition: certain that you will receive something or that something will happen

examples.x: You're always sure of a warm welcome there.
We could not be sure of financial support.
England must win this game to be sure of qualifying for the World Cup.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói 'có' với ai đó

senses.definition: certain to do something or to happen

examples.x: The exhibition is sure to be popular.
It's sure to rain.
You’re sure to get lost if you don’t keep to the path.
She's sure to be picked for the team.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói 'có' với ai đó

senses.definition: that can be trusted or relied on

examples.x: It's a sure sign of economic recovery.
There's only one sure way to do it.
He is a sure bet for the presidential nomination (= certain to succeed).
I told my friends that our winning was a sure thing.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói 'có' với ai đó

senses.definition: steady and confident

examples.x: We admired her sure touch at the keyboard.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói 'có' với ai đó

senses.definition: used to tell somebody to do something

examples.x: Be sure to give your family my regards.
Be sure to check out our website.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói 'có' với ai đó

senses.definition: without doubt

examples.x: No one knows for sure what happened.
I think he'll be back on Monday, but I can't say for sure.
One thing is for sure—it's not going to be easy.
‘Will you be there?’ ‘For sure.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói 'có' với ai đó

senses.definition: something that is likely to happen, to succeed or to be suitable

examples.x: He's a good bet to earn a spot on the US team.
Clothes are a safe bet as a present for a teenager.
The movie looks like a sure bet for Best Film.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói 'có' với ai đó

senses.definition: to do something in order to be certain that something else happens

examples.x: Make sure (that) no one finds out about this.
They scored another goal and made sure of victory.
Our staff will do their best to make sure you enjoy your visit.
To make doubly sure they would not be disturbed she turned the key in the lock.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói 'có' với ai đó

senses.definition: to check that something is true or has been done

examples.x: She looked around to make sure that she was alone.
I think the door's locked, but I'll just go and make sure.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói 'có' với ai đó

senses.definition: very confident

examples.x: She seems very sure of herself.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói 'có' với ai đó

senses.definition: used to say ‘yes’ to a suggestion or request

examples.x: ‘Are you coming?’ ‘Sure thing.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói 'có' với ai đó

senses.definition: used to admit that something is true

examples.x: He is intelligent, to be sure, but he's also very lazy.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói 'có' với ai đó

senses.definition: used to show that you are almost certain of what you are saying and want other people to agree with you

examples.x: Surely we should do something about it?
It's surely only a matter of time before he is found, isn't it?
Surely by now, things could be organized better?
Oil prices will surely have some impact on trade.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy bạn gần như chắc chắn về những gì bạn đang nói và muốn người khác đồng ý với bạn

senses.definition: used with a negative to show that something surprises you and you do not want to believe it

examples.x: Surely you don't think I was responsible for this?
‘They're getting married.’ ‘Surely not!’
They won't go, surely?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với phủ định để cho thấy điều gì đó làm bạn ngạc nhiên và bạn không muốn tin điều đó

senses.definition: without doubt; certainly

examples.x: He knew that if help did not arrive soon they would surely die.

senses.definition_vi: không còn nghi ngờ gì nữa; chắc chắn

senses.definition: used to say ‘yes’ to somebody or to agree to something
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói 'có' với ai đó hoặc đồng ý với một cái gì đó

senses.definition: making slow but definite progress

examples.x: We'll get there slowly but surely.

senses.definition_vi: tiến triển chậm nhưng chắc chắn

senses.definition: the outside or top layer of something

examples.x: We need a flat, smooth surface to play the game on.
an uneven road surface
a broad leaf with a large surface area
Surface water (= rainwater that has collected on the surface of a road) made driving conditions hazardous.
Teeth have a hard surface layer called enamel.

senses.definition_vi: lớp ngoài hoặc trên cùng của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: the top layer of an area of water or land

examples.x: the earth's surface
These plants float on the surface of the water.
We could see fish swimming just below the surface.
Alligators lurk beneath the surface of the swamp.
The earth’s surface temperature is rising.

senses.definition_vi: lớp trên cùng của một vùng nước hoặc đất liền

senses.definition: the flat upper part of a piece of furniture, that is used for working on

examples.x: She's cleaned all the kitchen surfaces.
You'll need a large smooth surface for rolling out the pastry.

senses.definition_vi: phần trên phẳng của một món đồ nội thất, được sử dụng để làm việc

senses.definition: the outer appearance of a person, thing or situation; the qualities that you see or notice, that are not hidden

examples.x: Rage bubbled just below the surface of his mind.
She gives the impression of being rather conventional, but under the surface she is wildly eccentric.

senses.definition_vi: bề ngoài của một người, sự vật hoặc tình huống; những phẩm chất mà bạn nhìn thấy hoặc nhận thấy, không bị che giấu.

senses.definition: when not thought about deeply or carefully and completely; when not looked at carefully

examples.x: It seems like a good idea on the surface but there are sure to be problems.
On the surface, he appeared unchanged.
On the surface his words were funny, but I detected a lot of anger behind them.

senses.definition_vi: khi không suy nghĩ sâu sắc hoặc cẩn thận và hoàn toàn; khi không xem xét kỹ lưỡng.

senses.definition: to deal with, understand, or find out about only a small part of a subject or problem

examples.x: We left feeling that we had just scratched the surface of this fascinating country.
The investigation barely scratched the surface of the city's drug problem.

senses.definition_vi: để giải quyết, hiểu hoặc tìm hiểu chỉ một phần nhỏ của một chủ đề hoặc vấn đề.

senses.definition: a sudden increase of a strong feeling

examples.x: She felt a sudden surge of anger.
a surge of excitement

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển nhanh chóng và mạnh mẽ theo một hướng cụ thể.

senses.definition: a sudden increase in the amount or number of something

examples.x: a surge in consumer spending
We are having trouble keeping up with the recent surge in demand.
A last-minute surge in ticket sales saved the show from closure.
After an initial surge of interest, there has been little call for our services.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển nhanh chóng và mạnh mẽ theo một hướng cụ thể.

senses.definition: a sudden, strong movement forward or upwards

examples.x: a tidal surge
A surge of people poured through the gates.
Police struggled to control the sudden surge forward by the demonstrators.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển nhanh chóng và mạnh mẽ theo một hướng cụ thể.

senses.definition: a sudden increase in the flow of electrical power through a system

examples.x: An electrical surge damaged the computer's disk drive.
The National Grid was hit by a huge power surge.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển nhanh chóng và mạnh mẽ theo một hướng cụ thể.

senses.definition: a doctor who is trained to perform surgery (= medical operations that involve cutting open a person’s body)

examples.x: a brain/heart surgeon
Surgeons performed two operations on him yesterday.

senses.definition_vi: một bác sĩ được đào tạo để thực hiện phẫu thuật (= các ca phẫu thuật y tế liên quan đến việc rạch cơ thể người).

senses.definition: medical treatment of injuries or diseases that involves cutting open a person’s body and often removing or replacing some parts; the branch of medicine connected with this treatment

examples.x: major/minor surgery
to undergo heart/knee/shoulder surgery
He will require surgery on his left knee.
The doctor had to perform emergency surgery to the patient's head.
She's a specialist in reconstructive and cosmetic surgery.
The president is to undergo minor surgery to remove a small growth from his hand.

senses.definition_vi: điều trị y tế các vết thương hoặc bệnh tật liên quan đến việc rạch cơ thể người và thường là loại bỏ hoặc thay thế một số bộ phận; lĩnh vực y học liên quan đến việc điều trị này.

senses.definition: a place where a doctor, dentist or vet sees patients

examples.x: a doctor’s/dentist’s/vet's surgery

senses.definition_vi: một nơi mà bác sĩ, nha sĩ hoặc bác sĩ thú y khám bệnh.

senses.definition: the time during which a doctor, dentist or vet is available to see patients

examples.x: morning/afternoon/evening surgery
surgery hours
Is there a surgery this evening?
He holds surgery from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m.

senses.definition_vi: thời gian mà bác sĩ, nha sĩ hoặc bác sĩ thú y có mặt để khám bệnh.

senses.definition: a time when people can meet their Member of Parliament to ask questions and get help

examples.x: a constituency surgery

senses.definition_vi: một thời điểm mà mọi người có thể gặp Nghị sĩ của họ để đặt câu hỏi và nhận trợ giúp.

senses.definition: used in or connected with surgery

examples.x: surgical procedures
a surgical ward (= for patients having operations)

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong hoặc liên quan đến phẫu thuật.

senses.definition: very accurate

examples.x: They launched surgical strikes against enemy targets.
surgical bombing
The quarterback found the wide receiver with a pass of almost surgical precision.

senses.definition_vi: rất chính xác.

senses.definition: an amount that is extra or more than you need

examples.x: food surpluses
Wheat was in surplus that year.

senses.definition_vi: một số lượng dư thừa hoặc nhiều hơn bạn cần.

senses.definition: the amount by which the amount of money received is greater than the amount of money spent

examples.x: a surplus of £400 million
The balance of payments was in surplus last year (= the value of exports was greater than the value of imports).

senses.definition_vi: số tiền mà số tiền nhận được lớn hơn số tiền chi tiêu.

senses.definition: an event, a piece of news, etc. that is unexpected or that happens suddenly

examples.x: What a nice surprise!
I have a surprise for you!
a surprise attack
There are few surprises in this year's budget.
It comes as no surprise to learn that they broke their promises.
Her letter came as a complete surprise.
‘The appointment came as a pleasant surprise to me,’ she says.
The announcements came as something of a surprise to them.
There are lots of surprises in store for visitors to the gallery.
He was there on a surprise visit to the troops.
Life’s full of surprises.
She likes springing surprises on people.
Visitors to the gallery are in for a few surprises.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy ngạc nhiên.

senses.definition: a feeling caused by something happening suddenly or unexpectedly

examples.x: a look of surprise
She looked up in surprise.
He gasped with surprise at her strength.
They couldn't conceal their surprise at seeing us together.
I got a surprise when I saw the bill.
To everyone's surprise, the plan succeeded.
Much to my surprise, I passed.
Imagine our surprise when he walked into the room!
When we went inside we got a nasty surprise.
The decision has been greeted with surprise.
They expressed surprise at the outcome.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy ngạc nhiên.

senses.definition: the use of methods that cause feelings of surprise

examples.x: A successful campaign should have an element of surprise.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy ngạc nhiên.

senses.definition: used to show that something is not a surprise to you, as you could easily have predicted that it would happen or be true

examples.x: One of the candidates was the manager's niece, and surprise, surprise, she got the job.
Bob turned up half an hour late, surprise surprise.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy ngạc nhiên.

senses.definition: used when giving somebody a surprise

examples.x: Surprise, surprise! Look who's here!

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy ngạc nhiên.

senses.definition: to happen unexpectedly so that somebody is slightly shocked; to surprise somebody

examples.x: His frankness took her by surprise.
The storm took us completely by surprise.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy ngạc nhiên.

senses.definition: to attack or capture somebody/something unexpectedly or without warning

examples.x: The police took the burglars by surprise.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy ngạc nhiên.

senses.definition: feeling or showing surprise

examples.x: a surprised look
She looked surprised when I told her.
I was surprised at how quickly she agreed.
I'm surprised at you, behaving like that in front of the kids.

examples.cf: surprised to see, hear, learn, discover, find
examples.x: They were surprised to find that he'd already left.
You shouldn’t be surprised (that) he didn’t come.
Don't be surprised if I pretend not to recognize you.
‘Will she cancel the party?’ ‘I wouldn't be surprised.’
You’d be surprised how many people voted for him.
He was pleasantly surprised to discover that he was no longer afraid.
to be a little/a bit/quite surprised
She seemed somewhat surprised at his reaction.

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy hoặc thể hiện sự ngạc nhiên.

senses.definition: causing surprise

examples.x: It’s not surprising (that) they lost.
The frequency of such bad weather is hardly surprising given how far north we are.
A surprising number of people came.
We had a surprising amount in common.
It's surprising what people will do for money.
It’s surprising how many people applied for the job.

senses.definition_vi: gây ngạc nhiên.

senses.definition: to admit that you have been defeated and want to stop fighting; to allow yourself to be caught, taken prisoner, etc.

examples.x: The rebel soldiers were forced to surrender.
He surrendered voluntarily to his enemies.
The hijackers eventually surrendered themselves to the police.

senses.definition_vi: thừa nhận rằng bạn đã bị đánh bại và muốn ngừng chiến đấu; cho phép bản thân bị bắt, bị bắt làm tù binh, v.v.

senses.definition: to give up something/somebody when you are forced to

examples.x: He agreed to surrender all claims to the property.
They surrendered their guns to the police.
The defendant was released to await trial but had to surrender her passport.
The dictator surrendered power to Parliament.

senses.definition_vi: từ bỏ điều gì đó/ai đó khi bạn bị buộc phải làm vậy.

senses.definition: to be all around something/somebody

examples.x: Tall trees surround the lake.
the membranes surrounding the brain
The garden is surrounded by a wall.
As a child I was surrounded by love and kindness.
I loved being surrounded by enthusiastic young people.
The lake is surrounded with trees.

senses.definition_vi: ở xung quanh ai đó/điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to move into position all around somebody/something, especially so as to prevent them from escaping; to move somebody/something into position in this way

examples.x: Police surrounded the building.
They've surrounded the building with police.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển vào vị trí xung quanh ai đó/điều gì đó, đặc biệt là để ngăn họ trốn thoát; di chuyển ai đó/điều gì đó vào vị trí theo cách này.

senses.definition: to be closely connected with something/somebody

examples.x: publicity surrounding the divorce
the controversy/circumstances surrounding his death
The report explores the issues surrounding the case.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan chặt chẽ đến ai đó/điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to choose to have particular people or things near you all the time

examples.x: I like to surround myself with beautiful things.

senses.definition_vi: chọn có những người hoặc vật cụ thể ở gần bạn mọi lúc.

senses.definition: that is near or around something

examples.x: Oxford and the surrounding area
From the top of the hill you can see all the surrounding countryside.
the immediately surrounding area
The college tries to respond to the needs of the surrounding community.

senses.definition_vi: ở gần hoặc xung quanh một cái gì đó.

senses.definition: the act of carefully watching a person suspected of a crime or a place where a crime may be committed

examples.x: The police are keeping the suspects under constant surveillance.
surveillance cameras/equipment

senses.definition_vi: hành động theo dõi cẩn thận một người bị nghi phạm tội hoặc một địa điểm có thể xảy ra tội phạm.

senses.definition: an investigation of the opinions, behaviour, etc. of a particular group of people, which is usually done by asking them questions

examples.x: A recent survey showed 75 per cent of those questioned were in favour of the plan.
The survey revealed/found that…
to conduct/carry out/do/complete a survey
According to the survey, many young adults have experimented with drugs of some kind.
Another national survey conducted last year found the same result.
Roughly half of survey respondents express strong interest in additional education.
The results of the survey come as no surprise to us.

senses.definition_vi: nhìn kỹ toàn bộ một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là để có được ấn tượng chung về nó

senses.definition: the act of examining and recording the measurements, features, etc. of an area of land in order to make a map or plan of it

examples.x: an aerial survey (= made by taking photographs from a plane, drone, etc.)
A geological survey revealed the presence of oil beneath the ground.

senses.definition_vi: nhìn kỹ toàn bộ một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là để có được ấn tượng chung về nó

senses.definition: an examination of the condition of a house, etc., usually done for somebody who is thinking of buying it

examples.x: a detailed structural survey

senses.definition_vi: nhìn kỹ toàn bộ một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là để có được ấn tượng chung về nó

senses.definition: a general study, view or description of something

examples.x: a comprehensive survey of modern music
a historical survey of children's clothing

senses.definition_vi: nhìn kỹ toàn bộ một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là để có được ấn tượng chung về nó

senses.definition: the state of continuing to live or exist, often despite difficulty or danger

examples.x: the struggle/battle/fight for survival
His only chance of survival was a heart transplant.
Exporting is necessary for our economic survival.
Continued trade in these products is a threat to the survival of the species.

senses.definition_vi: tình trạng tiếp tục sống hoặc tồn tại, thường bất chấp khó khăn hoặc nguy hiểm

senses.definition: something that has continued to exist from an earlier time

examples.x: The ceremony is a survival from pre-Christian times.

senses.definition_vi: thứ gì đó đã tiếp tục tồn tại từ thời kỳ trước đó

senses.definition: the principle that only the people or things that are best adapted to their environment will continue to exist
senses.definition_vi: nguyên tắc chỉ những người hoặc vật thích nghi tốt nhất với môi trường của họ mới tiếp tục tồn tại

senses.definition: to continue to live or exist

examples.x: She was the last surviving member of the family.
Of the six people injured in the crash, only two survived.
Many of these teachers are struggling to survive financially.
He must betray his friend in order to survive.
The children had to survive by begging and stealing.
‘How are you these days?’ ‘Oh, surviving.’
Don't worry, it's only a scratch—you'll survive.
Some strange customs have survived from earlier times.
I can't survive on £40 a week (= it is not enough for my basic needs).
They spent two months in the jungle, surviving on small animals and fruit.
He survived as party leader until his second election defeat.

senses.definition_vi: tiếp tục sống hoặc tồn tại

senses.definition: to continue to live or exist despite a dangerous event or time

examples.x: Her 5-year-old son miraculously survived the crash.
He only survived the attack because he was wearing body armour.
Many birds didn't survive the severe winter.
The company managed to survive the crisis.
Few buildings survived the war intact.

senses.definition_vi: tiếp tục sống hoặc tồn tại bất chấp một sự kiện hoặc thời gian nguy hiểm

senses.definition: to live or exist longer than somebody/something

examples.x: She survived her husband by ten years.
He is survived by his wife and two sons (= he has just died but they are still alive).

senses.definition_vi: sống hoặc tồn tại lâu hơn ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: a person who continues to live, especially despite being nearly killed or experiencing great danger or difficulty

examples.x: the sole/only survivor of the massacre
The plane crashed in an area of dense jungle. There were no survivors.
There are only a few survivors from the original team (= members who remain in it while others have been replaced).
She'll cope. She's one of life's great survivors (= somebody who deals very well with difficult situations).
A movie has been made about the last remaining survivor of the tribe.

senses.definition_vi: một người tiếp tục sống, đặc biệt là bất chấp việc suýt chết hoặc trải qua nguy hiểm hoặc khó khăn lớn

senses.definition: a person who is suspected of a crime or of having done something wrong

examples.x: a murder suspect
He is the prime suspect in the case.
Five suspects have been detained for questioning.
Do you have a list of likely suspects?

senses.definition_vi: có ý tưởng rằng điều gì đó có thể đúng hoặc có khả năng xảy ra, đặc biệt là điều gì đó tồi tệ, nhưng không có bằng chứng xác định

senses.definition: the people you would usually expect to do something or be included in something

examples.x: She thanked all the usual suspects in her acceptance speech: her family, the director, the cast and the crew.

senses.definition_vi: có ý tưởng rằng điều gì đó có thể đúng hoặc có khả năng xảy ra, đặc biệt là điều gì đó tồi tệ, nhưng không có bằng chứng xác định

senses.definition: to hang something from something else

examples.x: A lamp was suspended from the ceiling.
Her body was found suspended by a rope.

examples.cf: be suspended by/on something from something
examples.x: A boat was suspended on wires from the rafters.

senses.definition_vi: treo một cái gì đó lên một cái gì đó khác

senses.definition: to officially stop something for a time; to prevent something from being active, used, etc. for a time

examples.x: Production has been suspended while safety checks are carried out.
The constitution was suspended as the fighting grew worse.
In the theatre we willingly suspend disbelief (= temporarily believe that the characters, etc. are real).

senses.definition_vi: chính thức dừng một cái gì đó trong một thời gian; ngăn một cái gì đó hoạt động, được sử dụng, v.v. trong một thời gian

senses.definition: to officially delay something; to arrange for something to happen later than planned

examples.x: The introduction of the new system has been suspended until next year.
to suspend judgement (= delay forming or expressing an opinion)

senses.definition_vi: chính thức trì hoãn một cái gì đó; sắp xếp để một cái gì đó xảy ra muộn hơn dự kiến

senses.definition: to officially prevent somebody from doing their job, going to school, etc. for a time, as a punishment or while a complaint against them is investigated

examples.x: The police officer was suspended while the complaint was investigated.
She was suspended from school for a week.

senses.definition_vi: chính thức ngăn cản ai đó làm công việc, đi học, v.v. trong một thời gian, như một hình phạt hoặc trong khi một khiếu nại chống lại họ đang được điều tra

senses.definition: to float in liquid or air without moving

examples.x: Small droplets are held suspended in the atmosphere.

senses.definition_vi: nổi trong chất lỏng hoặc không khí mà không di chuyển

senses.definition: the act of officially removing somebody from their job, school, team, etc. for a period of time, usually as a punishment

examples.x: suspension from school
The two players are appealing against their suspensions.

senses.definition_vi: hành động chính thức khai trừ ai đó khỏi công việc, trường học, đội, v.v. trong một khoảng thời gian, thường là một hình phạt

senses.definition: the act of delaying something for a period of time, until a decision has been taken

examples.x: These events have led to the suspension of talks.
Many movies require the viewer to engage in a willing suspension of disbelief.

senses.definition_vi: hành động trì hoãn một cái gì đó trong một khoảng thời gian, cho đến khi một quyết định được đưa ra

senses.definition: the system of springs, etc. by which a vehicle is supported on its wheels and that makes it more comfortable to ride in when the road surface is not even

examples.x: the front/rear suspension
The new model is fitted with computer-controlled suspension.

senses.definition_vi: hệ thống lò xo, v.v. mà nhờ đó một phương tiện được đỡ trên bánh xe của nó và làm cho nó thoải mái hơn khi đi lại khi mặt đường không bằng phẳng

senses.definition: a liquid with very small pieces of solid matter floating in it; the state of such a liquid

examples.x: The suspension was passed through a filter to separate out the solid particles.
The material carried in suspension by the tide is deposited on the shore.

senses.definition_vi: một chất lỏng với các hạt rắn rất nhỏ lơ lửng trong đó; trạng thái của một chất lỏng như vậy

senses.definition: a feeling that somebody has done something wrong, illegal or dishonest, even though you have no proof

examples.x: They drove away slowly to avoid arousing suspicion.
He was arrested on suspicion of murder.
I have a sneaking suspicion that she's not telling the truth.
My suspicions were confirmed when police raided the property.
She was reluctant to voice her suspicions.
His resignation seemed only to fuel suspicions.
It’s time to confront him with our suspicions.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác rằng ai đó đã làm điều gì đó sai trái, bất hợp pháp hoặc không trung thực, mặc dù bạn không có bằng chứng

senses.definition: a feeling or belief that something is true, even though you have no proof

examples.x: I have a horrible suspicion that we've come to the wrong station.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác hoặc niềm tin rằng điều gì đó là đúng, mặc dù bạn không có bằng chứng

senses.definition: the feeling that you cannot trust somebody/something

examples.x: Their offer was greeted with some suspicion.
Water from shallow wells should be regarded with suspicion, as it may be contaminated.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác rằng bạn không thể tin tưởng ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: a small amount of something

examples.x: His mouth quivered in the suspicion of a smile.
Wasn’t there even a suspicion of truth in what he said?

senses.definition_vi: một lượng nhỏ của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: too good, honest, etc. to have done something wrong, illegal or dishonest

examples.x: Nobody who was near the scene of the crime is above suspicion.
They thought the head teacher was beyond suspicion.

senses.definition_vi: quá tốt, trung thực, v.v. để đã làm điều gì đó sai trái, bất hợp pháp hoặc không trung thực

senses.definition: if the finger of blame/suspicion points or is pointed at somebody, they are suspected of having committed a crime, being responsible for something, etc.

examples.x: The inquiry pointed the finger of blame at the driver of the crashed coach.
The finger of suspicion was pointed at the chicken served for lunch.

senses.definition_vi: nếu ngón tay đổ lỗi/nghi ngờ chỉ vào ai đó, họ bị nghi ngờ đã phạm tội, chịu trách nhiệm về điều gì đó, v.v.

senses.definition: suspected of doing something wrong, illegal or dishonest

examples.x: The whole family is currently under suspicion of her murder.
A number of doctors came under suspicion of unethical behaviour.

senses.definition_vi: gắn một nhãn lên một cái gì đó/ai đó

senses.definition_vi: gắn một nhãn lên một cái gì đó/ai đó

The male has beautiful tail feathers.
It was black from its nose to the tip of its tail.

senses.definition_vi: phần nhô ra ở phía sau cơ thể của chim, động vật hoặc cá, mà động vật có thể di chuyển sang hai bên hoặc lên xuống

senses.definition_vi: phần phía sau của máy bay, tàu vũ trụ, v.v.

senses.definition_vi: một phần của cái gì đó nhô ra ở phía sau giống như một cái đuôi

the truck at the tail of our convoy

senses.definition_vi: phần cuối cùng của một cái gì đó đang di chuyển ra xa bạn

senses.definition: a person who is sent to follow somebody secretly and find out information about where that person goes, what they do, etc.

examples.x: The police have put a tail on him.

senses.definition_vi: một người được cử đi theo dõi ai đó một cách bí mật và tìm hiểu thông tin về nơi người đó đi, những gì họ làm, v.v.

senses.definition: to be unable to understand something

examples.x: I couldn't make head nor tail of what he was saying.

senses.definition_vi: không thể hiểu điều gì đó

senses.definition: to be very busy but in fact achieve very little
senses.definition_vi: rất bận rộn nhưng thực tế lại đạt được rất ít

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để hỏi ai đó nghĩ mặt nào của đồng xu sẽ hướng lên trên khi tung để quyết định điều gì đó bằng may rủi

senses.definition: if cars, etc. are nose to tail, they are moving slowly in a long line with little space between them

examples.x: The traffic was nose to tail for miles.

senses.definition_vi: nếu ô tô, v.v. đi nối đuôi nhau, chúng đang di chuyển chậm thành một hàng dài với khoảng cách nhỏ giữa chúng

senses.definition: following behind somebody very closely, especially in a car

examples.x: There’s been a white van sitting on my tail for the past ten miles.

senses.definition_vi: đi theo sát phía sau ai đó, đặc biệt là bằng ô tô

senses.definition: an unpleasant feature that comes at the end of a story, an event, etc. and makes it less good, successful, etc.
senses.definition_vi: một đặc điểm khó chịu xuất hiện ở cuối một câu chuyện, một sự kiện, v.v. và làm cho nó kém hay, thành công, v.v.

senses.definition: used to describe a situation in which the most important aspect is being influenced and controlled by somebody/something that is not as important
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để mô tả một tình huống mà khía cạnh quan trọng nhất bị ảnh hưởng và kiểm soát bởi ai đó/điều gì đó không quan trọng bằng

senses.definition: to run away from a fight or dangerous situation

examples.x: When they heard the sirens, they turned tail and ran.

senses.definition_vi: chạy trốn khỏi một cuộc chiến hoặc tình huống nguy hiểm

examples.x: Remember to take your coat when you leave.

Shall I take my host family a gift?

senses.definition_vi: mang hoặc di chuyển cái gì đó từ nơi này đến nơi khác

senses.definition: to go with somebody from one place to another, especially to guide or lead them

examples.x: It's too far to walk—I'll take you by car.
A boy took us to our room.
I'm taking the kids swimming later.
The boys were taken to see their grandparents most weekends.

senses.definition_vi: đi cùng ai đó từ nơi này đến nơi khác, đặc biệt là để hướng dẫn hoặc dẫn dắt họ

senses.definition: to make somebody/something go from one level, situation, etc. to another

examples.x: Her energy and talent took her to the top of her profession.
The new loan takes the total debt to $100 000.
I'd like to take my argument a stage further.
He believes he has the skills to take the club forward.
We'll take the matter forward at our next meeting (= discuss it further).

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó/điều gì đó thay đổi từ cấp độ, tình huống, v.v. này sang cấp độ, tình huống, v.v. khác

senses.definition: to need or require a particular amount of time

examples.x: The process took about a year.
The journey to the airport takes about half an hour.

That cut is taking a long time to heal.
The official seemed to take hours to examine my passport.
That should only take you ten minutes.

examples.cf: take somebody something to do something
examples.x: It took her three hours to repair her bike.
It'll take her time to recover from the illness.

examples.cf: take something for somebody to do something
examples.x: It'll take time (= take a long time) for her to recover from the illness.
I need a shower—I won't take long.

senses.definition_vi: cần hoặc đòi hỏi một lượng thời gian nhất định

senses.definition: to photograph somebody/something

examples.x: to take a picture/photo/shot of somebody/something
to have your picture/photo taken

senses.definition_vi: chụp ảnh ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to use a form of transport, a road, a path, etc. to go to a place

examples.x: to take the bus/train
to take a cab/plane

It's more interesting to take the coast road.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng một phương tiện giao thông, một con đường, một lối đi, v.v. để đi đến một địa điểm

senses.definition_vi: đặt tay hoặc cánh tay của bạn quanh ai đó/điều gì đó và giữ họ/nó; vươn tới ai đó/điều gì đó và giữ họ/nó

The sign must be taken down.
He took some keys out of his pocket.

The machine takes its name from its inventor.

senses.definition_vi: lấy cái gì đó từ một nguồn cụ thể

senses.definition_vi: ngồi vào hoặc sử dụng một chiếc ghế, v.v.

The doctor has given me some medicine to take for my cough.

senses.definition_vi: ăn, uống, v.v. cái gì đó

examples.x: The police officer took my name and address.

senses.definition_vi: làm một kỳ thi hoặc một bài kiểm tra

examples.x: She is planning to take a course in web design.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng một phương pháp hành động cụ thể để giải quyết hoặc đạt được điều gì đó

examples.x: to take a look
to take a break
to take a shot at somebody/something
to take a step/walk/stroll
to take a bath/shower/wash
to take a bite/drink/sip
to take a deep breath

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với danh từ để nói rằng ai đó đang làm điều gì đó, thực hiện một hành động, v.v.

senses.definition_vi: kiểm tra hoặc đo lường điều gì đó

senses.definition_vi: chiếm lấy một địa điểm hoặc người; giành quyền kiểm soát điều gì đó

senses.definition_vi: chọn, mua hoặc thuê cái gì đó

senses.definition_vi: mua một tờ báo hoặc tạp chí thường xuyên

examples.x: If they offer me the job, I'll take it.

If you take my advice you'll have nothing more to do with him.
Will you take $10 for the book (= will you sell it for $10)?

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận hoặc nhận cái gì đó

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận ai đó làm khách hàng, bệnh nhân, v.v.

I find his attitude a little hard to take.

senses.definition_vi: có thể chịu đựng điều gì đó

senses.definition_vi: phản ứng với điều gì đó/ai đó theo một cách cụ thể

senses.definition_vi: lấy một số trừ đi giá trị của một số khác

The home side had a chance to take the lead.

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc bắt đầu có một hình thức, vị trí hoặc trạng thái cụ thể

examples.x: It only takes one careless driver to cause an accident.
It doesn't take much to make her angry.
He didn't take much persuading (= he was easily persuaded).

senses.definition_vi: cần hoặc đòi hỏi một cái gì đó để xảy ra hoặc được thực hiện

senses.definition: to use something in order to work

examples.x: The buses have been adapted to take biofuel.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng một cái gì đó để làm việc

senses.definition: to wear a particular size in shoes or clothes

examples.x: What size shoes do you take?

senses.definition_vi: mặc một cỡ giày hoặc quần áo nhất định

senses.definition: to have enough space for something/somebody; to be able to hold or contain a particular quantity

examples.x: The bus can take 60 passengers.
The tank takes 50 litres.

senses.definition_vi: có đủ không gian cho cái gì đó/ai đó; có thể chứa hoặc đựng một số lượng nhất định

senses.definition: to be the teacher or leader in a class or a religious service

examples.x: The head teacher usually takes us for French.
Mr Perkins took the morning service.

senses.definition_vi: là giáo viên hoặc người lãnh đạo trong một lớp học hoặc một buổi lễ tôn giáo

senses.definition: to go over or around something

examples.x: The horse took the first fence well.
He takes bends much too fast.

senses.definition_vi: đi qua hoặc vòng quanh một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to kick or throw the ball from a fixed or agreed position

examples.x: to take a penalty/free kick/corner

senses.definition_vi: đá hoặc ném bóng từ một vị trí cố định hoặc đã thỏa thuận

senses.definition: to use a particular method to find out people’s opinions

examples.x: to take a vote/poll/survey

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng một phương pháp cụ thể để tìm hiểu ý kiến của mọi người

senses.definition: to be successful; to work

examples.x: The skin graft failed to take.

senses.definition_vi: thành công; hoạt động tốt

senses.definition: to have or require something when used in a sentence or other structure

examples.x: The verb ‘rely’ takes the preposition ‘on’.

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc yêu cầu một cái gì đó khi được sử dụng trong một câu hoặc cấu trúc khác

senses.definition: used to say that you do not care if somebody accepts or rejects your offer
senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng bạn không quan tâm liệu ai đó có chấp nhận hay từ chối lời đề nghị của bạn hay không

senses.definition: used to say that somebody does not have a strong opinion about something

examples.x: Dancing? I can take it or leave it.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng ai đó không có ý kiến mạnh mẽ về một điều gì đó

senses.definition: to have the qualities, ability, etc. needed to be successful
senses.definition_vi: có những phẩm chất, khả năng, v.v. cần thiết để thành công

senses.definition: used to say that you cannot trust somebody to behave well in public

examples.x: You haven’t spilled your coffee again! I can’t take you anywhere!

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng bạn không thể tin tưởng ai đó sẽ cư xử tốt ở nơi công cộng

senses.definition: to accept something/somebody without wishing it/them to be different or without thinking about it/them very much in advance

examples.x: She takes life as it comes.

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận một cái gì đó/ai đó mà không mong muốn nó/họ khác đi hoặc mà không suy nghĩ về nó/họ nhiều trước

senses.definition: to suppose; to assume

examples.x: I take it you won't be coming to the party?

senses.definition_vi: giả sử; cho rằng

senses.definition: used to emphasize that what you are going to say is the truth

examples.x: Take it from me—he'll be a millionaire before he's 30.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng điều bạn sắp nói là sự thật

senses.definition: to make somebody physically or mentally tired

examples.x: Looking after small children really takes it out of you.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó mệt mỏi về thể chất hoặc tinh thần

senses.definition: to decide to do something without asking permission or advice
senses.definition_vi: quyết định làm điều gì đó mà không xin phép hoặc lời khuyên

senses.definition: to need a lot of effort or time; to be very difficult to do
senses.definition_vi: cần nhiều nỗ lực hoặc thời gian; rất khó để thực hiện

senses.definition: used as an exclamation when you are hitting somebody or attacking them in some other way
senses.definition_vi: được dùng như một tiếng kêu khi bạn đánh ai đó hoặc tấn công họ theo cách khác

senses.definition: a story created using the imagination, especially one that is full of action and adventure

examples.x: a coming-of-age/morality tale

senses.definition_vi: thước đo mức độ nóng của cơ thể ai đó

senses.definition: to increase/decrease the amount of excitement, emotion, etc. in a situation

examples.x: His angry refusal to agree raised the temperature of the meeting.
The government tried to lower the political temperature by agreeing to some of the demands.

senses.definition_vi: tăng/giảm mức độ hứng thú, cảm xúc, v.v. trong một tình huống

senses.definition: a building used for religious worship, especially in religions other than Christianity

examples.x: the Temple of Diana at Ephesus
a Buddhist/Hindu/Sikh temple
to go to temple (= to a service in a synagogue, where Jewish people worship)

senses.definition_vi: một tòa nhà dùng để thờ cúng tôn giáo, đặc biệt là trong các tôn giáo khác ngoài Cơ đốc giáo

senses.definition: each of the flat parts at the sides of the head, at the same level as the eyes and higher

examples.x: He had black hair, greying at the temples.
There was a throbbing in her temples.

senses.definition_vi: phần phẳng ở hai bên đầu, ngang tầm mắt và cao hơn

senses.definition: in a way that lasts or is intended to last or be used only for a short time; in a way that is not permanent

examples.x: We regret this service is temporarily unavailable.
The company announced that it would be temporarily closing the factory because of the global downturn.

senses.definition_vi: trong một khoảng thời gian hoặc dự định chỉ dùng trong một thời gian ngắn; không vĩnh viễn

senses.definition: lasting or intended to last or be used only for a short time; not permanent

examples.x: to hire temporary workers
They had to move into temporary accommodation.
Volunteers built temporary shelters for the survivors.
temporary relief from pain
a temporary fix/measure/solution
More than half the staff are temporary.

senses.definition_vi: kéo dài hoặc dự định chỉ dùng trong một thời gian ngắn; không vĩnh viễn

senses.definition: to attract somebody or make somebody want to do or have something, even if they know it is wrong

examples.x: I was tempted by the dessert menu.
Don't tempt thieves by leaving valuables clearly visible.
He was tempted into a life of crime.
I was tempted to take the day off.

senses.definition_vi: thu hút ai đó hoặc làm cho ai đó muốn có hoặc làm điều gì đó, ngay cả khi họ biết điều đó là sai

senses.definition: to persuade or try to persuade somebody to do something that you want them to do, for example by offering them something

examples.x: How can we tempt young people into engineering?
Nothing would tempt me to live here.

senses.definition_vi: thuyết phục hoặc cố gắng thuyết phục ai đó làm điều bạn muốn họ làm, ví dụ bằng cách đưa cho họ thứ gì đó

senses.definition: to do something too confidently in a way that might mean that your good luck will come to an end

examples.x: She felt it would be tempting fate to try the difficult climb a second time.
It would be tempting fate to say that we will definitely win the game.

senses.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó quá tự tin theo cách có thể khiến vận may của bạn kết thúc

examples.x: There are only ten of these rare animals left.
ten of Sweden’s top financial experts
Twelve people were invited but only ten turned up.
Do you have change for ten dollars?
a ten-month contract
Look at page ten.
Ten and two is twelve.
Two tens are twenty.
I can't read your writing—is this meant to be a ten?
The bulbs are planted in sevens or tens (= groups of seven or ten).
We moved to America when I was ten (= ten years old).
Shall we meet at ten (= at ten o'clock), then?

senses.definition: used to say that somebody has guessed something correctly or done something very well

examples.x: Not brilliant, Robyn, but I'll give you ten out of ten for effort.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng ai đó đã đoán đúng điều gì đó hoặc đã làm điều gì đó rất tốt

senses.definition: very probably

examples.x: Ten to one he'll be late.

senses.definition_vi: rất có thể

senses.definition: very common and therefore not valuable

examples.x: Teachers of history are ten a penny.

senses.definition_vi: rất phổ biến và do đó không có giá trị

senses.definition: a person who pays rent for the use of a room, building, land, etc. to the person who owns it

examples.x: They had evicted their tenants for non-payment of rent.
The decorating was done by a previous tenant.
tenant farmers (= ones who do not own their own farms)

senses.definition_vi: một người trả tiền thuê để sử dụng một căn phòng, tòa nhà, đất đai, v.v. cho người sở hữu nó

senses.definition: to be likely to do something or to happen in a particular way because this is what often or usually happens

examples.x: Women tend to live longer than men.
People tend to be happier if they are in a long-term relationship.
When I'm tired, I tend to make mistakes.
It tends to get very cold here in the winter.
People tend to think that the problem will never affect them.
I tend to agree with many of the points you make.
I tend to focus on dance, but acting and singing are equally important to me.
Large class size will tend to increase the use of the lecture.

senses.definition_vi: có khả năng làm điều gì đó hoặc xảy ra theo một cách nhất định vì đây là điều thường xuyên hoặc thường xảy ra

senses.definition: to take a particular direction or often have a particular quality

examples.x: His views tend towards the extreme.
Prices have tended downwards over recent years.

senses.definition_vi: có một hướng đi cụ thể hoặc thường có một phẩm chất nhất định

senses.definition: to care for somebody/something

examples.x: a shepherd tending his sheep
Doctors and nurses tended the injured.
well-tended gardens
Ambulance crews were tending to the injured.

senses.definition_vi: chăm sóc ai đó/thứ gì đó

senses.definition: to serve customers in a store, bar, etc.

examples.x: He had a job tending bar in San Francisco.

senses.definition_vi: phục vụ khách hàng trong cửa hàng, quán bar, v.v.

senses.definition: if somebody/something has a particular tendency, they are likely to behave or act in a particular way

examples.x: to display artistic tendencies
I have a tendency to talk too much when I'm nervous.
This material has a tendency to shrink when washed.

examples.cf: tendency for somebody/something to do something
examples.x: There is a tendency for this disease to run in families.
She has a strong natural tendency towards caution.

senses.definition_vi: nếu ai đó/thứ gì đó có một xu hướng nhất định, họ có khả năng hành xử hoặc hành động theo một cách nhất định

senses.definition: a new custom that is starting to develop

examples.x: There's a growing tendency for women to marry later.
Industry showed a tendency towards increasingly centralized administration.

senses.definition_vi: một phong tục mới đang bắt đầu phát triển

senses.definition: a group within a larger political group, whose views are more extreme than those of the rest of the group

examples.x: a growing separatist tendency within the Anglo-Irish community

senses.definition_vi: một nhóm trong một nhóm chính trị lớn hơn, có quan điểm cực đoan hơn so với phần còn lại của nhóm

senses.definition: kind, gentle and loving

examples.x: tender words
What he needs now is a lot of tender loving care (= sympathetic treatment).

senses.definition_vi: tử tế, dịu dàng và yêu thương

senses.definition: easy to bite through and cut

examples.x: This meat is extremely tender.
Boil the beans until they are tender.
four large slices of tender chicken

senses.definition_vi: dễ dàng cắn và cắt

senses.definition: painful when you touch it

examples.x: My leg is still very tender where I banged it.
The back of my neck feels very tender.

senses.definition_vi: đau khi bạn chạm vào nó

senses.definition: easily hurt or damaged

examples.x: tender young plants

senses.definition_vi: dễ bị tổn thương hoặc hư hại

senses.definition: used in connection with somebody who is still young and does not have much experience

examples.x: He left home at the tender age of 15.
She shouldn't be having to deal with problems like this at such a tender age.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ai đó còn trẻ và chưa có nhiều kinh nghiệm

senses.definition: a game in which two or four players use rackets to hit a ball backwards and forwards across a net on a specially marked court

examples.x: to play tennis
a tennis player/court/ball
I met a friend for a quick game of tennis after work.
a tennis match/tournament
She is a popular figure on the international tennis circuit.
He retired from competitive tennis at the age of 34.

senses.definition_vi: một trò chơi trong đó hai hoặc bốn người chơi sử dụng vợt để đánh bóng qua lại qua lưới trên một sân được đánh dấu đặc biệt

senses.definition: a situation in which people do not trust each other, or feel unfriendly towards each other, and that may cause them to attack each other

examples.x: There is mounting tension along the border.
international/racial/political tensions
Family tensions and conflicts may lead to violence.
The incident has further increased tension between the two countries.

senses.definition_vi: một tình huống mà mọi người không tin tưởng lẫn nhau, hoặc cảm thấy không thân thiện với nhau, và điều đó có thể khiến họ tấn công lẫn nhau

senses.definition: a situation in which the fact that there are different needs or interests causes difficulties

examples.x: There is often a tension between the aims of the company and the wishes of the employees.

senses.definition_vi: một tình huống mà sự tồn tại của các nhu cầu hoặc lợi ích khác nhau gây ra khó khăn

senses.definition: a feeling of worry and stress that makes it impossible to relax

examples.x: nervous tension
We laughed and that helped ease the tension.
Walking and swimming are excellent for releasing tension.
a tension headache

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác lo lắng và căng thẳng khiến bạn không thể thư giãn

senses.definition: the feeling of fear and excitement that is created by a writer or a film director

examples.x: dramatic tension
As the movie progresses the tension builds.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác sợ hãi và phấn khích được tạo ra bởi một nhà văn hoặc đạo diễn phim

senses.definition: the state of being stretched tight; the extent to which something is stretched tight

examples.x: muscular tension
Adjust the string tension of your tennis racket to suit your style of playing.
When knitting, try to keep the same tension throughout.
Massage can relieve tension in your shoulders and back.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái bị kéo căng; mức độ mà một thứ gì đó bị kéo căng

senses.definition: a shelter made of a large sheet of canvas, nylon, etc. that is supported by poles and ropes fixed to the ground, and is used especially for camping

examples.x: to put up/take down a tent
to pitch (= put up) a tent
Food will be served in the hospitality tent (= for example at an outdoor show).
Everyone was sleeping outside in tents.

senses.definition_vi: một nơi trú ẩn được làm bằng một tấm vải bạt lớn, nylon, v.v. được đỡ bởi các cột và dây thừng cố định xuống đất, và đặc biệt được sử dụng để cắm trại

senses.definition: the period of time when somebody holds an important job, especially a political one; the act of holding an important job

examples.x: his four-year tenure as president
She had a long tenure of office.

senses.definition_vi: khoảng thời gian mà ai đó giữ một chức vụ quan trọng, đặc biệt là chức vụ chính trị; hành động giữ một chức vụ quan trọng

senses.definition: the right to stay permanently in your job, especially as a teacher at a university

examples.x: It's still extremely difficult to get tenure.
She has been granted tenure at Leeds University.

senses.definition_vi: quyền được giữ công việc của bạn vĩnh viễn, đặc biệt là giáo viên đại học

senses.definition: the legal right to live in a house or use a piece of land

examples.x: When you rent a house here, you don’t have security of tenure.

senses.definition_vi: quyền pháp lý để sống trong một ngôi nhà hoặc sử dụng một mảnh đất

senses.definition: a word or phrase used as the name of something, especially one connected with a particular type of language

examples.x: a technical/legal/generic term
a glossary of terms
a term of abuse
What is the meaning of the term ‘globalization’?
William Gibson coined the term (= invented the term) ‘cyberspace’ in 1984.
‘Old man’ is a slang term for ‘father’.
The term ‘Generation X’ refers to the people born in the 1950s and 1960s.
‘Register’ is the term commonly used to describe different levels of formality in language.
I would describe myself, for want of a better term, as a nerd.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng một tên hoặc từ cụ thể để mô tả ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: (especially in the UK) one of the three periods in the year during which classes are held in schools, universities, etc.

examples.x: the spring/summer/autumn/fall term
Many students now have paid employment during term.
It's nearly the end of term.
It's nearly the end of the term.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng một tên hoặc từ cụ thể để mô tả ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: a period of time for which something lasts; a fixed or limited time

examples.x: during the president’s first term of/in office
a term as president/mayor/governor/prime minister
He was sentenced to a prison/jail term of 25 years for the offence.
She served a five-year term of imprisonment.
The contract was for a fixed term of five years.
to extend the term of a loan
His presidential term expires at the end of May.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng một tên hoặc từ cụ thể để mô tả ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: the end of a particular period of time, especially one for which something is expected to last

examples.x: His life had reached its natural term.
This view of the economy is approaching its term (= it will soon be old-fashioned).
The pregnancy went to full term (= lasted the normal length of time).
Her baby was born at term.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng một tên hoặc từ cụ thể để mô tả ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: each of the various parts in a series, an equation, etc.
senses.definition_vi: sử dụng một tên hoặc từ cụ thể để mô tả ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: used to describe what will happen a long, short, etc. time in the future

examples.x: Such a development seems unlikely, at least in the short term (= it will not happen for quite a long time).
In the longer term, children of depressed mothers are more likely to suffer from childhood depression.
In the long term, our efforts will pay off.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng một tên hoặc từ cụ thể để mô tả ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: that cannot be cured and will lead to death, often slowly

examples.x: He has terminal lung cancer.
The illness is usually terminal.
She's suffering from terminal (= very great) boredom.

senses.definition_vi: một tòa nhà hoặc một cụm tòa nhà tại sân bay nơi hành khách đến và đi

senses.definition: suffering from an illness that cannot be cured and will lead to death

examples.x: a terminal patient

senses.definition_vi: một tòa nhà hoặc một cụm tòa nhà tại sân bay nơi hành khách đến và đi

senses.definition: certain to get worse and come to an end

examples.x: The industry is in terminal decline.

senses.definition_vi: một tòa nhà hoặc một cụm tòa nhà tại sân bay nơi hành khách đến và đi

senses.definition: at the end of something

examples.x: a terminal branch of a tree
terminal examinations (= at the end of a course, etc.)

senses.definition_vi: một tòa nhà hoặc một cụm tòa nhà tại sân bay nơi hành khách đến và đi

senses.definition: to end; to make something end

examples.x: Your contract of employment terminates in December.
The agreement was terminated immediately.
to terminate a pregnancy (= to perform or have an abortion)

senses.definition_vi: kết thúc; làm cho một cái gì đó kết thúc

senses.definition: to end a journey

examples.x: This train terminates at London Victoria.

senses.definition_vi: kết thúc một chuyến đi

senses.definition: the conditions that people offer, demand or accept when they make an agreement, an arrangement or a contract

examples.x: peace terms
They failed to agree on the terms of a settlement.
These are the terms and conditions of your employment.
Under the terms of the agreement, their funding of the project will continue until 2025.
We are negotiating terms for the development of the site.

senses.definition_vi: các điều kiện mà mọi người đưa ra, yêu cầu hoặc chấp nhận khi họ đưa ra một thỏa thuận, một sự sắp xếp hoặc một hợp đồng

senses.definition: conditions that you agree to when you buy, sell, or pay for something; a price or cost

examples.x: to buy something on easy terms (= paying for it over a long period)
My terms are £20 a lesson.

senses.definition_vi: các điều kiện mà bạn đồng ý khi mua, bán hoặc thanh toán cho một thứ gì đó; một mức giá hoặc chi phí

senses.definition: a way of expressing yourself or of saying something

examples.x: We wish to protest in the strongest possible terms (= to say we are very angry).
I'll try to explain in simple terms.
The letter was brief, and couched in very polite terms.
She spoke of you in glowing terms (= expressing her admiration of you).

senses.definition_vi: một cách để diễn đạt bản thân hoặc để nói một điều gì đó

senses.definition: to have a good, friendly, etc. relationship with somebody

examples.x: I had no idea that you and he were on such intimate terms (= were such close friends).
He is still on excellent terms with his ex-wife.
I'm on first-name terms with my boss now (= we call each other by our first names).

senses.definition_vi: có mối quan hệ tốt, thân thiện, v.v. với ai đó

senses.definition: to be willing to be polite or friendly towards somebody, especially after an argument

examples.x: She's not been on speaking terms with her uncle for years.
Are they speaking to each other again yet?

senses.definition_vi: sẵn lòng lịch sự hoặc thân thiện với ai đó, đặc biệt là sau một cuộc tranh cãi

senses.definition: to reach an agreement with somebody; to find a way of living or working together

examples.x: The enemy was eventually forced to come to terms.

senses.definition_vi: đạt được thỏa thuận với ai đó; tìm ra cách sống hoặc làm việc cùng nhau

senses.definition: to accept something unpleasant by learning to deal with it

examples.x: She is still coming to terms with her son's death.

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận một điều gì đó khó chịu bằng cách học cách đối phó với nó

senses.definition: a statement containing two words that contradict each other’s meaning

examples.x: A ‘nomad settlement’ is a contradiction in terms.
The idea is almost a contradiction in terms.

senses.definition_vi: một câu nói chứa hai từ mâu thuẫn với ý nghĩa của nhau

senses.definition: clearly and strongly

examples.x: I told him what I thought of him in no uncertain terms.

senses.definition_vi: rõ ràng và mạnh mẽ

senses.definition: used to show what aspect of a subject you are talking about or how you are thinking about it

examples.x: The job is great in terms of salary, but it has its disadvantages.
This title ranks alongside the Olympics in terms of importance.
What does this mean in terms of cost?
In terms of cost—how much were you thinking of charging?
In terms of extra staff—how many will we need?
In practical terms this law may be difficult to enforce.
The decision was disastrous in political terms.
He's talking in terms of starting a completely new career.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho biết khía cạnh nào của một chủ đề bạn đang nói đến hoặc cách bạn đang suy nghĩ về nó

senses.definition: having the same advantages and disadvantages as somebody else

examples.x: Can our industry compete on equal terms with its overseas rivals?

senses.definition_vi: có những lợi thế và bất lợi giống như người khác

senses.definition: according to the conditions that you or somebody else decides

examples.x: I'll only take the job on my own terms.
I'm not doing it on your terms.

senses.definition_vi: theo các điều kiện mà bạn hoặc người khác quyết định

senses.definition: used to refer to an area of land when you are mentioning its natural features, for example, if it is rough, flat, etc.

examples.x: difficult/rough/mountainous terrain
They walked for miles across steep and inhospitable terrain.
