I didn't think people were allowed to park here.
Am I right in thinking that you used to live here?
I think this is their house, but I'm not sure.
He ought to resign, I think.
That's my opinion, but you might think otherwise (= have a different opinion).
We'll need about 20 chairs, I should think.
I can't help thinking (that) things could have been different.
It was once thought that the sun travelled around the earth.
Well, I like it. What do you think?
What did you think about the idea?
What did you think of the film?
‘Is he any good?’ ‘I don't think so.’
‘Will we make it in time?’ ‘I think so.’
I think it highly unlikely that I'll get the job.
She thought him kind and generous.
It was better than I thought possible.
I thought it a good idea to go with him.
He's thought to be one of the richest men in Europe.
I think of this place as my home.
She is thought of as a possible director.

senses.definition_vi: có một ý tưởng hoặc ý kiến cụ thể về điều gì đó/ai đó; tin vào điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to use your mind to consider something, to form connected ideas, to try to solve problems, etc.

examples.x: Are animals able to think?
Let me think (= give me time before I answer).
Stop and think for a moment before making any decisions.
I'm sorry, I wasn't thinking (= said when you have upset or offended somebody accidentally).
I can't tell you now—I'll have to think about it.
The government needs to think carefully about the issues raised.
All he ever thinks about is money.
He was trying to think what to do.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng tâm trí của bạn để xem xét một điều gì đó, hình thành các ý tưởng liên kết, cố gắng giải quyết vấn đề, v.v.

senses.definition: to have ideas, words or images in your mind

examples.x: You're very quiet. What are you thinking?
I was just thinking what a long way it is.
‘I must be crazy,’ she thought.
‘What can I do now?’ he thought frantically.

senses.definition_vi: có những ý tưởng, từ ngữ hoặc hình ảnh trong tâm trí.

senses.definition: to form an idea of something; to imagine something

examples.x: We couldn't think where you'd gone.
Just think how nice it would be to see them again.
I hate to think what would have happened if we hadn't arrived.
I like to think (that) he would help if I needed it.
I can’t think (that) he would be so stupid.
If I'm home late, my mother always thinks the worst.
Just think—we'll be lying on the beach this time tomorrow.
Try to think yourself into the role.

senses.definition_vi: hình thành một ý tưởng về điều gì đó; tưởng tượng một điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to expect something

examples.x: I never thought (that) I’d see her again.
The job took longer than we thought.
You'd think she'd have been grateful for my help (= but she wasn't).
I never thought you would carry out your threat.
Who would have thought to find you here?

senses.definition_vi: mong đợi một điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to think in a particular way or on a particular subject

examples.x: Let's think positive.
You need to think big (= aim to achieve a lot).
If you want to make money, you've got to think money.

senses.definition_vi: suy nghĩ theo một cách cụ thể hoặc về một chủ đề cụ thể.

senses.definition: used in questions to show that you are angry or surprised

examples.x: What do you think you're doing?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong câu hỏi để thể hiện sự tức giận hoặc ngạc nhiên của bạn.

senses.definition: used to make something you say sound less definite or more polite

examples.x: I thought we could go out tonight.
Twenty guests are enough, I would have thought.
Do you think you could open the window?
‘You've made a mistake.’ ‘I don't think so.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để làm cho điều gì đó bạn nói nghe bớt dứt khoát hơn hoặc lịch sự hơn.

senses.definition: to intend something; to have a plan about something

examples.x: I think I'll go for a swim.
I'm thinking in terms of about 70 guests at the wedding.

senses.definition_vi: có ý định về điều gì đó; có một kế hoạch về điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to remember something; to have something come into your mind

examples.x: I didn't think (= it did not occur to me) to tell her.
I can't think where I put the keys.

senses.definition_vi: nhớ lại một điều gì đó; có một điều gì đó hiện lên trong tâm trí bạn.

senses.definition: to behave in a very confident way that annoys other people, for example by telling them what to do

examples.x: She was acting as if she owned the place.

senses.definition_vi: hành xử một cách rất tự tin khiến người khác khó chịu, ví dụ bằng cách nói cho họ biết phải làm gì.

senses.definition: used when you suddenly remember something or realize that it might be important

examples.x: Come to think of it, he did mention seeing you.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đột nhiên nhớ ra điều gì đó hoặc nhận ra rằng nó có thể quan trọng.

senses.definition: used to say that you and another person must both be very clever because you have had the same idea or agree about something
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn và một người khác phải rất thông minh vì cả hai đã có cùng ý tưởng hoặc đồng ý về điều gì đó.

senses.definition: used to say very strongly that you do not agree with something, or that something is not possible

examples.x: Me? Fail? I don't think so.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rất mạnh mẽ rằng bạn không đồng ý với điều gì đó, hoặc điều gì đó là không thể.

senses.definition: used to draw attention to a fact that is not obvious or has not previously been mentioned

examples.x: It was a difficult situation, when you think about it.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để thu hút sự chú ý vào một sự thật không rõ ràng hoặc chưa được đề cập trước đó.

senses.definition: used to say that you hope or believe that something is true

examples.x: I like to think I'm broad-minded.
I’d like to think that you were helping me because you wanted to, not because you felt you had to.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn hy vọng hoặc tin rằng điều gì đó là đúng.

senses.definition: that is what I expected or suspected

examples.x: ‘He said he'd forgotten.’ ‘I thought as much.’

senses.definition_vi: đó là những gì tôi mong đợi hoặc nghi ngờ.

senses.definition: used when you are thinking or trying to remember something

examples.x: Now let me see—where did he say he lived?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang suy nghĩ hoặc cố gắng nhớ lại một điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to consider it right or acceptable to do something; to decide or choose to do something

examples.x: You must do as you think fit (= but I don't agree with your decision).
The newspaper did not see fit to publish my letter (= and I criticize it for that).

senses.definition_vi: coi là đúng hoặc chấp nhận được khi làm một điều gì đó; quyết định hoặc chọn làm một điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to say or think bad things about somebody

examples.x: Don't speak ill of the dead.

senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc nghĩ những điều tồi tệ về ai đó.

senses.definition: to consider a situation again and perhaps change your idea or intention

examples.x: You really should think again about that.

senses.definition_vi: xem xét lại một tình huống và có lẽ thay đổi ý tưởng hoặc ý định của bạn.

senses.definition: to say what your thoughts are as you have them
senses.definition_vi: nói ra những suy nghĩ của bạn khi bạn đang có chúng.

senses.definition: to have a higher opinion of somebody

examples.x: She has behaved appallingly—I must say I thought better of her.

senses.definition_vi: có ý kiến cao hơn về ai đó.

senses.definition: to decide not to do something after thinking further about it

examples.x: Rosie was about to protest but thought better of it.

senses.definition_vi: quyết định không làm một điều gì đó sau khi đã suy nghĩ thêm về nó.

senses.definition: to form your own opinions and make decisions without depending on others
senses.definition_vi: hình thành ý kiến của riêng bạn và đưa ra quyết định mà không phụ thuộc vào người khác.

senses.definition: to say or think bad things about somebody

examples.x: I wouldn't want them to think ill of me.

senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc nghĩ những điều tồi tệ về ai đó.

senses.definition: to consider an activity to be normal and not particularly unusual or difficult

examples.x: She thinks nothing of walking thirty miles a day.

senses.definition_vi: coi một hoạt động là bình thường và không đặc biệt khác thường hoặc khó khăn.

senses.definition: used as a polite response when somebody has said sorry to you or thanked you
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng như một phản hồi lịch sự khi ai đó đã xin lỗi bạn hoặc cảm ơn bạn.

senses.definition: to be able to think and react to things very quickly and effectively without any preparation
senses.definition_vi: có thể suy nghĩ và phản ứng với mọi thứ rất nhanh chóng và hiệu quả mà không cần chuẩn bị.

senses.definition: to think about something, or how to do something, in a way that is new, different or shows imagination
senses.definition_vi: suy nghĩ về một điều gì đó, hoặc cách làm một điều gì đó, theo một cách mới, khác biệt hoặc thể hiện sự sáng tạo.

senses.definition: to think in a clear or logical way

examples.x: The drugs were affecting her and she couldn't think straight.

senses.definition_vi: suy nghĩ một cách rõ ràng hoặc logic.

senses.definition: to think carefully before deciding to do something

examples.x: You should think twice about employing someone you've never met.

senses.definition_vi: suy nghĩ cẩn thận trước khi quyết định làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to have a very good, poor, etc. opinion of somebody/something

examples.x: He thinks the world of his daughter.
I don't think much of her idea.

senses.definition_vi: có một ý kiến rất tốt, rất tệ, v.v. về ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to show that you are surprised or shocked by something

examples.x: To think that my mother wrote all those books and I never knew!

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để thể hiện rằng bạn ngạc nhiên hoặc sốc về điều gì đó

senses.definition: the process of thinking about something

examples.x: I had to do some quick thinking.

He had some serious thinking to do.

senses.definition_vi: quá trình suy nghĩ về điều gì đó

senses.definition: ideas or opinions about something

senses.definition_vi: những ý tưởng hoặc ý kiến về điều gì đó

senses.definition_vi: theo ý kiến của tôi

needing or wanting to drink

examples.x: We were hungry and thirsty.
Digging is thirsty work (= makes you thirsty).
She felt suddenly very thirsty.
I was starting to get quite thirsty.
I'm really thirsty.

senses.definition_vi: cần hoặc muốn uống

senses.definition: having a strong desire for something

examples.x: He is thirsty for power.

senses.definition_vi: có một mong muốn mạnh mẽ về điều gì đó

senses.definition: dry; in need of water
senses.definition_vi: khô; cần nước

senses.definition: numbers, years or temperatures from 30 to 39

senses.definition: between the ages of 30 and 39

senses.definition: to this degree; so

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để chỉ một người, vật hoặc sự kiện cụ thể ở gần bạn, đặc biệt so với cái khác

senses.definition: done completely; with great attention to detail

senses.definition_vi: được thực hiện hoàn toàn; với sự chú ý cao đến chi tiết

senses.definition: doing things very carefully and with great attention to detail

examples.x: She's very thorough and conscientious.

senses.definition_vi: làm mọi việc rất cẩn thận và với sự chú ý cao đến chi tiết

senses.definition: used to emphasize how bad or annoying somebody/something is

examples.x: Everything was in a thorough mess.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh mức độ tệ hoặc khó chịu của ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: very much; completely

examples.x: We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves.
I'm thoroughly confused.
a thoroughly professional performance
I can thoroughly recommend it.
I felt thoroughly ashamed of myself.

senses.definition_vi: rất nhiều; hoàn toàn

senses.definition: completely and with great attention to detail

examples.x: Wash the fruit thoroughly before use.
The work had not been done very thoroughly.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn và với sự chú ý cao đến chi tiết

senses.definition: used especially at the end of a sentence or clause to add a fact or an opinion that makes the previous statement less strong or less important

examples.x: Our team lost. It was a good game though.
‘Have you ever been to Australia?’ ‘No. I'd like to, though.’
At first, it can all be a bit confusing. Don't worry though, my instructions page is here to help!
She wanted to talk to him. First, though, she had to talk to Clayton.

senses.definition_vi: mặc dù thực tế là

senses.definition: something that you think of or remember

examples.x: I couldn't bear the thought of waiting any longer.
The very thought of it makes me feel sick.
I don't like the thought of you walking home alone.
She was struck by the sudden thought that he might already have left.
Thank you for sharing your thoughts on this topic.
I'd like to hear your thoughts on the subject.
He shared his thoughts about the future of technology.
He shuddered at the thought of going to the dentist.
He often expresses his thoughts on social media.
I've just had a thought (= an idea).
Would Mark be able to help? It's just a thought.
‘Why don't you try the other key?’ ‘That's a thought!’
Just then a worrying thought came to me.
Suddenly a thought struck him—he didn't even know her name.
I must admit, the thought crossed my mind too.
Negative thoughts can be a symptom of depression.

senses.definition_vi: một điều gì đó bạn nghĩ ra hoặc nhớ lại

senses.definition: a person’s mind and all the ideas that they have in it when they are thinking

examples.x: This is the time of year when our thoughts turn to summer holidays.
You are always in my thoughts.

senses.definition_vi: tâm trí của một người và tất cả những ý tưởng mà họ có trong đó khi họ đang suy nghĩ

senses.definition: the act of thinking seriously and carefully about something

examples.x: I've given the matter careful thought.
We need to put some thought into how to solve this problem.
Not enough thought has gone into this essay.
They had acted rashly, without thought.

senses.definition_vi: hành động suy nghĩ nghiêm túc và cẩn thận về một điều gì đó

senses.definition: the power or process of thinking

examples.x: A good teacher encourages independence of thought.
She was lost in thought (= concentrating so much on her thoughts that she was not aware of her surroundings).

senses.definition_vi: khả năng hoặc quá trình suy nghĩ

senses.definition: a feeling of care or worry

examples.x: Spare a thought for those without enough to eat this winter.
Don't give it another thought (= to tell somebody not to worry after they have said they are sorry).
It's the thought that counts (= used to say that somebody has been very kind even if they have only done or given something small or unimportant).

senses.definition_vi: một cảm giác quan tâm hoặc lo lắng

senses.definition: an intention or a hope of doing something

examples.x: She had given up all thought of changing her job.
He acted with no thoughts of personal gain.

senses.definition_vi: một ý định hoặc một hy vọng làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: ideas in politics, science, etc. connected with a particular person, group or period of history

examples.x: feminist thought

senses.definition_vi: những ý tưởng trong chính trị, khoa học, v.v. liên quan đến một người, nhóm hoặc thời kỳ lịch sử cụ thể

senses.definition: to try to control your emotions and become calm

examples.x: I'm fine—I just need a minute to collect myself.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng kiểm soát cảm xúc của bạn và trở nên bình tĩnh

senses.definition: to prepare yourself mentally for something

examples.x: She paused to collect her thoughts before entering the interview room.

senses.definition_vi: chuẩn bị tinh thần cho một điều gì đó

senses.definition: an idea that makes you think seriously and carefully

examples.x: The programme certainly provides plenty of food for thought.

senses.definition_vi: một ý tưởng khiến bạn suy nghĩ nghiêm túc và cẩn thận

senses.definition: to make somebody think seriously about something or hesitate before doing something

examples.x: Popular resistance to the measures should give the government pause for thought.

senses.definition_vi: khiến ai đó suy nghĩ nghiêm túc về một điều gì đó hoặc do dự trước khi làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to change your opinion after thinking about something again

examples.x: You’re not having second thoughts about it, are you?

senses.definition_vi: thay đổi ý kiến của bạn sau khi suy nghĩ lại về một điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to say that you have changed your opinion

examples.x: I'll wait here. No, on second thoughts, I'll come with you.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn đã thay đổi ý kiến

senses.definition: used to ask somebody what they are thinking about
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để hỏi ai đó họ đang nghĩ gì

senses.definition: used to say that you find a suggestion unacceptable or that you hope that something will never happen

examples.x: Me get married? Perish the thought!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn thấy một đề xuất không thể chấp nhận được hoặc bạn hy vọng điều gì đó sẽ không bao giờ xảy ra

senses.definition: a way of thinking that a number of people share

examples.x: There are two schools of thought about how this illness should be treated.
He belongs to the school of thought that says that competition can be very stimulating for children.

senses.definition_vi: một cách suy nghĩ mà nhiều người chia sẻ

senses.definition: the connected series of thoughts that are in your head at a particular time

examples.x: The phone ringing interrupted my train of thought.
I lose my train of thought when there are distractions.

senses.definition_vi: chuỗi suy nghĩ liên kết có trong đầu bạn tại một thời điểm nhất định

senses.definition: we believe a thing because we want it to be true
senses.definition_vi: chúng ta tin một điều vì chúng ta muốn nó đúng

senses.definition: immediately; without stopping to think about something further

examples.x: He dived in after her without a second thought.
I accepted the offer without a second thought.

senses.definition_vi: ngay lập tức; không dừng lại để suy nghĩ thêm về điều gì đó

senses.definition: quiet, because you are thinking

examples.x: He looked thoughtful.
They sat in thoughtful silence.

senses.definition_vi: im lặng, vì bạn đang suy nghĩ

senses.definition: showing that you think about and care for other people

examples.x: The hotel manager was very kind and thoughtful.

examples.cf: it is thoughtful (of somebody) (to do something)
examples.x: It was very thoughtful of you to send the flowers.

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện rằng bạn nghĩ và quan tâm đến người khác

senses.definition: showing signs of careful thought

examples.x: a player who has a thoughtful approach to the game

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện dấu hiệu của sự suy nghĩ cẩn thận

senses.definition: a large number

examples.x: There were thousands of people there.

senses.definition_vi: một số lượng lớn

senses.definition: the numbers from 1 000 to 9 999

examples.x: The cost ran into the thousands.

senses.definition_vi: các số từ 1.000 đến 9.999

senses.definition: to be very successful

examples.x: He’s made another sale? He’s really batting a thousand!

senses.definition_vi: rất thành công

senses.definition: a thin string of cotton, wool, silk, etc. used for sewing or making cloth

examples.x: a needle and thread
a robe embroidered with gold thread
the delicate threads of a spider’s web
You've pulled a thread in your jumper.

senses.definition_vi: một sợi chỉ mỏng bằng bông, len, lụa, v.v. dùng để may hoặc làm vải

senses.definition: an idea or a feature that is part of something greater; an idea that connects the different parts of something

examples.x: A common thread runs through these discussions.
The author skilfully draws together the different threads of the plot.
I lost the thread of the argument (= I could no longer follow it).
The speaker lost his thread (= forgot what he wanted to say) halfway through the talk.

senses.definition_vi: một ý tưởng hoặc một đặc điểm là một phần của một cái gì đó lớn hơn; một ý tưởng kết nối các phần khác nhau của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a long, thin line of something

examples.x: A thread of light emerged from the keyhole.
a silvery thread of water
Thin threads of blood glittered on his forehead and cheeks.

senses.definition_vi: một dòng dài, mỏng của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a series of connected messages on email, social media, etc. that have been sent by different people
senses.definition_vi: một chuỗi các tin nhắn được kết nối trên email, mạng xã hội, v.v. đã được gửi bởi những người khác nhau

senses.definition: the raised line that runs around the length of a screw and that allows it to be fixed in place by twisting
senses.definition_vi: đường gờ chạy dọc theo chiều dài của vít và cho phép nó được cố định bằng cách xoay

senses.definition: clothes
senses.definition_vi: quần áo

senses.definition: to be in great danger
senses.definition_vi: gặp nguy hiểm lớn

senses.definition: to return to an earlier situation or way of life after a period doing something else
senses.definition_vi: quay trở lại một tình huống hoặc lối sống trước đó sau một thời gian làm việc khác

senses.definition: a statement in which you tell somebody that you will punish or harm them, especially if they do not do what you want

examples.x: to make threats against somebody
She is prepared to carry out her threat to resign.
She received death threats on social media.
a phony bomb threat
crimes involving violence or the threat of violence

senses.definition_vi: một tuyên bố trong đó bạn nói với ai đó rằng bạn sẽ trừng phạt hoặc làm hại họ, đặc biệt nếu họ không làm những gì bạn muốn

senses.definition: the possibility of trouble, danger or disaster

examples.x: These ancient woodlands are under threat from new road developments.
Many wild plants are under threat of extinction.
There is a real threat of war.
the threat of terrorism/violence/attack
the imminent/immediate/real/potential threat of something
With little access to clean drinking water and sanitation, the inhabitants face a constant threat of disease.
The forecast is for rain with the threat of thunderstorms.
At the end of the Cold War, the nuclear threat receded.
What can we do to counter this threat?

senses.definition_vi: khả năng xảy ra rắc rối, nguy hiểm hoặc thảm họa

senses.definition: a person or thing that is likely to cause trouble, danger, etc.

examples.x: Drugs pose a major threat to our society.
We're facing a very strong terrorist threat.
He is unlikely to be a threat to the Spanish player in the final.
The missiles present a clear threat to the security of the nation.
The magazine asked about the greatest threats to world peace.
a threat to health/life/safety
the threat from overfishing
Viruses and other internet security threats can look like valid files or photos.
Food insecurity represents a serious threat for humanity.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật có khả năng gây rắc rối, nguy hiểm, v.v.

senses.definition: to say that you will cause trouble, hurt somebody, etc. if you do not get what you want

examples.x: They broke my windows and threatened me.
People have even threatened his life.
The attacker threatened them with a gun.
He was threatened with dismissal if he continued to turn up late for work.
The threatened strike has been called off.
Students are threatening legal action.
The hijackers threatened to kill one passenger every hour if their demands were not met.
The bank is threatening to sue him.
They threatened that passengers would be killed.
‘I'm going to kill him!’ she threatened.

senses.definition_vi: nói rằng bạn sẽ gây rắc rối, làm tổn thương ai đó, v.v. nếu bạn không nhận được thứ bạn muốn

senses.definition: to seem likely to happen or cause something unpleasant

examples.x: A storm was threatening.
When war threatens, people act irrationally.
This dispute threatens to split the party.
The clouds threatened rain.
Many species are now threatened with extinction.
The theatre was threatened with closure.

senses.definition_vi: có vẻ sắp xảy ra hoặc gây ra điều gì đó khó chịu

senses.definition: to be a danger to something

examples.x: Pollution is threatening marine life.
to threaten national security
They are not currently an endangered or threatened species.

senses.definition_vi: là một mối nguy hiểm cho cái gì đó

examples.x: There are only three cookies left.
three of Sweden’s top financial experts
Ten people were invited but only three turned up.
Can you lend me three dollars?
a three-month contract
Look at page three.
Three and four is seven.
Three threes are nine.
I can't read your writing—is this meant to be a three?
The bulbs are planted in threes or fives (= groups of three or five).
We moved to America when I was three (= three years old).
Shall we meet at three (= at three o'clock), then?

senses.definition: two or three at a time; in small numbers

examples.x: People arrived in twos and threes.

senses.definition_vi: hai hoặc ba cùng một lúc; với số lượng nhỏ

senses.definition: reading, writing and arithmetic, thought to be the most important parts of a child’s education
senses.definition_vi: đọc, viết và số học, được coi là những phần quan trọng nhất trong giáo dục của trẻ em

senses.definition: the floor or ground at the bottom of a doorway, considered as the entrance to a building or room

examples.x: He stepped across the threshold.
She stood hesitating on the threshold.

senses.definition_vi: sàn hoặc mặt đất ở đáy của một lối đi, được coi là lối vào của một tòa nhà hoặc căn phòng

senses.definition: the level at which something starts to happen or have an effect

examples.x: He has a low boredom threshold (= he gets bored easily).
I have a high pain threshold (= I can suffer a lot of pain before I start to react).
My earnings are just above the tax threshold (= more than the amount at which you start paying tax).

senses.definition_vi: mức mà tại đó điều gì đó bắt đầu xảy ra hoặc có tác dụng

senses.definition: the point just before a new situation, period of life, etc. begins

examples.x: She felt as though she was on the threshold of a new life.

senses.definition_vi: điểm ngay trước khi một tình huống, giai đoạn cuộc sống mới, v.v. bắt đầu

senses.definition: very excited and pleased

examples.x: ‘Are you pleased?’ ‘I'm thrilled.’
He was thrilled at the prospect of seeing them again.
I'm really thrilled with the results.
I was thrilled to be invited.
She was thrilled to bits (= extremely pleased) that he'd been offered the job.

senses.definition_vi: rất phấn khích và vui vẻ

senses.definition: to become, and continue to be, successful, strong, healthy, etc.

examples.x: New businesses thrive in this area.
These animals rarely thrive in captivity.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên, và tiếp tục là, thành công, mạnh mẽ, khỏe mạnh, v.v.

senses.definition: a passage in the neck through which food and air pass on their way into the body; the front part of the neck

examples.x: A sob caught in his throat.
He held the knife to her throat.
Their throats had been cut.
They caught a pig and Jack slit (= cut) its throat.
He quickly stuffed a hot dog down his throat.

senses.definition_vi: một đường dẫn trong cổ họng mà thức ăn và không khí đi qua trên đường vào cơ thể; phần trước của cổ

senses.definition: having the colour of throat mentioned; making a sound in the throat of the type mentioned

examples.x: a blue-throated macaw
a deep-throated roar

senses.definition_vi: có màu sắc của cổ họng được đề cập; tạo ra âm thanh trong cổ họng của loại được đề cập

senses.definition: to be fighting or arguing with each other
senses.definition_vi: đang đánh nhau hoặc tranh cãi với nhau

senses.definition: to cough (= to force out air noisily through your throat) so that you can speak clearly
senses.definition_vi: ho (= đẩy không khí ra ngoài một cách ồn ào qua cổ họng) để có thể nói rõ ràng

senses.definition: to do something that is likely to harm you, especially when you are angry and trying to harm somebody else
senses.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó có khả năng gây hại cho bạn, đặc biệt là khi bạn tức giận và cố gắng làm hại người khác

senses.definition: to try to force somebody to listen to and accept your opinions in a way that they find annoying

examples.x: People are sick of having advertising rammed down their throats.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng ép ai đó lắng nghe và chấp nhận ý kiến của bạn theo cách mà họ thấy khó chịu

senses.definition: to lose your voice or be unable to speak clearly for a short time
senses.definition_vi: bị mất giọng hoặc không thể nói rõ ràng trong một thời gian ngắn

senses.definition: to feel pressure in the throat because you are very angry or emotional
senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy áp lực trong cổ họng vì bạn rất tức giận hoặc xúc động

senses.definition: to react very angrily to somebody
senses.definition_vi: phản ứng rất tức giận với ai đó

senses.definition: to be difficult or impossible to say

examples.x: She wanted to say how sorry she was but the words seemed to stick in her throat.

senses.definition_vi: khó hoặc không thể nói ra

senses.definition: to be difficult or impossible to accept; to make you angry
senses.definition_vi: khó hoặc không thể chấp nhận; làm bạn tức giận

senses.definition: from one end or side of something to the other

examples.x: Put the coffee in the filter and let the water run through.
The tyre's flat—the nail has gone right through.
The onlookers stood aside to let the paramedics through.

senses.definition_vi: từ đầu này đến đầu kia của cái gì đó/ai đó

senses.definition: from the beginning to the end of a thing or period of time

examples.x: Don't tell me how it ends—I haven't read it all the way through yet.
I expect I'll struggle through until payday.

senses.definition_vi: từ đầu đến cuối của một hoạt động, một tình huống hoặc một khoảng thời gian

senses.definition: past a barrier, stage or test

examples.x: The lights were red but he drove straight through.
Our team is through to (= has reached) the semi-finals.

senses.definition_vi: vượt qua một rào cản, giai đoạn hoặc bài kiểm tra

senses.definition: travelling through a place without stopping or without people having to get off one train and onto another

examples.x: ‘Did you stop in Oxford on the way?’ ‘No, we drove straight through.’
This train goes straight through to York.

senses.definition_vi: từ đầu này đến đầu kia của cái gì đó/ai đó

senses.definition: connected by phone

examples.x: Ask to be put through to me personally.
I tried to call you but I couldn't get through.

senses.definition_vi: từ đầu này đến đầu kia của cái gì đó/ai đó

senses.definition: used after an adjective to mean ‘completely’

examples.x: We got wet through.

senses.definition_vi: từ đầu này đến đầu kia của cái gì đó/ai đó

senses.definition: completely; in every way

examples.x: He's British through and through.

senses.definition_vi: từ đầu này đến đầu kia của cái gì đó/ai đó

senses.definition: in or into every part of something

examples.x: They export their products to markets throughout the world.
The house was painted white throughout.

senses.definition_vi: ở hoặc vào mọi bộ phận của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: during the whole period of time of something

examples.x: The museum is open daily throughout the year.
The ceremony lasted two hours and we had to stand throughout.

senses.definition_vi: trong toàn bộ khoảng thời gian của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to send something from your hand through the air by moving your hand or arm quickly

examples.x: Practise throwing and catching.
They had a competition to see who could throw the furthest.
Who threw that rock?
Stop throwing stones at the window!
She threw the ball up and caught it again.
He threw the ball into the bushes and the dog ran to fetch it.
Three grenades were thrown into the corridor.
Two petrol bombs had been thrown through the front window.
Don't throw it to him; give it to him!
Can you throw me that towel?

senses.definition_vi: ném cái gì đó từ tay bạn qua không khí bằng cách di chuyển tay hoặc cánh tay của bạn nhanh chóng

senses.definition: to put something in a particular place quickly and carelessly

examples.x: Just throw your bag down over there.
He threw the keys casually down on the table.
A blanket was thrown over the bed.
I took some folders and started throwing stuff in them.

senses.definition_vi: đặt cái gì đó vào một vị trí nào đó một cách nhanh chóng và bất cẩn

senses.definition: to move something/somebody suddenly and with force

examples.x: The boat was thrown onto the rocks.
The sea throws up all sorts of debris on the beach.
They were thrown to the floor by the impact.
He was arrested and thrown in jail (= sent to prison).
He threatened to throw her in the river if she screamed.
I threw open the windows to let the smoke out.
He threw the double doors open in a dramatic gesture.
Miraculously he was thrown clear (= out of the vehicle when it crashed) and suffered nothing more than severe bruising.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển ai đó/cái gì đó đột ngột và mạnh mẽ

senses.definition: to move your body or part of it quickly or suddenly

examples.x: He threw back his head and roared with laughter.
I ran up and threw my arms around him.
Jenny threw herself onto the bed.
I just wanted to throw myself into his arms and cry.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển cơ thể hoặc một bộ phận của cơ thể một cách nhanh chóng hoặc đột ngột

senses.definition: to make somebody fall quickly or violently to the ground

examples.x: Two riders were thrown (= off their horses) in the second race.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó ngã nhanh chóng hoặc dữ dội xuống đất

senses.definition: to make somebody/something be in a particular state

examples.x: Hundreds were thrown out of work.
The future of the project has been thrown into doubt.
Everything was thrown into chaos.
We were thrown into confusion by the news.
The problem was suddenly thrown into sharp focus.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó ở một trạng thái cụ thể

senses.definition: to direct something at somebody/something

examples.x: to throw doubt on the verdict
to throw the blame on someone
to throw accusations at someone
He threw the question back at me (= expected me to answer it myself).

senses.definition_vi: hướng cái gì đó về phía ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: to make somebody feel upset, confused, or surprised

examples.x: The news of her death really threw me.
The speaker was completely thrown by the interruption.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy khó chịu, bối rối hoặc ngạc nhiên

senses.definition: to roll a dice or let it fall after shaking it; to obtain a particular number in this way

examples.x: Throw the dice!
He threw three sixes in a row.

senses.definition_vi: tung xúc xắc hoặc thả nó rơi sau khi lắc; nhận được một số cụ thể theo cách này

senses.definition: to make a clay pot, dish, etc. on a potter’s wheel

examples.x: a hand-thrown vase

senses.definition: to put a lot of effort and enthusiasm into something that is difficult enough to keep you interested

senses.definition_vi: đặt nhiều nỗ lực và sự nhiệt tình vào một điều gì đó đủ khó để giữ cho bạn hứng thú

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn nói rằng bạn muốn một cái gì đó rất nhiều

senses.definition_vi: cắn chặt răng lại

senses.definition_vi: quyết tâm tiếp tục làm điều gì đó trong một tình huống khó khăn hoặc khó chịu

senses.definition: to be powerful and effective

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để bày tỏ sự tức giận hoặc ngạc nhiên

senses.definition_vi: bất chấp các vấn đề, sự phản đối, v.v.

senses.definition_vi: nói điều gì đó hoàn toàn không đúng sự thật

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng rất khó để ai đó làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: old or too old
senses.definition_vi: cũ hoặc quá cũ

senses.definition: involving opposition or competition that is violent and without sympathy

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến sự phản đối hoặc cạnh tranh bạo lực và không khoan nhượng

top quality silk

senses.definition_vi: rất mạnh mẽ và có khả năng đối phó thành công với các điều kiện hoặc tình huống khó khăn

senses.definition: used to say how easy and quick it is to do a particular task

senses.definition_vi: lo lắng, bối rối hoặc sợ hãi và không thể thư giãn; làm cho bạn cảm thấy như vậy

senses.definition_vi: khó chịu hoặc khó giải quyết

senses.definition: in a state like sleep because of an injury or illness, and not able to use your senses

senses.definition_vi: không nhận thức về ai đó/cái gì đó; không nhận thấy điều gì đó; không tỉnh táo

senses.definition_vi: ở, đến hoặc qua một vị trí bên dưới một cái gì đó

senses.definition_vi: ở, đến hoặc qua một vị trí bên dưới một cái gì đó

senses.definition_vi: ở, đến hoặc qua một vị trí bên dưới một cái gì đó

senses.definition_vi: dưới bề mặt của mặt đất

senses.definition_vi: là loại duy nhất trong số đó.

senses.definition: very special or unusual

examples.x: The preview offers a unique opportunity to see the show without the crowds.
This house has many unique features, including a 45-foot-long outdoor swimming pool.
He approaches problems in his own unique way.
The vast red sand dunes are what makes this area unique.
a unique talent
The deal will put the company in a unique position to export goods to Eastern Europe.
He brings a unique combination of skills to this project.
I feel I have a unique perspective on the situation.
his unique style of leadership
The museum provides a unique experience for anyone with an interest in naval history.
Unfortunately your situation is not unique among assistants in New York.

senses.definition_vi: rất đặc biệt hoặc khác thường.

senses.definition: belonging to or connected with one particular person, place or thing

examples.x: an atmosphere that is unique to New York
The koala is unique to Australia.

senses.definition_vi: thuộc về hoặc liên quan đến một người, địa điểm hoặc vật cụ thể.

senses.definition: a single thing, person or group that is complete by itself but can also form part of something larger

examples.x: After 1946 the British Government treated the four territorial divisions as a single unit.
The basic unit of society is the family.
The cell is the unit of which all living organisms are composed.
the role of the family unit in the community

senses.definition_vi: một thứ, một người hoặc một nhóm duy nhất, hoàn chỉnh nhưng cũng có thể là một phần của cái gì đó lớn hơn.

senses.definition: a single item of the type of product that a company sells

examples.x: The game's selling price was $15 per unit.
What's the unit cost?

senses.definition_vi: một mặt hàng duy nhất thuộc loại sản phẩm mà một công ty bán.

senses.definition: one of the parts into which a textbook or a series of lessons is divided

examples.x: Each unit of the course that we completed felt like a real achievement.
The present perfect is covered in Unit 8.
The university is recruiting staff to teach the new units.
You learned this in the first unit.

senses.definition_vi: một trong những phần mà một sách giáo khoa hoặc một loạt bài học được chia thành.

senses.definition: a group of people who work or live together, especially for a particular purpose

examples.x: army/military/combat/police units
a special unit of the FBI
Medical units were operating in the disaster area.
Two members of the unit died on the mission.
They formed small units of 15 to 20 people.
The marching column encountered large units of the enemy.
Soldiers in the unit are trained to survive in the snow and cold.

senses.definition_vi: một nhóm người làm việc hoặc sống cùng nhau, đặc biệt là vì một mục đích cụ thể.

senses.definition: a department, especially in a hospital, that provides a particular type of care or treatment

examples.x: the intensive care unit
a maternity unit
The cancer research unit is attached to the local university.
patients in the psychiatric unit

senses.definition_vi: một khoa, đặc biệt là trong bệnh viện, cung cấp một loại chăm sóc hoặc điều trị cụ thể.

senses.definition: a piece of furniture, especially a cupboard, that fits with and matches others of the same type

examples.x: a fitted kitchen with white units
floor/wall units
bedroom/kitchen units

senses.definition_vi: một món đồ nội thất, đặc biệt là một cái tủ, phù hợp và khớp với những món đồ cùng loại khác.

senses.definition: a fixed quantity, etc. that is used as a standard measurement

examples.x: a unit of measurement
Women are advised not to drink more than fourteen units of alcohol per week.
a unit of time/length/weight
a unit of currency, such as the euro or the dollar
Electricity is ten pence per unit.
The law requires almost all federal agencies to use metric units.
The highest carbon emissions per unit of energy are from coal.

senses.definition_vi: một số lượng cố định, v.v. được sử dụng làm thước đo tiêu chuẩn.

senses.definition: a small machine that has a particular purpose or is part of a larger machine

examples.x: a waste disposal unit
the central processing unit of a computer
an air-conditioning unit

senses.definition_vi: một máy nhỏ có mục đích cụ thể hoặc là một phần của máy lớn hơn.

senses.definition: a single flat, house or section in a building or group of buildings

examples.x: a housing/residential unit
to build new affordable housing units
The site is being redeveloped for 62 home units.
a single dwelling unit
a retail/business unit
an industrial unit

senses.definition_vi: một căn hộ, nhà hoặc khu vực duy nhất trong một tòa nhà hoặc một nhóm tòa nhà.

senses.definition: any whole number from 0 to 9

examples.x: a column for the tens and a column for the units

senses.definition_vi: bất kỳ số nguyên nào từ 0 đến 9.

senses.definition: to join together with other people in order to do something as a group

examples.x: Nationalist parties united to oppose the government's plans.
Local resident groups have united in opposition to the plan.
We will unite in fighting crime.
Will they unite behind the new leader?

senses.definition_vi: kết hợp với những người khác để làm điều gì đó như một nhóm.

senses.definition: to make people or things join together to form a unit; to join together

examples.x: A special bond unites our two countries.
His aim was to unite Italy.
The two countries united in 1887.
She unites keen business skills with a charming personality.
uniting the North with the South

senses.definition_vi: làm cho mọi người hoặc mọi vật kết hợp lại để tạo thành một đơn vị; kết hợp lại.

senses.definition: joined together as a political unit or by shared aims

examples.x: the United States of America
efforts to build a united Europe
a politically united federation

senses.definition_vi: được kết hợp với nhau như một đơn vị chính trị hoặc bởi các mục tiêu chung.

senses.definition: in agreement and working together

examples.x: We need to become a more united team.
They are united in their opposition to the plan.
The two parties were united in insisting on keeping the two regions of the Sudan together.
The various religious and ethnic groupings were united by their desire to end British rule.
The EU has sent a clear message that it stands united against terrorism.
In contrast, the Republican Party is united behind its candidate.

senses.definition_vi: thống nhất và làm việc cùng nhau.

senses.definition: used in the names of some teams and companies

examples.x: Manchester United
United Biscuits

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong tên của một số đội và công ty.

senses.definition: to show people that all members of a group have the same opinion about things

examples.x: The prime minister stressed the need to present a united front.

senses.definition_vi: cho mọi người thấy rằng tất cả các thành viên của một nhóm đều có cùng ý kiến về mọi thứ.

senses.definition: the state of being in agreement and working together; the state of being joined together to form one unit

examples.x: European unity
a plea for unity within the party
unity of purpose

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái đồng thuận và làm việc cùng nhau; trạng thái được kết hợp lại để tạo thành một đơn vị.

senses.definition: the quality of looking or being complete in a natural and attractive way

examples.x: The design lacks unity.
the organic unity of Raphael's picture

senses.definition_vi: phẩm chất của việc trông hoặc trở nên hoàn chỉnh một cách tự nhiên và hấp dẫn.

senses.definition: any of the principles of classical or neoclassical theatre that limit the action of a play to a single story, day and place

examples.x: the unities of action, time and place

senses.definition_vi: bất kỳ nguyên tắc nào của nhà hát cổ điển hoặc tân cổ điển giới hạn hành động của một vở kịch trong một câu chuyện, một ngày và một địa điểm duy nhất

senses.definition: a single thing that may consist of a number of different parts

examples.x: If society is to exist as a unity, its members must have shared values.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ duy nhất có thể bao gồm nhiều bộ phận khác nhau

senses.definition: the number one
senses.definition_vi: số một

senses.definition: done by or involving all the people in the world or in a particular group

examples.x: Such problems are a universal feature of old age.
Agreement on this issue is almost universal.
universal suffrage (= the right of all the people in a country to vote)

senses.definition_vi: được thực hiện bởi hoặc liên quan đến tất cả mọi người trên thế giới hoặc trong một nhóm cụ thể

senses.definition: true or right at all times and in all places

examples.x: universal facts about human nature

senses.definition_vi: đúng hoặc đúng mọi lúc và mọi nơi

senses.definition: the whole of space and everything in it, including the earth, the planets and the stars

examples.x: Could there be intelligent life elsewhere in the universe?
theories of how the universe began
As far as we know, the entire universe was created in the big bang.

senses.definition_vi: toàn bộ không gian và mọi thứ trong đó, bao gồm Trái đất, các hành tinh và các vì sao

senses.definition: a system of stars, planets, etc. in space outside our own

examples.x: The idea of a parallel universe is hard to grasp.
He lives in a little universe of his own.
A tidal pool is its own little universe, bustling with activity and life.

senses.definition_vi: một hệ thống các vì sao, hành tinh, v.v. trong không gian bên ngoài của chúng ta

senses.definition: a particular area of experience or activity

examples.x: the moral universe

senses.definition_vi: một lĩnh vực kinh nghiệm hoặc hoạt động cụ thể

senses.definition: an institution at the highest level of education where you can study for a degree or do research

examples.x: Is there a university in this town?
Ohio State University
the University of York
York University
She studied at the University of Chicago.
Both their children are at university.
He's hoping to go to university next year.
a university student/lecturer/professor
a university degree/course
The site lies on the university campus next to the lake.

senses.definition_vi: một tổ chức ở cấp cao nhất của giáo dục nơi bạn có thể học để lấy bằng hoặc nghiên cứu

senses.definition: the experience of life thought of as giving somebody an education, instead of the person gaining formal qualifications

examples.x: a degree from the university of life

senses.definition_vi: kinh nghiệm sống được coi là mang lại cho ai đó sự giáo dục, thay vì người đó đạt được bằng cấp chính thức

senses.definition: not known or identified

examples.x: A previously unknown group claimed responsibility for the bombing.
He was trying, for some unknown reason, to count the stars.
The man's identity remains unknown.
An unknown number of civilians were killed or injured in the attack.
patients suffering from fevers of unknown origin
a species of insect hitherto unknown to science

senses.definition_vi: không được biết hoặc xác định

senses.definition: not famous or well known

examples.x: She was then still relatively unknown.
The author is virtually unknown outside Poland.
a film with a largely unknown cast
an unknown actor

senses.definition_vi: không nổi tiếng hoặc được biết đến

senses.definition: never happening or existing

examples.x: The disease is as yet unknown in Europe (= there have been no cases there).

examples.cf: it is unknown for somebody/something to do something
examples.x: It was not unknown for people to have to wait several hours (= it happened sometimes).
It is virtually unknown for foxes to attack anyone.
a period of democratic development unknown in their country until now

senses.definition_vi: không bao giờ xảy ra hoặc tồn tại

senses.definition: a person or thing whose qualities or abilities are not yet known
senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật có phẩm chất hoặc khả năng chưa được biết đến

senses.definition: without the person mentioned being aware of it

examples.x: Unknown to me, he had already signed the agreement.

senses.definition_vi: mà người được đề cập không biết

senses.definition: used to say that something can only happen or be true in a particular situation

examples.x: You won't get paid for time off unless you have a doctor's note.
I won't tell them—not unless you say I can.
Unless I'm mistaken, she was back at work yesterday.
He hasn't got any hobbies—unless you call watching TV a hobby.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng một điều gì đó chỉ có thể xảy ra hoặc đúng trong một tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: used to give the only situation in which something will not happen or be true

examples.x: I sleep with the window open unless it's really cold.
Unless something unexpected happens, I'll see you tomorrow.
Have a cup of tea—unless you'd prefer a cold drink?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đưa ra tình huống duy nhất mà điều gì đó sẽ không xảy ra hoặc đúng

senses.definition: different from a particular person or thing

examples.x: Music is quite unlike any other art form.
The sound was not unlike that of birds singing.

senses.definition_vi: khác với một người hoặc vật cụ thể

senses.definition: used to contrast somebody/something with another person or thing

examples.x: Unlike most systems, this one is very easy to install.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đối chiếu ai đó/cái gì đó với một người hoặc vật khác

senses.definition: not typical of somebody/something

examples.x: It's very unlike him to be so late.

senses.definition_vi: không điển hình của ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: not likely to happen; not probable

examples.x: The project seemed unlikely to succeed.
Of course, such an event is very unlikely to happen.
It was highly unlikely that the gunshot wound was self-inflicted.
It is extremely unlikely that the new owner would want to make people redundant.
It looks unlikely that prices will fall.
It's most (= very) unlikely that she'll arrive before seven.
Problems with the evidence made it unlikely that he would ever be prosecuted.
In the unlikely event of a problem arising, please contact the hotel manager.

senses.definition_vi: không có khả năng xảy ra; không có khả năng

senses.definition: not the person, thing or place that you would normally think of or expect

examples.x: He seems a most unlikely candidate for the job.
They have built hotels in the most unlikely places.

senses.definition_vi: không phải là người, vật hoặc nơi mà bạn thường nghĩ đến hoặc mong đợi

senses.definition: difficult to believe

examples.x: She gave me an unlikely explanation for her behaviour.

senses.definition_vi: khó tin

senses.definition: not needed; more than is needed

examples.x: They were found guilty of causing unnecessary suffering to animals.
All this fuss is totally unnecessary.

examples.cf: it is unnecessary to do something
examples.x: It was unnecessary to carry out more stringent safety testing.

examples.cf: it is unnecessary for somebody/something to do something
examples.x: They argued that it was unnecessary for government to regulate the industry.
Don't take any unnecessary risks.
Cigarette smoking causes 450,000 unnecessary deaths every year.
unnecessary expense
Antibiotics should be unnecessary for most patients with a sore throat.

senses.definition_vi: không cần thiết; nhiều hơn mức cần thiết

senses.definition: not needed in the situation and likely to be offensive

examples.x: That last comment was a little unnecessary, wasn't it?
That was quite unnecessary and I want you to apologize.

senses.definition_vi: không cần thiết trong tình huống và có khả năng gây xúc phạm

senses.definition: not pleasant or comfortable

examples.x: an unpleasant experience/surprise/task
The minerals in the water made it unpleasant to drink.
It can be unpleasant to sit next to a group of people arguing.

examples.cf: unpleasant for somebody to do something
examples.x: It must have been unpleasant for her neighbours to be exposed to the constant loud music.
Torrential made conditions unpleasant for both players and spectators.
What then took place was a deeply unpleasant attack.
an unpleasant truth/fact/reality/consequence
an unpleasant feeling/sensation/memory
an unpleasant smell/odour/taste

senses.definition_vi: không dễ chịu hoặc thoải mái

senses.definition: not kind, friendly or polite

examples.x: He was very unpleasant to me.
You don't have to be so unpleasant about it. I said I was sorry.
She said some very unpleasant things about you.

senses.definition_vi: không tốt bụng, thân thiện hoặc lịch sự

senses.definition: that has never happened, been done or been known before

examples.x: The situation is unprecedented in modern times.
There were unprecedented scenes of violence in the city’s main square.

senses.definition_vi: chưa từng xảy ra, được thực hiện hoặc được biết đến trước đây

senses.definition: up to the point in time or the event mentioned

examples.x: Let's wait until the rain stops.
Until she spoke I hadn't realized she wasn't English.
You're not going out until you've finished this.
Until now I have always lived alone.
They moved here in 2009. Until then they'd always been in the London area.
He continued working up until his death.
The street is full of traffic from morning till night.
You can stay on the bus until London (= until you reach London).

senses.definition_vi: cho đến thời điểm hoặc sự kiện được đề cập

senses.definition: different from what is usual or normal

examples.x: The case is highly unusual.
Police then took the unusual step of publishing the names and pictures of the two suspects.

examples.cf: it is unusual for somebody/something to do something
examples.x: It's not unusual for young doctors to work a 70-hour week (= it happens often).
It's unusual for the trees to flower so early.

examples.cf: it is unusual to do something
examples.x: It was a bit unusual to see her up and about before nine in the morning.
She has a very unusual name.
She hadn't noticed anything unusual about Susan's behaviour.

senses.definition_vi: khác với những gì thường lệ hoặc bình thường

senses.definition: different from other similar things and therefore interesting and attractive

examples.x: an unusual colour
Are you looking for an unusual gift idea this Christmas?
their unusual mix of funk, rock, hip hop, jazz and techno

senses.definition_vi: khác với những thứ tương tự khác và do đó thú vị và hấp dẫn

senses.definition: a category of very severe punishment that is banned under US law

examples.x: This important case confronts the issue of what constitutes cruel and unusual punishment.
Detainees are subjected to malnutrition, forced labor, and to other cruel and unusual punishments.

senses.definition_vi: một loại hình phạt rất nghiêm khắc bị cấm theo luật Hoa Kỳ

senses.definition: to remove a cover or curtain from a painting, statue, etc. so that it can be seen in public for the first time

examples.x: The Queen unveiled a plaque to mark the official opening of the hospital.

senses.definition_vi: gỡ bỏ một tấm vải che hoặc rèm khỏi một bức tranh, tượng, v.v. để nó có thể được nhìn thấy trước công chúng lần đầu tiên

senses.definition: to show or introduce a new plan, product, etc. to the public for the first time

examples.x: They will be unveiling their new models at the Motor Show.
The government has unveiled plans for new energy legislation.

senses.definition_vi: trình bày hoặc giới thiệu một kế hoạch, sản phẩm mới, v.v. với công chúng lần đầu tiên

senses.definition: towards or in a higher position

examples.x: He jumped up from his chair.
Your mum said you were up here (= upstairs).
The sun was already up (= had risen) when they set off.
They live up in the mountains.
It didn't take long to put the tent up.
You look nice with your hair up (= arranged on top of or at the back of your head).
Lay the cards face up (= facing upwards) on the table.
Up you come! (= said when lifting a child)
The car was up on blocks.
I was up on deck at first light.
Two men were up on the roof, repairing a leak.
I pinned the notice up on the wall.
She tries to stay under water but she floats back up.

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó

senses.definition: to or at a higher level

examples.x: She turned the volume up.
Prices are still going up (= rising).
United were 3–1 up at half-time.
The wind is getting up (= blowing more strongly).
Sales are well up on last year.

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó

senses.definition: to the place where somebody/something is

examples.x: A car drove up and he got in.
She went straight up to the door and knocked loudly.

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó

senses.definition: out of bed

examples.x: I stayed up late (= did not go to bed until late) last night.
He's up and about again after his illness.

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó

senses.definition: to or at an important place, especially a large city

examples.x: We're going up to New York for the day.
His son's up at Oxford (= Oxford University).

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó

senses.definition: to a place in the north of a country; further north than somewhere else

examples.x: They've moved up north.
We drove up to Inverness to see my father.
I'm up there almost every other weekend
Up here in Liverpool things are different.

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó

senses.definition: completely

examples.x: We ate all the food up.
The stream has dried up.

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó

senses.definition: so as to be finished or closed

examples.x: I have some paperwork to finish up.
Do your coat up; it's cold.

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó

senses.definition: into pieces or parts

examples.x: She tore the paper up.
They've had the road up (= with the surface broken or removed) to lay some pipes.
How shall we divide up the work?

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó

senses.definition: so as to be formed or brought together

examples.x: The government agreed to set up a committee of inquiry.
She gathered up her belongings.

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó

senses.definition: finished; over

examples.x: Time's up. Stop writing and hand in your papers.

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó

senses.definition: used to say that something is happening, especially something unusual or unpleasant

examples.x: I could tell something was up by the looks on their faces.
What's up? (= What is the matter?)
What's up with him? He looks furious.
Is anything up? You can tell me.

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó

senses.definition: about to happen, be discussed, etc.

examples.x: Next up in our top ten is a new release by Ariana Grande.
Up after the break we will be introducing our mystery guest!

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó

senses.definition: to be somebody’s duty or responsibility; to be for somebody to decide

examples.x: It's not up to you to tell me how to do my job.
Shall we eat out or stay in? It's up to you.

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó

senses.definition: to be of poor quality; to not be very good

examples.x: His work isn't up to much.

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó

senses.definition: facing problems or opposition

examples.x: Teachers are up against some major problems these days.
She's really up against it (= in a difficult situation).

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó

senses.definition: moving upwards and downwards

examples.x: The boat bobbed up and down on the water.

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó

senses.definition: in one direction and then in the opposite direction

examples.x: She was pacing up and down in front of her desk.

senses.definition_vi: theo một hướng rồi theo hướng ngược lại dọc theo một cái gì đó

senses.definition: sometimes good and sometimes bad

examples.x: My relationship with him was up and down.

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó

senses.definition: if you swear up and down that something is true, you say that it is definitely true
senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó

senses.definition: working; being used

examples.x: By that time the new system should be up and running.

senses.definition_vi: ở một vị trí cao hơn ở đâu đó
