senses.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc được thực hiện hầu hết thời gian hoặc trong hầu hết các trường hợp

senses.definition: what usually happens; what you usually have, especially the drink that you usually have
senses.definition_vi: điều thường xảy ra; những gì bạn thường có, đặc biệt là đồ uống bạn thường uống

senses.definition: in the way that is normal or usual; as often happens

examples.x: Everyone blamed me as per usual.

senses.definition_vi: theo cách bình thường hoặc thông thường; như thường xảy ra

senses.definition: in the same way as what happens most of the time or in most cases

examples.x: Steve, as usual, was the last to arrive.
As usual at that hour, the place was deserted.
Despite her problems, she carried on working as usual.
Despite the problems staff arrived for work as usual.

senses.definition_vi: theo cách giống như những gì xảy ra hầu hết thời gian hoặc trong hầu hết các trường hợp

senses.definition: a way of saying that things will continue as normal despite a difficult situation

examples.x: It's business as usual at the factory, even while investigators sift through the bomb wreckage.

senses.definition_vi: một cách nói rằng mọi thứ sẽ tiếp tục như bình thường bất chấp một tình huống khó khăn

senses.definition: the people you would usually expect to do something or be included in something

examples.x: She thanked all the usual suspects in her acceptance speech: her family, the director, the cast and the crew.

senses.definition_vi: những người bạn thường mong đợi làm điều gì đó hoặc được bao gồm trong điều gì đó

senses.definition: in the way that is usual or normal; most often

examples.x: How long does the journey usually take?
Tension headache is not usually associated with any other symptoms.
For Americans, ‘mad’ usually means ‘angry’.
Usually, there's no extra charge for delivery.
I'm usually home by 6 o'clock.
We usually go by car.
Results are usually available within a couple of days.
I usually only see them at Christmas or weddings.
Patients usually have no symptoms.
The focus groups usually involve about eight people.
You can usually find him at home.
These two words usually occur together.

senses.definition_vi: theo cách thông thường hoặc bình thường; hầu hết thời gian

senses.definition: a service provided for the public, for example an electricity, water or gas supply

examples.x: a privatized electricity utility
Rescue teams worked desperately to restore utilities in the area shattered by the hurricane.
Legislation will be introduced to regulate the privatized utilities.

senses.definition_vi: một dịch vụ được cung cấp cho công chúng, ví dụ như cung cấp điện, nước hoặc gas

senses.definition: the quality of being useful

examples.x: This information is of the highest utility to a historian.

senses.definition_vi: phẩm chất hữu ích

senses.definition: a piece of computer software that performs a particular task
senses.definition_vi: một phần mềm máy tính thực hiện một tác vụ cụ thể

senses.definition: to use something, especially for a practical purpose

examples.x: The Romans were the first to utilize concrete as a building material.
The resources at our disposal could have been better utilized.
Vitamin C helps the body utilize the iron present in your body.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là cho một mục đích thực tế

senses.definition: completely

examples.x: We're so utterly different from each other.
She utterly failed to convince them.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn

senses.definition: a period of time spent travelling or relaxing away from home

examples.x: They're on vacation in Hawaii right now.
I'm going on vacation for a couple of weeks.
You look tired—you should take a vacation.
We're planning a summer vacation to Europe next year.
I just got back from a family vacation in New Orleans.
The job includes two weeks' paid vacation.
a vacation home
He had a lot of unused vacation time.

senses.definition_vi: một khoảng thời gian dành để đi du lịch hoặc thư giãn xa nhà

senses.definition: (in the UK) one of the periods of time when universities or courts of law are closed; (in the US) one of the periods of time when schools, colleges, universities or courts of law are closed

examples.x: the Christmas/Easter/summer vacation
the long vacation (= the summer vacation)
I got a full-time job during the vacation.

senses.definition_vi: (ở Vương quốc Anh) một trong những khoảng thời gian mà các trường đại học hoặc tòa án đóng cửa; (ở Hoa Kỳ) một trong những khoảng thời gian mà các trường học, cao đẳng, đại học hoặc tòa án đóng cửa

senses.definition: a space that is completely empty of all substances, including all air or other gas

examples.x: a vacuum pump (= one that creates a vacuum)
vacuum-packed foods (= in a package from which most of the air has been removed)

senses.definition_vi: một không gian hoàn toàn trống rỗng không có bất kỳ chất nào, bao gồm tất cả không khí hoặc khí khác

senses.definition: a situation in which somebody/something is missing

examples.x: His resignation has created a vacuum which cannot easily be filled.
The writer criticized the moral vacuum in society.

senses.definition_vi: một tình huống mà ai đó/cái gì đó bị thiếu

senses.definition: the act of cleaning something with a vacuum cleaner

examples.x: to give a room a quick vacuum

senses.definition_vi: hành động làm sạch thứ gì đó bằng máy hút bụi

senses.definition: existing separately from other people, events, etc. when there should be a connection

examples.x: This kind of decision cannot ever be made in a vacuum.

senses.definition_vi: tồn tại tách biệt với những người khác, sự kiện, v.v. khi lẽ ra phải có sự kết nối

senses.definition: not clear in a person’s mind

examples.x: to have a vague impression/memory/recollection of something
They had only a vague idea where the place was.

senses.definition_vi: không rõ ràng trong tâm trí của một người

senses.definition: not having or giving enough information or details about something

examples.x: She's a little vague about her plans for next year.
The politicians made vague promises about tax cuts.
He was accused of being deliberately vague.
We had only a vague description of the attacker.
He outlined the policy in vague terms.

senses.definition_vi: không cung cấp đủ thông tin hoặc chi tiết về điều gì đó

senses.definition: suggesting a lack of clear thought or attention

examples.x: His vague manner concealed a brilliant mind.
She seems to be getting rather vague as she grows older.

senses.definition_vi: gợi ý về sự thiếu suy nghĩ hoặc chú ý rõ ràng

senses.definition: not having a clear shape

examples.x: In the darkness they could see the vague outline of a church.

senses.definition_vi: không có hình dạng rõ ràng

senses.definition: that is legally or officially acceptable

examples.x: Do you have a valid passport?
He bought a bus pass valid for one month.
They have a valid claim to compensation.

senses.definition_vi: hợp pháp hoặc được chấp nhận chính thức

senses.definition: based on what is logical or true

examples.x: She had valid reasons for not supporting the proposals.
The point you make is perfectly valid.
That argument is not strictly valid in this case.

senses.definition_vi: dựa trên những gì logic hoặc đúng sự thật

senses.definition: that is accepted by the system

examples.x: a valid password

senses.definition_vi: được hệ thống chấp nhận

senses.definition: the state of being legally or officially acceptable

examples.x: The period of validity of the agreement has expired.

senses.definition_vi: tình trạng hợp pháp hoặc được chấp nhận chính thức

senses.definition: the state of being logical and true

examples.x: We had doubts about the validity of their argument.

senses.definition_vi: tình trạng logic và đúng sự thật

senses.definition: an area of low land between hills or mountains, often with a river flowing through it; the land that a river flows through

examples.x: In the valley below cows were grazing peacefully.
the fertile soils of river valleys
A stream runs the length of the valley floor.
the Shenandoah Valley
the valley of the Nile
a small town set in a valley
The cottage was in a wooded valley.
The road climbs up the side of the valley.

senses.definition_vi: một khu vực đất thấp giữa đồi hoặc núi, thường có sông chảy qua; vùng đất mà sông chảy qua

senses.definition: worth a lot of money

examples.x: My home is my most valuable asset.
She claims hospitals waste valuable resources by admitting patients days before surgery.
valuable antiques
Luckily, nothing valuable was stolen.

senses.definition_vi: có giá trị tiền bạc lớn

senses.definition: very useful or important

examples.x: a valuable experience/lesson
You should gain some valuable insights into the world of business.
documents that are enormously valuable to historians
The book provides valuable information on recent trends.
He had already made a valuable contribution to economic theory.
The results will be a valuable tool for further research in the area.
This advice was to prove valuable.
Spinach is a valuable source of iron.
The data will be extremely valuable for medical research.
a simple blood test that is very valuable in the management of diabetes
Student input can be particularly valuable in improving the teaching process.

senses.definition_vi: rất hữu ích hoặc quan trọng

senses.definition: how much something is worth in money or other goods for which it can be exchanged

examples.x: to go up/rise/increase in value
to go down/fall/decline in value
rising property values
The value of the shares has continued to fall.
The winner will receive a prize to the value of £1 000.
Don't leave anything of value in the car.
Sports cars tend to hold their value well.

senses.definition_vi: nghĩ rằng ai đó/cái gì đó là quan trọng

senses.definition: how much something is worth compared with its price

examples.x: to be good/great value (= worth the money it costs)
to be bad/poor value (= not worth the money it costs)
Larger sizes give the best value for money.
The hotel gives value for money.
They're only £40—not bad value, really.
This great value-for-money offer is only available to society members.

senses.definition_vi: nghĩ rằng ai đó/cái gì đó là quan trọng

senses.definition: the quality of being useful or important

examples.x: The value of regular exercise should not be underestimated.
She placed a high value on loyalty.
He didn't say anything of value.
The arrival of canals was of great value to many industries.
to be of little/no value to somebody
The library's value to the community is enormous.
This ring has great sentimental value for me.
I suppose it has a certain novelty value (= it's interesting because it's new).
food with a high nutritional value
The story has very little news value.
Branding has to add value to the product.

senses.definition_vi: nghĩ rằng ai đó/cái gì đó là quan trọng

senses.definition: beliefs about what is right and wrong and what is important in life

examples.x: We need to be guided by our moral values.
a return to traditional values in education, such as firm discipline
The school's core values include the ability to work with others.
The young have a completely different set of values and expectations.

senses.definition_vi: nghĩ rằng ai đó/cái gì đó là quan trọng

senses.definition: the amount represented by a letter or symbol

examples.x: Let y have the value 33.

senses.definition_vi: nghĩ rằng ai đó/cái gì đó là quan trọng

senses.definition: a covered vehicle with no side windows in its back half, usually smaller than a lorry, used for carrying goods or people

examples.x: the driver of a white van
a police van (= for carrying police officers or prisoners)
A delivery van was almost blocking the narrow street.
an ice-cream van
a van driver
A passenger in the van was fatally injured.
He usually sleeps in the back of his van.

senses.definition_vi: một phương tiện có mui, không có cửa sổ hai bên ở nửa sau, thường nhỏ hơn xe tải, dùng để chở hàng hóa hoặc người

senses.definition: a covered vehicle with side windows, usually smaller than a lorry, that can carry about twelve passengers
senses.definition_vi: một phương tiện có mui, có cửa sổ hai bên, thường nhỏ hơn xe tải, có thể chở khoảng mười hai hành khách

senses.definition: a closed coach on a train for carrying bags, cases, etc. or mail

examples.x: a luggage van
The gang robbed a mail van, seriously injuring one of the guards.

senses.definition_vi: một toa kín trên tàu để chở túi, vali, v.v. hoặc thư

senses.definition: at the front or in the leading position

examples.x: These artists felt themselves in the van of the movement, true pioneers.

senses.definition_vi: ở phía trước hoặc ở vị trí dẫn đầu

senses.definition: to disappear suddenly and/or in a way that you cannot explain

examples.x: He turned around and vanished into the house.
The magician vanished in a puff of smoke.
My glasses seem to have vanished.
He vanished without trace.

senses.definition_vi: biến mất đột ngột và/hoặc theo cách không thể giải thích

senses.definition: to stop existing

examples.x: the vanishing woodlands of Europe
All hopes of a peaceful settlement had now vanished.
All thoughts of leaving vanished from his mind.

senses.definition_vi: ngừng tồn tại

senses.definition: to disappear completely

examples.x: Keep looking—they can't just have vanished off the face of the earth.

senses.definition_vi: biến mất hoàn toàn

senses.definition: to disappear suddenly in a mysterious way

examples.x: She can’t just have vanished into thin air.
At a stroke she could make things vanish into thin air.

senses.definition_vi: biến mất đột ngột theo một cách bí ẩn

senses.definition: to go away or be impossible to find when people need or want you

examples.x: The cat had done a disappearing act.

senses.definition_vi: đi đi hoặc không thể tìm thấy khi mọi người cần hoặc muốn bạn

senses.definition: often changing; likely to change

examples.x: variable temperatures
The acting is of variable quality (= some of it is good and some of it is bad).

senses.definition_vi: một tình huống, số hoặc số lượng có thể thay đổi hoặc được thay đổi

senses.definition: able to be changed

examples.x: The drill has variable speed control.
The kitchen boasts stylish units and variable lighting.
These systems are infinitely variable.

senses.definition_vi: một tình huống, số hoặc số lượng có thể thay đổi hoặc được thay đổi

senses.definition: a change, especially in the amount or level of something

examples.x: The dial records very slight variations in pressure.
Currency exchange rates are always subject to variation.
regional/seasonal variation (= depending on the region or time of year)

senses.definition_vi: một sự thay đổi, đặc biệt là về số lượng hoặc mức độ của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a thing that is different from other things in the same general group

examples.x: This soup is a spicy variation on a traditional favourite.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ khác với những thứ khác trong cùng một nhóm chung

senses.definition: any of a set of short pieces of music based on a simple tune repeated in a different and more complicated form

examples.x: a set of variations on a theme by Mozart
His numerous complaints are all variations on a theme (= all about the same thing).

senses.definition_vi: bất kỳ một loạt các đoạn nhạc ngắn dựa trên một giai điệu đơn giản được lặp lại theo một hình thức khác và phức tạp hơn

senses.definition: of many different types

examples.x: varied opinions
They stock a wide and varied selection of cheeses.

senses.definition_vi: có nhiều loại khác nhau

senses.definition: not staying the same, but changing often

examples.x: He led a full and varied life.
I've had a varied career.

senses.definition_vi: không giữ nguyên mà thường xuyên thay đổi

senses.definition: several different sorts of the same thing

examples.x: There is a wide variety of patterns to choose from.
He resigned for a variety of reasons.
This tool can be used in a variety of ways.
The text consists of extracts from a variety of sources.
articles and essays on a variety of topics
I don't eat meat, only fish, but there's a good variety available here.
The day-long excursion is one of a variety on offer for tourists.
I was impressed by the variety of dishes on offer.

senses.definition_vi: nhiều loại khác nhau của cùng một thứ

senses.definition: the quality of not being the same or not doing the same thing all the time

examples.x: It's the variety that makes my job so enjoyable.
We all need variety in our diet.
We want more variety in our work.
a constant craving for variety and adventure
The festival demonstrates the variety of the UK music scene.

senses.definition_vi: phẩm chất không giống nhau hoặc không làm cùng một việc mọi lúc

senses.definition: a type of a thing, for example a plant or language, that is different from the others in the same general group

examples.x: Apples come in a great many varieties.
different varieties of English
This is a very rare variety of orchid.
A typical estate in the region will grow at least three grape varieties.
My cooking is of the ‘quick and simple’ variety.

senses.definition_vi: một loại của một thứ, ví dụ như thực vật hoặc ngôn ngữ, khác với những thứ khác trong cùng một nhóm chung

senses.definition: a form of theatre or television entertainment that consists of a series of short performances, such as singing, dancing and funny acts

examples.x: a variety show/theatre

senses.definition_vi: một hình thức giải trí sân khấu hoặc truyền hình bao gồm một loạt các màn trình diễn ngắn, như ca hát, nhảy múa và các tiết mục hài hước

senses.definition: having a range of different experiences makes life more interesting
senses.definition_vi: có nhiều trải nghiệm khác nhau làm cho cuộc sống thú vị hơn

senses.definition: several different

examples.x: various types/forms/kinds of somebody/something
We talked about jobs, family, football and various other things.
documentaries that explored various aspects of life in Germany
Tents come in various shapes and sizes.
She took the job for various reasons.
There are various ways of doing this.
He spent his childhood in various parts of Italy.
Various groups use the centre.
Data will be collected at various stages.
My films involve various different points of view.
Members of the various political parties were calling for something to be done.
His complaints were many and various.

senses.definition_vi: nhiều cái khác nhau

senses.definition: having many different features

examples.x: a large and various country

senses.definition_vi: có nhiều đặc điểm khác nhau

senses.definition: to be different from each other in size, shape, etc.

examples.x: New techniques were introduced with varying degrees of success.
Estimates of how many civilians were killed varied widely.
Class size varies greatly.
The students' work varies considerably in quality.
The rooms vary in size.
There are a number of routes to the summit, with varying levels of difficulty.

senses.definition_vi: khác nhau về kích thước, hình dạng, v.v.

senses.definition: to change or be different according to the situation

examples.x: The menu varies with the season.
Cancer rates vary significantly by gender and ethnicity.
Results can vary greatly from year to year.
Pulse rates vary slightly from person to person.
Class numbers vary between 25 and 30.
Costs are likely to vary depending on where you live.
‘What time do you start work?’ ‘It varies.’
Prices vary according to the type of room you require.

senses.definition_vi: thay đổi hoặc khác nhau tùy thuộc vào tình huống

senses.definition: to make changes to something to make it slightly different

examples.x: The job enables me to vary the hours I work.
The aerobics instructor varies the routine each week.
Consumers may apply to the lender to vary the terms of their contract.
Drivers need to take note of the weather conditions and vary their speed accordingly.

senses.definition_vi: thực hiện các thay đổi đối với một cái gì đó để làm cho nó hơi khác

senses.definition: used to say that people may experience a particular thing in different ways

examples.x: Highly recommend the company! Of course, your mileage may vary.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng mọi người có thể trải nghiệm một điều gì đó theo những cách khác nhau

senses.definition: extremely large in area, size, amount, etc.

examples.x: a vast area of forest
a vast crowd
In the vast majority of cases, this should not be a problem.
They sell a vast array of products.
a vast amount of information
At dusk bats appear in vast numbers.
vast quantities of food
His business empire was vast.
vast sums of money
The special effects were a vast improvement over the original film.
She writes on a vast range of subjects.
It is a very rich country with vast resources.
Your help made a vast difference.
We’ve hired a marquee at vast expense.

senses.definition_vi: cực kỳ lớn về diện tích, kích thước, số lượng, v.v.

senses.definition: a plant or part of a plant that is eaten as food. Potatoes, beans and onions are all vegetables.

examples.x: The children don't eat enough fresh vegetables.
root vegetables (= for example carrots)
a vegetable garden
We grow our own vegetables.
a salad of raw vegetables
organic vegetables
a vegetable patch/plot
vegetable soup
vegetable matter (= plants in general)

senses.definition_vi: một loại thực vật hoặc bộ phận của thực vật được ăn làm thức ăn. Khoai tây, đậu và hành đều là rau.

senses.definition: an offensive word for a person who is physically alive but not capable of much mental or physical activity, for example because of a serious accident or illness
senses.definition_vi: một từ xúc phạm để chỉ một người còn sống về mặt thể chất nhưng không có khả năng hoạt động nhiều về tinh thần hoặc thể chất, ví dụ như do một tai nạn hoặc bệnh tật nghiêm trọng

senses.definition: a person who has a boring life

examples.x: Since losing my job I've been a vegetable.

senses.definition_vi: một người có cuộc sống nhàm chán

senses.definition: a thing that is used for transporting people or goods from one place to another, such as a car or lorry

examples.x: motor vehicles (= cars, buses, lorries, etc.)
Are you the driver of this vehicle?
The police think that he was driving a stolen vehicle.
rows of parked vehicles

senses.definition_vi: một thứ được sử dụng để vận chuyển người hoặc hàng hóa từ nơi này đến nơi khác, chẳng hạn như ô tô hoặc xe tải

senses.definition: something that can be used to express your ideas or feelings, or as a way of achieving something

examples.x: Art may be used as a vehicle for propaganda.
The play is an ideal vehicle for her talents.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó có thể được sử dụng để thể hiện ý tưởng hoặc cảm xúc của bạn, hoặc như một cách để đạt được điều gì đó

senses.definition: a film, television programme, song, etc. that allows a particular performer to show their ability

examples.x: The new series has been created as a vehicle for the young star.

senses.definition_vi: một bộ phim, chương trình truyền hình, bài hát, v.v. cho phép một nghệ sĩ cụ thể thể hiện khả năng của mình

senses.definition: any of the tubes that carry blood from all parts of the body towards the heart

examples.x: the jugular vein
The nurse was having trouble finding a vein in his arm.

senses.definition_vi: bất kỳ ống nào mang máu từ khắp cơ thể về tim

senses.definition: any of the very thin tubes that form the frame of a leaf or an insect’s wing
senses.definition_vi: bất kỳ ống rất mỏng nào tạo thành khung của lá hoặc cánh côn trùng

senses.definition: a narrow area of a different colour in some types of stone, wood and cheese
senses.definition_vi: một vùng hẹp có màu sắc khác nhau trong một số loại đá, gỗ và phô mai

senses.definition: a thin layer of minerals or metal contained in rock

examples.x: a vein of gold

senses.definition_vi: một lớp mỏng khoáng chất hoặc kim loại chứa trong đá

senses.definition: an amount of a particular quality or feature in something

examples.x: They had tapped a rich vein of information in his secretary.
There was a vein of proverbial wisdom in what he said.

senses.definition_vi: một lượng của một phẩm chất hoặc đặc điểm cụ thể trong một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a particular style or manner

examples.x: A number of other people commented in a similar vein.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rõ về vật hoặc những vật mà bạn muốn nói đến

senses.definition: used to give more information about something

examples.x: His best movie, which won several awards, was about the life of Gandhi.
Your claim ought to succeed, in which case the damages will be substantial.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để cung cấp thêm thông tin về một cái gì đó

senses.definition: used to talk about recognizing the difference between one person or thing and another

examples.x: The twins are so alike I can't tell which is which.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói về việc nhận ra sự khác biệt giữa người này hoặc vật này và người kia hoặc vật kia

senses.definition: during the time that something is happening; at the same time as something else is happening

examples.x: We must have been burgled while we were asleep.
Her parents died while she was still at school.
While I was waiting at the bus stop, three buses went by in the opposite direction.
You can go swimming while I'm having lunch.
Shoes mended while you wait (= on a shop sign)

senses.definition_vi: một khoảng thời gian

senses.definition: used to contrast two things

examples.x: While Tom's very good at science, his brother is absolutely hopeless.
Some people work better to music while others do not.

senses.definition_vi: một khoảng thời gian

senses.definition: although; despite the fact that…

examples.x: While I am willing to help, I do not have much time available.

senses.definition_vi: một khoảng thời gian

senses.definition: used to suggest that somebody could do something while they are doing something else

examples.x: ‘I'm just going to buy some postcards.’ ‘Can you get me some stamps while you're at it?’

senses.definition_vi: một khoảng thời gian

senses.definition: during the time that something is happening; at the same time as something else is happening

examples.x: In the UK it is illegal to drive whilst holding a mobile phone.
Harrison's clock allowed seamen to keep time accurately whilst at sea.

senses.definition_vi: trong suốt thời gian một điều gì đó đang xảy ra; đồng thời với việc điều khác đang xảy ra

senses.definition: used to contrast two things

examples.x: Whilst my brother is hard-working, I'm quite lazy.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để đối chiếu hai điều

senses.definition: although; despite the fact that…

examples.x: Whilst the results of this study are certainly interesting, they are far from conclusive.

senses.definition_vi: mặc dù; bất chấp sự thật là…

senses.definition: to hit a person or an animal hard with a whip, as a punishment or to make them go faster or work harder

examples.x: He was taken back to the jail and soundly whipped.

senses.definition_vi: đánh một người hoặc động vật bằng roi, như một hình phạt hoặc để làm cho họ đi nhanh hơn hoặc làm việc chăm chỉ hơn

senses.definition: to move, or make something move, quickly and suddenly or violently in a particular direction

examples.x: A branch whipped across the car window.
Her hair whipped around her face in the wind.
The waves were being whipped by 50 mile an hour winds.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển, hoặc làm cho cái gì đó di chuyển, nhanh chóng và đột ngột hoặc dữ dội theo một hướng cụ thể

senses.definition: to remove or pull something quickly and suddenly

examples.x: She whipped the mask off her face.
The man whipped out a knife.

senses.definition_vi: loại bỏ hoặc kéo cái gì đó ra một cách nhanh chóng và đột ngột

senses.definition: to mix cream, etc. very quickly until it becomes stiff

examples.x: Serve the pie with whipped cream.
Lightly whip the egg whites and add them to the mixture.
Whip the egg whites up into stiff peaks.

senses.definition_vi: trộn kem, v.v. rất nhanh cho đến khi nó trở nên đặc

senses.definition: to defeat somebody very easily in a game

examples.x: The team whipped its opponents by 35 points.
They whipped Australia 18–3 in the final game.

senses.definition_vi: đánh bại ai đó rất dễ dàng trong một trò chơi

senses.definition: to steal something
senses.definition_vi: ăn cắp một thứ gì đó

senses.definition: to tell the MPs belonging to a political party that they must vote a particular way on an issue

examples.x: Conservative MPs were whipped to support the amendment.
The government decided to whip the vote on this controversial bill.

senses.definition_vi: yêu cầu các nghị sĩ thuộc một đảng phái chính trị phải bỏ phiếu theo một hướng nhất định về một vấn đề

senses.definition: a low, quiet voice or the sound it makes

examples.x: ‘I love you,’ he said in a whisper.
They spoke in whispers.
‘I feel the same way,’ he said, his voice barely above a whisper.
Her voice dropped to a whisper.

senses.definition_vi: nói rất khẽ với ai đó để người khác không nghe thấy bạn đang nói gì

senses.definition: a soft sound

examples.x: I could hear the whispering of the sea.

senses.definition_vi: nói rất khẽ với ai đó để người khác không nghe thấy bạn đang nói gì

senses.definition: a piece of news that is spread by being talked about but may not be true

examples.x: I've heard whispers that he's leaving.
If the whispers are to be believed, the two companies are talking about a merger.

senses.definition_vi: nói rất khẽ với ai đó để người khác không nghe thấy bạn đang nói gì

senses.definition: having the colour of fresh snow or of milk

examples.x: a crisp white shirt
a white dress
a plant with beautiful white flowers
The suspect was seen driving a white van.
a spacious room with white walls and large windows
a set of perfect white teeth
His hair was as white as snow.
The horse was almost pure white in colour.

senses.definition_vi: màu sắc của tuyết tươi hoặc sữa

senses.definition: belonging to or connected with a group of people who have pale skin, especially people who come from or whose ancestors came from Europe

examples.x: white middle-class families
She writes about her experiences as a black girl in a predominantly white city.
He grew up in a mostly white neighbourhood.
middle-aged white men in suits
policies intended to appeal to white working-class voters

senses.definition_vi: màu sắc của tuyết tươi hoặc sữa

senses.definition: pale because of emotion or illness

examples.x: white with shock
Zack's face turned white and his jaw dropped.
She went white as a sheet when she heard the news.
He looked red-eyed and white-faced, slightly fearful and anxious.

senses.definition_vi: màu sắc của tuyết tươi hoặc sữa

senses.definition: with milk added

examples.x: Two white coffees, please.
Do you take your coffee black or white?

senses.definition_vi: màu sắc của tuyết tươi hoặc sữa

senses.definition: used in questions to ask about the name, identity or function of one or more people

examples.x: Who is that woman?
I wonder who that letter was from.
Who are you phoning?
Who's the money for?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong câu hỏi để hỏi về tên, danh tính hoặc chức năng của một hoặc nhiều người

senses.definition: used to show which person or people you mean

examples.x: The people who called yesterday want to buy the house.
The people (who) we met in France have sent us a card.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ rõ người hoặc những người bạn muốn nói đến

senses.definition: used to give more information about somebody

examples.x: Mrs Smith, who has a lot of teaching experience at junior level, will be joining the school in September.
And then Mary, who we had been talking about earlier, walked in.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cung cấp thêm thông tin về ai đó

senses.definition: used to ask what right or authority somebody has to do something

examples.x: Who are you to tell me I can't park here?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để hỏi người nào có quyền hoặc thẩm quyền làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: the person or people who; any person who

examples.x: Whoever says that is a liar.
Send it to whoever is in charge of sales.

senses.definition_vi: người hoặc những người; bất kỳ ai

senses.definition: used to say that it does not matter who, since the result will be the same

examples.x: Come out of there, whoever you are.
I don't want to see them, whoever they are.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng không quan trọng là ai, vì kết quả sẽ như nhau

senses.definition: used in questions to mean ‘who’, expressing surprise

examples.x: Whoever heard of such a thing!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong câu hỏi với nghĩa 'ai', bày tỏ sự ngạc nhiên

senses.definition: full; complete

examples.x: Let's forget the whole thing.
Jenna was my best friend in the whole world.
It seems I've spent my whole life travelling.
The whole family will be there.
But that's not the whole story, is it?
He spent the whole day writing.
We drank a whole bottle each.
I went through the whole process with them.
My whole body ached.
The whole country (= all the people in it) mourned her death.
The school is keen to involve the whole community in this project.
She wasn't telling the whole truth.

senses.definition_vi: tất cả những gì có của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: used to emphasize how large or important something is

examples.x: I'm going to be talking about a whole range of things today.
We are going to have a whole bunch of people over tomorrow night.
I can't afford it—that's the whole point.
We offer a whole variety of weekend breaks.
I think the whole idea is ridiculous.

senses.definition_vi: tất cả những gì có của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: not broken or damaged

examples.x: Owls usually swallow their prey whole (= without biting it into small pieces).
Peel the small onions, but leave them whole.

senses.definition_vi: tất cả những gì có của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: very much; a lot

examples.x: I'm feeling a whole lot better.

senses.definition_vi: tất cả những gì có của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a large number or amount

examples.x: There were a whole lot of people I didn't know.
I lost a whole lot of money.

senses.definition_vi: tất cả những gì có của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: everything; all of something

examples.x: I've sold the whole lot.

senses.definition_vi: tất cả những gì có của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a completely different thing

examples.x: Now that's a whole 'nother question.

senses.definition_vi: tất cả những gì có của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: completely

examples.x: wholly inappropriate behaviour
The government is not wholly to blame for the recession.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn

senses.definition: used instead of ‘who’ as the object of a verb or preposition

examples.x: Whom did they invite?
To whom should I write?
The author whom you criticized in your review has written a reply.
Her mother, in whom she confided, said she would support her unconditionally.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng thay cho ‘who’ làm tân ngữ của động từ hoặc giới từ

senses.definition: used in questions to ask who something belongs to

examples.x: Whose house is that?
I wonder whose this is.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng trong câu hỏi để hỏi ai sở hữu cái gì

senses.definition: used to say which person or thing you mean

examples.x: He's a man whose opinion I respect.
It's the house whose door is painted red.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói người hoặc vật nào bạn đang đề cập đến

senses.definition: used to give more information about a person or thing

examples.x: Isobel, whose brother he was, had heard the joke before.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để cung cấp thêm thông tin về một người hoặc một vật

senses.definition: used in questions to ask the reason for or purpose of something

examples.x: Why were you late?
Tell me why you did it.
‘I would like you to go.’ ‘Why me?’
Why oh why do people keep leaving the door open?

senses.definition_vi: được dùng trong câu hỏi để hỏi lý do hoặc mục đích của một việc gì đó

senses.definition: used in questions to suggest that it is not necessary to do something

examples.x: Why get upset just because you got one bad grade?
Why bother to write? We'll see him tomorrow.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng trong câu hỏi để gợi ý rằng việc gì đó không cần thiết phải làm

senses.definition: used to give or talk about a reason

examples.x: That's why I left so early.
I know you did it—I just want to know why.
The reason why the injection needs repeating every year is that the virus changes.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để đưa ra hoặc nói về một lý do

senses.definition: used in questions to mean ‘why’, expressing surprise

examples.x: Why ever didn't you tell us before?

senses.definition_vi: được dùng trong câu hỏi với nghĩa ‘tại sao’, diễn tả sự ngạc nhiên

senses.definition: used to make or agree to a suggestion

examples.x: Why not write to her?
‘Let's eat out.’ ‘Why not?’
Why don't we go together?

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để đưa ra hoặc đồng ý với một đề nghị

senses.definition: measuring a large distance from one side to the other

examples.x: It's a wide, fast-flowing river.
The river gets quite wide here.
He wore a jacket with wide lapels.
Her face broke into a wide grin.

senses.definition_vi: đo một khoảng cách lớn từ bên này sang bên kia

senses.definition: measuring a particular distance from one side to the other

examples.x: How wide is that stream?
It's about 2 metres wide.
The road was just wide enough for two vehicles to pass.
The road was only wide enough for only one vehicle at a time.

senses.definition_vi: đo một khoảng cách nhất định từ bên này sang bên kia

senses.definition: including a large number or variety of different people or things; covering a large area

examples.x: a wide range/choice/variety/selection of goods
The company offers a wide array of services to businesses.
Her music appeals to a wide audience.
It's the best job in the whole wide world.
Experts believe the project could bring positive benefits to the wider community.
The contributors to this volume represent a wide spectrum of opinion on the subject.
Publication on the internet makes the material accessible to a wider public for the first time.
He is a manager with a wide experience of industry.
Jenny has a wide circle of friends.
The incident has received wide coverage in the press.
The festival attracts people from a wide area.

senses.definition_vi: bao gồm một số lượng lớn hoặc nhiều loại người hoặc vật; bao phủ một khu vực lớn

senses.definition: very big

examples.x: The Australians won by a wide margin.
There are wide variations in prices.

senses.definition_vi: rất lớn

senses.definition: general; not only looking at details

examples.x: the wider aims of the project
We are talking about education in its widest sense.
You can't just look at it in terms of the immediate problem. You've got to see it in a wider context.

senses.definition_vi: chung chung; không chỉ nhìn vào chi tiết

senses.definition: fully open

examples.x: She stared at him with wide eyes.

senses.definition_vi: mở hoàn toàn

senses.definition: far from the point aimed at

examples.x: Her shot was wide (of the target).
Her shot fell just wide of the target.

senses.definition_vi: xa mục tiêu nhắm tới

senses.definition: happening or existing in the whole of a country, etc.

examples.x: a nationwide search
We need to act on a Europe-wide scale.

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc tồn tại trên toàn bộ một quốc gia, v.v.

senses.definition: to not go too near somebody/something; to avoid somebody/something

examples.x: He gave the dog a wide berth.

senses.definition_vi: không đi quá gần ai/cái gì; tránh ai/cái gì

senses.definition: not accurate

examples.x: Their predictions turned out to be wide of the mark.

senses.definition_vi: không chính xác

senses.definition: by a lot of people; in or to many places

examples.x: The term is widely used in everyday speech.
The idea is now widely accepted.
There is still no word on when the service will become widely available.
The film is widely regarded as a masterpiece.
The company is widely acknowledged as a leader in the field.
He is widely recognized as the founder of modern anatomy.
Her remarks were widely reported in the media.
a widely held belief
The 2012 Olympic Games were widely considered a success.
He was not widely known outside China.
the most widely distributed species of lizards in North America
The ruling party was widely expected to win the elections.
It is widely believed that the bank may move its headquarters to Frankfurt.
a widely publicized murder case
The president was widely criticized for his response to the disaster.
He has travelled widely in Asia.
Her books are widely read (= a lot of people read them).
He's an educated, widely read man (= he has read a lot of books).

senses.definition_vi: bởi nhiều người; ở hoặc đến nhiều nơi

senses.definition: to a large degree; a lot

examples.x: Standards vary widely.
The two men have widely different views on the question.
There are widely divergent opinions about who is responsible.

senses.definition_vi: ở mức độ lớn; nhiều

senses.definition: to become wider; to make something wider

examples.x: Her eyes widened in surprise.
Jasmine's eyes widened with disbelief.
Here the stream widens into a river.
The road gradually widens out.
They may have to widen the road to cope with the increase in traffic.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên rộng hơn; làm cho cái gì đó rộng hơn

senses.definition: to become larger in degree or range; to make something larger in degree or range

examples.x: Another concern is the widening gap between rich and poor.
We plan to widen the scope of our existing activities by offering more language courses.
The legislation will be widened to include all firearms.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên lớn hơn về mức độ hoặc phạm vi; làm cho cái gì đó lớn hơn về mức độ hoặc phạm vi

senses.definition: to consider or include a larger range of options or possibilities, especially when searching for something

examples.x: It's time to widen the net in the search for a suitable candidate.

senses.definition_vi: cân nhắc hoặc bao gồm một phạm vi lựa chọn hoặc khả năng lớn hơn, đặc biệt là khi tìm kiếm một cái gì đó

senses.definition: existing or happening over a large area or among many people

examples.x: The storm caused widespread damage.
The plan received widespread support throughout the country.

senses.definition_vi: tồn tại hoặc xảy ra trên một khu vực rộng lớn hoặc trong nhiều người

senses.definition: a woman whose husband or wife has died and who has not married again

examples.x: She gets a widow’s pension.

senses.definition_vi: một người phụ nữ mà chồng hoặc vợ đã qua đời và chưa tái hôn

senses.definition: the measurement from one side of something to the other; how wide something is

examples.x: The terrace runs the full width of the house.
It's about ten metres in width.
The carpet is available in different widths.

senses.definition_vi: số đo từ bên này sang bên kia của một vật; vật đó rộng bao nhiêu

senses.definition: a piece of material of a particular width

examples.x: You'll need two widths of fabric for each curtain.

senses.definition_vi: một dải vật liệu có chiều rộng nhất định

senses.definition: the distance between the two long sides of a swimming pool

examples.x: How many widths can you swim?

senses.definition_vi: khoảng cách giữa hai cạnh dài của bể bơi

senses.definition: the woman that somebody is married to; a married woman

examples.x: I met my wife at university.
He wants a divorce from his estranged wife.
He is survived by his wife Anne.
She has a wife and two children.
He left his wife for a younger woman.
the wife of the Italian ambassador
She's his second wife.
his former/future wife
his wife of 25 years
The actress was photographed on the red carpet with her wife, Ellen.
Many of the players brought their wives or girlfriends along for the trip.
He is still struggling with the death of his wife.
Steve lives here with his wife and children.

senses.definition_vi: người phụ nữ mà ai đó kết hôn; một phụ nữ đã kết hôn

senses.definition: a man and woman who are married to each other

examples.x: They lived together as husband and wife (= as if they were married) for years.
a husband-and-wife team

senses.definition_vi: một người đàn ông và một người phụ nữ đã kết hôn với nhau

senses.definition: an old idea or belief that people now know is not correct
senses.definition_vi: một ý tưởng hoặc niềm tin cũ mà bây giờ người ta biết là không đúng

senses.definition: everyone; a large number of people
senses.definition_vi: tất cả mọi người; một số lượng lớn người

senses.definition: living or growing in natural conditions; not kept in a house or on a farm

examples.x: wild animals/birds/flowers
wild salmon
wild mushrooms/rice
The plants grow wild along the banks of rivers.
Their aim is to document wild populations of fast-disappearing species.
a wild boar

senses.definition_vi: sống hoặc phát triển trong điều kiện tự nhiên; không được nuôi trong nhà hoặc trên nông trại

senses.definition: in its natural state; not changed by people

examples.x: the destruction of forests and other wild lands
wild moorland
The island is a wild and lonely place.
This is truly wild and unspoilt countryside.

senses.definition_vi: ở trạng thái tự nhiên; không bị con người thay đổi

senses.definition: having no discipline or control

examples.x: The boy is wild and completely out of control.
He had a wild look in his eyes.
a woman with wild hair
wild mood swings

senses.definition_vi: không có kỷ luật hoặc kiểm soát

senses.definition: full of very strong feeling

examples.x: The crowd went wild.
It makes me wild (= very angry) to see such waste.
Everything about her drove him wild (= made him like her very much).
wild laughter/celebrations
The couple were dancing with wild abandon.

senses.definition_vi: đầy cảm xúc mãnh liệt

senses.definition: not carefully planned; not sensible or accurate

examples.x: He made a wild guess at the answer.
wild accusations

senses.definition_vi: không được lên kế hoạch cẩn thận; không hợp lý hoặc không chính xác

senses.definition: very good, pleasant or exciting

examples.x: We had a wild time in New York.

senses.definition_vi: rất tốt, dễ chịu hoặc thú vị

senses.definition: very enthusiastic about somebody/something

examples.x: She's totally wild about him.
She was absolutely wild about him.
I'm not wild about the idea.

senses.definition_vi: rất nhiệt tình với ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: affected by storms and strong winds

examples.x: a wild night
The sea was wild.

senses.definition_vi: bị ảnh hưởng bởi bão và gió mạnh

senses.definition: far more, better, etc. than you could ever have imagined or hoped for
senses.definition_vi: nhiều hơn, tốt hơn, v.v. so với những gì bạn có thể tưởng tượng hoặc hy vọng

senses.definition: used to say that something has happened in a way that somebody did not expect at all

examples.x: Never in my wildest dreams did I think I'd meet him again.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó đã xảy ra theo cách mà ai đó không hề mong đợi

senses.definition: to grow or develop freely without any control

examples.x: The ivy has run wild.
Let your imagination run wild and be creative.
I just let my imagination run wild and come up with as many ideas as I can.

senses.definition_vi: mọc hoặc phát triển tự do mà không có bất kỳ sự kiểm soát nào

senses.definition: if children or animals run wild, they behave as they like because nobody is controlling them

senses.definition_vi: có khả năng đưa ra các quyết định sáng suốt và lời khuyên tốt vì kinh nghiệm và kiến thức bạn có

senses.definition_vi: hiểu một điều gì đó, hoặc nhận ra những gì bạn nên làm, chỉ sau khi một điều gì đó đã xảy ra

senses.definition_vi: để làm cho những câu chuyện cười

senses.definition_vi: muốn điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc trở thành sự thật ngay cả khi nó không có khả năng hoặc không thể

senses.definition_vi: muốn điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc trở thành sự thật ngay cả khi nó không có khả năng hoặc không thể

senses.definition: a thing that you want to have or to happen

senses.definition_vi: muốn điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc trở thành sự thật ngay cả khi nó không có khả năng hoặc không thể

senses.definition: wishing for something does not make it happen
senses.definition_vi: muốn điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc trở thành sự thật ngay cả khi nó không có khả năng hoặc không thể

senses.definition: used to say that you are ready to do whatever somebody asks you to do
senses.definition_vi: muốn điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc trở thành sự thật ngay cả khi nó không có khả năng hoặc không thể

senses.definition_vi: muốn điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc trở thành sự thật ngay cả khi nó không có khả năng hoặc không thể

senses.definition_vi: khả năng nói hoặc viết những điều vừa thông minh vừa hài hước

senses.definition_vi: có loại trí thông minh được đề cập

senses.definition: to earn money by clever or sometimes dishonest means

senses.definition_vi: cùng với sự hiện diện của ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc mang theo thứ gì đó

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng một cái gì đó

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói những gì lấp đầy, bao phủ, v.v. một cái gì đó

examples.x: to fight with somebody
to play tennis with somebody
at war with a neighbouring country

senses.definition_vi: đối lập với ai đó/điều gì đó; chống lại ai đó/điều gì đó

examples.x: Be careful with the glasses.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến; trong trường hợp của

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi xem xét một sự kiện này liên quan đến một sự kiện khác

senses.definition_vi: bao gồm

senses.definition_vi: bởi vì; như là kết quả của

senses.definition_vi: có thể hiểu những gì ai đó đang nói về

senses.definition_vi: nhận thức được những gì đang xảy ra xung quanh bạn

senses.definition_vi: biết về các xu hướng và ý tưởng hiện tại

examples.x: his withdrawal from the election

senses.definition_vi: hành động ngừng tham gia vào một cái gì đó hoặc là thành viên của một tổ chức

senses.definition_vi: khoảng thời gian khi ai đó đang quen với việc không sử dụng một loại thuốc mà họ đã nghiện, và những tác động khó chịu của việc này

senses.definition_vi: trước khi một khoảng thời gian nhất định trôi qua; trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định

senses.definition_vi: trong phạm vi hoặc giới hạn của một cái gì đó

Despite her grief, she found a hidden strength within herself.

senses.definition_vi: bên trong một cái gì đó/ai đó

senses.definition: not having, experiencing or showing something

examples.x: They had gone two days without food.
He found the place without difficulty.

senses.definition_vi: không có, trải nghiệm hoặc thể hiện một cái gì đó

senses.definition_vi: không có sự hiện diện của ai đó

senses.definition: not using or taking something

senses.definition_vi: không sử dụng hoặc lấy một cái gì đó

senses.definition_vi: không thực hiện hành động được đề cập

examples.x: He failed to interview a key witness.

Mark had to go into the witness protection programme to escape the violence.

senses.definition_vi: nhìn thấy điều gì đó xảy ra (thường là tội phạm hoặc tai nạn)

senses.definition_vi: nhìn thấy điều gì đó xảy ra (thường là tội phạm hoặc tai nạn)

senses.definition_vi: nhìn thấy điều gì đó xảy ra (thường là tội phạm hoặc tai nạn)

senses.definition: evidence of a person’s strong religious beliefs, that they show by what they say and do in public

senses.definition_vi: nhìn thấy điều gì đó xảy ra (thường là tội phạm hoặc tai nạn)

married/single women
